At their lowest the two feed each other. Wanting out of an unsafe feeling makes you impatient, and the impatience sharpens the hunger. Under both is the fear that time is running out. Open it when you cannot tell whether you are waiting for something or only wanting it.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Light
codon_ring.teaching: This waiting keeps a strength ready until its time comes. It belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Light, and each of them holds a strength that is not spent at once. UL 9, Ease in This, is where you spend it one small step at a time. UL 11, Sol Star, is where you turn it into a picture of how things could be. UL 26, Lighter Than a Feather, is where you let it build the longer you hold it in.

tarot.teaching: Five of the tarot's major cards sit around this energy, and each shows one side of waiting well.

sky.teaching: the water bearer, who pours out what was gathered over a long while. It is the time when what you have waited for is finally given.

immortals.teaching: Li Tie Guai carries this energy above, the healer whose student burned his body a day before the seven days of waiting were up. He is what it costs you to end a wait early. Han Xiangzi stands below, the flute player whose tune opened peonies in the snow. He is what patience can bring out of a cold season.

hebrew_letter.teaching: a fish-hook let down into deep water and left there. What you wait for comes to a line held still, and pulling early loses it.

cards.essence: Diplomacy is alive in you as a feel for people, and it starts in your belly. You sense a quarrel coming before anyone has spoken, while there is still time to change your words. You can say a hard truth kindly, at the moment it can be heard. When someone's anger comes at you, you take it in and let it go back no bigger than it came.

glance.reading:
Diplomacy is alive in you as a feel for people, and it starts in your belly. You sense a quarrel coming before anyone has spoken, while there is still time to change your words. You can say a hard truth kindly, at the moment it can be heard. When someone's anger comes at you, you take it in and let it go back no bigger than it came.

At times your guard goes up before you have answered, as if this person could take something from you. Stay in your body and let the feeling run its course without putting it on them. When you watch it instead of obeying it, it moves through and leaves you clear.

Move toward the people who stir you up, with your guard lowered and your heart where they can see it. Look after your own heart, and it comes back to life. What you were guarding against turns out to be a mirage. More people come close, and near you they soften.

iching.trigram_combination: Heaven over Water is the hexagram of a dispute. Heaven is the drive in you that keeps pressing forward and never tires. Water is the part of you that feels at risk and means every word. The strength sits above the risk because you push hardest when you feel least safe. This hexagram has long been read as the sky rising while water runs down. In an argument each of you keeps talking, and neither one moves toward the other. The harder you press your case, the further you get from the person you want to reach.
iching.reading:
Your case in this dispute is honest, and the other side will not hear it. The two of you are pulling apart, and every push widens the gap. Nobody comes out of the far end of a quarrel with what they wanted. So stop halfway, while you still can. The middle of a dispute is the one place in it where things settle well.

This time asks for a fair third person, someone who wants nothing from either side. Let that person say what is really being fought over. Leave the big ventures alone until this is settled, the move or the new undertaking. Every dispute sits inside a relationship, and you will still live beside this person when it is over. Be firm inside and give way outside, the way water does. Giving way here keeps the peace, and it is no surrender.

Your ears do the work now. Listen until what is said has come all the way in, and only then answer.
judgement_lines: Conflict. You are sincere, and you are blocked.
Halt halfway, with care, and it goes well. Carry it to the end, and it goes badly.
It helps to see the great person. It does not help to cross the great water.
image_lines: Heaven and water go opposite ways: that is conflict.
So the wise, in everything they undertake, consider the beginning with care.

upper_trigram.name: Heaven (Ch'ien)
upper_trigram.nature: Unceasing forward movement, dynamic, enduring, untiring. Spirit power. Heaven, sovereign, father.

lower_trigram.name: Water (K'an)
lower_trigram.nature: Precipice, dangerous place. Stream, flowing water, river. Venture and fall. The middle son.

lines.image: not carrying the matter on; a little talk, then a good end.
lines.reading: The quarrel has barely started and you are the weaker of the two. There will be a little talk about you, a few words behind your back, and that is the whole price. What is true and what is false will sort itself out without your help. Let it drop now, while dropping it costs you almost nothing.

lines.image: not up to the contest; going home to a town of three hundred houses.
lines.reading: The other side is stronger, and you cannot win this. Press it and the trouble comes down on everyone who stands with you. Go back to the small town you belong to, three hundred houses and nobody looking for you. Trouble cannot reach a house that does not rise to meet it. Make yourself small, and be safe.

lines.image: living on what was earned before; serving a king and claiming no merit.
lines.reading: You are living on what you earned earlier, and you are not strong enough to contend for more. Stay inside the share that is already yours, and reach for no new ground while the dispute runs. If a greater person's work wants your hands, give them and let the credit be theirs. Hold to that, and it ends well.

lines.image: not up to the contest; turning back, a change of heart, resting in what is right.
lines.reading: You could fight this, because the strength is in you, and you would still not win. When two hard people meet, an argument always starts. Turn back instead, to the work that is yours, and let your mind change about the whole matter. Rest in what you know is right, and peace comes of it.

lines.image: the dispute brought before the one in the centre.
lines.reading: Here the matter comes before someone in the centre, fair, wanting nothing for themselves. That is the one place in the whole business where a case can be pressed. If that seat is yours, hear both sides and settle it. If it is not, this is the person to take the matter to. Contend here, and it goes very well.

lines.image: a leather belt given in honour, taken back three times before the morning is out.
lines.reading: You carried the quarrel to the end, you won it, and the prize is in your hands. Three times before the morning is out, it is taken back. What you take by force goes back by force, and the respect you wanted is not in the prize. Stop before you lose more of yourself than you gained.

gene_keys.shadow:
The guard you keep against other people went up early, between the ages of seven and fourteen. You built it against the heated moments you lived through as a child. Most adults still carry it, and a great deal of a life's strength goes into keeping it up. Behind it your heart hardens, and you judge the other person or simply avoid them.

Think of the hardest relationship in your life now. That person seems able to ruin your peace whenever they like. What you dislike is the part of you they bring out. They are giving you a way into a fear far older than the two of you, carried down from those who came before. Relationships like this hold the start of your own peace, so do not shy away from them.
gene_keys.repressive: This person keeps the peace at any price, and pays it themselves. What they sweep under the carpet lies there until it blows up. People sense the falseness and never quite trust them. When they finally face a quarrel, it is never as bad as they feared.
gene_keys.reactive: The feeling goes straight out at the closest person, before it has been held for a moment. This person lashes out, then storms away. They cannot hear their own lack of tact, so the fault always lies with the other person. The only one who stays is someone who keeps the peace at any price.
gene_keys.gift:
Diplomacy begins the moment your guard drops and your heart opens. It has nothing to do with strategy or the right words, which anyone can learn and use with a shut heart. You sense where another person's heart is and how far it is open. You can do this because you let yourself be hurt too, with your heart on your sleeve.

Fear still comes, and you are no longer afraid of it. So other people's fears stop moving you around. The people you are meant to open, and who open you, keep coming into your life. Each one opens you further, and that opens more in them.
gene_keys.siddhi: Peace is what is left when there is nothing in you to defend. An old man crossing a river bumped his boat into another, and the man in it cursed him. He did not react at all, since there was not a soul in his boat to shout at. Live like that and nothing reaches you as an attack. This peace lies under everything. It is there when you stop what you are doing and listen, to birds singing or the wind dropping. Even your skin stops being a wall, and you feel life moving in everything that lives. Nobody can take your life from you, because you are life.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy guards you against other people, and the guard grows out of a nervousness it cannot see. Crystal Creation holds that nervousness, the unease that rises whenever life feels uncertain. The two feed each other: your nerves make you defensive, and your defensiveness makes the people near you nervous. Open it when you find yourself on guard and cannot say why.

human_design.gate: Gate 6 sits in the centre of feeling, low in the body, and presses you toward other people. It carries two things at once: the wish to be close, and the fear of being seen as you are. Closeness is the thing it fears most. When it runs well, your feeling brings people together in a way that is fair to each of them. When it runs badly, you feel that nobody will see you unless you force your way in. Its work is to trust that what you say will reach people at the right time, without pushing.
human_design.centre:
The Emotional Solar Plexus Center sits in the belly and is where feeling moves. It is the only centre that both drives you and tells you what is going on. Feeling here runs in a wave, from hope down to pain and back, over hours or days. There is no truth in the moment of it. What a feeling means becomes clear only once the wave has passed.

A little more than half of all people have this centre defined. They always have their feelings to hand, and they never know what they will feel next. Where this gate is part of a defined channel, upsets get pushed down and pile up. Then one broken promise brings the whole lot out at once. The rest have it open. They take in the feelings around them and feel them louder than the person who had them. To avoid the blast they may stay nice and leave the truth unsaid. Alone, they settle into a steady peace. For everyone, a feeling that is felt passes in a few minutes, and a hand on the shoulder calms the whole of you.
human_design.channel: On its own, this pressure has nowhere to go. Gate 59, in the Sacral Center below, is the drive to break through the walls between people. Together they make the Channel of Mating, which turns the wish to be close into closeness itself. It builds intimacy through sex, through children and through a business built together. Gate 59 may be in you or in a person close by, and the channel runs only when both are present.

tarot.ring_role: This energy breaks down the walls between two people. It belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Alchemy, whose theme is turning something rough into something fine. UL 40, Eternal Wellspring, carries the new openness into a community. UL 47, Garden of Alchemy, carries the change of old ways. UL 64, Communion, carries the fresh possibilities that follow. This one carries the first opening, between two people.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Its family and its two trigrams bring five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, to this one.

body.physiology:
The belly knows first, and that is why this energy is given to the net of nerves over your gut. Your gut has a nervous system of its own, with more nerve cells than your spinal cord. Most of the news on the great nerve between belly and brain runs upward, so the belly reports before the head decides. Under threat these nerves slow the gut and send blood to the muscles. That is the drop or the knot you feel in an argument before anyone speaks.

Bring to mind someone you have been avoiding, and your belly answers before the thought is finished. Then breathe out slowly with a hand laid flat below your ribs. The nerves that tightened it let it go as the breath lengthens. Your hand rests on the part of you that felt it first.
body.amino_acid:
When the last wall in you comes down, your body follows, and every cell in it makes peace with the rest. That peace has a substance in you, and its name is glycine. It is the smallest of the twenty pieces your proteins are built from, and it tastes sweet on your tongue. Your body makes some, and food adds more, from meat or the bones a soup is boiled on. The same substance that is in you has been found in the dust of a comet.

This energy shares that substance with three of its kin. Together they turn something dark in you into something lighter. It happens in the body first, in the belly, where the rough material is heated until it changes. Then it spreads from one opening to the next, out into the people around you.

relations.unity_line: UL 5 is this card's pair and its inverse at once: the need that waits, where this one presses its case.

pair.teaching: This energy presses its case now, and it runs out when pressing only drives the other person away. The Space Between Time is where it goes next: the wait for what is already on its way, which no pushing brings sooner. Open it when you have said your piece and nothing has moved. A dispute often starts when people cannot wait for what they need.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy end for end and the push becomes a wait. The Space Between Time is the same need seen from the side that holds still. Open it when you are tired of pushing and nothing can be won by force.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy guards you against other people, and the guard grows out of a nervousness it cannot see. Crystal Creation holds that nervousness, the unease that rises whenever life feels uncertain. The two feed each other: your nerves make you defensive, and your defensiveness makes the people near you nervous. Open it when you find yourself on guard and cannot say why.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Alchemy
codon_ring.teaching: This energy breaks down the walls between two people. It belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Alchemy, whose theme is turning something rough into something fine. UL 40, Eternal Wellspring, carries the new openness into a community. UL 47, Garden of Alchemy, carries the change of old ways. UL 64, Communion, carries the fresh possibilities that follow. This one carries the first opening, between two people.

tarot.teaching: Its family and its two trigrams bring five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, to this one.

sky.teaching: the swift planet, the messenger who carries a word between two sides that do not yet agree, as you can in a dispute that is not yours.

immortals.teaching: Heaven above carries Han Xiangzi, the flute player whose tune made flowers open in the snow. Water below carries Li Tie Guai, the healer who came back from his own death carrying medicine in a gourd. They show you two ways a quarrel can end. You can say one thing so plainly that both sides hear it. Or you can lose, and come back with what heals the hurt.

hebrew_letter.teaching: four walls and a roof. A house holds two people who disagree without coming apart, which is the work here.

cards.essence: Guidance is alive in you as a way of listening. With you at its centre, a group finds its own way and starts to move as one. Someone talks to you and hears their own answer before you have said a word. You sense where things are heading before others do. You are content to steer from behind while someone else takes the front.

glance.reading:
Guidance is alive in you as a way of listening. With you at its centre, a group finds its own way and starts to move as one. Someone talks to you and hears their own answer before you have said a word. You sense where things are heading before others do. You are content to steer from behind while someone else takes the front.

At times you want to be seen for it, and advice comes out before anyone has asked. Wait to be asked, then take your time with the answer. Some days the best help is to hold back, and that takes strength. Hold your own ground, so a charming voice cannot pull you into its plans.

Set your opinions aside and take people in as they are. Near you they grow stronger, and they need you less. Do the good thing for its own sake, with no one watching. Each one adds to the last, out of sight, like water gathering under the ground. In time it shows, and people come to you as they come to a spring.

iching.trigram_combination: Earth over Water is the hexagram of many people moving as one. Water is the strength in you that can run wild. Earth is the part of you that serves the people around you. The earth sits above because strength does harm until the people it serves take hold of it. This hexagram has long been read as water in the middle of the earth. Your strength works like water in the ground, feeding the fields above it. Its name has been read as a crowd and as the teacher it follows, because the one at the centre shapes where everyone goes. You are strongest among the people you serve.
iching.reading:
A quarrel has gone past words, and people are rising on every side. Strength is being gathered, and it can do great harm. Use it only for a right end, to protect people or to stop someone who is hurting them. The way you use it has to be right as well, above all at the start.

What this time asks for is a seasoned hand. It takes years to know when to press on and when to fall back. Grow your following by being generous to the people. Treat them well, and they will stand with you when it matters.

Your belly and your ears do the work now. The belly carries the weight of everyone who relies on you. The ears hear trouble while it is still far off. Sit the way ground sits over water, still above and holding what lies below.
judgement_lines: The Army. It needs holding firm, and a seasoned hand. Good fortune, no blame.
image_lines: In the middle of the earth there is water.
So the wise grow their following by generosity to the people.

upper_trigram.name: Earth (K'un)
upper_trigram.nature: Surface of the world, support of all existence. Essential Yin. Rest, receptivity.

lower_trigram.name: Water (K'an)
lower_trigram.nature: Precipice, dangerous place. Stream, flowing water, river. Venture and fall. The middle son.

lines.image: the army setting out under its rule, and what happens without one.
lines.reading: The army sets out, and before any strength is spent it needs its order. Everyone needs to know where they stand, and that includes you. Set out clear ranks now. Begin in good order, and a later mistake can still be carried. Begin without it, and even a good cause goes wrong.

lines.image: the leader in the midst of the army, and the king's charge given three times.
lines.reading: The one fit to command stands inside the army and level with the people he leads. From there he can be firm or give way as the hour asks. Trust comes down to him whole, given once and never taken back. Everything here turns on that one place. Stand in the middle with your people, and take the charge.

lines.image: the army carting its dead.
lines.reading: The wagons built to carry the attack come back loaded with the dead. Too many hands reached for the command, or the unready one took it. Either way the force turned on itself. Stop where you are. Set down the old defeats you are still hauling before you take another step. Do not advance until the head has changed.

lines.image: the army drawn back to camp on the left.
lines.reading: The army falls back to camp, and there is no fault in it. Knowing you cannot advance, and pulling back to safe ground, is a discipline of its own. The camp is a place to halt and catch your breath. Hold to what is proper rather than press into danger to prove a point.

lines.image: game in the fields, the eldest leading, the younger carting the dead.
lines.reading: Game has come into the open fields to plunder them, and it is right to take it. Only a war fought in defence is allowed here. Let the seasoned one lead. Put the unready in command, however good his cause, and the wagons fill with the dead again. One head, not two. The rest follow, hold to the plan, and the harvest is saved.

lines.image: the great prince giving out the charges, and the small kept out of office.
lines.reading: The campaign is over and the rewards go out. States are founded and households raised, each by what it earned. That is where a gathered force ends, in careful sorting by merit. Even now, do not put small people into real positions, whatever they did on the road. What discipline won, a small hand can lose again.

gene_keys.shadow:
Division is the line that puts some people above others, and it runs so deep that it looks like the shape of the world. It sorts everyone into classes and sides, then teaches each side to think that way. After that nobody can picture another arrangement. Some are raised to follow and hand their authority to whoever sounds certain. Others are raised to take that authority and hold on to it. The fear of losing power keeps both in place. Like draws like here. Stand at the level of someone waiting to be rescued, and you draw the leader who profits from keeping you there. Most of the people paid to help would be out of work if you stopped needing them. Without a steady sense of yourself, you can be swept into anyone's plan that sounds exciting enough.

There is nothing wrong with looking up to someone. It is a natural stage. The trick is to find someone who feels what you carry so fully that you dare to feel it yourself. Once you have felt what you carry, it loosens its hold.
gene_keys.repressive: Some carry the mark of a leader and keep it hidden. A veil sits over it, drawn from the inside. The pressure builds with nowhere to go, into resentment and into the body as ache. Nothing outside is holding them back. The moment they see their own power, everyone else sees it too.
gene_keys.reactive: Others know they are followed, and they use it. They bind people to them, lock them into patterns, and mistake reliance for respect. It looks like strong leadership. What it is doing is making sure nobody under them learns to stand alone. It draws only the ones who wanted to stay small.
gene_keys.gift:
Guidance is help that does not impose, the way good teaching never does. It helps a person find their own way forward and leaves their power with them. A group thrives only when the people in it have power of their own.

Carried like this, you lead from behind the throne rather than on it. You shape the way a group is going without telling the people in it what to do. You make room for them to find their own order, then step back and let someone else have the light. People feel clearer about their own direction just from being near you. What holds it together is trusting life to go where it is going, rather than taking hold of it.
gene_keys.siddhi: Virtue is what is best in a person, out in the open air, with nothing in them bent. It has nothing to do with being good on purpose, which anyone can perform. It is your own nature going through you unimpeded. Its reward is itself, past being seen and past being useful. It is delicate, and it cannot breathe where people speak ill of each other. Every day people do small unseen acts of it, and those acts hold the chaos off. An old story says the world is made of the shards of a vessel that broke, and each act sets one shard back. A child raised among people like this needs no other teaching.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy leans toward the future, toward what a group can become. Universal Crest holds what it is missing: the memory of where the people have been, and what they still carry from it. People follow a direction only when what they have lived through has been heard. Open it when you know the road and have lost touch with the ones walking it.

human_design.gate:
Gate 7 is the pull to give a group one direction. You see how each person fits and what they are good at, so everyone's effort goes the same way. Your place is beside the one at the front, the way a chief of staff directs the energy and holds the team together. A leader is only as strong as the support behind them.

Seen from outside, this can look like control, or like someone who will not take a suggestion. The cost runs inward. Pushed into the spotlight, this pull drains you, because standing at the front is not what it is for.
human_design.centre:
This pull runs from the middle of your chest, the Identity Center. It holds who you are, which way your life faces, and what you love. It has no engine. It draws with a single pole, like a magnet that can only attract. What it pulls in is what a life needs, the people as much as the work. The same force keeps every other part of you joined into one whole.

About six people in ten have this centre defined. Their sense of self stays put whoever they are with, and the direction of their life holds across the years. They choose from the same short menu all their lives. When they are sure of a way, they expect everyone with them to take it too. The other four in ten have it open. They take in the sense of self of the people around them and let it go when those people leave. For them place is everything: the right city hands them back to themselves, and the wrong one takes them away.
human_design.channel: A sense of where a group should go stays private until something speaks it. Gate 31, in the throat, is the voice that speaks for the many. Together they make the Channel of the Alpha. The group moves behind that voice because every voice was heard before the direction was given. It waits to be called on before it speaks. Gate 31 may be in you or in someone close to you, and the channel runs only when both are present.

tarot.ring_role: This energy leads people. It belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Union, which holds what people are to one another. UL 4, Veils of Knowledge, carries the wish to make sense of things. UL 29, All In, carries the whole yes. UL 59, Mystics Treasures, carries the longing to be known. This one carries the order that lets a group move as one.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, arrive through the ring and the two trigrams.

body.physiology:
The diaphragm is where this energy lives, and the reason is the breath. It is a dome of muscle across your middle, and every breath you take begins there. It tightens and drops, and the whole of you moves. The lungs fill, the belly rises, and blood is drawn toward the heart. One muscle in the middle moves, unseen, and the rest of you follows without being told. That is what this energy does with people.

It runs without an order, twenty thousand times a day, and takes one when you give it. Hold your breath and you have commanded it. Let go and it leads again on its own. Put a hand on your belly and breathe in. The belly comes out under your hand, pushed from above. You are feeling the one in the middle that the rest of you follows.
body.amino_acid:
Guidance has a chemistry in you, and valine is part of it. Your body cannot make it, so it comes from food, eggs or oats among them. The muscle you move with takes it apart for itself instead of leaving it to the liver. You share this chemistry with three other energies that together shape how people bond. What the four are for is leading together, with nothing ranked between you.

Guidance comes when you pause with someone and are truly together. Sit and talk about ordinary things, and what is needed comes out of the space between you. This is the deepest kind of guidance, and it happens through the body.

relations.unity_line: UL 8 is this card's pair and its inverse at once: the order that gathers people, and the bond that makes them want to stay.

pair.teaching: This energy ranks scattered people into one body and sets them moving, and it cannot make any of them want to be there. Odyssey of Freedom is where it goes next: the belonging people choose for themselves. Open it when everyone is in step and nobody is glad to be. Nobody can be ordered to belong.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy end for end, and the strength held low among the ranks rises to the top. What was an army becomes a company held together by trust. Open it when you want people to stay because they choose to.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy leans toward the future, toward what a group can become. Universal Crest holds what it is missing: the memory of where the people have been, and what they still carry from it. People follow a direction only when what they have lived through has been heard. Open it when you know the road and have lost touch with the ones walking it.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Union
codon_ring.teaching: This energy leads people. It belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Union, which holds what people are to one another. UL 4, Veils of Knowledge, carries the wish to make sense of things. UL 29, All In, carries the whole yes. UL 59, Mystics Treasures, carries the longing to be known. This one carries the order that lets a group move as one.

tarot.teaching: Five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, arrive through the ring and the two trigrams.

sky.teaching: the twins, for a mind that can hold one person and the whole group in view at once.

immortals.teaching: Earth above carries Lan Cai He, the wandering singer who gave his coins away, which is help that wants no title. Water below carries Li Tie Guai, the healer who keeps his medicine in a gourd, ready for the day someone needs it. Between them, you serve without a position and keep your help ready until you are asked.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the blade that cuts one thing from another, as a command worth following is cut from one that is not.

cards.essence: You want the people around you to know you as you really are, and the freedom to be yourself is what lets them. That freedom lives in the way you move and in the sound of your voice. You can lead an ordinary life on the outside and be wholly yourself inside it. The people who belong with you know you when they meet you.

glance.reading:
You want the people around you to know you as you really are, and the freedom to be yourself is what lets them. That freedom lives in the way you move and in the sound of your voice. You can lead an ordinary life on the outside and be wholly yourself inside it. The people who belong with you know you when they meet you.

At times you shape yourself to what others expect, because standing out feels unsafe. The same fear can make you work at looking different, which is still copying. Notice when you do it, and go back to what you actually want. If someone does not warm to you, you are still the same person.

Say what you mean in plain words, and let that be enough. Make the first move toward the people you feel drawn to, then give them time to come. The ones who stay with you come because they want to. Near you, other people start being themselves too.

iching.trigram_combination: Water over Earth is the hexagram of finding the ones you belong with. Water is the restless part of you that goes out looking. Earth is the part of you that takes people in and holds them. The restlessness sits above because you go out long before you know where you will rest. This hexagram has long been read as water lying on the earth. The ground drinks the water and goes soft, and the water spreads until it is still. So you belong where you can come to rest as you are.
iching.reading:
People come toward you, or you go to them, and the pull is real. Underneath it a quieter sorting goes on. Nobody builds it; you recognise it. Before you join anything, ask yourself three things and answer honestly. Is what you bring big enough, will it last, will it hold? If it will, you have nothing to answer for. The ones with no settled place will come to you from every side. They arrive one at a time, as they each make up their minds.

Force nobody and delay nothing. Whoever comes too late finds the door shut, and that is the one hard edge in a gentle time. If you are the one keeping people together, you do it from underneath, the way the ground carries water. The people standing on you lend you that strength. Start pulling at them and it goes. Keep to the kind who come of their own accord. Pass on whatever comes to you, down through everyone, and the belonging lasts.

Your belly is the part of you that takes this in, and your ear is where it reaches you first. What you hear goes down into you and stays, the way ground keeps rain. Sit low, let your middle soften, and let what belongs to you arrive.
judgement_lines: Holding together brings good fortune. Ask the oracle once more whether what you bring is great, lasting and firm; if it is, there is no fault.
The unsettled come, one after another. Whoever comes too late meets misfortune.
image_lines: On the earth lies water: that is holding together.
So the kings of old raised the many cities, and kept close to every lord.

upper_trigram.name: Water (K'an)
upper_trigram.nature: Precipice, dangerous place. Stream, flowing water, river. Venture and fall. The middle son.

lower_trigram.name: Earth (K'un)
lower_trigram.nature: Surface of the world, support of all existence. Essential Yin. Rest, receptivity.

lines.image: holding to him in truth, a plain bowl filled to the brim.
lines.reading: At the start of a bond you have only your honesty, and it is enough. Be like a plain clay bowl filled to the brim, with no decoration on it and no gap inside. Carry it that full and you spill not a drop. Hold to what is true in you, and good comes from a direction you did not expect.

lines.image: holding to him from within.
lines.reading: A bond begins inside you, before it goes anywhere else. Know what you want before you ask anyone to stand with you. A person divided inside joins nothing and loses themselves in the trying. What you hold to from within, nobody can take. Settle yourself first, stay firm, and the joining outside follows.

lines.image: holding together with the wrong people.
lines.reading: You are standing among people who are not yours, and the effort tells you so. What they are after is not what you are after. However close it looks now, they will be the first to turn when it matters. There is no gain in it, only harm. Look hard at who is around you, and step out before the circle closes.

lines.image: holding to the one outside and above.
lines.reading: The one worth holding to stands outside your circle and a little above you. Go toward them openly, without pretending to be their equal and without hiding that you chose them. Beside a person like that, what is weak in you grows strong. Follow the better one, stay firm, and it goes well.

lines.image: the king hunting on three sides, letting the game in front run free.
lines.reading: You stand at the centre of a gathering and leave one way open for anyone who wants to go. Nobody near you needs telling, because they already know how you are. Take the ones who come willingly, let the rest go, and what stays with you is yours.

lines.image: holding together with no head.
lines.reading: Nobody stands at the head of this bond, and it comes together too late. You waited to belong and never took the first step, or you came when the others had found their places. A thing you never begin cannot end. Take the first step now, wherever you stand, because waiting for a leader is how a life gets spent.

gene_keys.shadow:
Mediocrity is the fear of being different, and it wears the face of being sensible. You learned it in the years when sameness was rewarded and difference was corrected, and by now it feels like your own temperament. It is a stereotype you have worn so long that it keeps you safe. It keeps everyone else safe too, about who they think you are. Under it you think what everyone thinks and serve the machine that was here before you. You keep the machinery going instead of adding anything to it.

What you fear is not failing. It is succeeding, because becoming what you are would mean stepping past everything expected of you. You do not know who you would be out there. So you dream about the lives you might have had, watching other people live them on a screen, moved and going nowhere. Every child gives off a light, and yours went dim so gradually that you never caught the day it happened.
gene_keys.repressive: Nothing in this person catches light any more. They are useful, decent and reliable, with no fire in them. Somewhere between the child and the adult they set the dream down and let responsibilities pile on top. The life they live now is not one they chose, and they stay because leaving would mean change.
gene_keys.reactive: Here the spirit went outward and built a picture of itself. From the front this person looks successful, even original, and underneath the same bargain has been struck with the system. The face holds until it cracks, and it always does. Then the rage comes up, and they are gone before anyone asks.
gene_keys.gift:
Style is what you are, flowering where anyone can see it. Living this takes a leap of faith in yourself. It has nothing to do with what you wear or how you live. Nobody can fake it or copy it, because it never passes through the mind on its way out. You are yourself without wondering what anyone thinks, and only other people call that a risk. Something creative takes hold of you rather than you of it. Once you have felt that freedom, whether it succeeds stops being the point.

It behaves like nature, which follows no plan at all. So anyone who keeps things running by rules finds it dangerous. It is wild, unplanned and full of leaps. So people push it to the edges, into art or music, where there is room for it. It does not need the edges. A person with this lives an ordinary outer life and a rebellious inner one. They walk through the market with everyone else, and you would still pick them out. Their freedom catches, and all they want is more people free. They stop dreaming the dream and start making it.
gene_keys.siddhi: You have fallen in love with what you are, and it is not vanity. Everywhere you look you see the same thing in other people, each one a diamond cut differently. Your nature is wild, and nothing tames it. You are never the same from one moment to the next, as fleeting as light through clouds. You lead nobody and leave no tracks to follow. The only strangers you know are the people who spend their lives copying someone else. They have become strangers to themselves. Water is weak, so nothing sticks to it, no plan and no grudge. You can rest completely, and resting is the last rebellion. A star at dawn and a bubble in a stream are gone while you look at them. So is all of this, and that is what makes it exquisite.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This self of yours knows what it is and can still trade it away for a safe life. Ancestors Bloom holds what this one lacks, the power and the means to make a life. Open it when you know who you are and keep choosing the safer week. A contribution with no means behind it stays a dream. Means with no self behind them stay hollow.

human_design.gate:
Something in you wants to add itself to the world and have it count. Gate 8 is the name for that pull. It is the urge to bring what only you see out where other people can use it, in your own words. With it comes the pressure to know when. Not every room wants it, and some ideas land nowhere. So you learn the hard way when to speak and when to keep the thing to yourself. What you are contributing in the end is yourself.

To other people it looks like someone who sets the fashion and does not mind standing out. What is really going on is quieter: they cannot be anyone but themselves. The cost is being misunderstood by people who wanted them to fit, and the loneliness that follows. Trying to be a model for others, by becoming someone they are not, is the one thing that wears them out.
human_design.centre:
The contribution comes out at the Throat centre, where everything in a person becomes real. This is the place a thought or a feeling turns into words, or into something done. The rest of you is all trying to reach it, the way every road in a town runs to the square. What arrives there is what actually happens. Through it you speak your mind, say what you feel, or put your own self into words.

Seven people in ten or so have this centre running on its own, and the voice is always there. It is one voice, the same in whatever room they stand in. For them speaking is broadcasting rather than receiving, so they can be blunt without knowing it. They can spend a life saying they never got to give their contribution, when it was theirs to make all along. In the other three the voice comes and goes with the company. For them the trouble started young, when nobody seemed to hear them. It became either silence or noise, anything to be noticed. There is a pressure to say something with no idea what, and what comes out sounds like somebody else. What they have instead is range, any tone, a voice that can meet whoever is in front of them. People hear it once they stop trying to be heard.
human_design.channel: A voice with nothing of its own behind it is only noise. What completes this one is Gate 1, in the centre of the chest, the drive to make things in a shape nobody else could. Together the two form the Channel of Inspiration. Along it a self turns into words unusual enough to catch the heart of a thing. They carry because a person is standing behind them. Gate 1 may sit in you or in somebody close, and the channel runs only when both are present.

tarot.ring_role: This self of yours shows most clearly when you stop holding a shape. It belongs to a family of two called the Ring of Water, and the other is UL 2, the open ground that receives everything. One takes in whatever falls on it, the other shines by its own nature, and the same chemistry runs through both. Open it when showing yourself has started to feel like work.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Its family and its two trigrams bring five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, near this energy.

body.physiology:
Of every organ, this energy is given to the thyroid, and the reason is the pace. Everything in you keeps one time, the warmth of your skin and the beat of your heart at rest. One small gland low in your neck sets that time, and it reaches every cell in you. It is two halves held as one by a bridge across your windpipe, about the weight of four coins.

You can feel that setting on a cold morning, in the warmth of your own hands, which is partly this gland's doing. Rest two fingers on the inside of your wrist and count. Fear can hurry that beat in a second, but the pace it settles back to was set weeks ago, here in your neck.
body.amino_acid:
The self in you that nobody can copy has a substance, and its name is phenylalanine. Twenty small pieces build every protein in you, and this is one of them. Your body cannot make it, so it has to arrive in your food, in eggs or beans. Once inside you it turns into the pigment that colours your eyes. It also becomes the hormone that sets your pace.

Deep in you this substance works with a second one, and the two of them draw you toward people unlike you. The push and pull inside you is settled down there, below anything you decide. You change from one day to the next while the same substance goes in and burns away. A river is never the same water and is still the river.

relations.unity_line: Read alongside UL 7, this is the whole motion of gathering: the one who calls people together and the force that organises them into a single body.

pair.teaching: This self of yours draws people who come because they want to, and it has no orders to give them. Essential Nexus is where it goes next, the one will that moves a crowd as a single body. Open it when the people have gathered and nothing is moving. People gathered around you are not yet going anywhere.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy end for end and the people who came of their own accord are led as one body. Essential Nexus is that army, one will moving many people. Open it when the people around you need a direction as well as a place. Every crowd needs a bond to hold it together.

programming_partner.teaching: This self of yours knows what it is and can still trade it away for a safe life. Ancestors Bloom holds what this one lacks, the power and the means to make a life. Open it when you know who you are and keep choosing the safer week. A contribution with no means behind it stays a dream. Means with no self behind them stay hollow.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Water
codon_ring.teaching: This self of yours shows most clearly when you stop holding a shape. It belongs to a family of two called the Ring of Water, and the other is UL 2, the open ground that receives everything. One takes in whatever falls on it, the other shines by its own nature, and the same chemistry runs through both. Open it when showing yourself has started to feel like work.

tarot.teaching: Its family and its two trigrams bring five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, near this energy.

sky.teaching: the fixed air sign, the water bearer who pours out for everybody and still stands off to one side. You can give yourself to a crowd and still stay your own person.

immortals.teaching: Water above carries Li Tie Guai, the healer who came back through his own death with medicine in a gourd. He is the part of you that comes back from a loss still carrying help. Earth below carries Lan Cai He, the wandering singer who belongs nowhere and keeps nothing. He is the part of you that can be yourself anywhere, owning nothing. People gather around both, and around you, for what you are.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the hook that draws something up out of deep water. What it brings up is the self you kept down there, so the people who are yours can see it.

cards.essence: Determination lives in you as a love for the next small step. When what you want is still far off, you give your whole attention to what is in front of you today. Cooking a meal or washing a cup becomes a step toward what you want, so no chore feels wasted. There is ease in this: steps taken with heart wear a path, and the path starts to carry you.

glance.reading:
Determination lives in you as a love for the next small step. When what you want is still far off, you give your whole attention to what is in front of you today. Cooking a meal or washing a cup becomes a step toward what you want, so no chore feels wasted. There is ease in this: steps taken with heart wear a path, and the path starts to carry you.

Some days what you want feels so far away that today seems pointless. Your focus comes and goes in waves, so bring it back gently to one thing when it wanders. When a day leaves you cold, you have not chosen the wrong work; you have lost sight of what you are walking toward.

Put your heart behind each thing you do, and nothing is out of your reach. At the start of anything new, the first few steps set the direction for everything after. Small acts done in joy make more joy. Your smallest act counts for more than you know, to you and to everyone near you.

iching.trigram_combination: Wind over Heaven is the hexagram of a great strength guided by something small. Heaven is the strength in you that wants to move. Wind is the gentle part of you that changes things a little at a time. The gentle sits above the strong because great strength is led best by kindness, never by force. This hexagram has long been read as thick clouds before the rain. The rain is gathering, and nothing you do will bring it sooner. Its name has also been read as raising animals and storing up food, and neither is done in a day. Your strength goes furthest under a gentle hand.
iching.reading:
A great strength in you is being held back by something much smaller than itself. The strength is real and ready, and still its time has not come. The clouds are thick and the rain has not fallen. It is not yet the moment for the big plan.

So store up what you have, and do the small things well. Keep your manners and your days in order, since those are what you can change now. Be like a shepherd who keeps a flock calm by staying calm, and lets the sheep find their own grass. When something blocks you, take it in without bitterness, and it becomes part of how you grow. Do not grab for a quick result. Do not grow so fond of small gains that they are all you ever have.

Your legs do the carrying now, while your head keeps the far aim in view. Wait the way a farmer waits under a heavy sky, with everything ready for the rain.
judgement_lines: Small taming. Success.
Thick clouds, and no rain, from our western fields.
image_lines: The wind moves across the sky: small taming.
So the wise refine the outward things, and keep the pattern fine.

upper_trigram.name: Wind (Sun)
upper_trigram.nature: Subtly penetrating. Mild, nourishing. Wood and wind. The eldest daughter.

lower_trigram.name: Heaven (Ch'ien)
lower_trigram.nature: Unceasing forward movement, dynamic, enduring, untiring. Spirit power. Heaven, sovereign, father.

lines.image: turning back onto your own road.
lines.reading: You turn back onto your own road, and there is no blame in it. You could have taken the main road with everyone else. On this one your strength grows a little each day, where no one sees it. Go back to the way your heart already knew was yours.

lines.image: led back, one hand drawing the other.
lines.reading: Someone takes you by the hand and leads you back. You go willingly, because you are not too proud to ask or to learn. Let yourself be drawn back to the middle of the road. You lose nothing of yourself by being led.

lines.image: the spokes out of the wheel, a husband and wife looking away from each other.
lines.reading: The spokes come out of the wheel, and the two at home will not look at each other. Strength that goes its own way, thinking only of itself, has stopped the cart. The problem in the way is small. Stop asking who is to blame, make peace at home, then go on.

lines.image: blood gone, fear gone.
lines.reading: Among many strong people you are the gentle one, with no force to hold them. Tell the truth and hide nothing, and the danger of a fight passes. The fear goes with it. Lean on the strength of the people near you. Choose to be a gentle wind rather than an anger.

lines.image: trust binding, the wealth shared with a neighbour.
lines.reading: Trust ties you to the people around you. They trust you because you keep faith with them, never because you ask it of them. What you gain here is shared with your neighbours. Give support and you will be given it, so keep no good fortune to yourself.

lines.image: the rain has fallen and there is rest; the moon nearly full.
lines.reading: The rain has fallen and there is rest. What you gathered a little at a time is complete. The moon is nearly full, and a full moon can only begin to wane. Pushing on now brings trouble, and so does pride in what you did. Rest, and let the fullness pass.

gene_keys.shadow:
Inertia is what happens when the small things take hold of you. A path of stepping-stones runs in a circle, and you watch each stone as you step onto it. You never notice that the footprints are yesterday's. The errands and the things that do not matter take your life a little at a time. You feel busy and believe you are moving, while every step brings you back to the same place. Your enthusiasm goes, then your energy, and each loss feeds the other. What is left goes into complaining, out loud or under your breath.

Anything that is neither beautiful nor useful is trivia, and here it fills the days. Some days you make a great leap only to fall further, and it feels like you are back at the start.
gene_keys.repressive: Held in, the inertia freezes the will. These people see the way out and understand it completely, and still cannot take a step. They did not choose this, and the old patterns hold them fast. Leaving would mean walking straight into what they fear, so they stay, and the decline is slow.
gene_keys.reactive: Let out, it turns into restlessness. Nothing in these people can sit still, and any noise or screen will do to draw the charge out of their bodies. A fixed routine would let their rage catch up with them, so they keep no commitment long. Their lives are full of movement and never at rest.
gene_keys.gift:
Determination is one step, taken. The mind shows you the whole mountain at once, and your knees go weak just looking at it. So you look down at your feet instead, where there is one stone to step onto. That first step is the hardest, because the whole weight of staying put is against it. It is also the easiest, because it is only one step. Every step after it comes easier. If you fall off the path, that first step is what brings you back. Now the stones lead off over the horizon, and you do not need to see where.

The word sounds like force and gritted teeth, and it is nearly the opposite. The more determined you become, the less willpower it takes. Small acts done with heart build a momentum of their own. Break through once, and you know you can do it again.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Invincibility lives in the weak, not the strong. It is a child running into a misty field at sunrise, soaked to the knees. Open like that, you cannot be beaten. There is no wall in you to break through. Love works this way: it only gives, so it is never emptied.

The smaller the thing you give yourself to, the more of your power goes into it. Held that way, one small thing in your hand can feel like all there is. People near someone who lives this can find them hard to bear. Their presence shows others what they most fear in themselves.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy keeps at one thing, step by step. Grand Rising holds what it lacks: the enthusiasm that gets a thing out of your head and into the world. When determination drains away, the enthusiasm goes first, so the two rise and fall together. Repetition is what turns that enthusiasm into skill. Open it when the steps are steady and the joy has gone out of them.

human_design.gate: Gate 9 is the drive to put all your energy into one thing. It picks out the few details that serve the larger aim and lets the rest fall away. When it is on, you can work for hours on one thing and forget the room. It comes in waves, focus and then scatter, and the scatter is part of it. From outside the scatter is sometimes given a diagnosis, when it is only how this gate works. Once it is set on something it is hard to turn. Its danger is getting so lost in a detail that you lose sight of the whole. At its best it holds the detail and the whole at once.
human_design.centre:
Gate 9 sits in the Sacral Center, low in the body between the navel and the legs, where your energy for doing things comes from. This centre does not decide by thinking. It answers what is in front of you with a lift or a flat no, and focus follows the lift. Given something it has a yes for, it can stay with it for years. Pointed at what it has no yes for, the energy drains away on things that do not matter.

About seven people in ten have this centre defined. For them the energy renews by being used. Left unused, it runs down like a car battery that dies in the driveway. The other three in ten have it open. They take in the energy of the people around them and can focus harder than anyone for a while. They often do not know when enough is enough. Their gift is the pause, knowing when a thing is finished.
human_design.channel: Focus alone is only a flicker. Gate 52, in the Root Center at the base of the spine, is the drive to keep still. Together they make the Channel of Concentration, which turns pressure into long hours of attention on one thing. With both present, you can stay with a task under stress and finish it. The risk is getting so absorbed that you forget to rest. Gate 52 may be in you or in someone you work beside, and the focus settles only when both are present.

tarot.ring_role: This energy builds great things out of small ones, and it does not do it alone. It belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Light. UL 5, The Space Between Time, is the patience to wait for the right hour. UL 11, Sol Star, is the ideal that shows you where to walk. UL 26, Lighter Than a Feather, is the knack of getting a thing done unseen. This one is the step you keep taking.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Through the ring and the two trigrams come five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana.

body.physiology:
Walking is the reason this energy is given to the sacral plexus. From this weave of nerves at the base of your spine comes the largest nerve you have. It is about as wide as your thumb where it starts. It runs down the back of each leg to the foot, so every step you take begins here. The same low ground is where your will is kept. It is the part of you that goes on after the wanting has worn off.

Once you have taken the first step, the rest go on without your thinking about them. The rhythm is made low in your spine and reaches your legs through this weave. Sit on something hard and feel the two bones you sit on. A little to the outside of each, the nerve that walks you passes on its way down.
body.amino_acid:
The focus in you has a chemistry, and one substance in it is threonine. Your body cannot make it, so it comes in with food such as eggs, meat or lentils. It is where your body switches a protein on or off, one of the commonest switches you have.

You share it with three other energies in you, and what they do together is gather light. This one brings the light to a single point, the way a lens focuses sunlight until it burns.

relations.unity_line: UL 10 is this card's pair and its inverse at once: steps taken with ease, where this one takes them with determination.

pair.teaching: This energy takes small steps toward something it wants, and it runs out when every step becomes an effort. Internal Treasure is where it goes next: the ease of being at home in your own skin, which lightens every step. Open it when the work is steady and the walking has grown heavy. The way is easier when you walk it as yourself.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy upside down and gathering becomes walking on. Internal Treasure keeps moving, where this energy stores up. Open it when you have gathered enough and it is time to go.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy keeps at one thing, step by step. Grand Rising holds what it lacks: the enthusiasm that gets a thing out of your head and into the world. When determination drains away, the enthusiasm goes first, so the two rise and fall together. Repetition is what turns that enthusiasm into skill. Open it when the steps are steady and the joy has gone out of them.

codon_ring.name: Codon Ring of Light
codon_ring.teaching: This energy builds great things out of small ones, and it does not do it alone. It belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Light. UL 5, The Space Between Time, is the patience to wait for the right hour. UL 11, Sol Star, is the ideal that shows you where to walk. UL 26, Lighter Than a Feather, is the knack of getting a thing done unseen. This one is the step you keep taking.

tarot.teaching: Through the ring and the two trigrams come five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana.

sky.teaching: the fixed air that keeps a far hope steady across a long stretch.

immortals.teaching: Wind above carries He Xian Gu, the one woman among the Eight, who carries a lotus. Heaven below carries Han Xiangzi, the flute player whose music makes flowers open. Neither of them forces a thing to open. Your strength works best the same way, by tending until what you want opens by itself.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the small hook and the patient line that bring up something far larger than themselves.

cards.essence: Ease lives in you as being at home in your own skin, through an ordinary day. You do things the way you do them, and nobody is being performed for. Your step stays light, even around people who could make things hard for you. Those near you relax, because your ease leaves them free to be at home in themselves. It is a treasure most people pass every day without stopping.

glance.reading:
Ease lives in you as being at home in your own skin, through an ordinary day. You do things the way you do them, and nobody is being performed for. Your step stays light, even around people who could make things hard for you. Those near you relax, because your ease leaves them free to be at home in themselves. It is a treasure most people pass every day without stopping.

Some days you cannot stop watching yourself, checking how you come across before you have said a word. That watching is what makes your step stiff. See it without judging it, and the looking wears itself out.

Take the easy way when it is there, even when the hard way feels more like you. The harder you struggle, the more you feel you exist, so ease can feel like doing nothing. Once you stop defining yourself, you feel part of something much wider. What you make from here has play in it, and it is new because you copied it from no one.

iching.trigram_combination: Heaven over Lake is the hexagram of how you walk when something stronger is near. Heaven is the strength in you that keeps pressing forward and never tires. Lake is the part of you that is open and glad and says what it feels. The strength sits above the gladness because most days you walk under a power bigger than your own. This hexagram has long been read as stepping on a tiger's tail and not being bitten. A glad step provokes no one, so whoever holds the power lets you pass. You come through close danger by walking as yourself.
iching.reading:
You are walking close to a power bigger than you, someone with a say over your life, in a mood that could turn. Your task is to get through without being hurt. Nothing here is won by being stronger than the strong one. Keep your step light and your manner glad, because a glad step provokes nobody.

Know what is above you and what is below you, and pick your battles. Do not provoke the one who can bite, and do not freeze in fear either, because fright gets bitten too. Keep your kindness, and do not turn fierce yourself to feel safe. You are the one steering here, and others rise or fall with your choices. Go at a steady pace, neither rushing nor holding back.

Your feet do the work now. One goes, then the other, firm and soft by turns. Walk like that, and the dangerous stretch is how you come through.
judgement_lines: Treading on the tail of a tiger, and it does not bite.
It goes through.
image_lines: Heaven above, the lake below.
So the wise tell high from low, and give people something steady to set their hearts on.

upper_trigram.name: Heaven (Ch'ien)
upper_trigram.nature: Unceasing forward movement, dynamic, enduring, untiring. Spirit power. Heaven, sovereign, father.

lower_trigram.name: Lake (Tui)
lower_trigram.nature: Open surface, interaction, pleasure, the mouth, exchange. The youngest daughter.

lines.image: plain shoes on the accustomed road, walking alone.
lines.reading: You are on the road you know, in plain shoes, and nobody is watching you. This is not the time to be noticed. Want nothing beyond your place, and think less about how you look than about where you are going. Walk it alone, trusting your own values, and going on brings no harm.

lines.image: a level road, and someone quiet walking it apart from the crowd.
lines.reading: The road is level and wide, and you walk it apart from the crowd. You have left the loud life for a quieter one, and you are not lost in it. Time spent with yourself is how you learn to be yourself. You do not have to be who others think you are. Keep to this road with nothing to hide, and it goes well.

lines.image: a squint called sight, a limp called a stride, and a bold foot on the tail.
lines.reading: You squint and call it seeing, you limp and call it a stride, and you step on the tail as if nothing could happen. This time the tiger bites. You have taken on more than your strength can carry, pushed from behind into a fight in front. A soldier set on a king's throne falls fast. Know the size of what you have, and step no further.

lines.image: the tail underfoot, and a wary tread.
lines.reading: Your foot is on the tail, and you know it. Caution is right here, but panic gets bitten. Stay watchful and keep walking, firm where you must be and flexible everywhere else. Take care with each step to the last one, and it ends well.

lines.image: a fork in the road and a firm step taken at it.
lines.reading: At a fork in the road you choose, and you walk your choice with your whole weight. You are right, and you stand in the right place, and there is still danger. The higher you stand, the further you can fall. Stay humble once the choice is made, and keep watching the road.

lines.image: the whole road walked, looked back on from the end.
lines.reading: From the end of the road you look back over the whole of it. Notice where you walked gladly and where you did not. Turn toward what made you glad, and your walking and your road agree. If every step has been sound, the best fortune there is comes round to you now.

gene_keys.shadow:
Your attention turns in on yourself and stays there. You worry about your clothes, your future and what people think of you. Even when you look calm, you are running from yourself into work and busyness, and rest is put off until Friday or the holidays. Underneath is a fear of losing who you are, so you set out to find yourself. The search becomes a maze full of drama, where you never have to face yourself. While you look at yourself you cannot see anyone else, and everyone you look at becomes someone you would like to change.

You need no judging and no fixing here. See the pattern in your life, and add nothing to it. The search wears itself out once you see that what it hunts cannot be found.
gene_keys.repressive: This person has turned their attention away from themselves altogether. Their life is lived for others and through others, and from outside it can pass for kindness. It is compromise from end to end, with no centre of its own. Whatever authority they need, they look for in someone else.
gene_keys.reactive: Nobody else has room in this person's life. Their fear of losing themselves comes out as anger at whoever might take their freedom. They cannot give up any part of themselves to someone else. They are in love with a self, and it is not the true one.
gene_keys.gift:
Naturalness is being what you already are, and nothing more. You are not your name, your feelings or your beliefs, and no label fits you. Once you feel that, the tightness around who you are lets go, and what the search held comes back as energy. It shows as play, and what you make is new because you copied it from nobody. You have nothing to defend, because you hold no position on yourself. The easy way opens in front of you, with places to rest along it and friends walking it.

You cannot practise this or copy it, because it has no method. It dawns as you see that everything in you is natural, the laziness and the pain included. Your edges soften, and you grow more open and more yielding.
gene_keys.siddhi: Being is what is left when even the question of who you are has gone. There is nothing to find and no one looking for it. Life has no hidden meaning, only the beauty of this moment turning into the next. You see the whole search as a joke, and you laugh. This state is so ordinary that you would pass it in a room. Stay near it a while, and you would notice how tense you are yourself. There has never been anything to do, because there is no one to do it, and everything still gets done.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy is at ease being different, and at its lowest it runs from the crowd at any cost. Ordinary Valiance holds the other side: the fear of being different, which makes people follow the crowd. The one who follows the crowd and the one who flees it are both kept from being themselves. Open it when being yourself has turned into trying to be unlike everyone else.

human_design.gate: Gate 10 sits in the middle of your chest and presses you to act as who you are. Its other name is self-love. When you love yourself, the people near you are freed to love themselves. When you do not, it is unbearable, and you push the feeling away by blaming others. At its best you live by your own values and stand up for them without fear of judgment. People follow the example you set more than anything you say. Left unchecked, it can turn into self-centredness.
human_design.centre:
The Identity Center sits in the middle of your chest and holds who you are and which way your life goes. It works like a magnet with one pole, only ever drawing. It draws the people, the work and the places your life needs. When you do not trust yourself, you fight against what it brings you.

About six people in ten have this centre defined. They have a steady sense of who they are, whoever they are with, and they walk their own path. Following someone else's direction makes them lose heart. The other four have it open. Who they are shifts with the people around them, and they can fit in anywhere. Place matters to them, down to the house they live in and where they sit in a restaurant. They are not on the way to becoming somebody. They meet what is in front of them as whoever they are that day.
human_design.channel: On its own, this gate is a self that no one hears. Gate 20, in the throat, is the drive to speak and act in the present moment. Together they make the Channel of Being Yourself, which says who you are out loud as it happens. It also reaches Gate 34, where being yourself becomes action. A third wiring runs to Gate 57, where it becomes a gut sense of what to do next. Gate 20 may be in you or in a person close by, and the channel runs only when both are present.

tarot.ring_role: This energy finds your true self, and that is one chapter of a longer story. It belongs to a family of six, the Ring of Humanity, whose theme is the story every human life tells. UL 25, The Mysteries Play, carries the wound you start with. UL 38, Inner Light Symphony, carries the fight with your own shadows. UL 17, Pearl of Christos, carries the limits of the mind. UL 21, Beyond Binary, carries letting go of control. UL 51, Unshakable Arrival, carries the waking. This one carries finding yourself.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Five of the tarot's major cards sit with this energy. Each shows you one side of being yourself.

body.physiology:
Your heart beats as itself, and that is why this energy is given to the heart. Nothing tells it how to beat. A patch of cells in its own wall sets the pace, about once a second. A heart cut from every nerve goes on beating, as a transplanted heart does. The nerves only make it faster or slower. The heart rules the body by being in place, and the presence in your face comes from it.

It sits behind the breastbone, most of it left of the middle. Lay a flat hand there, or two fingers at the side of your neck. When you feel watched or afraid the beat quickens, and when that passes it settles. It was beating before you noticed, and it goes on when you stop.
body.amino_acid:
Being yourself has a chemistry in you, and one substance in it is arginine. It is one of the twenty pieces every protein in you is built from. Your body makes it for itself, so as an adult you do not need to eat it. As a growing child you could not make enough, and you took the rest from meat, milk or a handful of nuts.

You share this substance with a family of energies, and much of that family is about trusting your heart. Your body was making it before you knew your own name. It needs no effort from you, and it goes on whether or not you argue with your life.

relations.unity_line: UL 9 is this card's pair and its inverse at once: the small steps that store up, where this one walks on as itself.

pair.teaching: This energy walks on as itself, and it runs out when there is no strength left to walk on with. Ease in This is where it goes next: small steps that store up strength toward something far off. Open it when you have been moving for a long time and need to gather yourself before the next stretch. Walking on and storing up take turns.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy upside down and walking on becomes storing up. Ease in This stays and gathers, where this energy keeps moving. Open it when you have walked far enough and it is time to pause.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy is at ease being different, and at its lowest it runs from the crowd at any cost. Ordinary Valiance holds the other side: the fear of being different, which makes people follow the crowd. The one who follows the crowd and the one who flees it are both kept from being themselves. Open it when being yourself has turned into trying to be unlike everyone else.

codon_ring.name: Codon Ring of Humanity
codon_ring.teaching: This energy finds your true self, and that is one chapter of a longer story. It belongs to a family of six, the Ring of Humanity, whose theme is the story every human life tells. UL 25, The Mysteries Play, carries the wound you start with. UL 38, Inner Light Symphony, carries the fight with your own shadows. UL 17, Pearl of Christos, carries the limits of the mind. UL 21, Beyond Binary, carries letting go of control. UL 51, Unshakable Arrival, carries the waking. This one carries finding yourself.

tarot.teaching: Five of the tarot's major cards sit with this energy. Each shows you one side of being yourself.

sky.teaching: the crab, soft inside a shell it carries everywhere, at home wherever it walks, as you are when you are yourself.

immortals.teaching: Heaven above carries Han Xiangzi, the flute player who left the life laid out for him, as you do when you stop playing a part. Lake below carries Zhong Li Quan, the general who lost a battle and came back from the mountains with a fan that wakes the dead. He shows you that a loss can wake you to who you are.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the fence round a field, which shows where you end so you can be at home inside it.

cards.essence: Life changes when you stop reacting to whatever the day brings and start living toward something you chose. Idealism lives there, as a picture of how things could be. You set it higher than any sensible person would. It gets you out of bed in the morning, and every choice you make leans toward it. You feel it as a warmth in your chest long before any of it shows.

glance.reading:
Life changes when you stop reacting to whatever the day brings and start living toward something you chose. Idealism lives there, as a picture of how things could be. You set it higher than any sensible person would. It gets you out of bed in the morning, and every choice you make leans toward it. You feel it as a warmth in your chest long before any of it shows.

Some days the dream and your ordinary life look far apart, and people tell you to be realistic. Keep it anyway, because it is there to lift you.

Believe in the dream, and let go of what it should look like. It never arrives the way it first appeared in your head. Give it some structure to work through, and it starts to take form. What you have to give is your heart more than any picture. Leave it open, and it sets the people around you alight.

iching.trigram_combination: Earth over Heaven is the hexagram of a good season in your life. Heaven is the drive in you that keeps going and does not tire. Earth is the part of you that is easy to meet and lets things grow. The drive sits inside and the ease outside, because you can be strong within and still gentle with people. This hexagram has long been read as heaven and earth coming together. When the people above and the people below want the same thing, the work moves without a fight. It is also the first month of spring, so what you start now has half a year to grow. Your life goes well when your strength meets the world softly.
iching.reading:
Things are going well, and they are going well because the parts of your life are meeting. What you hope for and what is in front of you line up. The people above you and the people below you want the same thing. This time came after a stretch of careful steps, and it is a season you are passing through.

It asks you to use what you have to keep things moving. Spend your means to hold the meeting open, and make room for the people on either side of you. Every level road has a slope ahead, so the season will turn. Some good times are won with strength, and some are kept with gentleness. This one is kept with gentleness, and sharing what comes is how it lasts.

In the body this is the belly placed over the head. Let what you feel toward people lead, and let your thinking follow.
judgement_lines: Peace. The small departs and the great arrives.
Good fortune. It goes through, and it grows.
image_lines: Heaven and earth come together: the image of peace.
So the one in charge divides and completes the course of heaven and earth, furthers and orders what they give, and helps the people with it.

upper_trigram.name: Earth (K'un)
upper_trigram.nature: Surface of the world, support of all existence. Essential Yin. Rest, receptivity.

lower_trigram.name: Heaven (Ch'ien)
lower_trigram.nature: Unceasing forward movement, dynamic, enduring, untiring. Spirit power. Heaven, sovereign, father.

lines.image: a reed pulled up, its roots bringing the others with it.
lines.reading: Pull up one reed and the others come with it, their roots tangled together. When you move now, the people who are like you move too. Set your aim beyond your own concerns and your family's. Go forward, and it goes well.

lines.image: bearing with the rough, and crossing the river on foot.
lines.reading: You have strength, and the time supports bold moves, even crossing a river with no boat. Be patient with people who are rough and unskilled. Do not forget the ones far away, and do not keep to a clique. Walk the middle road, and you will be honoured for it.

lines.image: no level ground without a slope, no going without a return.
lines.reading: The good time is at its height, and every level road has a slope ahead. What leaves comes back. Stay upright through the hard work, and nothing is your fault. Do not grieve that your honesty was not repaid. Enjoy the good that is still on your table.

lines.image: fluttering down, not rich, together with the neighbours.
