lines.reading: Past the middle of the season you come down without your old wealth. Your neighbours join you without being asked, because the wish comes from their hearts. Trust the people who want what you want, with nothing written down. That trust keeps the peace when the riches have gone.

lines.image: the sovereign gives his younger sister in marriage, below her rank.
lines.reading: The one at the top gives a sister of the royal house to a lesser lord, and she goes to live under his roof. Power that bends down to meet the people it leads is blessed. If you hold a high place, listen to the ones below it. That brings great good fortune and what you wished for.

lines.image: the city wall falls back into the moat.
lines.reading: The earth dug out to build the wall has fallen back into the ditch. The good time is over, and force will not bring it back. Do not send out an army. Even right orders given inside your own town bring regret now. Accept that the season has turned.

becomes.name: The Taming Power of the Great

gene_keys.shadow:
Obscurity is a haze between you and what is in front of you. You look at your beliefs about a thing and call it seeing. Most of what people take for the world is a dim version of it, seen through a narrow band of light. Inside the haze, belief feels like knowing. It loves a system, a teacher or a method that promises to lift the haze for you. A system can carry you across, the way a raft carries you over a river, and then you have to step off.

The haze is made of pictures you pushed away. They rise from the side of you that thinks in images rather than words. They come faster than you can sort, and they do not seem to make sense. So you put them out of sight, where they turn into secret daydreams and hidden wishes. The ones you avoid hardest keep finding you, often in the face of the person you love.
gene_keys.repressive: Kept inside, the pictures grow into a private world. It drains their body of the strength it would take to live a real life. Their true path waits behind the fantasy, and the longer it is held in, the darker it twists.
gene_keys.reactive: Pushed outward, the pictures are thrown at the world before they are ready. They hold a great idea and never bring it about, because they cannot let go of who they think they will one day be. Denial and anger sit under it, and it ends in disappointment.
gene_keys.gift:
Idealism is a mind that plays with the pictures that come to it. Once you start to trust them, they arrive in a flood, and some of them are huge. For an afternoon you may feel you are someone great from history. None of it is you. Each picture is moving through you, and you can enjoy it without becoming it. Only the present is safe, because the present is the one thing you cannot turn into a character.

Held that way, the pictures keep moving. A castle you were shown can turn out to stand for a way of living in fellowship. These pictures are old memories, far older than you, on their way into the world. First you have to find out which dreams are truly yours.
gene_keys.siddhi: Light begins as one point in a dark sky: a single moment when your thoughts stop and you are simply aware. Then another comes, and another, while you wash the dishes or wait at a red light. In time there is more light than dark, and the dark patches open from inside. At the end the pictures fuse into one image of everything you fear and love. You sit face to face with it until nothing of you stands apart. Then a clear light shows through every form, and no one can hide or pretend. It is found only by going down into the dark. The world looks the way it did to you as a child, before good and evil divided it.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy fills you with more pictures than you can use. Petals of Freedom holds what it lacks: the heart's sense of which ones are real. With it, you can use a dream without taking it literally. Open it when you cannot tell your vision from a story you were sold.

human_design.gate: Gate 11 is the gate of ideas, and it fills you with more of them than you know what to do with. It presses you to sort them, as if each one is a job to do. Most are not yours to act on. You come up with ideas for other people, and your part is to hold each one until the right person or moment appears. The few that are yours, you guard, because others will take them and sell them. When the pressure wins, you try to force every idea into being and wear yourself out. The question this gate keeps asking is what if, and it is happy to let the answer wait.
human_design.centre:
The Ajna Center sits at your forehead and makes sense of what inspires you. It can see the whole of a thing and all its parts at once. It cannot act on what it sees, because it has no path of its own to an engine in the body. So its clearest idea waits until something else moves it. When you grip a thought, your body tightens with it, often first in your hands and wrists.

About half of people have this centre defined. Their mind works the same way every day, and they can trust what they think. Their risk is holding an answer so hard that it stops moving. Advice from them, given to someone not ready for it, turns from medicine to poison. For everyone else it is open. Information runs through them like water through a sieve, and they are not built to be certain. For them, a thought held lightly works best, the way a loose hand on a steering wheel keeps a car steady. They can see a question from many sides.
human_design.channel: Gate 56, in the throat, turns ideas into stories. Joined to Gate 11 it makes the Channel of Curiosity, which carries a picture out of your head and into a room of listeners. Its stories reach for truths that hold for everyone. They land best with a lived day inside them. Gate 56 may be in you or in someone close, and the idea is spoken only when both are there.

tarot.ring_role: This energy sees how things could be, and it belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Light. UL 5, The Space Between Time, is the answer you wait for. UL 9, Ease in This, is the small step you keep taking. UL 26, Lighter Than a Feather, is your knack for getting a thing done unseen. This one is the picture that shows you where to walk.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, come through the ring and the two trigrams.

body.physiology:
The pituitary is given this energy because a picture in you has to reach the rest of you. The gland sits deep behind the bridge of your nose, about the size of a pea. It does almost none of the body's work itself. Nearly everything it releases is a message to another gland, and the whole body answers. That is what a picture does in you: it is seen behind your eyes, and it moves you from there.

The nerves from your two eyes cross just above it, so everything you look at passes over it on the way to becoming sight. Close your eyes and put a finger on the bridge of your nose. The crossing lies straight back from there, and the gland hangs just under it. How tall you grew was set by this small gland while you slept.
body.amino_acid:
The pictures in you have a chemistry, and one substance in it is threonine. Your body cannot make it, so it comes from food such as milk and cheese. Light reaches your eyes, and further back in your head it becomes the images you imagine. This substance belongs to that passage, from light to picture. When a haze sits between you and what you see, it sits there, between the light and how your mind reads it.

You share this chemistry with three other energies, each a different way you take in light. Much of what you eat of it goes to renew the slippery lining of your gut, where no light ever reaches.

relations.unity_line: UL 12 is this card's pair, its inverse and its partner at once: the shut season, where this one is the open one.

pair.teaching: This energy dreams how things could be, and it runs out when the good season closes and nothing will meet. Petals of Freedom is where it goes next: the shut season, when a guarded heart tells real from fake. Open it when doors that stood open have closed. Every good season is followed by a quiet one.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy upside down and meeting becomes standing apart. Petals of Freedom keeps its heart to itself, where this energy opens to everything that comes. Open it when you have let too much in and need to know what is truly yours.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy fills you with more pictures than you can use. Petals of Freedom holds what it lacks: the heart's sense of which ones are real. With it, you can use a dream without taking it literally. Open it when you cannot tell your vision from a story you were sold.

codon_ring.name: Codon Ring of Light
codon_ring.teaching: This energy sees how things could be, and it belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Light. UL 5, The Space Between Time, is the answer you wait for. UL 9, Ease in This, is the small step you keep taking. UL 26, Lighter Than a Feather, is your knack for getting a thing done unseen. This one is the picture that shows you where to walk.

tarot.teaching: Five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, come through the ring and the two trigrams.

sky.teaching: the fixed air of someone who pictures a better world for everyone at once.

immortals.teaching: Earth above carries Lan Cai He, the wandering singer who gives away coins without looking back. In a good season you can give like that. Heaven below carries Han Xiangzi, the flute player whose music makes flowers open. Your strength can help what is near you bloom the same way.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the hook that brings a hidden picture up from deep water, so a dream you kept to yourself can come into the light.

cards.essence: Someone is talking to you, and under their words you can hear whether they mean them. That is your heart at work, telling the real from the fake before you can say why. What you can fall in love with, you trust. When you speak from your heart, people hear what you feel, and it stirs them.

glance.reading:
Someone is talking to you, and under their words you can hear whether they mean them. That is your heart at work, telling the real from the fake before you can say why. What you can fall in love with, you trust. When you speak from your heart, people hear what you feel, and it stirs them.

There are stretches when you let people in a little at a time and keep the rest back. Turn the same honesty on yourself and you will find a fear under it, that someone could take something from you. Nobody can take it, because what is pure in your heart is out of anyone's reach. The feelings you kept out rise and fall again without drowning you.

So let people in, and the world with them. Your heart opens a petal at a time, and each one that opens leaves you freer. The aloneness you have been looking for turns out to be your own heart. From there you can love without holding anything back.

iching.trigram_combination: Heaven over Earth is the hexagram of a time when nothing passes between you and the people around you. Heaven is the strength in you that stands firm. Earth is the softness in you that takes things in. Here the strength is on the outside and the softness is hidden within, so you look steady while nothing reaches you. This hexagram has long been read as heaven and earth drawing apart. A face kept firm over a heart kept shut is that drawing apart in a person. Around you, the small come forward and the worthy step back. You keep what you are worth inside until the time turns.
iching.reading:
Nothing is getting through. What you say is not heard, you reach out and no help comes, and the people who should meet you have turned away. The ones who flatter get ahead, and the ones with something real to give step back. This is a season, the end of summer, when the growing has stopped. No one can change it, and none of it is your fault.

Do not push against it. Draw in, and spend little, of your money and of yourself. Turn down the pay and the praise this time offers, because taking them ties you to it. Keep to the few who are like you. Keep what you are worth inside, where no one can make a show of it. Whatever others do, do not let it wear away your own honesty. Learn what you can while you wait, so the hard time is not wasted.

You may feel it as a tightness in the throat and an unease in the chest. Sit with it and keep your word. This time turns, as every season does.
judgement_lines: Standstill. The wrong people hold the way, and it does not favour the one who stays true.
The great goes. The small comes.
image_lines: Heaven and earth do not meet: the image of standstill.
So the wise fall back on their worth within, to come through the hard time, and take no pay or honour from it.

upper_trigram.name: Heaven (Ch'ien)
upper_trigram.nature: Unceasing forward movement, dynamic, enduring, untiring. Spirit power. Heaven, sovereign, father.

lower_trigram.name: Earth (K'un)
lower_trigram.nature: Surface of the world, support of all existence. Essential Yin. Rest, receptivity.

lines.image: a reed pulled up, and the roots of its neighbours come with it.
lines.reading: Pull up one reed and the others come with it, because their roots are tied together. This is the first hour of the closing, and you do not move alone. The people bound to you move when you do. Hold to what is right now, while little has set, and it can still go well.

lines.image: bearing it and enduring; luck for the small, and the great held back.
lines.reading: Going along with this time pays the ones who flatter. For you it sits uneasy in the chest. That unease is what keeps you from being swept along with the crowd. Bear the block as it is, without bending to it, and you will come through.

lines.image: shame carried folded inside.
lines.reading: You carry shame folded away where no one sees it. The place you stand in is wrong, and part of you already knows. Looking away will not make it go. Face what you can already see, and do what helps, whatever it does to how you look.

lines.image: acting on the order from above, and no blame; companions share the good.
lines.reading: Something has begun to move in the stillness, and not by your will. Act as your own sense of right directs, and no blame comes. That sense is as whole in ordinary people as in the wise. Follow it, and the ones who feel as you do will come and share in what it brings.

lines.image: the standstill giving way, and a great one tied to a clump of mulberry.
lines.reading: The standstill is giving way, and it goes well for the one who ends it. Even now, say to yourself that it could still fail. Tie what you have won to something with deep roots. Keep trouble in mind while things are calm, and it will not catch you.

lines.image: the standstill overturned; first blocked, then joy.
lines.reading: The standstill is overturned, and it goes as easily as turning over a hand. Nothing built to block can last. First the block, then the joy. Let the old way of thinking go with it, and go to meet the people you were kept from.

gene_keys.shadow:
Vanity is the quiet love of being separate, of being the one who is different. It needs no audience, which is what sets it apart from pride. It hides in what you leave unsaid as easily as in what you say. The finer you become, the finer it becomes, until you feel a little purer than the people around you. Your mind is sharp enough to find the reason each person falls short. On the surface you are calm and collected. Underneath, feeling runs hot, and being loved can frighten you more than being alone.

You cannot think your way out of it, because the thought that you are getting over it is more of the same. As long as you feel yourself to be separate, it keeps pace with you. It lets go late, and all at once.
gene_keys.repressive: Held in, it goes underground. This person agrees with you out loud and thinks otherwise, or says nothing at all. They feel clearer than the people around them, above any belief. It passes for calm, and it keeps them from the one leap they most want to make.
gene_keys.reactive: Turned outward, it becomes a sharp tongue. When this person feels wronged, they find the word that hurts and say it, with a voice that knows how to reach anyone. It is rarely planned. Under it is anger, under the anger fear, and it usually ends badly for them.
gene_keys.gift:
Discrimination is the urge to be better, turned into art. A fake reaches you as a discomfort in the body, from a person with a hidden aim or a song with nothing behind it. Nobody selling a dream can take you in. You know which food and which people are good for you. It sets you apart, because it cannot sit near a compromise.

What it is for is falling in love, the human kind, with all its drama and its danger. You are moved by feeling all your life, and you are here to pass the feeling on. Enter the drama without fear and let it run through you. In time you stop watching love from the side and become it.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Purity is a heart with nothing on it, and it lies under everything else in everyone. Lower down, you love yourself as someone set apart. Here, what is highest in you falls in love with you, and the two are one love. Lock such a person up and their love goes on. Even the worst person has this at the centre, so there is no evil, only thicker and thinner layers over it.

To arrive here you give up everything you gained. You come out like a child, still human, with a voice past words. Most who live it live plain lives, unseen, and remind whoever meets them that this can exist in a person. The moment you see anything as bad, it is gone.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy tells the real from the fake, and on its own it has nothing to reach for. Sol Star holds what it lacks, a dream of how things could be. The two need each other, because a dream with no feel for what is real stays a dream. Open it when your standards have left you nothing to hope for.

human_design.gate:
Gate 12 is the drive to put what you feel into words, held by a fine sense of when. You speak when you are moved to, not because a silence needs filling. You take longer than most to answer, because the answer has to come up from what you feel. When the words come easily, the time is right. When they will not come, wait. Forced out early, they fall flat and leave you doubting yourself.

People who like speed may read your pauses as shyness, and your silence when you are overwhelmed as coldness. The shyness is only the timing. You are shy and bold by turns, and when you do speak, your words carry weight.
human_design.centre:
The Throat Center is where what is inside you becomes something outside, a word or an act. Every other part of you is pushing to reach it, which is why it has been called the town square of the body. It has no power of its own, so whichever part it is joined to speaks through it. Gate 12 reaches toward your feelings, so what comes out of you is how you feel.

About seven in ten people have this centre defined. Their voice carries one steady theme, the same whoever is in the room. The other three in ten have it open. They tune their voice to whoever they are with, and can meet anyone in their own tone. Many of them were not listened to as children, and they learn that the right moment is what lets them be heard. For everyone, the pauses in a voice can carry as much as the sound.
human_design.channel: Gate 12 on its own is the caution. Gate 22 completes it, from the Solar Plexus, where feelings rise and fall. It brings a grace with people and a feel for what they need. Joined, they make the Channel of Openness, your feelings given words with the grace to know the room. It runs on the mood. Some days your words reach from the depths of sorrow to the heights of joy, and some days you want only quiet. Gate 22 may be in you or in someone close to you.

tarot.ring_role: This energy is the last thing in you to let go, and that is its test. It belongs to a family of three, the Ring of Trials, three tests on the way to knowing yourself. First comes forgetting who you are, in UL 33, Echos of Time. Then comes being pulled about by your senses, in UL 56, Infinite Journey. This one is the last test, the belief that you are separate. Inside the three it forms its own ring, the Ring of Secrets, and what you keep hidden there opens only when your heart does.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Five major tarot cards arrive through the ring and the two trigrams, each one a way you guard or open your heart.

body.physiology:
Swallowing is the reason this energy is given to the throat. Each time you swallow, your voice box lifts and a small flap folds down over it. Inside it, the two folds that make your voice close tight. For about a second your breath stops while what you swallowed passes behind. It happens several hundred times a day: everything in you goes still so that one thing can pass. When you laugh or cry, the rhythm of your breath changes, and your chemistry changes with it.

Put a finger on the ridge at the front of your throat and swallow. It rises under your finger, and for that second no breath comes. The old story calls it the apple caught in Adam's throat, the place where you get stuck on your own words.
body.amino_acid:
No substance in your body answers to this energy. Your body builds itself by reading a long written message, and three of the words in it name nothing. Where the reading reaches one, nothing more is added. The piece being made is let go whole. This energy carries that stop into your life. It is a passage from one way of being to another. Your hold on your own past ends, and you come out changed for good. At its far end the sense of being separate ends too, and you are taken into life itself.

Two other energies in you carry the same stop, and of the three this is the last.

relations.unity_line: UL 11 is this card's pair, its inverse and its partner at once: the heart that meets people freely, where this one holds back.

pair.teaching: This energy keeps its heart shut until it can trust what is in front of it, and no heart stays shut forever. Sol Star is where it goes next: the time when everything flows and people meet freely. Open it when the guard has come down and you are ready to let the world in. Every standstill turns into its opposite in time.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy upside down and the drawing apart becomes a meeting. Sol Star is the same two forces facing each other instead of turning away. Open it when you have kept to yourself so long that you have forgotten what meeting feels like.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy tells the real from the fake, and on its own it has nothing to reach for. Sol Star holds what it lacks, a dream of how things could be. The two need each other, because a dream with no feel for what is real stays a dream. Open it when your standards have left you nothing to hope for.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Secrets
codon_ring.teaching: This energy is the last thing in you to let go, and that is its test. It belongs to a family of three, the Ring of Trials, three tests on the way to knowing yourself. First comes forgetting who you are, in UL 33, Echos of Time. Then comes being pulled about by your senses, in UL 56, Infinite Journey. This one is the last test, the belief that you are separate. Inside the three it forms its own ring, the Ring of Secrets, and what you keep hidden there opens only when your heart does.

tarot.teaching: Five major tarot cards arrive through the ring and the two trigrams, each one a way you guard or open your heart.

sky.teaching: the light that wanes and always comes back full, as a shut season in you gives way to an open one.

immortals.teaching: Heaven above carries Han Xiangzi, the flute player whose music made flowers open out of season. Earth below carries Lan Cai He, the wandering singer with a basket of flowers, who sang of how quickly a life goes by. One is your voice opening what was shut, and the other is the reminder that there is no time to keep your heart closed.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the animal that carries water across the desert, as you carry what is in you through a dry time until it can be shared.

cards.essence: When someone starts telling you what they have kept to themselves for years, you go quiet and listen with all of you. Your whole body takes in what they mean and cannot say. You need time for this, and often a little distance. People sense it, and trust you before they know why.

glance.reading:
When someone starts telling you what they have kept to themselves for years, you go quiet and listen with all of you. Your whole body takes in what they mean and cannot say. You need time for this, and often a little distance. People sense it, and trust you before they know why.

Some days everything you hear sounds heavy, your own life included. Watch the heavy feeling without arguing with it, and it loses its hold.

Let your heart speak before your thoughts do, and give it quiet to speak in. Listen to your own past like that, and it starts to teach you. What kept repeating becomes something you learned from. The more you listen, the more strangers feel like your own people.

iching.trigram_combination: Heaven over Fire is the hexagram of people joined by one aim. Fire is the clear sight in you that sees each person as they are. Heaven is the aim in you that keeps going, the same from every side. The aim sits above the sight because people who see each other clearly still need something to face together. This hexagram has long been read as fire climbing toward the sky. People who share an aim rise together, and each can still be seen. It also asks you to tell one kind of thing from another. You belong with the people you see clearly and walk the same way with.
iching.reading:
You are among people who are not your family or your usual crowd, out in the open, and something has to hold you together. Blood will not do it here, and neither will habit. What holds you is an aim you all share, bigger than any one of you. Keep your own gain out of it. A group gathered for one person's profit breaks at the first strain. A group gathered for everyone's good can take on something hard together.

Be the first to give. Help the others toward what they want, and in time you find your own aim reached along the way. Do not leave a friend to walk home alone at night.

Your eyes do the work here. Look at each face as it is, without hurry, and keep your hands open. A company holds when every person in it has been seen.
judgement_lines: Fellowship in the open country, far from the walls. It goes through and grows.
It is good to cross the great river.
It goes well for the one who holds to what is true.
image_lines: Heaven, and fire rising under it: fellowship.
So the wise sort the families by their kind, and see each thing for what it is.

upper_trigram.name: Heaven (Ch'ien)
upper_trigram.nature: Unceasing forward movement, dynamic, enduring, untiring. Spirit power. Heaven, sovereign, father.

lower_trigram.name: Fire (Li)
lower_trigram.nature: Glowing light spreading in all directions. The power of consciousness. Magical fire-bird. The middle daughter.

lines.image: fellowship at the gate, just stepping out.
lines.reading: You are at the gate, just stepping out to meet people. Nothing has been promised to anyone yet, and nobody can fault what you do here. Before you are through the door, you already know whom it is right to stand with. Go out openly, with nothing hidden behind you.

lines.image: fellowship kept to one's own clan.
lines.reading: You keep company only with your own family and the people who already agree with you. It is warm and it is small, and in time you regret it. Falling in with whoever happens to be near, you become one of them without choosing to. Open the circle to people who are not like you.

lines.image: weapons hidden in the long grass, a watch kept from the high mound, three years without rising.
lines.reading: You hide weapons in the long grass and watch from a hill, and for three years you never rise. You want someone who belongs with another, and the other side is too strong. Nobody is harmed, because nobody moves. Force cannot make this bond. Put the weapons away and be content with things as they are.

lines.image: climbed onto the wall, and the attack not made.
lines.reading: You climb the wall with the attack ready, and the attack does not come. You are strong enough to force it, and something in you knows it would be wrong. Being stopped is your good fortune. Come down, and let the matter return to order.

lines.image: the fellowship first weeps and cries out, then laughs; the great army wins, and they meet.
lines.reading: First you cry out, then you laugh. Something stands between you and the people you belong with, and breaking through takes everything you have. Your heart is straight, so you weep openly and act without doubt. Give it all you have, and the meeting will come with laughter.

lines.image: fellowship out in the meadow, beyond the town, the aim not yet reached.
lines.reading: You are out in the meadow past the last houses, with nobody standing beside you. The great gathering you hoped for has not come, and you have nothing to regret. You can move among people now without being changed by them. Take the peace of this, and keep your aim.

gene_keys.shadow:
Discord is hearing only one band of what is going on. An old part of you listens for danger, and on its days the world comes in as bad news, one crisis after another. It does not feel like a mood. It feels like being realistic. Every generation says it the same way: things were simpler once, and people cared more. Good news comes too, and you hear it and cannot believe it. How could so many people be wrong, and only you and a few others be right?

Under it is distrust, of people and then of life itself, as if the story were bound to end badly. Nobody chooses to hear this way. There is too much noise in the head and too much armour round the heart. Under the noise, what you have forgotten is love.
gene_keys.repressive: Some agree with everyone and make a show of listening. People walk over them, and they learn nothing from it. It looks like kindness. Underneath, they refuse to take in either pain or pleasure, and settle for a safety that is not real.
gene_keys.reactive: Others disagree with you whatever you say. They hold one hard view for life, bitter about what people are and angry at anyone who still hopes. Their fear has become a philosophy. Often their life's work is proving the hopeful wrong.
gene_keys.gift:
Discernment starts when you listen to yourself. The wants still run through your body, and you cannot stop them. Now something in you watches them go by and is not carried off. You see how much of your view of other people was your own mood. Your agenda comes into the light, where you can set it down. From there you can hear other people properly for the first time.

Then your past changes. What looked like a run of accidents shows a pattern, the same few stories every culture tells, and you are living one of them. That brings a hope you feel in your belly. The deeper you listen, the more of what you hear is love.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Empathy is being inside another person, not beside them. Sympathy needs two people. Empathy needs one, and the one is not you. It is a kind of death: the one who was listening goes. What is left is the listening itself, and it can take in any living thing from the inside. First there is a fear to cross, the cold of feeling cut off from everything alive.

To sit with someone who lives here is to be healed by being heard. Every fear you have comes up and is loved until it is gone. You stop being a point and become a place, with every creature in it.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy listens to what has been lived, and on its own it can stay facing the past. Essential Nexus holds what it lacks: guidance that faces the future and gathers scattered people into one body. You only guide well when you have listened, and what you hear needs somewhere to lead. Open it when you have heard enough and people are waiting to know which way to go.

human_design.gate:
Gate 13 is the drive to take in what has been lived, yours and other people's, and keep it until it means something. You give people direction just by listening to them with respect. What they confide is theirs, and keeping it private is part of this drive.

The cost is weight. Other people's stories stay with you, and so does your own past. You can end up living there, telling the old hurt until it is who you are. There can be so much room for others that none is left for you. The story you tell about yourself sets the direction of your life. You can tell it again, truer, on any day you choose.
human_design.centre:
The Identity Center sits in the middle of your chest and holds who you are, what you love and which way your life faces. It does not push you anywhere. It works like a magnet and draws to you the people, work and places your life needs. Stories are part of what it draws. So you never hold a story here at arm's length. One that is not yours can turn your whole life the wrong way, and a true one turns it back.

About six people in ten have this centre defined. They know who they are and where they are going, whoever they are with. The stories they keep do not move them off their road. They can forget that others are still finding theirs. The other four in ten have it open. They take on the people and places around them and feel them more strongly. So where they live matters, and even where they sit in a room. For them the question is whether they can feel someone's story completely without becoming it.
human_design.channel: Gate 33, in the throat, is the drive to step back and go over what has happened before saying anything. With Gate 13 it makes the Channel of the Prodigal, the one who goes away and comes back with the story. It is built for keeping, not talking. It stores what it has witnessed and tells it when the time is right. Its need to be alone rejects no one. The stories you gather are told only when both gates are present, in you or in someone close.

tarot.ring_role: This energy listens to the past, and desire is loud enough to drown it out. It belongs to a family of two, the Ring of Purification. The other is UL 30, Sparking the Blaze, the desire that heats a life from inside. Your listening and that desire are weighed against each other, and the ring is named for what the weighing does to both. Open it when wanting keeps winning over what you already know.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Five of the tarot's major cards show sides of this energy you may know in yourself.

body.physiology:
The flinch is the reason this energy is given to the amygdala. The amygdala is two clusters of nerve cells the size of almonds, one deep in each side of your head. It hears first: a rough copy of every sound and sight reaches it a moment before the thinking part of you has the whole. It keeps each memory with the feeling that came with it. A voice that once meant hurt is stored with the hurt still on it. A likeness alone can set your heart going before you know why. Someone speaks, and something in you has already answered. Real listening begins when you watch that answer instead of obeying it.

The next time a sudden sound makes you jump, notice that the jump comes before you know what it was. Put a fingertip just in front of the opening of your ear. A few centimetres straight in is the part of you that heard first.
body.amino_acid:
The heaviness you hear on a bad day has a chemistry in you, and it holds only while you believe it. One substance in that chemistry is glutamine. Your body makes it, mostly in the muscle, and bread is full of it. More of it floats loose in your blood than any other piece your proteins are built from.

It goes first to your gut. The cells lining your gut burn it before anything else, taking it from the blood as it passes. Your gut sorts what you eat: what feeds you is drawn out, and the rest is let go. Listening does the same with a day or a person, down in the belly, below thought. The desire that pulls against your listening runs on the same substance.

relations.unity_line: Your listening leads on from here: to plenty, to guidance, and to the desire it is weighed against.

pair.teaching: This energy gathers people and hears them, and it runs out once everyone is together with nothing yet to share. Ancestors Bloom is where it goes next: the plenty that work done from love brings in, more than anyone needs. Open it when the people are gathered and the question is what you will make together.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy over and people drawing close become a crowd with plenty. In Ancestors Bloom the people who drew close now share what they have. Open it when you have heard everyone and want to know what the gathering is for. Closeness comes first, and plenty follows it.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy listens to what has been lived, and on its own it can stay facing the past. Essential Nexus holds what it lacks: guidance that faces the future and gathers scattered people into one body. You only guide well when you have listened, and what you hear needs somewhere to lead. Open it when you have heard enough and people are waiting to know which way to go.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Purification
codon_ring.teaching: This energy listens to the past, and desire is loud enough to drown it out. It belongs to a family of two, the Ring of Purification. The other is UL 30, Sparking the Blaze, the desire that heats a life from inside. Your listening and that desire are weighed against each other, and the ring is named for what the weighing does to both. Open it when wanting keeps winning over what you already know.

tarot.teaching: Five of the tarot's major cards show sides of this energy you may know in yourself.

sky.teaching: the earth sign that climbs a long slope. It comes through the Devil, and means the steadiness a shared aim needs.

immortals.teaching: Heaven above carries Han Xiangzi, the flute player whose music brings life back to things. Fire below carries Lu Dong Bin, the scholar whose sword cuts through delusion. The music draws people to you, and the sword shows you which of them is true.

hebrew_letter.teaching: it comes by the same thin thread, and means seeing what holds you clearly enough to let it go.

cards.essence: On the days you have more in you than you know what to do with, an appetite for the work you love takes hold. Your body is at the work before your mind has decided to start. You do it in your own manner, one nobody else could copy. What you bring in is more than you need, and it feeds the people around you.

glance.reading:
On the days you have more in you than you know what to do with, an appetite for the work you love takes hold. Your body is at the work before your mind has decided to start. You do it in your own manner, one nobody else could copy. What you bring in is more than you need, and it feeds the people around you.

This appetite fades when you settle, one small time after another, for work you do not want. Each time, something low in you tightens, and you feel a little worse. When you notice it, one choice a day that stays true to yourself is enough to turn it round.

Get clear on what you want your work to serve, even if that takes months. Then start, and let it build speed at its own pace. Work among people, and the right help finds its way to you. This is how the gifts you were born with, handed down through everyone before you, come into bloom.

iching.trigram_combination: Fire over Heaven is the hexagram of having a great deal and using it well. Heaven is the strength in you that keeps working, day after day, without being asked. Fire is the clear sight in you that tells what is worth keeping from what is not. The clear sight sits on top because so much strength needs a goal to give it shape. This hexagram has long been read as the sun high in the sky. Like that sun, what you have does the most good when it goes out to everyone around you. What you have stays good for as long as you can see what it is for.
iching.reading:
The harvest is in, and it is large. You have more than you need, and it came from years of steady work as much as from good fortune. The season is right, and for now everything you start goes well.

The danger now is not loss but pride. Plenty tempts you to believe you made it alone. Those who have a great deal should not let themselves feel full. Stay modest, and stay easy for people to reach. Stop what does harm, in yourself first, and let the good in you show. Offer the best of what you have to something larger than your own house.

The belly does the work now. Fill it and keep your mind empty. Take in all that has come without holding on to it in your thoughts. Stand the way a generous host stands, with plenty on the table and the door open.
judgement_lines: Great possession. Supreme success.
The yielding line holds the high seat, and the strong lines above and below answer it.
Firm and strong within, bright without, in step with heaven and the season.
image_lines: Fire high above heaven. Great possession.
The one who has much stops what is harmful, lets the good show, and bends to the will of heaven.

upper_trigram.name: Fire (Li)
upper_trigram.nature: Glowing light spreading in all directions. The power of consciousness. Magical fire-bird. The middle daughter.

lower_trigram.name: Heaven (Ch'ien)
lower_trigram.nature: Unceasing forward movement, dynamic, enduring, untiring. Spirit power. Heaven, sovereign, father.

lines.image: no mingling with harm, the hard ground kept in mind.
lines.reading: Nothing much is yours yet, and nobody is looking. Keep away from what does harm, and count the thoughts you feed as company too. Remember that the ground is hard and the work repeats. Tend what you have out of sight, and nothing goes wrong.

lines.image: the big wagon loaded, with somewhere to go.
lines.reading: A big wagon stands loaded, with somewhere to go. What you have is real now, and you can carry it. Keep the load balanced in the middle, where it will not spoil. Choose where you are heading, and set off.

lines.image: a prince laying his harvest before the son of heaven.
lines.reading: A prince brings his harvest as an offering to the king. You have something worth giving, and it belongs to something larger than your own house. A small-minded person cannot do this, because their possessions hold them. Let the best of what you have serve something greater than you.

lines.image: great means held in check, the drum unanswered.
lines.reading: The drums beat, and you could drown everyone out. You have strength and you can see clearly, and it is better to lean on neither. Let others go their own way without pressing your views on them. Hold back, and what you have keeps growing.

lines.image: trust going out and coming back, a dignity that needs no preparing.
lines.reading: Your word is trusted, and the trust comes back to you. People can reach you, and you still carry yourself with dignity. Getting ready to impress would only show that you doubt yourself. Speak plainly and sincerely, and it stirs the will of others.

lines.image: help coming down from heaven itself.
lines.reading: Help comes down from heaven. Your strength and your clear sight have become one, and nothing you do fails to go well. Heaven helps the one who yields to it, and people help the one they trust. Take the help that comes.

gene_keys.shadow:
Settling for second best starts so young that most of us no longer notice we do it. The dream of being great that you had as a child was a real urge to excel. School taught most of us that work means boredom and effort, and by forty the dream has usually gone.

Each small surrender damps the fire in you a little more. Your spine droops, and your energy sinks with it. Not every give costs you. Staying home because someone you love is unwell costs nothing, since love made that choice. Work you dislike can cost nothing too, when it is a step toward your dream. What costs is doing what you do not want because others pressed you to. That becomes a habit, and what you were born with starts to leak away.
gene_keys.repressive: Held in, the fear goes quiet. This person goes along with whatever happens, and it passes for being easygoing. The power meant for their work stays choked up inside them. Even desire fades with it.
gene_keys.reactive: Let out, the same fear turns into proving. This person works hard at a job that is not theirs, to show they are special. Recognition comes and still does not fill them. Provoke them and their rage shows how unsure they are.
gene_keys.gift:
Competence is what someone who loves their work looks like while they do it. Nobody can teach it. It finds the quickest and simplest way past whatever is in the way. It has a style no one else could copy. When it meets a task it has never done, it learns it.

The fire sits in the belly, and it works by drawing rather than pushing. Your work goes like a saw pulled toward the belly: a finer cut for less effort than one shoved away. The heat of it spreads. It turns a small group into a team, all keen on the same thing. If you would rather work alone, look underneath the wish. Usually there is a fear of how large you could be.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Bounteousness begins as gratitude for a spark. The ember is tiny and easily lost, and you breathe on it in your hands until it holds. Fed, it grows into a flame and then a fire, until there is a sun inside you. A sun gives itself away all day and is filled again by the giving.

Nothing is taken anymore. Receiving is still here, and receiving only deepens the thanks. The more you give, the more you are given. What was plenty turns out to be fertility, moving through one life into many others.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy works hard and well, and without a style of its own it turns out more of the same. Odyssey of Freedom holds what it lacks: the courage to do a thing exactly your own way. At their lowest the two feed each other, settling for less and a life that looks like everyone else's. Open it when your work is good and could be anyone's.

human_design.gate: Gate 14 is a surge low in your body that wants to produce. It drives you to bring in resources, money and the things a life runs on, and much of what it brings is meant for others. It does not run at a steady level. It pulses, strong for a stretch and then gone, and on the strong days you can outwork anyone. Without a direction it turns into restlessness, and people may call you greedy or unable to stop. Pointed at something you want, it becomes stamina.
human_design.centre:
The Sacral Center sits under the navel and above the legs, and it is the strongest engine you have. It powers work, sex, raising a child and anything you can keep at for years. It does not decide. It answers, with a yes that lifts or a no that goes flat.

About seven people in ten have it defined, running all the time. For them the task of a life is to find the right work and master it. They are built to fall asleep worn out and wake up charged. Work with no yes behind it drains them. So does sitting idle, the way a car battery dies in the driveway. When they leave the wrong work, their energy comes back within weeks. Others see this engine and borrow it through guilt, and a plain yes or no is its only guard. The other three in ten have it open. They take in the energy around them and can outwork everyone for a while, without knowing when enough is enough. Their gift is the pause.
human_design.channel: Gate 2 sits in the chest and knows which way your life is heading. Together with Gate 14 it makes the Channel of the Beat, which joins a direction to the power to follow it. It keeps a rhythm of its own, and it works best when you move to that beat rather than anyone else's. Gate 2 may be in you or in a person close by.

tarot.ring_role: This energy pours what it has into work, and the spark behind it was there first. Its one sibling is UL 1, Earth's Breath, which carries creation out of nothing. Your plenty grows out of that creative spark. The spark of genius needs fanning, and freshness is what keeps it alight. Open it when the work you love has gone stale.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, arrive through the ring and the two trigrams.

body.physiology:
The meal is the reason this energy is given to the small intestine. Several metres of it lie folded under your navel. It receives whatever you have eaten and turns it into what the rest of you can use. Its inside is folded, and the folds are covered in tiny fingers. So a tube you could close a hand around has a surface as large as a room's floor. Nearly everything that feeds you crosses that wall into your blood. It keeps nothing for itself, and it passes on what it cannot use.

After a meal more blood goes to it, which is part of why you feel warm and slow for an hour. Its lining is shed and grown again every few days, faster than any other part of you. Between meals a slow wave sweeps it clean, every hour and a half or so. The growl you call hunger is mostly that wave.
body.amino_acid:
The spark in what you are good at has a chemistry in you, and lysine is part of it. Your body cannot make it, so it has to come in from meat, eggs or beans. Grain alone leaves you short of it. A spark like yours is there from birth, and it has to be fanned before it becomes a fire. In your body, what fans it is what you eat.

On a long walk, hours after your last meal, you are running on stored fat. Lysine goes into the carrier that brings that fat out to be burned. That is the fire in you with something to feed.

relations.unity_line: These are the cards your plenty moves toward: the people it is for, the style it lacks, and the spark it came from.

pair.teaching: This energy brings in more than one life needs, and it loses its point when nobody shares it. Universal Crest is where it goes next: people gathered who listen to one another. Open it when you have plenty and no one to share it with. A harvest is meant for a table of people.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy end for end and plenty becomes company. Seeking harmony with people is what brings a harvest in. Open it when the work goes well and you are doing it alone. The harvest follows the fellowship.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy works hard and well, and without a style of its own it turns out more of the same. Odyssey of Freedom holds what it lacks: the courage to do a thing exactly your own way. At their lowest the two feed each other, settling for less and a life that looks like everyone else's. Open it when your work is good and could be anyone's.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Fire
codon_ring.teaching: This energy pours what it has into work, and the spark behind it was there first. Its one sibling is UL 1, Earth's Breath, which carries creation out of nothing. Your plenty grows out of that creative spark. The spark of genius needs fanning, and freshness is what keeps it alight. Open it when the work you love has gone stale.

tarot.teaching: Five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, arrive through the ring and the two trigrams.

sky.teaching: the archer aiming at a far mark, as your plenty needs somewhere to go.

immortals.teaching: Fire above carries Lu Dong Bin, the scholar whose sword cuts through what is false, for seeing clearly what your work is for. Heaven below carries Han Xiangzi, whose flute makes flowers open, for the strength in you that helps things grow.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the peg that holds a tent up, as your steady work holds up everything you have.

cards.essence: It takes a quiet kind of courage to meet an ordinary day in full, with the same street and the same people. That is where your magnetism lives. It grows as you slow down to the pace of growing things. Without any effort from you, it draws people and what you need. You do the plain work well and let the credit go, and people feel something near you that they cannot name.

glance.reading:
It takes a quiet kind of courage to meet an ordinary day in full, with the same street and the same people. That is where your magnetism lives. It grows as you slow down to the pace of growing things. Without any effort from you, it draws people and what you need. You do the plain work well and let the credit go, and people feel something near you that they cannot name.

Some days go grey and flat, with nothing wrong in them, and you fear that every day will be like this one. Running from it into something new does not help, and neither does sinking into it. Let the grey all the way in, and at some depth it fills with life again.

Trust your own rhythm, slow for a stretch and then fast. Welcome everyone who comes, the drab and the bright alike. Lived this way, an ordinary day turns out to be full.

iching.trigram_combination: Earth over Mountain is the hexagram of a real strength carried low. Mountain is what is solid in you, the weight of what you can do. Earth is the plain, yielding side you show to people. The yielding side sits on top because people resent a strength that is shown off, and they help one that is kept low. This hexagram has long been read as a mountain inside the earth. Someone who looks ordinary can have a mountain of strength under the surface. You go furthest when you carry your strength without showing it off.
iching.reading:
You can do more than the people around you know, and this is a time to carry it low. Do the work in full and let the credit go. Treat the people around you as your equals, and share the plain work with them. People resent whoever is full of themselves, and they help whoever keeps low. Carried this way, every step turns out well, from the first to the last.

Weigh what is in front of you. Take some away where there is too much. Add where there is too little, and count your own share too. Then see the thing through, because starting is easy and finishing is the hard part. Keeping low is not the same as being weak. When someone threatens what is fair, stand up for it without taking it personally.

Your body does this through your hands, which work without anyone watching them. Stand with your weight low and your hands open, with nothing to prove.
judgement_lines: Modesty goes through, and grows.
The one who carries it carries it to the end.
image_lines: A mountain inside the earth: that is modesty.
So the wise take from what has too much and add to what has too little, weighing each thing and making it even.

upper_trigram.name: Earth (K'un)
upper_trigram.nature: Surface of the world, support of all existence. Essential Yin. Rest, receptivity.

lower_trigram.name: Mountain (Ken)
lower_trigram.nature: Limit, frontier, stillness. Solid, steady, unshakable. The youngest son.

lines.image: humble, and humble about that; the great river crossed.
lines.reading: You keep low, and you keep quiet about keeping low. That is what gets you across a great river. Nobody sees you as a threat, so nothing rises to stop you. Keeping low is how you get ready for what lies ahead. Get ready, then cross.

lines.image: humility that has made a sound, the call one bird knows another by.
lines.reading: People have noticed your modesty without your saying a word, the way birds know each other by their call. It rings true because it comes from your heart and not from a manner. Where you lack something, follow the one who has it, and say so. Keep it true, and it goes well.

lines.image: the one who works hardest, and stays lowest.
lines.reading: You do the hard work, see it through, and do not stand on top of what you finished. Everyone turns to you for that. The good in you grows each day while your sense of it shrinks. Carry the work to its end, and the end is good.

lines.image: humility stirred up and spread in every direction.
lines.reading: You have reached what you set out for, and now you stand close to real power. This is when confidence wants to loosen. Nothing here goes against you, as long as your modesty keeps spreading. Be as humble with those above you as with those below. Your place is still new, so keep it low.

lines.image: not rich, and the neighbours come anyway.
lines.reading: You have no wealth to draw people with, and your neighbours come to you anyway. Your good and theirs are now one thing, and nobody gets on alone. Where someone will not play fair, use a firm hand, fairly and without pride. Stand with your neighbours, and stand against whoever takes more than their share.

lines.image: humility trumpeted, and the army sent only against your own city.
lines.reading: At the top, your modesty has turned into something you announce. The word is there without the thing, and few people follow a word. What you meant to do is not done yet. Use your strength on your own house, not on anyone else's. Set your own place in order first.

gene_keys.shadow:
A grey day with nothing wrong in it is where this energy sinks lowest. The colour goes out of things. Underneath runs a fear that tomorrow will be the same, and every day after it. That is the fear of an ordinary life. Anger is not dull, and grief is not dull. Dullness is the dead middle, with no charge either way. On a cloudy morning your body changes a little, as everyone's does, and the dullness comes from how you take that change.

A dog can sit on a doorstep for a month and never be bored. Only a person can find a day dull, because only a person has an attitude toward it. Stuck in your head, you reach for anything to fill the day. Stuck in your feelings, you sink, and your energy sinks with you. No trick takes the feeling away. Let the grey in all the way, and at some depth it stops being dull.
gene_keys.repressive: Here the grey sinks into emptiness, close to depression. This person has quietly given up, and from outside it looks like acceptance. It is acceptance that stopped partway, stuck on a fear of fear itself. Once they find that fear, the emptiness goes deeper and turns into energy.
gene_keys.reactive: This person rebels against the grey and keeps moving, from one place and one thrill to the next, with no rhythm or purpose. They cannot commit to anything or anyone for long, because a hidden rage drives them on. Once they see the pattern, they can stop and face what they are running from.
gene_keys.gift:
Magnetism is a pull that grows as you slow down to the pace of the earth. The earth is never in a hurry: leave a city alone for a thousand years and it turns back into forest. The closer you come to that pace, the more you draw people and what you need. This is not charisma, which spills over the surface of a person. It comes from far below, and it may never show in your manner. People feel something around you that they cannot put a name to.

What you feared was draining your life turns out to feed it, the way an empty jar turns out to be full. Your love reaches people at every level of life, the grey ones included. Loving everyone does not mean liking them. It means you can feel what a person is and find something in them worth loving. The grey of the low days becomes colour here.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Florescence is a whole tree bursting into flower at once, in every direction. It comes when the seeking in you finally comes to rest. No effort brings it, and nothing can hurry it. People know it when they see it in someone.

Then the fruit falls back to the ground, and the flowering comes back into ordinary life. The ones it happens to come down off the mountain and become entirely ordinary, even a little strange. They may let you think they are weak or flawed, just to stay close to you. The holiest people are the gardeners, because they know that everything comes at its proper time. You learn the same, and everything in you flowers in the end.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy draws people to you only while nothing about you is an act. Internal Treasure holds what it needs: the ease of being at home in your own skin. When you are comfortable with who you are and accept other people's lives as they are, you are close to flowering. Open it when you catch yourself watching how you come across.

human_design.gate: Gate 15 is the pressure to live by your own rhythm, and that rhythm swings. You may work hard for weeks and then rest. You may spend time with people and then need to be alone. This is not balance. It is a love of the whole range of life, with room for every kind of person in it. From outside, the swings can look like you cannot follow through. Forced into fixed daily habits, the rhythm jams. Then you blame yourself for keeping hours that are not yours. You may also swing between giving everything away and keeping everything for yourself. Set limits around a stretch of work, go in fully while it lasts, and rest in between. Share from the heart without giving your heart away.
human_design.centre:
Gate 15 sits in the Identity Center, in the middle of the chest, which holds who you are and the direction your life takes. It works like a magnet with one pole: it only draws. It pulls in what your life needs, people and work and places. When you trust yourself, you let that pull work. When you do not, you fight what it brings.

About six people in ten have this centre defined. They know who they are and where they are going, and they lose heart when they follow someone else's direction. The other four in ten have it open. They take their sense of self from where they are and who they are with. Place matters to them, down to the city they live in and where they sit in a restaurant. They have usually tried many directions, and they grow wise about which ones are true.
human_design.channel: A swing needs a steady beat under it. Gate 5 is your need for meals and sleep at the same hours each day. It sits low in your belly, in the Sacral Center. Joined with Gate 15, it makes the Channel of Rhythm, which lays your wide swings over a fixed beat. Through it the rhythms of nature guide your timing. Gate 5 may be in you or in a person close to you, and the rhythm holds only when both are present.

tarot.ring_role: This energy is where seeking comes to rest. It belongs to a family of six, the Ring of Seeking, and each one presses you to look for something. UL 39, Nobel Spark, carries the push to break through. UL 52, Timeless Blossom, carries the wish for complete rest. UL 53, Creation Oscillation, carries the urge to start something new. UL 54, Everlasting Bounty, carries the drive to rise. UL 58, Rhythm of Life, carries joy. This one is where the looking ends.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Four of the tarot's major cards reach this one, and the Hermit comes by two roads.

body.physiology:
The liver holds this energy in your body, and the reason is direction. It keeps your blood and your energy moving freely, and it sends blood wherever you need it. It also gives a life its plan and the way it faces. When it moves freely, you go through a day at your own pace and in your own direction.

After a meal, the liver stores the sugar your blood does not need yet. Between meals it lets it out a little at a time. So your blood stays at one level, whether you ate an hour ago or ten. Go half a day without food and you keep going, because the liver is paying out what it put by. Whatever pace your day takes, fast or slow, it keeps you level underneath.
body.amino_acid:
The pressure in you to seek has a substance, and the substance is serine. It is one of the twenty small pieces every protein in you is built from. Your body makes it from what it is already burning, so you never have to eat it. The same substance runs through this energy's kin, and each of them presses you to seek something different.

Here is where that seeking finally comes to an end. All your struggles and your highest moments are written into this chemistry. The seeking in you runs on something you make yourself, and in time it burns itself out.

relations.unity_line: UL 16 is this card's pair and its inverse at once: the strength let out as joy, where this one keeps it low.

pair.teaching: This energy keeps what you can do low, and it runs out when something in you is ready to be heard. Grand Rising is where it goes next: the enthusiasm that gets a thing out of your head and into the world. Open it when you have kept quiet long enough and something wants to come out. What was held low can then be heard.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy end for end and what you kept low comes up out of you like thunder. Grand Rising is the same strength when you let it be heard. Open it when keeping low has started to feel like hiding.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy draws people to you only while nothing about you is an act. Internal Treasure holds what it needs: the ease of being at home in your own skin. When you are comfortable with who you are and accept other people's lives as they are, you are close to flowering. Open it when you catch yourself watching how you come across.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Seeking
codon_ring.teaching: This energy is where seeking comes to rest. It belongs to a family of six, the Ring of Seeking, and each one presses you to look for something. UL 39, Nobel Spark, carries the push to break through. UL 52, Timeless Blossom, carries the wish for complete rest. UL 53, Creation Oscillation, carries the urge to start something new. UL 54, Everlasting Bounty, carries the drive to rise. UL 58, Rhythm of Life, carries joy. This one is where the looking ends.

tarot.teaching: Four of the tarot's major cards reach this one, and the Hermit comes by two roads.

sky.teaching: the earth sign that tends and sorts and serves, as you do the plain work and let the credit go.

immortals.teaching: Earth above carries Lan Cai He, the barefoot singer with a basket of flowers. Mountain below carries Zhang Guo Lao, the old sage who rides his donkey facing backward. One walks the road with nothing to show. The other turns his back on the race ahead. Both show you how to stay ordinary on purpose.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the smallest letter, the one the others are drawn from. A hand does the work without needing to be seen, which is your way too.

cards.essence: Some mornings you wake up wanting to get to the thing you love. That is enthusiasm, and it says yes before you have thought it through. You begin before you feel ready, and you learn as you go. When you talk about it your voice lifts, and the people around you catch it.

glance.reading:
Some mornings you wake up wanting to get to the thing you love. That is enthusiasm, and it says yes before you have thought it through. You begin before you feel ready, and you learn as you go. When you talk about it your voice lifts, and the people around you catch it.

There are days when nothing seems worth getting up for, and your plans stay on the table. It feels like tiredness, and under it is a fear that caring will swamp you. Your heart cannot be overwhelmed; it only opens wider. Go and do one real thing, and the caring comes back with it.

Begin on the thing you most enjoy, and a surge of energy comes up in you. You stop bending your path to suit other people. Nobody else can take this first step for you. Once you are in it, your days fill with purpose and you are glad to get up.

iching.trigram_combination: Thunder over Earth is the hexagram of getting ready and then moving. Thunder is the excitement in you that gets you on your feet. Earth is the quiet part of you that rests and makes ready. The excitement sits on top because it comes up out of what was stored below. This hexagram has long been read as thunder rising out of the ground in spring, waking a whole field. Your excitement wakes a room the same way. Its name has been read both as delight and as getting ready, and your delight lasts when you have prepared. When you are ready, your joy carries others with it.
iching.reading:
You have made ready, and the time to move has come. What you prepared in quiet is ready to come out, and the people around you are ready to follow. It is a good time to bring helpers in and set out together.

It asks you to prepare, then go without hesitating. Study the target before you let the arrow go, and once you have seen it, do not wait out the day. Move with the time, the way the sun and the moon keep their course and the seasons come when they should. Enjoy what comes to you, and keep some of it back for what comes after. The danger is on the far side of the joy, when pleasure turns into laziness and you forget the people who came with you.

Your feet are where the body feels this. Notice whether your weight has already shifted forward. Stand as you do just before you step off, ready and at ease.
judgement_lines: Enthusiasm. It furthers you to set helpers in place and to set the armies marching.
image_lines: Thunder comes resounding out of the earth: the image of enthusiasm.
So the kings of old made music to honour what was done well, offered it up with splendour, and invited the ancestors in.

upper_trigram.name: Thunder (Chen)
upper_trigram.nature: Arousing power emerging from the depth of the earth. Excite, influence, move, affect. The eldest son.

lower_trigram.name: Earth (K'un)
lower_trigram.nature: Surface of the world, support of all existence. Essential Yin. Rest, receptivity.

lines.image: telling everyone how pleased you are.
lines.reading: You tell everyone how pleased you are with yourself. Joy told too soon is joy spent, and the more you tell it, the less of it you feel. Your will runs out soon after the telling. Keep your delight to yourself a while longer, and it stays yours.

lines.image: firm as a rock, not waiting out the day.
lines.reading: You stay steady as a rock while everyone around you is carried away. You want nothing from the excitement, so you see what is coming before it arrives. When a pleasure turns wrong, you let it go the same day. Stay that steady, and it goes well.

lines.image: looking up wide-eyed at someone else's joy.
lines.reading: You look up at someone else's joy and wait for some of it to reach you. What you hope to get from them, you lose in yourself while you wait. The longer you wait, the more you will regret it. Turn back to your own joy quickly.

lines.image: friends gathering like hair into a clasp.
lines.reading: The joy comes from you, and great things come of it. People who were scattered gather around you, the way loose hair is gathered into one clasp. Only doubt could spoil this, yours about them or theirs about you. Do not doubt, and they stay.

lines.image: a long illness that does not kill.
lines.reading: Something has troubled you for a long time, and it will not kill you. You cannot enjoy what others enjoy, so you keep to yourself. You stay upright because you hold to the middle of your life. That is better than chasing joy outside yourself. Let the old trouble be what drives you on.

lines.image: joy that has gone dark.
lines.reading: You have gone on into the pleasure past the point where you can see clearly. When joy goes on past its peak, sadness follows by itself. You still have time. Change your course now, even this late, and there is no blame.

gene_keys.shadow:
Not caring feels like nothing much, and under it is fear. You live in the comfortable part of your life, the emails and the job, and your attention stays on what does not matter. You are full of plans, and they rarely get off the ground. The book or the business waits for a day with more time, though time is not the reason.

The instrument you were born to play sits in the corner. Picking it up would make you different from everyone who is not bothering either, and there is safety in numbers. You can build a clever life out of skills and methods while it stays there. Skill of that kind makes an expert. It never makes a master.
gene_keys.repressive: Held down, not caring turns into believing what you are told. If governments cannot fix the world, they ask, how could one person? They take the fear on the news as the truth, and they hide their own not caring behind everyone else's. Their head goes into the sand, sure that nothing can be done.
gene_keys.reactive: Pushed out, the fear hides inside systems and methods. They follow their own structures so closely that they forget why they built them, and the structures become a wall. They believe their own account of things completely. Behind the wall is a great anger, and it will bring them down unless they see through it.
gene_keys.gift:
Versatility begins with caring about one thing enough to lose yourself in it. You pick up the instrument and give it years. It takes about seven for a skill to be written into your body, so that your hands know it without you. By then the skill has become a talent, and you no longer have to think about it.

Once you know one thing through and through, you find you can pick up almost anything. The same pattern runs under every art and every science, and that pattern is what you learned. The discipline that looked hard from outside is easy once your heart is warm. You move from painting to business with the same ease, and you waste nothing. You spot a child's talent early and put it where it can grow.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Mastery is living well, and it has stopped being about skill. For years your heart opened, closed and opened again, and now it no longer needs to close. The person it happens to is ordinary. They are cheerful without pretending, they give because they want to, and they pass almost unnoticed. They may not be rich, and you can still see that they are prospering.

Here all learning ends, and there are no more levels to climb. The knowledge of how to play the hardest music is already in every person alive. At this height your enthusiasm is what the word first meant, to be filled with the breath of God. Nobody near you can stay indifferent to it.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy leaps at what it loves. Ease in This holds what it lacks: small steps taken one after another, day after day. Without the steps the leap gets nowhere, and without the leap the steps go cold. Open it when the excitement is high and nothing has been done yet.

human_design.gate:
Gate 16 is the pull to leap at something you love and get good at it. It says yes before the details are in, dives to the bottom of a subject and wants to share what it can do. It masters by repetition, the way an instrument is learned, one pattern played until it is yours. Your passion for it tends to spread to whoever is listening.

When it is off, it presses in one of two ways. You may hold a skill back for years because it is not perfect yet. Or a leap that went wrong may have burned you, until your zest feels dangerous and you take no risks at all. Leaping with no map and no food makes you look unreliable. Your enthusiasm needs something to carry it, so pack what you need, then jump.
human_design.centre:
The Throat Center is where what is inside you becomes a word or a deed. Nearly all the energy in you heads here, so it works like a town square. Whatever reaches it comes out of you as words or action. Gate 16 puts your skill where other people can see it.

About seven people in ten have this centre defined. Their voice is steady and stays in one register. It goes out rather than taking in, and it can sound blunt. They say what they know the same way to everyone. The other three in ten have it open, and their voice changes with whoever is in the room. They can meet each person in that person's own tone. For many of them the trouble starts in childhood, when nobody listens, and they learn to go quiet or to get louder. They feel the pressure to speak with nothing to say, and their own words come when someone asks.
human_design.channel: Skill on its own stays on the surface. Gate 48 sits in the Spleen Center, the part of you that senses whether you are safe. It holds depth, and the fear of not being good enough. Together they make the Channel of the Wavelength, a talent built over years by repeating and improving one pattern. The fear sends you deeper instead of stopping you. Gate 48 may be in you or in someone close by, and the talent sounds when both are present.

tarot.ring_role: This energy finds the one thing you do best, and it cannot prosper alone. It belongs to a family of two, the Ring of Prosperity. UL 45, Tribal Tapestry, gathers people around what there is and shares it out. This one brings the talent. Real wealth comes when people follow their own gift and work together.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Five of the tarot's major cards come with this energy, and each is a stage of what it does in your life.

body.physiology:
The parathyroid holds this energy in the body, and the reason is the store. These are four glands the size of grains of rice, tucked behind the thyroid, and together they weigh less than a paperclip. Every muscle that closes and every beat of your heart runs on calcium, and these four keep its level in your blood steady. When a meal falls short, they draw on a store you laid down over years, your bones. When the meal is enough, the bones are built back. A move that comes easily to you is drawing on years.

You cannot feel the glands, only find the place. Put a fingertip in the notch at the top of your breastbone, then move a thumb's width up, either side of the windpipe. Now close your hand into a fist. Every muscle in that fist closes on calcium those four grains keep level.
body.amino_acid:
Enthusiasm has a chemistry in you, and one substance in it is cysteine. Your body makes it for itself, but only from a piece it has to be fed. That piece comes from meat, eggs or beans. It is one of two pieces in you that carry sulphur, the smell of burning hair.

This chemistry belongs to finding the one thing you do better than anything else, and to the risk of being different that finding it takes. When you stop spending yourself on what does not matter, your body has more for that one thing. The further you go into it, the more the world comes to meet you halfway. You share this chemistry with the energy that gathers people, so your talent does best among others.

relations.unity_line: UL 15 is this card's pair and its inverse at once: strength kept low and quiet, where this one rises and gets things moving.

pair.teaching: This energy rises and gets things moving, and it runs out when the excitement turns into showing off. Ordinary Valiance is where it goes next: the magnetism that grows as you slow down. Open it when your excitement has become the loudest thing in the room. Delight lasts when it stays humble.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy upside down and rising becomes bowing low. Ordinary Valiance keeps its strength quiet, where this energy lets it out. Open it when you have talked enough about what you love and it is time to simply do it.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy leaps at what it loves. Ease in This holds what it lacks: small steps taken one after another, day after day. Without the steps the leap gets nowhere, and without the leap the steps go cold. Open it when the excitement is high and nothing has been done yet.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Prosperity
codon_ring.teaching: This energy finds the one thing you do best, and it cannot prosper alone. It belongs to a family of two, the Ring of Prosperity. UL 45, Tribal Tapestry, gathers people around what there is and shares it out. This one brings the talent. Real wealth comes when people follow their own gift and work together.

tarot.teaching: Five of the tarot's major cards come with this energy, and each is a stage of what it does in your life.
