sky.teaching: the slow planet of time and form, the discipline that lets your enthusiasm last for years.

immortals.teaching: Thunder above carries Cao Guo Jiu, a nobleman's son who gave up his rank to wander. Earth below carries Lan Cai He, a street singer with a basket of flowers who had no rank at all. Both chose their lives by what they loved. Your enthusiasm asks the same of you, to follow what you love over what you were handed.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the last letter of the alphabet, the mark you put on a long piece of work when it is finished.

cards.essence: When something is only starting, you can often already see where it is heading. You watch one step lead to the next, and the pattern shows you what comes after. You feel it in your chest before your head can explain it. What you see can lift a conversation and help people imagine more than they thought possible.

glance.reading:
When something is only starting, you can often already see where it is heading. You watch one step lead to the next, and the pattern shows you what comes after. You feel it in your chest before your head can explain it. What you see can lift a conversation and help people imagine more than they thought possible.

The people around you may not be ready to hear it for years. Said too early, it only makes them push back, and you may start to doubt what you saw. Hold on to it, and the world catches up in its own time.

So hold what you see as a possibility and keep looking as things change. Share it when someone asks, and people will take it as help. Then you can see both sides of a question at once, and what you say points everyone in a better direction.

iching.trigram_combination: Lake over Thunder is the hexagram of following and being followed. Thunder is the drive in you to get up and move. Lake is the pleasure you take in the people around you. The movement sits below the pleasure because people come along gladly only when nobody is pushing them. This hexagram has long been read as thunder gone down into a lake at nightfall. The storm rests under the water until morning, the way you stop and go home when the day is done. It is also read as the strong one walking behind the weaker ones. You are followed once you have learned to follow.
iching.reading:
This is a time of following. Someone goes ahead and others come after, and you may be on either side of it. People follow gladly or not at all. Push them and they pull away. Serve them and they come, and they stay. So whoever wants others behind them learns first to walk behind someone worth following. To get, you give first.

What it asks is care over what you follow. Following is only as good as what lies ahead of it. Behind what is right, it takes you a long way. Behind whatever is nearest or loudest, it turns on you. Follow the time as well: move while the day moves, and stop when it ends.

Your feet do this now, each step going where the last one led. Walk behind the one you trust, at their pace. When evening comes, go in and rest until morning.
judgement_lines: Following. Great success, and it goes well for the one who stays true.
There is no fault in it.
image_lines: Thunder in the middle of the lake: that is following.
So at nightfall the wise go indoors and rest.

upper_trigram.name: Lake (Tui)
upper_trigram.nature: Open surface, interaction, pleasure, the mouth, exchange. The youngest daughter.

lower_trigram.name: Thunder (Chen)
lower_trigram.nature: Arousing power emerging from the depth of the earth. Excite, influence, move, affect. The eldest son.

lines.image: the standard changes, and you go out of your door to meet others.
lines.reading: What you have been following has changed, and you change with it. Staying true to what is right through the change brings good fortune. Do not work this out alone at home. Go out and meet people who are not your usual company, and good work comes of it.

lines.image: tied to the small boy, the grown man let go.
lines.reading: You hold on to the one who needs you and lose the one who could help you. You cannot keep both. Being needed is a comfort, and it is keeping you small. Look up and see who is worth following before they are out of sight.

lines.image: tied to the grown man, the small boy let go.
lines.reading: This time you go with the one who can help you and let go of the one who leaned on you. Following like this gets you what you are after. The cost is real, and your heart is softer than your choice. Stay with what is right and do not go back on it.

lines.image: a following that gathers followers of its own.
lines.reading: People have started to follow you, and it is working. Even so there is danger in it, because the one you follow may take you for a rival. Two strong people pulling the same way is too much strength. Be sincere, and let everyone see what you are aiming at.

lines.image: sincere in what is good.
lines.reading: You trust what is good, and it goes well. Speak up for the good in people and let the bad pass without comment. Spend nothing on small quarrels. Follow what your heart wants, and it will not lead you over the line.

lines.image: held fast, tied and bound; the king makes his offering on the western mountain.
lines.reading: The following here is held so tight it has become a binding. There is devotion in it, the kind a king carries up a mountain as an offering. There is also a wish to be followed without ever having followed. Loosen your hold, and let people come of their own accord.

gene_keys.shadow:
Somewhere young you took a side, and you have been finding proof for it ever since. You have two eyes so that the world has depth, and a fixed view closes one of them. The seed goes in during your first seven years, before you have words for it. It comes up in your teens, when the mind looks for something solid to hold on to. It finds a flaw in people or in you, and builds a whole story around it. By the time you are grown, a small thing has become a mountain.

A view held that way has to be defended, and while you defend it you stop looking. Take something that bothers you and see whether a should is hidden in it, the feeling that things should not be like this. That feeling is the first refusal of how things are. Notice, too, that the view could change by tomorrow. That is how you know the view is not who you are.
gene_keys.repressive: Turned inward, the sorting mind compares this person with everyone and sides with the others. They do not value their own view enough to hold one, let alone say it. They rarely notice they are doing it. Year after year they gather proof that their life counts for little.
gene_keys.reactive: Pointed outward, the same mind builds a set of rules and uses logic to make other people wrong. Whatever needs defending to stay standing is only a view. What drives this person is anger they have not noticed, and under the anger, fear.
gene_keys.gift:
Far-sightedness is seeing both sides of a thing at once. With both eyes open the world has depth again. You take in the small workings of a thing along with the whole of it. This gift has work to do. It calls out an argument that shows one side and hides the other. You know a fixed view from the inside, so you do not fight it in anyone else or try to win them round. You doubt your own doubt as freely as anyone else's, so there is nothing to defend.

At first the view comes and goes. There is a moment when the whole is clear, then ordinary sight again. You need the plain days between, to bring what you saw into your life.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Omniscience is one eye that sees in every direction at once. There is no longer you on one side and the world on the other, so there is nothing to take sides about. It feels less like seeing and more like being seen through, with nobody in the way.

A falcon wears a hood on the falconer's glove and dozes. When the hood comes off it is awake at once, and its body moves the moment its eye finds a mark. At this height you are the same: you see, and you act in that moment without second-guessing. Nothing needs doing, and whatever you decide is already right.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy sees the whole pattern and holds no tool to change it. Liberation of the Greater holds what it lacks: the need to find what is wrong and put it right. The two are born together in everyone, as opinion and judgement, and at their best they become far sight and integrity. Open it when you have seen enough and it is time to act.

human_design.gate:
Gate 17 presses your mind to run ahead. It takes what has already happened, finds the pattern in it and follows the pattern forward to what could be. It often reaches further than other people think is possible. It wants order in a world that keeps surprising you.

The same pressure brings the urge to say it now. A view offered before anyone asked shuts a room that it could have opened. The other habit is doubt for its own sake, until a mind built to see what could go right sees only what could go wrong. So hold the view until someone asks, and keep it open to change. People change, and not everything in a life follows a pattern.
human_design.centre:
The Ajna Center sits behind your brow. It takes what your head is inspired by and makes sense of it, seeing the whole and all its parts. It keeps what you believe and what you remember. It cannot act, because no path runs from it to any engine in the body. A clear idea waits there until something else moves it. Offered to someone who is not ready, what it knows turns from medicine into poison. Grip a thought and your hands tighten with it.

About half of people have this centre defined. Their mind never stops, and they can rest on being sure of what they think. Their risk is making every decision from the head. In everyone else it is open. A page read is soon gone, and the pull is to borrow the nearest person's thoughts so there is something to hold. They can end up surer than anyone, which is the warning sign. Held lightly, their mind sees many ways at once and can choose what is worth thinking about.
human_design.channel: Gate 62 sits in the throat and looks after details, the small facts and their names put in order. With Gate 17 it makes the Channel of Acceptance. This channel takes a view of what could be and lays it out in steps other people can follow. Gate 62 may be in you or in a person close by. A hunch becomes useful only when it meets the facts.

tarot.ring_role: This energy sees ahead, and that is one part of being human. It belongs to a family of six, the Ring of Humanity, which holds the story every life passes through. With UL 25, The Mysteries Play, you start out wounded. With UL 38, Inner Light Symphony, you fight your own shadows. Here you outgrow the limits of your mind. With UL 21, Beyond Binary, you give up control. With UL 10, Internal Treasure, you find yourself. With UL 51, Unshakable Arrival, you wake up.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, arrive through the ring and the two trigrams.

body.physiology:
Your pituitary gland carries this energy, and the reason is your eyes. The nerves from your two eyes cross just above it, deep in the middle of your head. Everything you look at passes over it on its way to becoming sight. It does none of the seeing itself. Nearly everything it releases is word sent to another gland, to your thyroid or to the glands above your kidneys, and they do the work. A pea-sized gland sends word, and the whole of you answers.

How tall you grew was set by this gland, year by year, in what it released while you slept. Close your eyes and put a fingertip to the bridge of your nose. The crossing is straight back from there, deep in your head, and the gland hangs just beneath it.
body.amino_acid:
Your far sight has a chemistry, and one substance in it is arginine. It is one of the twenty pieces every protein in you is built from. Your body makes most of what it needs, and the rest comes from meat, eggs or a handful of nuts. It is written into you in six different ways, more than almost any other piece.

You share this chemistry with the other energies that make a person human. What people are still to become is folded into it, along with what you already are.

relations.unity_line: UL 18 is this card's pair, its inverse and its partner at once: the hands that mend what this energy sees coming.

pair.teaching: This energy sees where a thing is heading, and it stops at seeing. Liberation of the Greater is where it goes next: the work of setting right what has gone wrong. Open it when you can see trouble coming and nobody has moved to fix it. Seeing a flaw is half the job, and mending it is the other part.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy end for end and looking ahead becomes looking back. Liberation of the Greater deals with what the past has left behind. Open it when the road ahead is clear but something behind you still needs care.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy sees the whole pattern and holds no tool to change it. Liberation of the Greater holds what it lacks: the need to find what is wrong and put it right. The two are born together in everyone, as opinion and judgement, and at their best they become far sight and integrity. Open it when you have seen enough and it is time to act.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Humanity
codon_ring.teaching: This energy sees ahead, and that is one part of being human. It belongs to a family of six, the Ring of Humanity, which holds the story every life passes through. With UL 25, The Mysteries Play, you start out wounded. With UL 38, Inner Light Symphony, you fight your own shadows. Here you outgrow the limits of your mind. With UL 21, Beyond Binary, you give up control. With UL 10, Internal Treasure, you find yourself. With UL 51, Unshakable Arrival, you wake up.

tarot.teaching: Five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, arrive through the ring and the two trigrams.

sky.teaching: the water sign of home and shelter, which asks you to steer by what you feel rather than by force.

immortals.teaching: Lake above carries Zhong Li Quan, whose fan brings the dead back to life. What you follow should make you more alive. Thunder below carries Cao Guo Jiu, who gives up the court he was born to. A title is no reason to follow anyone.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the fence around a field, which keeps what you see safe until someone asks for it.

cards.essence: An instinct for what has gone wrong lives in you, and so does the wish to put it right. When something comes to you already spoiled, in a family or in a piece of work, you are the one who sees it. Once you start on it, you stay, and you keep making it a little better. Held well, this is integrity. You keep a high standard, and it shows in how you stand.

glance.reading:
An instinct for what has gone wrong lives in you, and so does the wish to put it right. When something comes to you already spoiled, in a family or in a piece of work, you are the one who sees it. Once you start on it, you stay, and you keep making it a little better. Held well, this is integrity. You keep a high standard, and it shows in how you stand.

At times the faults are all you can see, in the people nearest you and in yourself. Ask whether you would rather be right or happy. What bothers you most in someone else usually points to something in you that wants settling, so start there.

Treat the life around you as your own body, only greater. The more of it you care for as yours, the less personally you take it, and the lighter your days become. Mend what you can, one thing at a time. What was spoiled becomes sound again, steadier than it was before.

iching.trigram_combination: Mountain over Wind is the hexagram of setting right what was spoiled. Wind is the gentleness in you that finds its way in. Mountain is the part of you that holds still. The stillness sits above because that is how a family or a workplace spoils, when those in charge stop and everyone else goes along. This hexagram has long been read as wind blocked at a mountain's foot, where the air goes stale. A bowl left standing too long spoils, and the cure is to clean it and use it. The same spoiling, watched and stopped in time, makes rice wine. You can make good what went bad.
iching.reading:
Something has come to you already going bad. It went wrong in the hands of the people before you, and now it is in yours. The spoiling is not your fault. Setting it right is your work, and this is a good time for it, because what has gone bad can still be mended.

This time asks you to act, not to wait for things to sort themselves out. Before you start, look hard at how it went wrong. When you finish, look again at what your work has changed. Take up what the ones before you meant, and leave what they did. Stir up whatever has gone still, in yourself and in the people around you, and give them heart.

Bend your back to it. No one is ever fully ready to carry the work a family or a place leaves undone. Carrying it is how you grow into it.
judgement_lines: Work on the decayed: from the source it goes through and grows.
It serves to wade the great river.
Three days before the turning. Three days after.
image_lines: The wind blows low on the mountain: what has been spoiled.
So the wise rouse the people and feed what is good in them.

upper_trigram.name: Mountain (Ken)
upper_trigram.nature: Limit, frontier, stillness. Solid, steady, unshakable. The youngest son.

lower_trigram.name: Wind (Sun)
lower_trigram.nature: Subtly penetrating. Mild, nourishing. Wood and wind. The eldest daughter.

lines.image: setting right what the father spoiled, and a son to do it.
lines.reading: You take up the work your father left spoiled, while the damage is still small. Take up what he meant and leave what he did, and no blame stays on him. There is danger here, because what is let slide now grows. Be careful at the start, and it ends well.

lines.image: setting right what the mother spoiled.
lines.reading: What was spoiled this time came from your mother, and it lives inside love. Correct it and you hurt the love. Leave it and you hurt what is right. Only someone strong who is not hard can do this. Bend where you must, keep to the middle, and do not push your rightness all the way.

lines.image: setting right what the father spoiled, with too strong a hand.
lines.reading: You set right what your father spoiled, with a heavier hand than it needed. There is a little regret in that, and no great fault. You were right to act. Keep going, and let the regret teach your hand.

lines.image: going easy on what the father spoiled.
lines.reading: You see what your father spoiled and let it be, telling yourself it can wait. It grows while you wait, and going on this way ends in shame. The fault lies with the one who will not look. Turn and face what you have been choosing not to see.

lines.image: setting right what the father spoiled, with praise.
lines.reading: You set right what your father spoiled, and people praise you for it. You come to it with an open heart, admit what you do not know and praise what others do well. Their clear sight helps you past what you cannot see yourself. Be honest with people, and the goodwill it brings undoes what force could not.

lines.image: serving neither king nor lord, and looking higher.
lines.reading: The work is done, and you no longer work to please anyone above you. You work for the purpose rather than a person, and not for pay or fame. Your footing is firm now, and nothing needs correcting. Keep your eyes on what is highest, and what is true in you will outlast you.

gene_keys.shadow:
The flaw is the first thing you see, and the mind that sees it was built that way. What goes wrong at this height is that you become your verdicts. Each one feels like who you are and makes you feel safe, so you defend it. Holding them that tightly makes you tense, and people feel the tension before they hear a single opinion. What you think about a thing hardly matters. How tightly you hold it does.

It usually sets in between fourteen and twenty-one. A young mind sees faults everywhere, in parents and teachers. It escapes them by freezing into one fixed view, usually borrowed from its friends. It feels like safety, and it stops the mind from growing. Much of a day's thinking stays there, in quiet complaints about the people nearest you and worry over money and health. Every complaint harms twice, the one it is about and the one who makes it.
gene_keys.repressive: Here the judging turns inward and stays there. Judged too hard in their teens, they compare themselves with whoever seems above them and always come up short. So they go along with the majority instead of standing up for what they believe, and quietly undermine themselves.
gene_keys.reactive: Aimed outward, the judging challenges every authority, starting with the parents. When the adults around them hold no firm line, an old anger sets in, and every rule becomes theirs to break. They are volatile, and their whole sense of who they are rests on putting other people down.
gene_keys.gift:
Integrity is a word builders use for how much load a structure can bear before it fails. In you it is physical, a steady core that shows in how you stand and move before you have said anything. Every animal has it without trying, which is why nothing in a forest judges. You were born with it too, and still you have to earn it. Once earned it stays, because it was your true nature all along.

The eye that found every flaw turns first on your own thinking, and clearing out old verdicts gives you back a clear head. From there you hold a high standard in all you do and ask it of others, from the heart, which is never cruel. You go against the grain calmly, leading by example. Part of you is in the game and part of you rests outside it, which is where the calm comes from. Having seen how a person is shaped young, you can help others finish growing up.
gene_keys.siddhi:
The world is perfect as it is, and now you can see it, the flaws included. The mind that judged goes quiet. The clearer it is that nothing needs mending, the more you mend until the day you die. The more good you do, the more you see could be done, and that restlessness is the work itself.

In anyone, even someone who seems wholly bad, you see only what is highest. Holding that sight lifts them. You could leave the world behind, and you stay. Your body belongs to the whole body of people, and no one is fully well until everyone is.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy looks at what is wrong right in front of it. Pearl of Christos holds what it lacks: the far sight that knows where things are going. A repair means little until you know what the thing was for. Open it when you can see every flaw and none of the purpose.

human_design.gate: Gate 18 gives you an eye for what has gone out of line, the detail everyone else has stepped over. It arrives as an instinct, before any thought, and it is usually right. It is less about getting a thing perfect than about making it a little better, again and again. The hard part is timing. Offered before anyone asks, a correction is heard as criticism, and people push away the very thing that would help them. Then you are the one who feels judged. So wait until you are asked, and give it to bring more joy between people, never to prove you were right. It is worth knowing how it feels to be right and keep it to yourself.
human_design.centre:
The Spleen Center sits low on the left side of the body, and it is your oldest alarm. It works through the senses, in the present, and tells you at once whether a thing is safe. It looks after your health, and it keeps time. It speaks once and softly, so a busy mind can talk straight over it. It holds the fear of being judged and the fear of things not being right. Seen for what they are, those fears ease into a relaxed alertness, like a cat asleep in the sun with one ear still turning.

A little more than half of people have this centre defined, and for them the knowing is there every day. Their bodies tend to glow with health, and the risk is taking it for granted, pushing on past feeling unwell. In the rest it is open, and the body is more sensitive. It knows it is getting ill before anything shows, and it takes in the fears of the people nearby and makes them louder. The work there is telling which fears are your own, and the reward is a fine sense of what is healthy for other people.
human_design.channel: Gate 58, at the base of the body, is the pressure to be alive and to enjoy it. Joined to Gate 18 it makes the Channel of Judgment, which sees what needs putting right so there can be more joy. A body stays alive on its vitality, and this is what the correcting is for. Gate 58 may be in you or in someone close by, and with both present the seeing becomes service.

tarot.ring_role: This energy shapes the mind between fourteen and twenty-one, when your views are formed. It belongs to a family of four called the Ring of Matter. Together they shape how soundly you grew in body, feeling and mind. UL 57, Flight of the Tao, carries the months before you were born. UL 46, Fountain of Light, carries your body in your first seven years. UL 48, Doorways of the Unknown, carries your feelings in the seven after. This one carries your mind.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, come to this energy through the ring and the two trigrams.

body.physiology:
The lymph carries this energy in the body, and the reason is washing. All day your blood leaves water behind in the spaces between your cells, along with whatever the cells are done with. None of it is left there. A second set of vessels gathers it, two or three litres a day, and carries it through several hundred small filters. Anything wrong in it is met there, before the water goes back into your blood. Your body has no pump for it. It moves when you move, lifted by each step and each breath, and it pools while you sit.

The clear drop that beads on a graze before any blood comes is that same water. The word lymph means clear water, so you have already seen what it washes.
body.amino_acid:
The energy that puts things right has a substance in you, and the substance is alanine. It is one of the twenty small pieces every part of you is built from. Your body makes this one itself, from what the sugar in your blood becomes as it burns. There is more of it in you than of almost any other piece. The fears this energy carries lie deep in your body, in the defences that fight off what does not belong in you. Going through them, never around them, is what opens what is higher in you.

This substance is made from what already runs in your blood. You share it with three other energies, each carried by a different part of your growing up.

relations.unity_line: UL 17 is this card's pair, its inverse and its partner at once: going gladly along, where this one sets right what going along has spoiled.

pair.teaching: This energy mends what went wrong, and it runs out when the thing works again. Pearl of Christos is where it goes next: the sense of where things are heading, which people gladly follow. Open it when the repair is done and you need to know what it was for. Whatever is followed long enough will one day need mending again.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy end for end and setting things right becomes going along with them. Pearl of Christos is the same road walked gladly, before anything has gone wrong. Open it when you have mended enough and it is time to follow. Going along too easily is how things start to spoil.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy looks at what is wrong right in front of it. Pearl of Christos holds what it lacks: the far sight that knows where things are going. A repair means little until you know what the thing was for. Open it when you can see every flaw and none of the purpose.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Matter
codon_ring.teaching: This energy shapes the mind between fourteen and twenty-one, when your views are formed. It belongs to a family of four called the Ring of Matter. Together they shape how soundly you grew in body, feeling and mind. UL 57, Flight of the Tao, carries the months before you were born. UL 46, Fountain of Light, carries your body in your first seven years. UL 48, Doorways of the Unknown, carries your feelings in the seven after. This one carries your mind.

tarot.teaching: Five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, come to this energy through the ring and the two trigrams.

sky.teaching: the first sign of spring, the start of the year, the fresh start your mending gives a spoiled thing.

immortals.teaching: Mountain above carries Zhang Guo Lao, who rides his donkey facing backwards. You look back the same way, to see where a thing went wrong. Wind below brings He Xian Gu, the one woman among the eight, who holds a lotus. The lotus comes up clean out of mud, and so can what you mend.

hebrew_letter.teaching: a window lets in air and light, which a shut, stale place needs before it can be put right.

cards.essence: When you come close to someone, you can feel what they are missing before they say a word. That is sensitivity, and it lives in your skin as much as in your mind. You walk into a room and know where the warmth has gone out of it. It is a kind of touch, and it reaches animals as well as people.

glance.reading:
When you come close to someone, you can feel what they are missing before they say a word. That is sensitivity, and it lives in your skin as much as in your mind. You walk into a room and know where the warmth has gone out of it. It is a kind of touch, and it reaches animals as well as people.

Some days you give until nothing is left, and you start leaning on the people you look after. Wanting something back from them blurs the feeling. See to your own needs first, and ask for help when you are low. Then what others are missing is plain to you again.

Lean into the hard conversation, or the friend who is ill, instead of keeping away. Let old resentments go, and look after yourself the way you look after others. Being open and soft is your strength. Living this way, you feel more alive and more human.

iching.trigram_combination: Earth over Lake is the hexagram of drawing near. Lake is the warmth in you that people feel before you speak. Earth is the part of you that makes room for whatever comes close. The warmth sits underneath because people come near to what is glad to see them. This hexagram has long been read as the turn of the year, when the days begin to lengthen and the cold still holds the ground. You do nothing to bring the spring, and it comes all the same. You cannot hurry what is coming to you, and you do not have to.
iching.reading:
Something good is on its way to you, and it is still some way off. The worst of the cold is over, though you may not feel it yet. What is coming grows a little every day. Let it travel the whole distance at its own pace. It has to run its full course before you can call it yours.

If you have come through a long dark stretch, do not look down on the people still in it. Do not think less of work that seems smaller than yours. Keep teaching, and do not tire of it. Look after the people near you without fencing them in. There is a warning inside this good time. By autumn, what rises now will be falling. Do the work while things are growing, and let go of what is already on its way down.

Your mouth does the work now, to welcome and to teach. Keep your face open and your words few, and let what is coming arrive.
judgement_lines: Drawing near. Great success, and it goes well for the one who keeps to what is right.
When the eighth month comes, there will be misfortune.
image_lines: Earth above the lake: the ground that meets the water with no gap between them.
So the wise never tire of teaching, and look after the people without setting a limit.

upper_trigram.name: Earth (K'un)
upper_trigram.nature: Surface of the world, support of all existence. Essential Yin. Rest, receptivity.

lower_trigram.name: Lake (Tui)
lower_trigram.nature: Open surface, interaction, pleasure, the mouth, exchange. The youngest daughter.

lines.image: two rising together, side by side.
lines.reading: You and someone beside you rise together, and the strength is new. A young strength tends to outrun its good sense long before it tires. Keep your aim and your actions straight from the first step, and it goes well.

lines.image: the two still rising as the tide turns their way.
lines.reading: The two of you are still rising, and now things start to turn in your favour. Your strength is small beside everything still above it. Do not force it early, and do not let it slip when its time comes. Stay still and do not ride the rush, and everything goes well.

lines.image: the sweet taste of arriving, and nothing further.
lines.reading: Arriving feels sweet, and life is comfortable. Nothing moves any further from here. You are saying the right things while your heart is somewhere else, and you know it. Let it worry you. Ask someone for guidance, and the fault will not last.

lines.image: the arrow standing in the ground where it was aimed.
lines.reading: The arrow stands in the ground where it was aimed. You have arrived after a long and tedious road, and nothing is wrong here. The only work left is to be ready. When the new thing shows itself, do not miss it.

lines.image: the wise ruler who lets able hands carry the work.
lines.reading: You are in charge, and you know how to come close. You do not do everything yourself. You trust the able person below you to carry the work. When they come to you, wait for them and take in what they bring. Keep your balance, and it goes well.

lines.image: the generous one who comes back down to teach.
lines.reading: You reached the top, withdrew into quiet, and now you come back down. You are generous and honest, able to take a blow as well as give one. You want nothing for yourself. Go back to the people below you and teach, and there is no fault in it.

gene_keys.shadow:
Leaning on something outside yourself is where this energy starts, and the habit is very old. People once lived on what nature gave them, and they made gods of it. The same lean runs through a marriage, a family or a faith. You are all right only while someone above you stays kind, which is how it feels to be a victim. From inside, it feels like love. Both people give up part of themselves to keep the other close, and neither feels whole.

The old fear of not having enough is fading, and it is not going quietly. Some people are stepping out on their own while others hold tighter to the old ways, and it shows first at home. What ends the lean is not a better person to lean on. It is finding that life feeds you directly, with no one standing in between.
gene_keys.repressive: Afraid of being alone, they cling to the past and to the people in it. Guilt is their quiet tool, and small dramas keep the attention coming. They need to feel needed. Any attention will do, even the angry kind.
gene_keys.reactive: The angry face of this announces loudly that it needs nobody. They make sure everyone sees how alone they are. Underneath the proud talk, they seethe with rage. Offer them friendship, and all that anger lands on you.
gene_keys.gift:
Sensitivity opens once you are fed. When your own needs are met, you stop wanting anything from the people around you. Then you start to read everyone nearby the way a barometer reads the weather. Much of it reaches you through the hands, the skin and even the hair, which is why many who have it heal for a living. Being easily hurt is something else. This is a strength, and it looks after itself because it knows what it needs.

Its whole art is going slowly. You do not rush to greet a stranger, and you let them come to you at the speed they like. With an animal you wait until it trusts you, then let it touch you first. You learn this fast, mostly from the times you got it wrong. Once it is yours, you feel strong and soft at the same time, as if you have come home to the family of living things.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Sacrifice is where this energy ends up, and it holds nothing back. The small kind gives your power away to please other people, and it harms you. The real kind happens inside you. You give up the harsh word about someone, the grievance, even the wish to be understood. Often the sacrifice is to say nothing, because what you see cannot yet be shown.

The greatest lives of this kind are never seen. Every living thing is fed by the life below it, and you belong to that chain. Past a certain point you work for everyone and no longer call it giving, because you know no other way to live.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy reaches out toward other people, and it can forget the strength it already holds. Echos of Time holds what it lacks: stepping back to remember. Open it when you have looked to others for so long that you forget your own power. You go back into yourself first, and then you have something to bring.

human_design.gate: Gate 19 is a pressure to have your needs met, and the needs of the people around you. You long to be close, and you notice at once when a person close to you is left out. Tension between people presses on you until you want to settle it. The feeling behind it can be fine to the point of discomfort. Some who carry it cannot stand the seams in their socks, or being touched in certain ways. The same pressure makes it easy to give too much. It works best when you give from what is left over, never from what you have to keep for yourself.
human_design.centre:
The Root Center sits at the base of your body and runs on adrenaline. It is where pressure starts, the push to get up and act. It works in pulses, on and then off. When it is off, you cannot make yourself start, however hard you try. From here, Gate 19 sends its pressure up toward your feelings.

About six people in ten have this centre defined. Pressure is familiar to them, and they can hold it and aim it. Their risk is burning out. The other four in ten have it open. They take in the pressure of everyone around them and feel it louder than its owner does. Someone only says what needs doing, and their body hears an order. Their gift is knowing which pressure is theirs to answer.
human_design.channel: Wanting alone longs for closeness and reaches for it. Gate 49, in the feelings, is the part of you that holds to your principles and breaks with what has gone false. Together they make the Channel of Synthesis, which drives you to connect with people in good faith and bring joy. When the good faith goes, someone is out. Gate 49 may be in you or in someone close, and the bond is made whole only when both are there.

tarot.ring_role: This energy reaches toward other creatures. It belongs to a family of three, the Ring of Gaia, which ties every living thing on earth into one body. This one carries sacrifice. UL 60, Woven Light, carries the justice that returns to you whatever you give up without thought for yourself. After that comes UL 61, Celestial Remembrance, which carries the sacred in every living thing.
tarot.tarot_resonance: The ring and the two trigrams bring five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana.

body.physiology:
The body hair carries this energy, and the reason is goosebumps. Every hair has a nerve wrapped round its root, so you feel a thing when it bends the hair, before it reaches your skin. At each root is a muscle the size of a thread, pulled by the same adrenaline that quickens your heart. Cold, fear or a bar of music can raise them, and nothing you decide can. In an animal the raised hair lifts a coat to keep it warm, and in you it still rises for a coat that is gone. Something comes near, your skin knows first, and your arms answer before you have named it.

Blow across the back of your hand. You feel the air at once, through the hairs, before it could cool the skin. That is the part of you that feels what is coming before it arrives.
body.amino_acid:
What you feel in other creatures has a chemistry in you, and one of its substances is isoleucine. Your body cannot make it and has to take it in from meat, milk or beans. The same piece is in every animal you have ever touched, because every living body is built from the same twenty. You share this substance with two other energies.

As the old ways tighten their grip, a reaction is going on in that chemistry, in your body more than your mind. It opens a way of feeling what it is like to live inside another creature. It brings you back to being one with everything alive on this planet.

relations.unity_line: UL 20 is this card's pair and its inverse: the long look from a height, where this one comes close.

pair.teaching: This energy comes close and feels what someone is missing, and up close it can lose the wider view. Emerging as the Code is where it goes next: stepping back to see the whole of what you came near. Open it when you have been close to something for a long time and cannot see it clearly anymore. Coming near is how you give, and looking from afar is how you understand.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy upside down and coming near becomes watching from above. Emerging as the Code is the same care, seen from the height. Open it when this good season starts to turn. By autumn the time for watching comes round again.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy reaches out toward other people, and it can forget the strength it already holds. Echos of Time holds what it lacks: stepping back to remember. Open it when you have looked to others for so long that you forget your own power. You go back into yourself first, and then you have something to bring.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Gaia
codon_ring.teaching: This energy reaches toward other creatures. It belongs to a family of three, the Ring of Gaia, which ties every living thing on earth into one body. This one carries sacrifice. UL 60, Woven Light, carries the justice that returns to you whatever you give up without thought for yourself. After that comes UL 61, Celestial Remembrance, which carries the sacred in every living thing.

tarot.teaching: The ring and the two trigrams bring five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana.

sky.teaching: the planet of attraction, the pull that draws you close to someone.

immortals.teaching: Earth above carries Lan Cai He, who wanders from town to town singing, with a basket of flowers and no care for money. He is the part of you that is at home anywhere. Lake below carries Zhong Li Quan, whose fan brings the dead back to life. Your warmth does the same for someone who has gone cold.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the door you wait at until you are asked in.

cards.essence: Just before you act, you can stop and see your life as it is. Calm lives in that pause. You see the kind moments and the careless ones alike, without judging either. From there a choice emerges on its own, clear, from the whole of you. People near you feel this calm before you have said a word.

glance.reading:
Just before you act, you can stop and see your life as it is. Calm lives in that pause. You see the kind moments and the careless ones alike, without judging either. From there a choice emerges on its own, clear, from the whole of you. People near you feel this calm before you have said a word.

For long stretches you are elsewhere, reacting and rushing, without noticing. Then something brings you up for air, and you remember what being here is like. Meet those stretches gently. Forcing the calm back only makes you tight.

Make room for it in small things. Keep your space simple, and know where things go in your house. Before you drink a cup of tea, stop and look at it. Calm grows from a love of small things like these. Then it stays with you through the day, and you know that everything is going to be all right.

iching.trigram_combination: Wind over Earth is the hexagram of looking at your life and being seen. Wind is the attention in you that moves gently into every part of a day. Earth is your life as it is, the ground under everything you do. The attention sits above the ground because you see your life only when you rise a little above it. This hexagram has long been read as a tower on high ground, where you see far and are seen from far. Stand at a window over a street, and the people below can see you too. You are known by where you stand when you look.
iching.reading:
You have stopped just before you act. The hands are washed, and the offering is not yet made. Nothing has happened yet, and this pause matters most. A sincerity gathers in you here, and it shows without a word being said. The people who look to you see it and are changed by it.

So look before you go on. Look at yourself first, at what you want from this and whether you are sure you are right. Sometimes it is not the question that needs looking at, but the one asking it. Then look out across your whole life, the way wind moves over a field and reaches every part of it. The seasons keep their order without a word from the sky, and what you teach by being seen works the same way.

Keep your eyes open and your hands still. Sit the way someone waits before an offering, and let what you see settle before you move.
judgement_lines: Contemplation. The hands are washed, and the offering is not yet made.
There is sincerity, and it shows with dignity.
image_lines: The wind moves over the earth: the image of looking.
So the kings of old went out through the land, looked at the people and set up their teaching.

upper_trigram.name: Wind (Sun)
upper_trigram.nature: Subtly penetrating. Mild, nourishing. Wood and wind. The eldest daughter.

lower_trigram.name: Earth (K'un)
lower_trigram.nature: Surface of the world, support of all existence. Essential Yin. Rest, receptivity.

lines.image: the looking of a child.
lines.reading: You look at the world the way a child does, seeing only what is bright and near. For someone who asks little of life, that is no fault. For you, wanting to see truly, it is not enough. Look longer than a child would, and let the surface be only the start.

lines.image: peeping out through the crack of a door.
lines.reading: You see the matter through the crack of a door, from one side only. Kept inside your own home, that narrow view does no harm. In work among other people it misleads you. Look at the matter from another side before you decide.

lines.image: looking at the course of my own life.
lines.reading: You look at your own life to decide whether to go forward or step back. Where something in you is growing well, go on with it. Where it is not, draw back and put it right before you look at anyone else. Watch yourself honestly, and you will not lose your way.

lines.image: seeing the light of the kingdom.
lines.reading: You see the shine of something larger than you, a place where things are done well. Go there as a guest, and let someone else be the host. Borrow their wide view to mend your own narrow one.

lines.image: looking at my own life through the people.
lines.reading: From a high place you look at your own life, and you see it best through the people who depend on you. Where they have gone wrong, look for the same fault in yourself first. Take their faults as your own, and you make no mistake.

lines.image: watched by everyone.
lines.reading: Everyone is watching you now, and you know it. Being watched keeps you from growing lazy, though it also keeps your mind from resting. Whatever you do is without blame if you do it in earnest. Take every step with care.

gene_keys.shadow:
Living on the surface of your own life is older than you are. An insect on a summer day is busy from the first warmth until dark, alive the whole time and aware of none of it. Much of a human day runs the same way. Your mind can only think in a line, from before to after, so each time you think you seem to leave the present. You still live in the present whether you like it or not. You only stop feeling it. Keeping busy then feels like being alive, though it is really a way of not being there.

It is painful to look back at the hurt you caused without noticing, or the dreams you left lying about. That is where the looking begins. At the end of a day, ask how much of it you were there for. Nothing is being judged. You are only seeing what is.
gene_keys.repressive: Their eyes go far away and seem to stare. A fear they cannot see freezes them, and for a while they have left their own body. Each time is a small death. It comes and goes with whatever the mind is doing.
gene_keys.reactive: The same fear goes straight into doing. They cannot stop moving, wrapped up in themselves and in the next thing to do. The world around them grows busier because of it. Most of what they do would simply stop if the mind went still.
gene_keys.gift:
Being looked after is the first feeling of this gift, as if something larger than you were keeping watch. That something is your own greater nature coming through. Life has its own plans, and you stop getting in their way. No method brings this; only life can show you how to let go. It rests on giving way rather than pushing, which makes it far more than confidence. Its seat is low in the belly. It grows through trust and patience. You let things come to you instead of chasing them down. This is a kind of holy laziness, and it is what lets you rest inside.

Criticism still comes, and you can take it in without falling over. Old habits come back and are let go again, slowly, achingly slowly. Life feels lighter, with a quiet humour inside it.
gene_keys.siddhi:
A leaf falls from a tree in autumn, and the leaf does not decide it. The tree lets it go. Presence is that letting go, and one day it happens to you. You do not decide it either. Life lets you go a little more each day, until nothing in you is holding on. You could sit in one place for three days and feel no time pass. A leaf or a stone in front of you holds more life than any idea you have. There is nothing to say about it, so you are silent.

Anyone can feel it near you. The air around you eases, breathing grows deeper, and soon the whole room breathes as one. Your gaze turns soft.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy sees clearly, and seeing alone moves nothing. Sublime Power holds what it lacks: the strength to act. Strength with no awareness in it becomes busyness that wrecks what it touches. Together they make right action, a deed that meets no resistance. Open it when you see what to do and still do not move.

human_design.gate: Gate 20 is the drive to act in the present, rather than planning ahead or going back over what is past. It carries a sense of timing, when to move and when to hold back, which is a different thing from haste. Waiting is part of it. While you wait, you sense what has to be set in motion behind the scenes, such as the right people or a skill to learn. When the moment is ripe, you move with all of your weight behind one act. In conversation your attention is undivided, and people feel it. The cost comes when you act too soon. You force what would have come on its own, then want to quit when it does not come.
human_design.centre:
The Throat Center sits in your throat, where what drives you turns into a word or a deed. It is the town square of the body, with eleven doors opening onto it from six other centres. It has no power of its own. It works like a gearbox, passing on whatever power is wired into it. Through Gate 20 your voice is strongest when you speak from the moment you are in.

About seven people in ten have this centre defined. They have steady use of their voice, in a tone that stays their own. The other three in ten have it open. As children they often spoke without being heard, so some went quiet and others got louder. Grown, they can meet each person in that person's own tone. They can say what a whole room feels and has not said.
human_design.channel: Gate 20 has three partners. With Gate 10 it becomes the voice of loving yourself as you are, right now. With Gate 34, the strongest power in the body, a word and an act become one deed. With Gate 57 you say what your instinct knows the moment it knows it. The moment turns into something done only when one of them joins it. Each may be in you or in someone close by.

tarot.ring_role: This energy watches, and a child learns by watching. It belongs to a family of six, the Ring of Life and Death. The other five are what a child needs to see you do. UL 27, Inner Majesty, carries the way you give. UL 42, Moving to Perfection, carries the way you let go. UL 24, Frequency Flutter, carries what you invent. UL 3, Messengers of the Infinite, carries the new things you try. UL 23, Beneath the Surface, carries how simply you live. This one carries your watching.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Its family and its two trigrams bring four of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, to this one.

body.physiology:
Now is the reason this energy is given to the brain stem. The brain stem is the stalk your brain sits on, just inside the base of your skull. It sets the pace of your breathing and the beat of your heart. It has done this since before you were born, through every night's sleep and every hour your mind was elsewhere. It keeps no memory and makes no plan. Your mind can be in last year or next week, while this part of you is in this breath. When your mind comes back to your body, it comes back to where the brain stem already was.

Count the breaths you have taken since you began reading. You decided none of them. Put a finger in the hollow at the back of your neck, just under the skull. A finger's length inside, behind the bone, is the part of you that is always in the present.
body.amino_acid:
The calm in you has a chemistry, and one substance in it is leucine. Your body cannot make it, so it has to come in from meat, milk or beans. Your body never turns it into sugar. It only burns it or builds you with it.

A child near you takes in what you are, more than anything you say. When you give without holding on, try new things and keep life simple, the child grows up sure of itself. Calm shares its chemistry in you with silence and with giving. It shares it too with a child's innocence and with celebration.

relations.unity_line: UL 19 is this card's pair and its inverse at once: the close look, where this one takes the wide view.

pair.teaching: This energy stands back and sees a life whole, and it runs out when seeing is all it does. Solection is where it goes next: coming close to the people who need warmth. Open it when you have looked long enough and it is time to go nearer. Watching from a height and coming near are two sides of one care.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy end for end and looking up becomes looking down with care. Solection is the same watch kept from above. Open it when people look to you and you need to go to them.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy sees clearly, and seeing alone moves nothing. Sublime Power holds what it lacks: the strength to act. Strength with no awareness in it becomes busyness that wrecks what it touches. Together they make right action, a deed that meets no resistance. Open it when you see what to do and still do not move.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Life and Death
codon_ring.teaching: This energy watches, and a child learns by watching. It belongs to a family of six, the Ring of Life and Death. The other five are what a child needs to see you do. UL 27, Inner Majesty, carries the way you give. UL 42, Moving to Perfection, carries the way you let go. UL 24, Frequency Flutter, carries what you invent. UL 3, Messengers of the Infinite, carries the new things you try. UL 23, Beneath the Surface, carries how simply you live. This one carries your watching.

tarot.teaching: Its family and its two trigrams bring four of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, to this one.

sky.teaching: the fixed water sign of death and rebirth, the depth in you that watches without looking away.

immortals.teaching: Wind above carries He Xian Gu, the one woman among the immortals, who holds a single lotus. Earth below carries Lan Cai He, the wandering singer who owns nothing and carries a basket of flowers. One shows you the quiet of standing still. The other shows you how lightly a life can be held.

hebrew_letter.teaching: a fish never closes its eyes, the way you can stay awake to your life as it moves.

cards.essence: When something is stuck and no one will decide, authority wakes in you. You feel it as a steadiness in your chest before you have said a word. You see what has to happen, you say it plainly, and you stand behind it. People settle when you speak, because they trust you to carry what follows.

glance.reading:
When something is stuck and no one will decide, authority wakes in you. You feel it as a steadiness in your chest before you have said a word. You see what has to happen, you say it plainly, and you stand behind it. People settle when you speak, because they trust you to carry what follows.

Some days you try to control everything around you, and by evening you are worn out. Under that grip is a fear that things will fall apart unless you hold them. Notice the fear and let one thing go its own way. Trust life to do some of the work, and your strength comes back.

Authority is given to you by people who trust you, and it cannot be taken. It grows as you stop needing to be in charge. Live in the balance between letting things go their own way and stepping in. Use it to serve the people who gave it to you. Then no one is above you or below you, and the people you lead work beside you.

iching.trigram_combination: Fire over Thunder is the hexagram of dealing with what stands in the way. Thunder is the strength in you that moves and acts. Fire is the clarity in you that tells one thing from another. The clarity sits above the strength because a blow struck before you can see lands in the wrong place. This hexagram has long been read as a mouth held open by something caught between the teeth. When something sits unsettled between you and another person, you cannot take anything in or speak freely either. Dealing with it lets the two of you come together again. You act well when you see clearly first.
iching.reading:
Something has come between you and the people you live or work with, and it will not go away by itself. Waiting will not move it, and talking around it will not either. It has to be dealt with, once and fairly. First look at it until you can see exactly what it is and how big it is. Then act, and make what you do fit the size of the wrong. Too little leaves it in place. Too much does harm of its own. Whatever you put right by force costs you something too, so try to settle it by talking first. When talking fails, be firm. Rules that everyone knows in advance save a great deal of trouble later.

Put your attention on your jaw for a moment. A jaw goes tight when something has to be dealt with and has not been. Once the matter is handled, the jaw closes and rests, and people can come together again.
judgement_lines: Biting through. It goes through, and there is success.
This is the time to let justice be done.
image_lines: Thunder and lightning: the image of biting through.
So the kings of old made the penalties clear and the laws firm.

upper_trigram.name: Fire (Li)
upper_trigram.nature: Glowing light spreading in all directions. The power of consciousness. Magical fire-bird. The middle daughter.

lower_trigram.name: Thunder (Chen)
lower_trigram.nature: Arousing power emerging from the depth of the earth. Excite, influence, move, affect. The eldest son.

lines.image: the feet held in the stocks, the toes hidden.
lines.reading: Your feet are held in the stocks, so you cannot walk any further. The mistake is small and it has been caught early. Being stopped now spares you a worse mistake later. Stay where you are and look at the way ahead before you take a step on it, and no blame comes of it.

lines.image: biting through soft meat, and the nose sinks in with it.
lines.reading: You bite into soft meat and your nose sinks in with it. The thing gave way so easily that you went further than you meant to. You are acting on something you only half understand. Go no further until you understand it, and there is no blame.

lines.image: chewing old dried meat, and finding poison in it.
lines.reading: You chew old dried meat and find something bad in it. An old matter turns out to be worse than it looked, and you took it on without the standing to finish it. It seemed right, and it was not, which brings a little shame. Stop, make it no worse, and no real harm is done.

lines.image: meat dried hard onto the bone, and a metal arrowhead in it.
lines.reading: You chew meat dried hard onto the bone and find an arrowhead in it. This is a fault that has sat for years, and getting it out is slow, hard work. Know how hard it is before you start. Stay honest and keep at it, and it turns out well.

lines.image: dried meat, and yellow gold found in it.
lines.reading: You chew dried meat and find yellow gold. You are the one who judges now, and your judgement is fair without being harsh. The power in your hands is real, and so is its danger. Stay upright and stay wary, and there is no blame.

lines.image: the heavy board locked around the neck, and the ears gone under it.
lines.reading: The heavy board is locked around your neck, and it covers your ears. You would not listen, and now you cannot hear any warning. Honest advice grates on the ears, and the trouble began there. If anyone is still telling you something you do not want to hear, listen to it now.

gene_keys.shadow: Everything you call yours is ground to be held, and the first ground is your own body. From there the line goes out around your family, your house, your money and your country. Under it is the oldest fear there is, that one day you will simply stop existing. So you take up the sword and hack at life to keep it in line, and life hits back. The grip works for a while. Rule people by force and you get your way for a time, and then it all comes apart. Too much discipline makes people rebel, and too little leaves everything loose. Here the one who controls and the one who is controlled both lose. What drives it all is a distrust of life itself. Hold on tight for long enough and you find you were only ever fighting yourself.
gene_keys.repressive: This person hands the wheel to someone else, or to life, then blames life for where it goes. They call it being easygoing. Underneath, they are afraid to be the one who answers for what happens. They would rather not take part at all.
gene_keys.reactive: Here the anger is coiled so tight that nothing nearby is allowed to move on its own. Change is bearable only if they started it. Cross one of their lines and everything held in goes off at once. The strain lands on the heart, and often only a real crisis brings them down.
gene_keys.gift:
Strength of this kind comes from giving up control, never from taking more of it. The sword you were handed is rusty, the horse is old and the odds are against you. That is the test, and it is the size you can meet. Meet each one with honesty and care, and the sword starts to shine where people can see it. Loyalty won through fear moves elsewhere the moment it can. Loyalty won through love stays, because there is more love in you than fear.

At its best the one in charge serves, and the one who serves is trusted with charge. Neither is under the other, and the two of you work with a power neither had alone. In time people come toward you, drawn by the same light they want in themselves.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Valour is courage with love in it, and it is what is left once no one in you needs to be in charge. You see something noble in the other person, even the one you cannot stand, and you bow to it. In an old story a young king wins a fight, then hands his sword to the man he beat. When you win and still bow to the one you beat, you gain their loyalty for life. The sword that once hacked is used to heal.

People who live this never feel like an authority, and they meet you as a friend. Threaten what they love, though, and they fight with everything they have.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy takes charge, and it grips hardest when it feels it is not enough. Doorways of the Unknown holds that feeling of not being enough, and the wisdom that fills it. Every tyrant feels inadequate underneath, and so does everyone who only follows. Open it when you catch yourself gripping and cannot say why.

human_design.gate:
Gate 21 is the drive to manage what you have, from your money and your time to the people who rely on you. It wants a say in how each of these is run. It is known as the hunter and the treasurer, the one who brings in what is needed and then keeps count of it. At its best it starts with you. You give yourself the rest and the limits you need, and act from there.

When fear takes over, you feel you have to earn your place. You take on too much and work for support you could simply accept. The challenge here is to let go of outcomes and of managing other people. What is left is a calm in the middle of your own storm.
human_design.centre:
The Will Center sits in the chest and gives you energy for the material world, for work, money and what you own. It carries the feeling of "I can do this." It works in bursts and then rests, and pushed past its rest it burns out.

Nearly four people in ten have it defined. They can say what they will do and then do it. A kept promise feels good to them, and testing themselves is a kind of play. Their sense of their own worth grows with each thing done. Their risk is burnout, or impatience with people who cannot simply decide.

The other six have it open, and their will comes and goes with the people near them. Beside someone with a defined will they feel able to do anything, and the feeling leaves when that person does. They can doubt their own value and soak up other people's sense of being worth little. Some spend years proving a worth that is not in question. Their gift is to know what is truly worth doing, and to have nothing to prove.
human_design.channel: Gate 21 manages what there is, and it has no voice of its own. Gate 45 in the Throat Center gives it one, the voice of whoever speaks for the group and shares out what it has. Together they make the Channel of Money. It gives the people around it the sense that someone is at the helm, who will make the hard calls and can be counted on. Gate 45 may be in you or in someone close to you.

tarot.ring_role: This energy decides for others, where the oldest wound between people begins. It belongs to a family of six, the Ring of Humanity, which tells the story every person lives. UL 25, The Mysteries Play, carries the wound you are born with. UL 38, Inner Light Symphony, carries the fight with your shadow. UL 17, Pearl of Christos, carries getting past your own mind. UL 10, Internal Treasure, carries finding yourself. UL 51, Unshakable Arrival, carries waking up. This one carries letting go of the need to run life.
tarot.tarot_resonance: The ring and the two trigrams give this card five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana.

body.physiology:
The breath out is the reason this energy is given to your lungs. You just let one go, and you will let the next one go without deciding to. Your lungs take the air of the room across a wall thinner than paper, and a moment later it is in your blood. Breathing is the one thing in your body your will can take over. You can hold a breath, slow it, or shape it into words. You cannot keep the hold. Within a minute or two your body takes the breath back, whatever you decide. That is where your say over your own body ends.

Your lungs have no muscle of their own, and your ribs move them. Breathe all the way out and wait, and the next breath comes without you. Even after the hardest breath out, about a litre of air stays inside. Your lungs have not been empty since your first breath.
body.amino_acid:
Leading and being led have a chemistry in you, and one substance in it is arginine. Your body makes it for itself, and more comes in with meat, beans or nuts. It is one of the twenty pieces every protein in you is built from. It is also the last step by which your body turns the nitrogen it cannot use into waste and lets it go.

Rank is one of the oldest wounds between people, one above and one below, and only love heals it. Your body carries the same substance whether you lead or follow. When the one in charge serves and the one who serves is trusted, the difference between them starts to fade.

relations.unity_line: UL 22 is this card's pair and its inverse at once: the grace that follows a hard decision, where this one makes it.

pair.teaching: This energy settles what stands between people, and it runs out once the matter is settled and feelings are still raw. Treasure of the Way is where it goes next: the grace that gives everyone their dignity after a hard call. Open it when the decision is made and people still need warmth from you.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy end for end and the firm hand becomes a gracious one. Treasure of the Way is the same meeting seen from the side that softens it. Open it when you have been firm for long enough and the people near you need gentleness.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy takes charge, and it grips hardest when it feels it is not enough. Doorways of the Unknown holds that feeling of not being enough, and the wisdom that fills it. Every tyrant feels inadequate underneath, and so does everyone who only follows. Open it when you catch yourself gripping and cannot say why.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Humanity
codon_ring.teaching: This energy decides for others, where the oldest wound between people begins. It belongs to a family of six, the Ring of Humanity, which tells the story every person lives. UL 25, The Mysteries Play, carries the wound you are born with. UL 38, Inner Light Symphony, carries the fight with your shadow. UL 17, Pearl of Christos, carries getting past your own mind. UL 10, Internal Treasure, carries finding yourself. UL 51, Unshakable Arrival, carries waking up. This one carries letting go of the need to run life.

tarot.teaching: The ring and the two trigrams give this card five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana.

sky.teaching: the crab that carries its home on its back, the ground you look after and guard wherever you go.

immortals.teaching: Fire above carries Lu Dong Bin, the scholar whose sword cuts through his own false beliefs, as your clarity can cut through yours. Thunder below carries Cao Guo Jiu, who left the court and the power he was born into. He is the rank you can set down when you no longer need it.

hebrew_letter.teaching: a fence round a field, which can keep people out or keep safe what you look after.

cards.essence: A strong feeling comes up in you while someone else is in the room. Graciousness lives in what you do next. You feel it whole in your body, the joy or the grief or the anger. The people with you are treated kindly all the same, and near you they feel listened to.

glance.reading:
A strong feeling comes up in you while someone else is in the room. Graciousness lives in what you do next. You feel it whole in your body, the joy or the grief or the anger. The people with you are treated kindly all the same, and near you they feel listened to.

Some days a low mood arrives for no reason you can find, and you want someone to blame. Let it pass through you without putting it on anyone, and it is gone within minutes. Decide nothing big until it has passed.

Say what you feel when the mood is with you, and wait when it is not. Say a hard thing kindly, at a time it can be heard. What you have lived through becomes a treasure, and it shows in the way you treat people. You grow grateful for whatever each day brings, and people turn to you when their own feelings run high.

iching.trigram_combination: Mountain over Fire is the hexagram of how what is inside you shows on the outside. Fire is the clarity in you that sees each thing plainly. Mountain is the steadiness in you that stays as it is, whatever light falls on it. The clarity sits inside and the steadiness outside, because you see a great deal and show only a little of it. This hexagram has long been read as a fire at the foot of a mountain. Its light makes the hillside beautiful at dusk, and the rock underneath does not change. So the light is enough for the small matters of a day, never for settling a serious dispute. What you show is beautiful when it comes from what you are.
iching.reading:
Things are going well enough, and how they look matters now. A kind word or a tidy room helps, and each is a small thing. Take care over the outside of things, and let it show what is truly there. The beauty is real, and it changes nothing underneath.

Use it for the small matters of the day. Do not settle anything serious by how it looks, because a decision made on the surface will not hold. Let what is solid lead and the beauty follow. If you want more than small gains, learn and live more, a little each day. What you know becomes your beauty, and what you live through becomes your grace.

Your eyes do the work now, and your hands stay still. Take in every detail of what is in front of you, and hold off from reaching for it. Sit the way someone sits looking at a hillside at dusk.
judgement_lines: Grace has success. In small matters it is good to set out.
Let what shows take the lead, and little comes of it.
image_lines: Fire at the foot of the mountain: the image of grace.
So the wise bring clarity to the day's affairs, and dare not decide a serious dispute by it.

upper_trigram.name: Mountain (Ken)
upper_trigram.nature: Limit, frontier, stillness. Solid, steady, unshakable. The youngest son.

lower_trigram.name: Fire (Li)
lower_trigram.nature: Glowing light spreading in all directions. The power of consciousness. Magical fire-bird. The middle daughter.

lines.image: the feet adorned; the carriage left standing, and the walk begun.
lines.reading: Your feet are dressed well, and you leave the carriage and walk. You could ride, and today riding is not yours to do. Start low, on your own two feet, with nothing borrowed. Let the outside of you wait while the inside grows. Walk, and be content to walk.

lines.image: the beard adorned, and it moves only with the chin.
lines.reading: You tend your beard, and a beard moves only when the chin moves. What you add has no life of its own; it goes where the thing under it goes. Your own understanding has a limit. Stay close to someone wiser than you and rise with them. Be patient, the way hair takes its time to grow.

lines.image: adorned and wet with dew; firmness kept through it.
lines.reading: Everything around you shines, as if wet with dew, and favour comes your way. It came from where you happen to stand as much as from anything you did. The shine that lasts comes from what is true in you, the way water sparkles by itself. Stay true through the whole good time, and no one can slight you.

lines.image: adorned or plain; a white horse coming as if on wings, not a robber but a suitor.
lines.reading: You cannot tell whether to dress this up or leave it plain. Something comes at you fast, a white horse that seems to have wings. For a moment it looks like an attack. It is someone who wants to join you. Ask plainly what they want, and welcome what comes in good faith.

lines.image: grace among hills and gardens; a roll of silk, small, slight.
lines.reading: You go up to a garden on the hill with a small roll of plain silk. It is less than the day seems to ask, and you feel the shame of it. A small gift that is meant is worth more than a lavish one that is not. Give what you truly have, and it ends in joy.

lines.image: white grace, with nothing added to it.
lines.reading: At the end the colour is gone, and only plain white is left. This plainness is what all the beauty was for, and it grows clearer as you get older. Wear only what is true of you, and what you set out for is yours.

gene_keys.shadow:
Discomfort comes, and the first thing you do is look for its cause outside you. You blame the weather, or more often another person. That is where dishonour starts, and it starts with you. Every time you refuse the way you feel, you dishonour yourself. Put your mood on someone else, and you dishonour both of you at once.

Think of your feelings as the strings of an instrument that hears everything. At this height the strings are out of tune, so whatever comes near sounds wrong. You try to fix your mood or change it, when it only needs to pass through. Every feeling is there to be trusted, and trusting it is not the same as acting on it. Nothing you do goes unheard, and what you send out comes back to you.
gene_keys.repressive: Held in, it looks like good manners. These people are calm, correct and at ease in company. Underneath, the feeling seethes, and they may carry lust or resentment nobody would guess. What they fear most is losing control. Left to stew, what they hold back can one day burst out.
gene_keys.reactive: Let out, it spills onto everyone. These people cannot hold back their reactions and wear their hearts on their sleeves. Many make fine art or music, while their private lives lie in pieces. Above all they cannot listen, to others or to themselves, so even their good intentions come at the wrong time.
gene_keys.gift:
Graciousness grows once your feelings are your own. You live fully and hold nothing back, and you still consider how the people around you feel. You express what you feel safely and disrespect no one, yourself included. Nobody else's mood makes a victim of you either. When someone close to you is low and puts it on you, you feel for them and stay clear of it.

Now the strings are in tune, and people feel listened to around you. You know that an unkindness done to someone comes back, so you treat everyone with dignity, however they behave. This is tested all your life, and each test refines it. You learn to be careful without being fearful, warm without being overbearing, and candid without being cruel. In time you grow grateful for whatever comes.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Grace comes down on you, and you cannot make it happen. It can be a small moment. A tiny bird with a gold stripe on its head stops you on a morning walk, and you carry it all day. Moments like this lift you when you have fallen. You prepare for them by meeting each fall openly, because grace is hidden inside every low.

When it stays, your life is no longer yours to steer. You are the instrument, and something greater plays you. Fear ends for good, and every feeling turns into love. Whoever meets you feels it and never forgets it.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy owns each feeling as it comes. Garden of Alchemy holds what it lacks: the old weight you were born carrying, which changes into something new when you face it. Graciousness is how you face it, one honest feeling at a time. Open it when a sadness feels older than your own life.

human_design.gate: Gate 22 sits in the pit of your stomach and wants to be heard. What you feel presses to be taken in by another person. Its fear is speaking and not being heard, and when the fear wins you go silent. It follows your mood. When the mood is right, you say what you feel with depth, and people are moved. When it is not, you want no company, and nothing is wrong with that. It has a sense of timing, knowing when to speak and when to listen. Held back out of fear, it settles for less than it wants.
human_design.centre:
