The Emotional Solar Plexus Center is where your feelings are made. It is the only centre that both drives you and lets you know things. What you feel moves in a wave, from hope down to pain and back. So there is no truth in the moment here, and a decision waits until the wave has passed.

A little more than half of people have this centre defined. With this gate their wave is passionate and moody. It runs mostly level, with short bursts up and down. Its low end holds a sadness with great wisdom in it, if it can be borne. They do well to spend the low alone, writing or playing music. The rest have it open. They take in the feelings of everyone near them and feel them louder, as if they were their own. Alone again, the feelings fade. They can be nice to avoid upsetting anyone, until they stop saying what is true.
human_design.channel: A feeling on its own stays in the stomach. In the throat sits Gate 12, the caution about when and how a feeling is said. Together they make the Channel of Openness, which turns what you feel into words that move other people. Gate 12 may be in you or in someone close, and the feeling finds its words only when both are present.

tarot.ring_role: This energy meets pain with kindness, and its family is built around suffering that opens you. It belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Divinity. UL 36, Crystal Creation, carries the dark stretch that tests you. UL 37, Journey Home, carries the warmth of the family you belong to. UL 63, Adornments of Time, carries the question that will not let you go. This one carries grace.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, arrive through the ring and the two trigrams.

body.physiology:
A catch under the breastbone is the reason this energy is given to the solar plexus. Bad news comes, and in the first second something catches there, before you have a word for it. Your breath stops for a beat. Then the feeling either rises to your throat and is said, or it stays where it landed. Held there, fear settles in as tension through your whole body. Let through, it leaves your body at rest.

The solar plexus is a knot of nerves on the front of your spine, behind the stomach. It is two knots, each the size of a fingertip, with fibres going out like the rays of a sun. Lay a hand flat in the soft hollow below your breastbone and take a sharp breath in. The hollow pushes out against your hand. About a hand's depth behind it is where you feel things before you know them.
body.amino_acid:
The feeling that comes over you has a chemistry, and one substance in it is proline. Every protein in you is built from twenty pieces, and your body makes this one itself, from another of the twenty. You never need to eat it.

At its fullest this energy comes down into you and fills the whole of you. It floods you the way a woman early in pregnancy is flooded and made ready. Your body is readied, low in the belly, for something that has not yet arrived. What fills you then was made inside you and never taken in from outside. Three other energies in you share this chemistry.

relations.unity_line: UL 21 is this card's pair and its inverse at once: the bite that clears what is in the way, where this one shows what is there with care.

pair.teaching: This energy keeps the peace and lets each feeling pass, and it runs out where something has to be stopped. Beyond Binary is where it goes next: the will that takes charge and bites through what is in the way. Open it when kindness is not enough and a situation needs a firm hand. A kind word lasts when there is strength behind it.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy upside down and the soft touch becomes the bite. Beyond Binary cuts down to what matters, where this energy shows it beautifully. Open it when what you are showing needs to be cleared away first.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy owns each feeling as it comes. Garden of Alchemy holds what it lacks: the old weight you were born carrying, which changes into something new when you face it. Graciousness is how you face it, one honest feeling at a time. Open it when a sadness feels older than your own life.

codon_ring.name: Codon Ring of Divinity
codon_ring.teaching: This energy meets pain with kindness, and its family is built around suffering that opens you. It belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Divinity. UL 36, Crystal Creation, carries the dark stretch that tests you. UL 37, Journey Home, carries the warmth of the family you belong to. UL 63, Adornments of Time, carries the question that will not let you go. This one carries grace.

tarot.teaching: Five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, arrive through the ring and the two trigrams.

sky.teaching: the fixed earth that loves what is beautiful and takes its time with it, as you do.

immortals.teaching: Mountain above carries Zhang Guo Lao, the old immortal who rides his donkey facing backwards. Fire below carries Lu Dong Bin, the scholar who turned his sword on his own delusion. One looks back over the road you have travelled, and the other cuts through any false show you put on. Your grace needs both.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the nail that joins one thing to another, the way what you show stays fixed to what you are.

cards.essence: Beneath all that a life piles up, there is one thing that matters, and clarity is how you find it. You feel it first as ease in your body. Worry drops away, and you breathe freely. A problem you have carried for days turns out to be simple. You cut through the rest and say the point in a few plain words.

glance.reading:
Beneath all that a life piles up, there is one thing that matters, and clarity is how you find it. You feel it first as ease in your body. Worry drops away, and you breathe freely. A problem you have carried for days turns out to be simple. You cut through the rest and say the point in a few plain words.

Some days your mind will not trust a plain answer, because a plain answer gives it nothing to think about. It wraps the answer in more, and the more it adds, the more anxious you feel. Then leave the problem alone and cook or dig, and your rhythm comes back.

Before each choice, ask whether it will make your life simpler. Look around your home for what is neither useful nor beautiful, and give it away. Eat when you are hungry, drink when you are thirsty, and stop when you have had enough. Your days open up, and people understand you the first time.

iching.trigram_combination: Mountain over Earth is the hexagram of what falls away. Earth is the part of you that gives way and carries whatever is put on it. Mountain is the part of you that stands firm and stops. The firm part sits on top because everything you have built rests on what holds it up. This hexagram has long been read as a tall mountain on too narrow a base, wearing away into the plain. What wears away first in your life is what you stand on. When the extra falls away, you see what was holding you up.
iching.reading:
Something you relied on is falling away, and it started low, where you were not looking. What was added for show goes first. Then whatever has the least beneath it begins to tip. It is the end of a season, and the change creeps up slowly from below.

Do not set out for anywhere now. Stay low and keep still, and do not argue with what is pulling at you. Give to the people who hold you up, since a height stands only on its base. What is against you is stronger than you for now, and it will pass. The turn back comes after it, so let it pass without bitterness.

Keep your feet where they are, and let the ground settle under them. Sit the way a mountain sits on the plain, low, wide and still.
judgement_lines: Splitting apart. The worn form comes away.
It does not help to set out anywhere now.
image_lines: The mountain rests on the earth: the image of falling away.
So those above keep their place by giving generously to those below.

upper_trigram.name: Mountain (Ken)
upper_trigram.nature: Limit, frontier, stillness. Solid, steady, unshakable. The youngest son.

lower_trigram.name: Earth (K'un)
lower_trigram.nature: Surface of the world, support of all existence. Essential Yin. Rest, receptivity.

lines.image: the legs of the bed splintered from below.
lines.reading: The legs of your bed give way, and the damage starts where it looks small. Someone has struck at what holds you up. Standing firm against it now is what breaks. Do not answer, and do not dig in. Keep still, keep quiet, and find the people who are still with you.

lines.image: the frame of the bed splintered, the legs already gone.
lines.reading: After the legs, the frame of the bed splits. The damage is closer now, and nobody has come to stand with you yet. You will want to show your authority, and a hard stance only brings the loss faster. Give way, stay soft, and watch how far it has reached.

lines.image: stripping, and no fault in it.
lines.reading: You stand among the ones pulling things down, and you belong with what still stands. Parting from the people on either side of you costs you, and there is no fault in it. Keep your loyalty quiet for now, and let the parting happen.

lines.image: the stripping reaches the skin of the one on the bed.
lines.reading: The splitting reaches the skin of the one lying on the bed. The danger is no longer near; it is here. Every crack before this was a warning, and this is the last. Nothing can be mended now, only saved. Go soft and go now.

lines.image: a string of fish, led into the favour of the house.
lines.reading: One fish leads and the rest follow, strung on one line, and the tide turns. The people who seem to hold no power hold the most. Go around rather than through. Win them one at a time, and nothing works against you.

lines.image: the great fruit left uneaten, its seed inside.
lines.reading: A large fruit hangs uneaten at the top, with its seed still inside. Whoever keeps the seed is carried again by the very people who seemed to be tearing things down. Whoever eats it pulls the roof off their own house. Keep the seed, because the turn back is already inside the falling.

gene_keys.shadow:
A mind that wants to feel safe makes things complicated. The harder it tries to control the world, the more tangled and unsafe the world becomes. In cloud a pilot sees nothing and flies in circles looking for a way out. The mind circles the same way around a simple question. You cannot give a straight reply, even when someone asks for one word, and the listener backs away.

It is never the words. It is the tone under them. If even a trace of fear drives what you say, nobody can take it in, however fine the words are. Under it is a fear of being shut out, and the fear brings about the very thing it fears.
gene_keys.repressive: Choked by fear, the words stop coming. You learn young, often under a strict parent, that saying what you think costs too much. So you go quiet, or keep to small talk. Other people take the silence for slowness, and it is fear holding the words in.
gene_keys.reactive: The talk never stops, and the timing is always a little off. You say the wrong thing, or the right thing at the wrong moment, and explain it twice. Each try to be heard pushes people further away. Under the circling is anger at not being understood.
gene_keys.gift:
Simplicity is a knack more than a skill, and it cannot really be taught. Above the cloud you see further, and you hear only what matters while the noise drops away. Your rooms have space in them. You are good with money because you know where not to waste it. People relax around you, and the problems they brought seem to dissolve. You watch in silence until the answer jumps out, then you say it. It is often funny and catches a whole moment in one line.

Inside, the clearing goes on for years. Your thoughts start to have gaps between them, and your feelings are let run their course. You stop needing to settle everything. When you say no, you say it with grace, and a yes sits inside it.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Quintessence is what is left when you boil something down to its heart, then boil that heart down again. Beyond the cloud there is only silence. Each thought you do not need splits apart, and what remains speaks through you. A person living this touches the gold in other people with a word or a look, without knowing they do it.

You cannot get here by trying. You find it by mistake, once you have stopped seeking and let yourself wonder. When you speak from here, the pauses between your words say as much as the words. You come to see your life and its ending at the heart of each other.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy says a thing plainly, and it needs something true to say. Cipher of Knowledge holds what it lacks: the insight that arrives whole, with no way to explain it. One is clear hearing and the other is clear saying, and each is deaf without its partner. Open it when you have the plain words and nothing new to put in them.

human_design.gate:
Gate 23 is the drive to take something complicated, break it down and say it in a way nobody has said it before. You know things ahead of the proof and ahead of the room. So you can feel like an outsider until the others catch up. Everything turns on the hour. Said too early, to people who are not ready, the truest thing you know sounds like a need to be right. Then you feel bitter and unseen, and you wonder why nobody sees what is obvious to you.

Broken down too far, a thing loses what mattered in it, so the work is to make it small without making it less. Trust what you know before you can explain it. The people who are ready will ask.
human_design.centre:
The Throat Center is where everything in you is trying to get out. Eleven roads from six other centres run into it, so almost everything in you is pressing to get out here. It has no power of its own. It works like a gearbox, and whichever part of you is joined to it speaks through it. Joined to the mind, as this gate is, you speak what you think once you are invited. Its rule is that a thing is said before it is done.

About seven in ten have this centre defined, and their voice keeps one steady tone all their life. The other three in ten have it open. As children they were often not heard, and grew up either quiet or loud. Their words arrive of their own accord and often say what the whole room would not. They can wear themselves out trying to be heard. Their gift is to speak for the room once they have been asked.
human_design.channel: Gate 43, in the mind, is the insight that arrives with no way to explain it. Joined to Gate 23 it makes the Channel of Structuring, which turns that insight into words another person can follow. On its own, this gate has nothing fixed to say. Gate 43 may be in you or in a person close by, and the knowing gets out only when both are present.

tarot.ring_role: This energy keeps what matters and lets the rest fall away. It belongs to a family of six, the Ring of Life and Death, which holds the plainest truths about a life. Messengers of the Infinite shows you that everything changes, and Emerging as the Code that what is real is this moment. Frequency Flutter shows you that things begin again, Inner Majesty the good in your heart, and Moving to Perfection how to let go. This one gathers them into a simple life.
tarot.tarot_resonance: The ring and the two trigrams bring five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, each a way you meet this energy.

body.physiology:
The pause is the reason this energy is given to the throat. Every breath in parts the two small folds in your throat, and while they stay apart you cannot make a word. They close for sound and part again for the next breath. So you build every sentence between breaths, and you never choose the gaps. Lay a hand on your throat and breathe in, and it goes still under your fingers. Say a long sentence and it stops where your breath runs out.

Just below your voice sits the gland that sets the pace of your whole body. Its hormone goes into each cell and works there, out of sight, so what it did this morning shows only hours or days later. The timing that decides whether your words suit the listener works the same way, below anything you can watch.
body.amino_acid:
The simplicity in you has a chemistry, and leucine is part of it. Your body cannot make it. It has to come in with food such as meat, milk or beans. It is part of every protein in your body. Your muscles take it apart themselves instead of sending it to the liver.

You share this chemistry with five other energies, and what they share is the plainest fact there is. Everything alive in you is changing, and everything that changes comes to an end. Its essence is not in your head. It sits deep in your belly, at the centre of all your centres.

relations.unity_line: UL 24 is this card's pair and its inverse: the new start that grows from what was kept when everything else fell away.

pair.teaching: This energy strips a thing back to what matters, and it runs out when there is nothing left to take away. Frequency Flutter is where it goes next: the return, where something starts again from the one seed that was kept. Open it when everything extra has gone and you are wondering what comes now. After the falling away comes the turn back.

inverse.teaching: This energy strips a thing back to what matters, and it runs out when there is nothing left to take away. Frequency Flutter is where it goes next: the return, where something starts again from the one seed that was kept. Open it when everything extra has gone and you are wondering what comes now. After the falling away comes the turn back.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy says a thing plainly, and it needs something true to say. Cipher of Knowledge holds what it lacks: the insight that arrives whole, with no way to explain it. One is clear hearing and the other is clear saying, and each is deaf without its partner. Open it when you have the plain words and nothing new to put in them.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Life and Death
codon_ring.teaching: This energy keeps what matters and lets the rest fall away. It belongs to a family of six, the Ring of Life and Death, which holds the plainest truths about a life. Messengers of the Infinite shows you that everything changes, and Emerging as the Code that what is real is this moment. Frequency Flutter shows you that things begin again, Inner Majesty the good in your heart, and Moving to Perfection how to let go. This one gathers them into a simple life.

tarot.teaching: The ring and the two trigrams bring five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, each a way you meet this energy.

sky.teaching: the fixed water sign of endings and renewal, for the times when something in you has to end.

immortals.teaching: Mountain above carries Zhang Guo Lao, the old immortal who rode his donkey facing backward. You can look back at what has fallen away in the same way, without going after it. Earth below carries Lan Cai He, the wanderer with a basket of flowers who owned nothing. Keep little, and you have little to lose.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the fish that stays alive in moving water, the way you stay whole while everything changes.

cards.essence: Invention comes alive in you when you go back to something you know well. You return to an old problem or a habit and turn it over once more. Then your thinking goes quiet for a moment. In that pause an idea is there that you could never have planned. It often comes while you rest or sleep, and it surprises you as much as anyone. It lifts you, and the old weight falls away.

glance.reading:
Invention comes alive in you when you go back to something you know well. You return to an old problem or a habit and turn it over once more. Then your thinking goes quiet for a moment. In that pause an idea is there that you could never have planned. It often comes while you rest or sleep, and it surprises you as much as anyone. It lifts you, and the old weight falls away.

Sometimes the quiet feels empty, even like falling. You reach for your phone or for something to do, and the same old round starts again. When that happens, stay a little longer. The empty feeling passes, and it is the room a new idea needs.

Be honest that you do not know, and let the question rest. Go back to an old hurt and look for what it gave you. When a new way appears, take one step with it, then take the same step next time until it is how you live. Each time you come round, you come round a note higher.

iching.trigram_combination: Earth over Thunder is the hexagram of coming back after the lowest point. Thunder is the part of you that starts to move again. Earth is the part of you that takes in what comes and lets it grow. The movement sits under the ground because a return starts out of sight, long before anything shows. This hexagram has long been read as thunder inside the earth at midwinter. On the shortest day the fields look dead, and the days are already getting longer. The same turn happens when you find your way back after a wrong turn. You come back to yourself before anyone can see it.
iching.reading:
A long decline has reached its end, and the turn has come. Nothing on the surface shows it yet. The light comes back on its own, the way the days lengthen after midwinter. No effort of yours brought it, and none can hurry it.

What has just come back is small, so keep it close. On the shortest day the rulers closed the gates, and even traders stayed at home. Rest, look after your own people, and spend no strength on the wider world for now. Come and go without strain. Friends will find you, and no one is at fault. The turn comes round in its own time, and once it has come it is good to have somewhere to go.

Part of this return happens by itself. The other part is your care in keeping it. Move your body a little each day, because the mind moves with it. Then stand still in your own centre and let the turn come to you.
judgement_lines: Return. It goes through, and grows.
Going out and coming in, nothing harms. Friends come, and no one is at fault.
To and fro goes the way. On the seventh day, the return. It is good to have somewhere to go.
image_lines: Thunder in the middle of the earth: the year turns.
So the old kings closed the passes at the solstice. Merchants and travellers stayed home, and the ruler did not go out to view the land.

upper_trigram.name: Earth (K'un)
upper_trigram.nature: Surface of the world, support of all existence. Essential Yin. Rest, receptivity.

lower_trigram.name: Thunder (Chen)
lower_trigram.nature: Arousing power emerging from the depth of the earth. Excite, influence, move, affect. The eldest son.

lines.image: return from a short way off, before there is anything to regret.
lines.reading: You have gone only a step off your path, and you turn back at once. Nothing has hardened yet, so there is nothing to regret. Put a small mistake right the moment you see it. The first to turn back is the safest.

lines.image: a figure leaning on a tree to rest, then coming back.
lines.reading: You rest a while, like someone leaning on a tree, then come back quietly. What makes this return good is staying close to people steadier than you. Where your own knowing runs short, borrow theirs. Come back beside them, and feel no shame in it.

lines.image: returning over and over, the whetstone that sharpens by friction.
lines.reading: You find the way back, lose it and find it again. Going back and forth is hard, and it is not wrong. Each loss works on you like a whetstone and sharpens your will to return. An old matter you left unsettled is back now. Meet it and decide.

lines.image: walking in the middle of the road, turning back alone while the others go on.
lines.reading: You walk in the middle of a crowd, and you alone turn back. Your way is not theirs, and nothing is wrong with either. Their direction cannot tell you yours. Keep to your own path, even when you walk it alone.

lines.image: the sincere return, made from the centre, with nothing to repent.
lines.reading: You come back honestly, from the centre of yourself, and look at what you did. Knowing what went wrong is only the start. Act on what you know, and you will have nothing to regret.

lines.image: lost in the return, bewitched; the army marches and is broken.
lines.reading: You miss the moment to turn and go on, lost and sure you are right. Anything pushed from here fails, like an army sent out with no purpose. The damage takes years to mend. Stop, and find out why you are going before you take another step.

gene_keys.shadow:
A mind finds a few tunes it likes and plays them for the rest of its life. There are many keys in you, and most days you play the same handful. Your thoughts follow the same routes, and your life follows them too. Every so often the tune stops, for a second or for a week. In that gap you meet your own discomfort with nothing in the way. Most people fill it fast, with a drink, a screen or more work. Then the old tune starts again.

That is why a new town or a new partner changes so little. The same scene plays out with new faces. Your hope moves into the future, and nothing outside you can end what runs inside. What begins to change it is noticing that you are in it. The moment you see the pattern, a pause has opened.
gene_keys.repressive: Some people meet the gap by going still. Fear locks them up, and the energy drains out of their body. Their view of the world narrows until it feels small and guarded. They shrink from the empty moment, so nothing new can take root in it.
gene_keys.reactive: Others meet the same gap by speeding up. They cannot sit still, so they work late and take chances. Their fear turns into activity. The busyness hides the one thing that was about to happen inside them.
gene_keys.gift:
Invention is what arrives when you stay in the gap. The gaps open for everyone, and once you meet one it is not frightening at all. You catch yourself reaching to fill it, and you stay instead. Then anything can happen. A great tennis player does this under pressure, with a shot nobody could have trained against. What comes surprises you as much as anyone.

It comes most often at rest, while you sit quietly, dream or do nothing. You think a problem over along the usual routes, and then something shifts and you see it whole. The same tune comes round, a note higher each time. It asks one honesty of you, to say you do not know and may never know.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Silence is what is left when the thinking stops for good. It is the quiet of a night sky, full of light. It comes down on you, though it was inside you all along. Your centre drops from your head into your belly. You stop doing the thinking, and life does it through you.

The last habit goes with it, the belief that you are separate from life. Your body will come and go, as every body does. The silence between the notes is the one thing that keeps coming back.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy keeps returning to its own patterns, and alone it sees only the loops of one life. Sophia's Orchestra holds what it lacks: every life woven into one great pattern, with yours in it. Open it when your going back has turned lonely. Your loops are threads in something larger.

human_design.gate:
Gate 24 is the need to know why. It sends your mind back over the same ground, an old hurt or an unsolved problem, to see what it missed. From outside this can look like being stuck. It is how this kind of mind works, by going back rather than going on. Each time round it can find something new.

Its trouble is that it can talk itself into anything. Faced with an old pain, it can build a story in which settling for less makes sense. The story feels like protection and does the damage. At its best it goes back to the pain on purpose and finds the blessing in it. Then it tells the story again with that inside it. The answers it cannot think of are waiting in the gaps between thoughts.
human_design.centre:
Gate 24 sits in the Ajna Center, the part of your mind just behind your forehead. This centre takes what presses in from above and makes sense of it. It keeps what it learns as beliefs and memories. It cannot act on anything by itself, and it can only see and sort.

About half of people have this centre defined. They can count on their mind, hold on to what they learn and stay steady among other people's opinions. Their trap is certainty, believing a thought because it is theirs.

In the rest the centre is open. Ideas come and go, and a question can meet a blank. Such a mind borrows thoughts from the people around it and loses them when those people leave. It may grip its thoughts to feel steady, like a driver clutching the wheel, and that makes it less safe. Held lightly, the same mind can see a whole situation at once.
human_design.channel: Gate 61, at the crown, is the pressure to know what cannot be known. Joined with Gate 24 it makes the Channel of Awareness, a mind that keeps making sense of life's mysteries. It is built to keep refining what it finds, and never to land on a final answer. Gate 61 may be in you or in a person close by. The going back finds its way out only when both are there.

tarot.ring_role: This energy goes back to the gap where one cycle ends and the next begins. It belongs to a family of six, the Ring of Life and Death, and between them they hold one whole life of yours. Your first breath is in Messengers of the Infinite, and your watching in Emerging as the Code. Your clearing out is in Beneath the Surface, your feeding in Inner Majesty and your finishing in Moving to Perfection. This one holds your turn at the bottom, when you start again. Open the one whose season you are in.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, stand near this energy.

body.physiology:
This energy is given to the neocortex, the outer sheet of the brain, and the reason is the path. Everything you learn is a route worn into that sheet. A route used once is faint. A route used a thousand times becomes a road you take without thinking, and routes you stop using fade. That is why your second try is easier than your first. The old thoughts you keep returning to are roads like this. Something you know well even uses less of the sheet than it did while you were learning it.

Sign your name, then sign it with the other hand. The first is a road worn over years. The second has no road at all, and you feel the difference at once. A new road in you is made the way the old one was, one step taken again.
body.amino_acid:
This energy has a chemistry in you, and the substance is leucine. Your body cannot make it, so it has to come from food such as meat, beans or corn. Corn is full of it and short of what beans have, so when you eat the two together you get what each lacks.

What this family shares is the gap. It is the family of coming into a body and leaving it, of a wheel that keeps turning. Whatever changes in you changes in the spaces between, between two lives or two notes. Your body takes its leucine in fresh with every meal.

relations.unity_line: Each of these takes your turn further, from the place where one thing in your life ends and the next begins.

pair.teaching: This energy goes back to where a thing began, and it cannot begin again while the old still clutters it. Beneath the Surface is where it goes next: the stripping back that leaves only what matters. Open it when your going back keeps finding the same old clutter. What is cleared away makes room for the return.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy end for end and coming back becomes falling away. Beneath the Surface is the same turn seen from the top, where the last of the old is stripped off. Open it when you cannot tell whether something is ending or beginning. At the bottom of the year they are one moment.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy keeps returning to its own patterns, and alone it sees only the loops of one life. Sophia's Orchestra holds what it lacks: every life woven into one great pattern, with yours in it. Open it when your going back has turned lonely. Your loops are threads in something larger.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Life and Death
codon_ring.teaching: This energy goes back to the gap where one cycle ends and the next begins. It belongs to a family of six, the Ring of Life and Death, and between them they hold one whole life of yours. Your first breath is in Messengers of the Infinite, and your watching in Emerging as the Code. Your clearing out is in Beneath the Surface, your feeding in Inner Majesty and your finishing in Moving to Perfection. This one holds your turn at the bottom, when you start again. Open the one whose season you are in.

tarot.teaching: Five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, stand near this energy.

sky.teaching: the sign of the depths, where things die and come back changed. It reaches you through Death, a thin thread, and says that an ending in you is also a turn.

immortals.teaching: Earth above carries Lan Cai He, who sang in the street that your life goes by fast and gave his coins away. Thunder below carries Cao Guojiu, who left a palace to keep company with players, as you can leave an old life behind. Both show you how little you need to begin again.

hebrew_letter.teaching: a fish lives on inside moving water. It comes by the same route and says that something in you carries on through every change.

cards.essence: Love runs through you most freely on a day that does not go to plan. The car ahead is slow and the rain comes at the wrong moment, and you let each be as it is. You slow down, and the day tastes different. You feel you belong wherever you are, and a grudge is hard for you to keep. What you do comes with nothing to gain from it, and people can feel that.

glance.reading:
Love runs through you most freely on a day that does not go to plan. The car ahead is slow and the rain comes at the wrong moment, and you let each be as it is. You slow down, and the day tastes different. You feel you belong wherever you are, and a grudge is hard for you to keep. What you do comes with nothing to gain from it, and people can feel that.

Some days a worry hums in you with no cause you can name. Thinking will not get you out of it. Feel it where it sits in your body, and it starts to loosen.

Nobody can force a heart open, and yours opens in its own time. The more you accept yourself and the people around you, the more love grows in your life. You are at your strongest when you are most natural. In the end the same warmth goes out from you to everyone alike.

iching.trigram_combination: Heaven over Thunder is the hexagram of acting with nothing false in you. Thunder is the sudden move in you that comes before you have thought it through. Heaven is the strength in you that keeps going and asks nothing back. The move sits under the strength because it goes well only when it serves more than what you want for yourself. This hexagram has long been read as thunder rolling under the sky. Thunder is loud and means no harm. When nothing is hidden in what you do, people trust even your strongest words. You do best when you want nothing back.
iching.reading:
You are acting from the heart, with nothing to gain. That is when things go best, and it is also when the unexpected finds you. Something may go wrong that you did not cause. Being blameless does not keep trouble away, but it does not have to throw you off balance either.

What this time asks is to keep your aim plain. A wish to be seen or a hidden bargain turns the same move against you. Then no direction helps. This is not the time for a long journey or a big plan. Wisdom here is knowing when fixing a thing would bring more trouble than leaving it be. Do your part, and let the result take its own course.

Stop turning it over in your head, and let your breath settle low in your belly. Let what you do be as plain as what you mean.
judgement_lines: Innocence. Great success, and holding to what is true brings it through.
If there is a crookedness in you, there is trouble, and setting out helps nothing.
image_lines: Under heaven the thunder rolls, and everything alive returns to what it is.
So the kings of old, rich in their nature and in step with the season, fed and raised every living thing.

upper_trigram.name: Heaven (Ch'ien)
upper_trigram.nature: Unceasing forward movement, dynamic, enduring, untiring. Spirit power. Heaven, sovereign, father.

lower_trigram.name: Thunder (Chen)
lower_trigram.nature: Arousing power emerging from the depth of the earth. Excite, influence, move, affect. The eldest son.

lines.image: setting out with nothing false in it.
lines.reading: You start out with nothing false in you, and the going is fortunate. Everything turns on the start. If the thought is right, the act that follows is right too. Do not reach for anything heroic. Go as you are, and what you wish for comes.

lines.image: ploughing without counting on the harvest.
lines.reading: You plough without counting on the harvest and clear the ground without thinking of what it will yield. Work done for its own sake goes well. Do not sow and reap in the same breath, or plant again in the same tired field. When the wanting drops out of the work, any direction is a good one.

lines.image: a tethered ox led away by a passer-by.
lines.reading: The ox was tied where it should be, a traveller led it off, and the village is blamed for the loss. Trouble can find someone who has done nothing wrong, and being right does not stop it. What harms you now is clinging to the principle after the ox has gone. Let the loss be a loss.

lines.image: holding fast to what you are.
lines.reading: You are strong, and able to act, and that is the danger. Nothing here is wrong yet, and nothing needs doing to keep it so. Do not act just because you can. Hold fast to what you are, and you stay free of blame.

lines.image: an illness that needs no medicine.
lines.reading: You have done nothing wrong and you have fallen ill anyway. What came through no fault of yours will leave the same way, in its own time. Reach for the medicine and you will cling to it until the clinging is the illness. Leave it alone, and there will be cause for joy.

lines.image: acting after the time has closed.
lines.reading: The move has run its whole course, and even a true one goes wrong from here, because the time for acting is over. You know how to go forward and not how to stop, so you go at full strength into a dead end. Be still, and let what has rolled be finished.

gene_keys.shadow:
Constriction starts in the breath. It sits as a tightness across the chest and a pressure pushed down into the belly. Most people learn it very young, from the way their parents breathed. Fear is what holds it in place, and fear is clever. It is afraid of itself, so it never looks at itself, and that is how it survives. The grip spreads into how you hold on to things, an opinion, an object or a person. Love grows where there is room and dies in a grip. Turn away from the pain and life shrinks to distraction, a half-life lived around the tightness. The harder you choke it down, the tighter it holds.

Something wound this tight is there to be unwound. Turn toward it, and the unwinding has already begun.
gene_keys.repressive: Pain that is never looked at still runs the whole person. All their strength goes into not seeing it, and they take the numbness for peace. The deeper it is kept, the more the rest of them shuts down. Now and then something breaks it open, and relief floods the chest.
gene_keys.reactive: Some cannot bear how their pain feels, so they hate it, and the hatred comes out as coldness. They take it out on the people closest to them. Warmth reminds them of their own pain, so they push it away the moment it comes near. Nobody gets close for long.
gene_keys.gift:
Acceptance is a way of seeing, and it comes in three steps. The first step is to allow. Whatever is happening, you let your body feel what it feels, and after a while your breath slows. Then you accept. With the breath settled, you can feel your feelings without drowning in them. You may weep, go numb or be afraid, and your heart reminds you that underneath it all things are still all right. Last you embrace, and the mind lets go like a factory manager who has spent all day keeping machines from overheating and gives up.

Resignation is the dropped head of someone who has decided nothing can change. Acceptance is done with your head held high, almost in defiance. It says to the pain: I see you, and you are only the beginning. Each time you try to accept yourself, you find a further place where you do not. Life keeps testing it, and each time it goes deeper.
gene_keys.siddhi:
There is nothing personal in universal love. It is what holds everything together, and here you can no longer say you love anyone more than anything else. It cannot be willed. You go on opening and softening, and it arrives on its own once the personal flavour has burned off. What remains is a knowing in your body that everything is one.

Blood has long stood for this love. What your family handed down to you in it carries both their old hurts and their healing. From here the tightness is nothing to be ashamed of. It was the grit inside the oyster, and the pearl formed around it.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This love opens as you stop gripping, and a grip is where it runs out. Fountain of Light holds what it lacks: delight in being in a body, the soft approach to life. The tighter you hold anything, an opinion or a person, the more it holds you. Open it when accepting life has started to feel like hard work.

human_design.gate: Gate 25 is the love of spirit, a love for life itself. It drives you to live as an offering instead of a performance put on to prove your worth. It carries a purity so bright it can overwhelm. You pick up what the people around you feel, sometimes before they have said it. Setbacks do not easily disillusion you, because you see them as part of a larger pattern. The same openness can make you idealise a partner and miss what is plainly wrong. When this pull is mistrusted, you try to make your life by willpower alone, and you end up feeling cut off and unworthy. Lived well, you take up no more room than is yours, and no less.
human_design.centre:
This love is felt in the centre of your chest, in the Identity Center. It holds who you are and where your life is heading, and it is love itself. It works like a magnet with one pole: it only draws. It pulls toward you the people, the work and the places your life needs. When you trust yourself, what you need arrives. When you do not, you push away what you are drawing in and go to war with your own life.

About six people in ten have this centre defined. They know who they are and where they are going, and somewhere underneath they know they are lovable. The other four in ten have it open. They can arrive not knowing who they are or which way to go, and whether they are lovable stays a question. Where the defined choose their life from a menu, the open go to the buffet and piece one together.
human_design.channel: Gate 51 is the gate of shock. It sits in the Will Center, which is also called the Heart Center. With Gate 25 it makes the Channel of Initiation, the move from the mind's control to the wisdom of the heart. A shock often opens this love all the way. Gate 51 may be in you or in someone close, and the love wakes when both are present.

tarot.ring_role: This love is the core of being human, and it starts from a wound. Its family of six tells the one story every life tells. The Mysteries Play is the wound you start with. Inner Light Symphony is the fight with your own shadows. Pearl of Christos is the mind's limits outgrown, and Beyond Binary is the need to control given up. Internal Treasure is finding who you are. Unshakable Arrival is the waking after. Open any of them to see where you stand.
tarot.tarot_resonance: The ring and the two trigrams bring five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana.

body.physiology:
The heart is given this energy because of the blood. It sends the same blood to every part of you and picks no favourites. Your brain and your little toe get it alike. The whole of it goes round your body in about a minute. It began beating about three weeks after you were conceived, before there was a brain to know it. That is what this love is like from inside, a warmth that goes to everything because that is the only way it goes.

Put your hand flat on the left of your chest and you will find the beat. When you are afraid, your chest tightens around it and your breath rises high. Let the fear be felt instead of braced against, and the chest gives, a little at a time. It does not have to be told. It only has to stop being held.
body.amino_acid:
This love has a chemistry in you, and one substance in it is arginine. It is part of every protein in your body. Your body makes it. A body healing from a wound cannot make enough, so it takes the rest from meat, eggs or beans.

What you carry is wound in layers deep in your body, one around another. As each layer relaxes, you can feel love moving in you again.

relations.unity_line: Each of these takes the same open love somewhere else: into waiting, into delight in the body, or into the story every human life tells.

pair.teaching: This love acts on the spot, with no plan, and what nobody planned can catch it out. Lighter Than a Feather is where it goes next: the strength that holds back and stores up until the time is right. Open it when acting on the spot has cost you and you need to know when to wait. Holding back is how an open heart lasts.

inverse.teaching: Upside down this is Lighter Than a Feather again, so the bond is one and it is written above.

programming_partner.teaching: This love opens as you stop gripping, and a grip is where it runs out. Fountain of Light holds what it lacks: delight in being in a body, the soft approach to life. The tighter you hold anything, an opinion or a person, the more it holds you. Open it when accepting life has started to feel like hard work.

codon_ring.name: Codon Ring of Humanity
codon_ring.teaching: This love is the core of being human, and it starts from a wound. Its family of six tells the one story every life tells. The Mysteries Play is the wound you start with. Inner Light Symphony is the fight with your own shadows. Pearl of Christos is the mind's limits outgrown, and Beyond Binary is the need to control given up. Internal Treasure is finding who you are. Unshakable Arrival is the waking after. Open any of them to see where you stand.

tarot.teaching: The ring and the two trigrams bring five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana.

sky.teaching: the sign of home and of caring for your own, where this love starts before it reaches everyone.

immortals.teaching: Han Xiangzi, above, plays the flute. His music was said to make flowers open. He is the warmth you give with nothing asked back, which opens the people near you. Cao Guo Jiu, below, gave up his place at court. He is the open heart that lets go of what it was given.

hebrew_letter.teaching: an enclosed yard, the room an open heart needs around it.

cards.essence: The drive to make things happen is alive in you, and it can get almost anything done. You feel it rise when you believe in something. You know how to show that thing so people want it, in words that fit whoever is in front of you. You love being seen carrying something that matters. Held back until you know what it is for, this drive grows stronger.

glance.reading:
The drive to make things happen is alive in you, and it can get almost anything done. You feel it rise when you believe in something. You know how to show that thing so people want it, in words that fit whoever is in front of you. You love being seen carrying something that matters. Held back until you know what it is for, this drive grows stronger.

Some days a voice in you says nothing comes unless you grab it. Then you cannot rest for a moment, and nothing you gather feels like enough. Stop there, and listen under your own plans for the aim that was there first.

When you hear it, put your whole heart behind it. Sell only what you know is true, and sell it with love. Rest when the work is done, because you are worth resting. Use what you gather to bring more to the people who have less. Then let the good you do go unseen, and you will feel lighter than a feather.

iching.trigram_combination: Mountain over Heaven is the hexagram of a great strength stored until its time. Heaven is the drive in you that never tires. Mountain is the part of you that can keep still. The stillness sits above the drive because strength spent the moment it arrives never builds into anything. This hexagram has long been read as the sky held inside a mountain. Your strength gathers the way rain gathers between the peaks, before it falls. It also asks you to take what you gather out into the world and never to live off the people you serve. What you store now is what you will one day give.
iching.reading:
You have more strength than this moment can use, and this is a time to store it. The power is real, and so is the danger of spending it all at once. When strength and plenty come together, it is easy to act without thinking. So when you feel the pull to rush in, keep still instead. Energy stored now is ready to be released later. What you learn now is ready to be taught.

Fill yourself each day with what the people before you said and did, and let it shape who you are. Renew yourself daily with rest, good food and a fresh look at what you are working for. Then go out and cross the great river, and take on the large thing. Take nothing for yourself from the people you serve.

Stand with the presence of a mountain, with the whole strength of the sky moving through you. Keep your hands still until it is time to use them.
judgement_lines: Great taming. It furthers to hold to what is right.
Not eating at home brings good fortune. It furthers to cross the great water.
image_lines: Heaven within the mountain: the image of great taming.
So the wise learn the many sayings and deeds of the past, and build their character on them.

upper_trigram.name: Mountain (Ken)
upper_trigram.nature: Limit, frontier, stillness. Solid, steady, unshakable. The youngest son.

lower_trigram.name: Heaven (Ch'ien)
lower_trigram.nature: Unceasing forward movement, dynamic, enduring, untiring. Spirit power. Heaven, sovereign, father.

lines.image: danger at hand; it furthers to stop.
lines.reading: Danger is close, and it is better to stop. Push your strength forward now and it goes badly. Keep it still and it goes well. Finish the work on yourself before you set out to help anyone else. Stop here, and let the strength keep gathering.

lines.image: the strap taken from under the cart.
lines.reading: The strap comes off under the cart, so the cart stays where it is. You took it off yourself, which is why there is no resentment in it. The strength is kept safe while it waits for its time. Let the stopping be your own choice, and rest easy in it.

lines.image: a good horse giving chase, with driving and defence practised daily.
lines.reading: A good horse gives chase, and those ahead of you want what you want. The way is hard, and the risk is going so fast that you slip. Practise every day, at driving and at guarding, so your skill keeps up with your speed. Then it is good to have somewhere to go.

lines.image: the board fitted over a young bull's horns.
lines.reading: A board is fitted over a young bull's horns before they have grown. A fault caught this early never forms, so no one is ever hurt. There is joy in this, the ease of a thing guided from its start. Set the limit while the strength is young.

lines.image: the tusks of a gelded boar.
lines.reading: The boar is gelded and keeps its tusks, yet it no longer wants to use them. Your strength stays whole while the need to fight goes out of it. Let go of the urge to beat everyone, and whatever you make goes well.

lines.image: the open road of heaven.
lines.reading: The road of heaven lies open, with nothing in the way. You worked at this where no one could see, and now people know you for it. What you aimed for in private is carried out on a large scale. Go ahead, because the way is clear.

gene_keys.shadow:
Pride starts from a belief that nothing comes to you unless you reach out and take it. Out of fear, you stop trusting the easy flow of life and pit your will against everything else. Will really can get you almost anything, and believing it is a step on the way. To climb by will alone you push others down, often without seeing it. Pride is clever enough to find the cheapest deal and pass off the blame. It even edits its own conscience. It forgets that what it takes from one place is taken from everyone.

Pride needs to be seen as strong, because underneath it fears being powerless. You can tell it in a person because they cannot relax, even for a moment. However much you gather, it never feels like enough inside. Under it all lies the oldest fear, of being no one. The more solidly you build yourself up, the harder that fear bites.
gene_keys.repressive: Held in, the pride goes underground and works by stealth. They belittle others, or slip guilt and shame in where no one can point to it. Most of it happens without their noticing, so they rarely feel answerable for the harm. Pride that grows out of fear always ends in manipulation.
gene_keys.reactive: Let out, the same pride boasts. It shows off money, power and property so as to look anything but powerless. The display wants admiration and draws envy instead. Under it a great anger is held down, and when it bursts it is pride at its ugliest.
gene_keys.gift:
Artfulness begins when you learn the difference between will and intention. Will is you forcing your idea onto life. Intention is a quiet aim that was in you before you chose anything, behind everything you do and say. You cannot force it out. You can only listen for it.

Then pride becomes a craft you enjoy. To sell a truth, you have to step into the light yourself, and you love the light. Freed from fear, your skill at winning people sells through love. Your ego becomes something you wear, like a costume before a show. In a crowded camp where most people waited, one group built a fire at the centre and cooked stew to share. Your cleverness can work the same way, for everyone. Ask yourself whether you are a giver or a taker.
gene_keys.siddhi: Invisibility comes when the pride has been polished all the way, until it serves everything. To give up an ego, you first need one worth giving up. Your own will stops pushing and joins the rest of life. People find you hard to pin down. Wherever they look you are there, and when they try to hold you, you are gone. You turn the light onto someone who needs it and step out of it yourself. Only you know what you did, and that is enough. You take life less seriously than anyone, and your laughter rings on like a string of bells.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy can make almost anything happen, and it falters when it works for itself alone. Tribal Tapestry holds what it lacks: the pull that gathers people around what there is and shares it out. Weigh a thing carefully before you promise it, or the people counting on it scatter. Open it when you have plenty and no one to share it with.

human_design.gate:
Gate 26 is the pull to tell a story so well that people take it in. It knows how to present a thing so it captivates, whether that is an idea, a product or yourself. What matters is what the selling serves. Out of lack, it sells to fill your own store. In integrity, it sells a real answer to a real problem. Integrity here means being whole, with no part of you split off from the rest.

The challenge of this gate is to believe you are worth your place in the world. If you learned you cannot afford that place, you trade your values for feeling safe. Then your worth hides under fear. Look after yourself so that you have something to give.
human_design.centre:
The Will Center is the smallest of the nine centres, and it is the part of you that deals with money, work and things. It holds your sense of worth and the plain charge of I can do this. It is an engine that works and then has to rest. You rest only when you believe you are worth resting.

Fewer than four people in ten have this centre defined. They say what they will do and then do it, and each promise kept builds trust in the next. Proving themselves is a kind of play, the way a workout is. Pushed without rest, they burn out, and the body gives out with them.

The rest have it open. They walk into a room and take in other people's sense of not being enough, then feel it as their own. Many spend years trying to prove a worth that is not in doubt. Their gift is knowing what is truly valuable, without ever having to prove it. An orchid is worth no more than a daffodil.
human_design.channel: On its own, Gate 26 can sell anything, true or not. Gate 44, in the Spleen Center, is your instinct for what people need to survive. Together they make the Channel of Surrender, which lets you pass on to others what is truly valuable. With it you can do a great deal of work in a fraction of the time. Gate 44 may be in you or in someone close, and the selling is honest when both are present.

tarot.ring_role: This energy finds the quickest way to a thing, and it does not work alone. It belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Light, each a way you work with light. UL 5, The Space Between Time, is the patience that keeps time with everything around you. UL 9, Ease in This, is the step you keep taking. UL 11, Sol Star, is the dream of how things could be. This one finds the shortcut.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, gather here through the ring and the two trigrams.

body.physiology:
Knowing what is yours is the reason this energy is given to the thymus gland. The thymus is where your body learned what belongs to it. Unfinished guard cells pass through it and are tested there. Any cell that would attack your own body is put down before it leaves. So the guard in you knows you and leaves you whole. When your will cannot rest, that guard wears down. When your will softens, your chest grows warm.

The gland did most of its work while you were a child. It shrinks after you stop growing, yet the cells it trained still stand guard in you. Lay a hand flat just below the notch at the top of your chest. Under your palm is the part of you that learned what is yours, without ever taking anything.
body.amino_acid:
The drive in you has a chemistry, and one substance in it is threonine. Your body cannot make it, so it comes to you in food, from fish or eggs. You share this substance with three other energies, and together they carry how your body takes in light and turns it into energy. Your part is the will, which bends that light to your own use.

The plainest proof of light at work in you is on your skin. Sunlight on it makes vitamin D, which your health depends on. Stand in the sun on any bright day and it is happening in you.

relations.unity_line: UL 25 is this card's pair and its inverse at once: strength that acts with no plan in it, where this one holds its strength in.

pair.teaching: This energy gathers and holds, and it runs out when the holding turns into a plan to win. The Mysteries Play is where it goes next: love that reaches everything alike, with no plan in it. Open it when you have stored enough and cannot remember what for. What you gather is meant to be given.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy upside down and holding becomes letting go. The Mysteries Play acts with nothing in reserve and no aim of its own. Open it when you have held on so long that holding is all you do.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy can make almost anything happen, and it falters when it works for itself alone. Tribal Tapestry holds what it lacks: the pull that gathers people around what there is and shares it out. Weigh a thing carefully before you promise it, or the people counting on it scatter. Open it when you have plenty and no one to share it with.

codon_ring.name: Codon Ring of Light
codon_ring.teaching: This energy finds the quickest way to a thing, and it does not work alone. It belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Light, each a way you work with light. UL 5, The Space Between Time, is the patience that keeps time with everything around you. UL 9, Ease in This, is the step you keep taking. UL 11, Sol Star, is the dream of how things could be. This one finds the shortcut.

tarot.teaching: Five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, gather here through the ring and the two trigrams.

sky.teaching: the water bearer, who pours out what he carries for everyone, as your strength does once you give it.

immortals.teaching: Mountain above carries Zhang Guo Lao, who rides his donkey facing backward and learns from where he has been. Heaven below carries Han Xiangzi, whose flute makes flowers open in their own time. Your strength works best with both, learning from the past and never forcing.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the hook that draws something hidden up into the light, the way your aim surfaces when you listen.

cards.essence: When a person close to you needs looking after, the care in you is already moving. You remember the birthday, and you look in on the friend who is sick. Near you, others lower their guard and let themselves be looked after, sometimes for the first time.

glance.reading:
When a person close to you needs looking after, the care in you is already moving. You remember the birthday, and you look in on the friend who is sick. Near you, others lower their guard and let themselves be looked after, sometimes for the first time.

At times you give more than you have, until it wears down your health. Resentment creeps in, or you hold people so close they cannot grow. Feed yourself first, with food, rest and time. Before you step in, notice who truly needs you.

Look after yourself as closely as you would anyone you love, and let others care for you in turn. Give to what is alive and able to grow, without keeping count. A day given freely moves slowly and feels full. Given this way, your care feeds you as it goes out, and you do not run dry.

iching.trigram_combination: Mountain over Thunder is the hexagram of how you are fed. Thunder is the movement in you that reaches for what you need. Mountain is the stillness in you that knows when you have had enough. The stillness sits above the movement because reaching on its own never stops. That is why this hexagram has long been read as a mouth. A mouth opens to take food in and closes when it is full. The same mouth speaks. So the care you take in eating is the care you take in what you say. You are fed by what you reach for and by when you stop.
iching.reading:
You have gathered something, and now it is time to eat from it and feed others with it. You stand at the mouth, where food goes in and words come out. What matters now is what you let in and what you let out. Feed the people who will go on to feed others, and what you give reaches everyone.

This time asks for care in two things: what you eat and drink, and what you say. Words are food too, so what you say to someone is something they have to eat. Keep to the kind who feed rather than take. Feed the ones below you before you go asking from the ones above.

Your jaw is the place to check. When you are reaching for more than you need, it hangs a little open, ready for the next thing. Close your lips, let the jaw go loose, and chew what you already have before you swallow it.
judgement_lines: Nourishment. Holding to what is right, it goes well.
Watch what you feed, and watch what you reach for to fill your own mouth.
Seek what fills your mouth from its source, and the source is yourself.
image_lines: Under the mountain, thunder: the jaws.
So the wise are careful in what they say, temperate in what they eat and drink.

upper_trigram.name: Mountain (Ken)
upper_trigram.nature: Limit, frontier, stillness. Solid, steady, unshakable. The youngest son.

lower_trigram.name: Thunder (Chen)
lower_trigram.nature: Arousing power emerging from the depth of the earth. Excite, influence, move, affect. The eldest son.

lines.image: the tortoise that lives on air set down, and a mouth watering at another's plate.
lines.reading: You have what the tortoise has, enough in yourself to live on. You have set that down to stare at what someone else is eating. Your own share is enough, and the staring is what makes it feel small. Nobody respects a mouth hanging open at another's table. Turn back to what is yours and eat from that.

lines.image: food sought from the hill-top, against the way it flows.
lines.reading: Food flows down from the strong to the weak; that is its proper way. You are reaching up the hill for it, toward someone with nothing to spare either. Going that way costs you your friends, because you have turned from the ones beside you. Ask nothing of the people above you. Feed yourself from where you stand.

lines.image: the back turned on what feeds, for ten years.
lines.reading: You have turned your back on what truly feeds you and care only for food and clothes. Keep that up as firmly as you like and it still ends badly. The part of you that you are starving is what keeps you alive. Ten years can pass that way with nothing to show for them. Stop now, while it has cost you ten years and not a life.

lines.image: a tiger's stare, fixed and hungry, and no fault in it.
lines.reading: This hunger is the right kind. You look down for what you need the way a tiger looks, steady and about to spring, and there is no fault in it. Asking those below you for the strength you lack is no shame, so long as you mean it and force nothing. Keep your eyes on what feeds you and go when it moves.

lines.image: off the usual road, and holding the ground where you stand.
lines.reading: You are off the usual road, responsible for people you have no means to feed. Stay upright where you are and lean on the one above you who has what you lack. Leaning is no weakness; it is how the wise find what is right. Keep what is in place and start nothing new. Do not cross the great stream yet; the big leap is not for this season.

lines.image: the one the food comes from, in a high and dangerous place.
lines.reading: You are the one the food comes from now, and everyone below you eats from your hand. The place is dangerous because so much rests on it, and it goes well because you know that. You have fed others through a hard time, so you can feed them in any season without being told. Cross the great stream: the big leap is yours.

gene_keys.shadow:
Selfishness is holding on to what you have, and it is the oldest move there is. Everything alive eats something else, and one thing's death is another's birth. You are in that chain, and holding on is what kept your blood line in it. So it is not a sin, whatever you were told. But it makes a small room, where life is tight and worry runs under everything. When you hurt inside you have no room to think of anyone else. At the table you eat with your arm around the plate.

You came into the world unselfish. A house or a school taught you to take, and what you learned you can unlearn. What is missing underneath is a purpose, a reason for your life bigger than yourself. People will do almost anything to avoid feeling that gap: once they went to war to fill it, now they go shopping. Stay in the small room long enough to ask what the larger reason would be. That question is what makes the room bigger.
gene_keys.repressive: Held down, the selfishness turns into giving everything away, and none of it from the heart. What this person hands over is their own strength, with no limit on it. So people use them, or resent the strain in the gift. A thin guilt runs under all of it, and slowly the body pays.
gene_keys.reactive: Turned outward, the giving has a hook in it: this person gives to get something back. It looks generous until the return does not come, and then the anger underneath breaks the surface. The shock is how generous it looked at the start. This giving comes from the head, never the heart.
gene_keys.gift:
Care that wants nothing back is your nature, and nobody taught it to you. When one dolphin in a pod is in trouble, the whole pod turns to help at once. Your care moves the same way, toward whoever is in trouble, before you have decided anything. When your arm comes off the plate it goes to the middle of the table, and you are fuller for it.

This care knows, without being taught, what is worth giving to whom. It will not feed anyone's wish to stay helpless. It is the same pull that keeps a parent beside a child for the first seven years, the years that shape everything. A wound of your own from those years heals as you give what you did not get. What comes off you is trust, so people near you lower their guard, some for the first time in their lives. Purpose wells up out of this like water from a spring and spreads to whoever stands close.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Nobody sits at the head of this table now. You still feed people, and there is no you doing it. What remains is a longing your body carries, for everything to be at peace with everything else. Food is only the visible part of it. This is different from doing good. The ones who help so they will be seen, or to cover a pain of their own, still have a self doing the helping. Here no self remains, so the people who live this go unnoticed, as ordinary as anyone in the street.

They give without end and never run dry, fed by the love around them. Where an ounce of life remains in anything, this care can reach it. Listen from there and everything eating and being eaten sounds like music. What you hear in it is love. You came into the world without a self and you will leave it without one. The self in between is something you dreamed up.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This care keeps a body alive and cannot say what the life is for. The Dark Side of Light holds what this one lacks: a reason to live, and the nerve to risk something for it. Care keeps the life going, and purpose gives it a reason. Open it when you are fed and still do not know why you are alive.

human_design.gate:
Low in you sits the pressure to look after what is yours. Gate 27 is the name for it. It drives you to feed and protect the people you are responsible for, yourself among them, before anyone has asked. It is the pull that checks the door at night and counts the ones asleep. Nobody has to ask, and when it has nowhere to go you are restless without knowing why.

Left to itself, the same pull feeds people who did not need it and holds them so close they cannot grow. It picks up loads that were never yours, until you are tired, unthanked and sour. The question to ask is whose problem this is. Treat the other person as able, and let go with love so they can find their own strength.
human_design.centre:
This care sits in the Sacral centre, low in the body between the navel and the thighs. It is the strongest energy you have, the one that brings a child into the world and feeds it. It does not decide; it answers. Put something in front of it and your gut says yes or no before you think. In anyone who carries it the caring is warm and motherly. Spend it on what you said yes to and it comes back as fast as you spend it. Spend it out of guilt and it drains. People learn to take from it, because a yes they talked you into looks like yours.

Most people, about seven in ten, have this energy running on its own all day. They can trust their gut about who is theirs to look after. Their risk is the role of the one who is always there. They keep it up long after the wanting has gone, until they get ill. The other three in ten have no caring energy of their own and take it in from the people around them. They can look after everyone in a house for a while. Then it is gone all at once, because nothing in them said when enough was enough. What they can do instead is stand back and watch the caring without joining it. They know what is theirs to do and what is not.
human_design.channel: On its own, the drive to feed does not know what deserves feeding. What completes it is Gate 50, the part of you that holds the values a family lives by. It sits in the Spleen centre, which knows by instinct what keeps you safe. Together they make the Channel of Preservation, two gates joined into one line of energy. With both you guard what you value. Not everyone needs your care, and Gate 50 knows it. It may sit in you or in someone close to you, and the channel runs only when both gates are present.

tarot.ring_role: This care keeps one life going on another, and it belongs to a family of six, the Ring of Life and Death. Each of the six is a stage that something in your life passes through. UL 3 is the stage where it begins, and UL 20 the stage where you are fully in it. UL 23 is where it falls apart, UL 24 where it comes back and UL 42 where it grows on. Open the one that matches where you are.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Five of the tarot's major cards come to this card through its family and its two trigrams. Each names one part of how you are fed.

body.physiology:
The sacral plexus is where feeding ends in you, and that is why this energy is given to it. It is a weave of nerves on the inside of the flat bone at the base of your spine. The same low place holds the energy to carry and feed a child. What went in at your mouth this morning ends its road here. Nerves from this weave move the last of it along and say when to let go. Low in your back beside it, you keep the strength you were born with. You lived on that before you could eat, and every meal since has added to it.

You are doing it now. Something you ate is on the last of its road, and this weave is moving it without a thought from you. Put your hand on the small of your back, where the bone goes flat. Your hand is resting on the part of you that finishes what feeding began.
body.amino_acid:
The care in you has a substance, and its name is leucine. Your body cannot make it. It arrives in meat, eggs or beans, or not at all. After a meal your muscle notices it first, and between meals it is gone. Whether you hold on or give, you are running on the same chemistry.

Give for the sake of giving and you start healthy currents deep in your body. You share its chemistry with five other energies.

relations.unity_line: UL 28 is this card's pair and its partner at once: this care keeps a life fed, and that one gives the life its reason.

pair.teaching: This care takes on whoever needs feeding, and it runs out when there are more people than you can carry. The Dark Side of Light is where it goes next, the weight of everything you have taken on. Open it when the load has grown heavier than you can bear.

inverse.teaching: This care looks the same from either end. Turn it end for end and it comes back as itself, with the one who fed now the one being fed. When you are the one who needs feeding, come back to this card from the other end.

programming_partner.teaching: This care keeps a body alive and cannot say what the life is for. The Dark Side of Light holds what this one lacks: a reason to live, and the nerve to risk something for it. Care keeps the life going, and purpose gives it a reason. Open it when you are fed and still do not know why you are alive.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Life and Death
codon_ring.teaching: This care keeps one life going on another, and it belongs to a family of six, the Ring of Life and Death. Each of the six is a stage that something in your life passes through. UL 3 is the stage where it begins, and UL 20 the stage where you are fully in it. UL 23 is where it falls apart, UL 24 where it comes back and UL 42 where it grows on. Open the one that matches where you are.

tarot.teaching: Five of the tarot's major cards come to this card through its family and its two trigrams. Each names one part of how you are fed.

sky.teaching: the sign of death and rebirth, where what you take in is broken down and comes back as part of you.

immortals.teaching: Zhang Guo Lao knew the secret of a long life, and he stands above for the part of you that makes what you feed last. Cao Guojiu walked away from the court he was born to. He stands below for the appetite in you that can stop taking what it is handed.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the letter of change without loss: you keep living through change the way a fish lives in moving water.

cards.essence: When something matters enough to give it everything, purpose wakes up in you. You feel it in your body: the day has an edge, and you are wide awake. You go toward the hard thing by choice, because a challenge you picked feels more alive than a comfort you were handed. You are building something you cannot see yet, and you give yourself to the mystery of where it leads.

glance.reading:
When something matters enough to give it everything, purpose wakes up in you. You feel it in your body: the day has an edge, and you are wide awake. You go toward the hard thing by choice, because a challenge you picked feels more alive than a comfort you were handed. You are building something you cannot see yet, and you give yourself to the mystery of where it leads.

Some days nothing seems to have a point, and a voice in you says it will all be too hard. That voice is fear, and your purpose lies inside the very fear you keep walking around. Look at it for as long as you can, and it loosens its grip.

Give the whole of yourself to what is in front of you. As your own fear quietens, your strength turns toward other people. Then you stop asking what your life is for, because you are living it.

iching.trigram_combination: Lake over Wind is the hexagram of carrying more than you were built to hold. Wind is the quiet strength in you that holds things up. Lake is the part of you that draws people in and stirs them to act. The gathering sits above the holding because what you take on grows faster than what carries it. This hexagram has long been read as a lake risen over the trees. Water feeds a tree until there is too much of it. Too much of what you love can do the same to you. When what you care about grows bigger than your life can hold, you have to move.
iching.reading:
Something you have taken on has grown bigger than what holds it up. It might be a plan, a love or a cause. The middle is strong and the ends are weak, and the whole thing has started to bend. This is an unusual time, and there is nothing wrong in it. An unusual time asks for action out of the ordinary.

It is good to have somewhere to go. A weight like this cannot be held still for long, so either lighten the load or carry it somewhere. Adjust as you go, firmer where you are weak and softer where you are too hard. If most people are against you, you can stand alone without fear. If you have to leave a whole world behind, you can go without sorrow.

Open your mouth and say plainly what you are carrying, and people will be glad to help you with it. Stand like someone who chose the load.
judgement_lines: Too much of the great, and the ridgepole sags.
It goes well to have somewhere to go, and to go there. What is undertaken comes through.
image_lines: The lake has risen over the trees. That is the great gone past its measure.
So the wise stand alone without fear, and can leave the whole age behind without sorrow.

upper_trigram.name: Lake (Tui)
upper_trigram.nature: Open surface, interaction, pleasure, the mouth, exchange. The youngest daughter.
