UL 12, Petals of Freedom, carries the last test of meeting who you really are. This one carries the first: seeing that you have forgotten.

tarot.teaching: Four of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, arrive through the ring and the two trigrams.

sky.teaching: the element that finds the lowest place and rests there, as you do when you step back.

immortals.teaching: Heaven above carries Han Xiangzi, whose flute made flowers open out of season, and he tells you that leaving costs you none of your gifts. Mountain below carries Zhang Guo Lao, who rides his donkey backwards, and he tells you that looking where you came from shows you the way.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the letter of deep water, where what happened settles until you can see it clearly.

cards.essence: You feel strong, and something real in front of you is asking for all of it. That is when strength moves through your whole body. You can work hard all day with nothing in you pulling against the work. The work flows out of you, and you become one with it.

glance.reading:
You feel strong, and something real in front of you is asking for all of it. That is when strength moves through your whole body. You can work hard all day with nothing in you pulling against the work. The work flows out of you, and you become one with it.

Some days there is nothing real to meet, and the strength goes looking for something to push. You lean on things that will not move and want them to go your way. Listen for the word try in your own voice, because it comes just as the pushing starts. Once you hear it, stop, and the strain goes out of your body.

Let the strength rest until something real calls it. You will know the call, because the strength rises on its own, with no talking yourself into it. Take the way that feels easy, since the easy way is the right one. Then all of you goes in, and the whole of life is behind you.

iching.trigram_combination: Thunder over Heaven is the hexagram of strength at its full height. Heaven is the steady strength inside you. Thunder is the urge in you to move, and to move now. The urge sits on top because once your strength is full, it wants to be used. This hexagram has long been read as thunder high in the sky. When your strength is this full, people feel it the way they feel thunder overhead. The same reading asks you to walk no road that is not right. You are strongest when your strength goes only where it should.
iching.reading:
Your strength has grown to its full height. The time of holding back is over, and you are ready to act on what is worth it. There is more power in you now than in anything around you. This is also where the danger lies. People with this much strength grow too sure of themselves and start to run wild. Great power draws envy from those who have less.

Use only as much strength as the moment needs. Never strike before you can strike at full strength, and never out of pride. Be fair with what you have, because only the weak are merciless. Strength spent on a cause nobody else supports is wasted. Put it behind what is right, and good people will stand with you.

Thunder belongs to the foot, the first part of you to move. Stand with your weight even over both feet. Let the strength settle there before you take a step.
judgement_lines: Great power.
It goes well for the one who stays firm and upright.
image_lines: Thunder high in the sky: the picture of great power.
So the wise walk no road that is not right.

upper_trigram.name: Thunder (Chen)
upper_trigram.nature: Arousing power emerging from the depth of the earth. Excite, influence, move, affect. The eldest son.

lower_trigram.name: Heaven (Ch'ien)
lower_trigram.nature: Unceasing forward movement, dynamic, enduring, untiring. Spirit power. Heaven, sovereign, father.

lines.image: strength in the toes, and the toes already marching.
lines.reading: Strength has reached your toes, and they want to march. The power is real but not gathered yet, so setting out now would end badly. Find someone who knows more, and learn from them first. Stay where you are until the rest of you catches up.

lines.image: the strong one at rest in the middle, with no fence in sight.
lines.reading: You are strong and settled in the middle, with nothing to prove. You are firm inside and easy on the outside, with more in reserve than you show. Strong here means no passing feeling can throw you. Keep that balance, and it goes well.

lines.image: a ram charging the fence, its horns caught in the wood.
lines.reading: A ram charges the fence, and its horns get caught. Small people spend all their strength where it can be seen, and the wise spend none. Pushing on here would hurt you before it won you anything. Keep your strength out of sight, and stay away from the fence.

lines.image: the fence opened, and strength in the axle of the great cart.
lines.reading: The fence opens on its own, and nothing catches. Your strength has moved from the horns to the axle, the hidden bar that turns the wheels while everyone looks at the cart. Nothing needs forcing now. Set yourself right first, then help others. Be the axle, and go.

lines.image: the ram lost in easy country, and no regret.
lines.reading: The ram wanders off in easy country, and you do not miss it. You have lost the butting kind of strength, and there is no fault in that. Open your mind to what other people know. Borrow what they have learned, and you grow strong in a new way.

lines.image: the ram caught in the fence, unable to go back or forward.
lines.reading: The ram is caught in the fence and can go neither back nor forward. Nothing you push from here will help. See plainly how stuck you are, since seeing it is the way out. Admit the difficulty, and the fault will not last long.

gene_keys.shadow:
Force is the oldest power in you. It is older than any animal, and it has one aim, to keep one life going. It does not even know that anyone else is there. Caught in it, you keep going the way you set out, and help from outside falls on deaf ears. Other people cannot see how you could be so blind. Their anger takes you by surprise, because you had no idea what you were doing.

Your spine feels it first. Each time you push your life where it does not want to go, your back tightens somewhere and you begin to stoop. Go to the ache and stay with it, instead of fixing it from outside. It is there because of something you are doing or not doing. The longer you listen, the plainer it says where your life wants to go.
gene_keys.repressive: Here the power hides from itself. These people put themselves down and let others be their authority, often after a hard childhood. Everyone walks over them. All that strength backs up inside and comes out as tiredness. When they leave the situation that holds them, their strength comes back.
gene_keys.reactive: Turned outward, the same power becomes bossy. These people push others around and have no idea they are doing it. They are furious when challenged and charge on when warned. It ends badly for them. They were taught to be this way and are deeply misunderstood. What they need is one healthy, hard thing to put their anger into.
gene_keys.gift:
Strength has always wanted to be seen. A flower opens its colour to bring the bee, and there is no pride in it. Your strength shows in the same way, and people notice it without being told. Someone who moves and speaks from their centre has a strength you can feel across a room.

You may do a brave thing without deciding to, then feel uneasy when people praise you for it. It seems to have happened through you. Your movement is at its finest once you stop watching yourself. Often this strength means not moving at all. The easiest fight is the one you never start. Real strength is not aware of itself.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Majesty is life moving through a body with no one in there taking charge. On a crowded train, an old man calms a raging drunk by asking about his garden, while a trained fighter sits ready to strike. At this height you settle a fight the way that old man did, without lifting a hand.

Majesty is hidden and humble, and it always finds the easiest way. A god living in a human body would not know it is one. Then the whole of life moves through you, and you are joy in a body.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This strength works best when you are not watching yourself use it. Emerging as the Code holds what it is missing: being fully here, sure of yourself in the moment. Lose that sureness and you start to try. Open it when you catch yourself trying and your strength has turned to strain.

human_design.gate: Gate 34 is the pressure to put your great store of energy to use. It can keep you busier than anyone around you. It gives you the stamina to keep going long after others stop. It is built to answer, not to start. When something real comes to you and your yes rises, the energy brings the right people together around one idea, and what you start lasts. When nothing has come, you stay busy to feel in control. All that work leaves you feeling powerless. The pressure asks you to carry the power rather than wield it.
human_design.centre:
The Sacral Center sits low in your body, under the navel and above the legs. It is the strongest engine you have. It drives your work, your sex and the raising of a child. It does not decide. It answers with a sound that rises before you think, a yes that lifts or a no that goes flat.

About seven people in ten have this centre defined. Their engine runs all the time and renews by being used on work they said yes to. Work without a yes burns it out, and so does doing nothing. The other three in ten have it open and take in the energy of the people around them. They can outwork everyone for a while but cannot keep it up. Their gift is knowing when enough is enough.
human_design.channel: Gate 34 reaches three ways at once. With Gate 20 in the throat it makes the Channel of Charisma, where your strength gets a voice and your words turn into action. With Gate 10 in the G Center it makes the Channel of Exploration, where it becomes behaviour that is yours alone. With Gate 57 in the Spleen it makes the Channel of Power, where it moves on instinct in the moment. The other gate may be in you or in someone close to you.

tarot.ring_role: This strength is the power of the body, and it has already done its greatest work by standing the human spine upright. It belongs to a family of two, the Ring of Destiny, which shapes where a life goes. UL 43, Cipher of Knowledge, carries the sudden knowing that breaks through your mind. This one carries the strength of the body. Together they are two halves of one destiny.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Your strength shows up in five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana.

body.physiology:
This strength is given to the sacral plexus, and the reason is that nothing in you is watched less. The plexus is a weave of nerves against the inside of the flat bone at the base of your spine. It sits low, below and around the level of your navel. Strength comes from here, from the belly, while pushing starts in the head. Its power is real because no thought sits on it.

Stand up from a chair. The big muscle of your buttock straightened your hip on an order from this weave, before you had finished deciding to stand. The muscles that kept your hips level took their orders from it too. You felt none of it, and that is how this strength works.
body.amino_acid:
The strength in you has a chemistry, and one substance in it is asparagine. Your body makes it for itself from what it already has, so it asks nothing of your plate. The proteins on the outside of every cell you have wear their coats of sugar on it.

When the strength takes you over and you can hear no one, this chemistry is part of what is moving. Left alone, your life runs smoothly and costs you little. Each push against the way it wants to go uses more of your energy than the flow would have. You share this chemistry with one other energy.

relations.unity_line: UL 33 is this card's pair and its inverse at once: the strength drawn back, where this one moves it forward.

pair.teaching: This strength moves forward with everything it has, and it runs out when there is nothing left to move toward. Echos of Time is where it goes next: the step back, where you withdraw and let what happened make sense. Open it when your strength is spent and going on would only hurt you. Every great push is followed by a stop.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy end for end and going forward becomes stepping back. Echos of Time is the same strength seen from the other side, gathered by withdrawing. Open it when you cannot tell whether to go or wait. The retreat is what built the strength in the first place.

programming_partner.teaching: This strength works best when you are not watching yourself use it. Emerging as the Code holds what it is missing: being fully here, sure of yourself in the moment. Lose that sureness and you start to try. Open it when you catch yourself trying and your strength has turned to strain.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Destiny
codon_ring.teaching: This strength is the power of the body, and it has already done its greatest work by standing the human spine upright. It belongs to a family of two, the Ring of Destiny, which shapes where a life goes. UL 43, Cipher of Knowledge, carries the sudden knowing that breaks through your mind. This one carries the strength of the body. Together they are two halves of one destiny.

tarot.teaching: Your strength shows up in five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana.

sky.teaching: the planet of growth and plenty, a reminder that your strength can grow large and still keep its place.

immortals.teaching: Thunder above carries Cao Guo Jiu, who left the rank he was born to, as you can set down power that is not yours. Heaven below carries Han Xiangzi, whose flute made flowers bloom out of season. Your strength can get its way by gentleness, as his music did.

hebrew_letter.teaching: a hand that can close hard or open, the choice your strength makes each time.

cards.essence: Life is opening up, and you want more of it. That wanting is your sense of adventure, the pull toward whatever you have not tried yet. You do not have to travel far for it. The streets around your own door hold enough to fill a lifetime, once you meet them as new each time. The same walk is never the same walk twice.

glance.reading:
Life is opening up, and you want more of it. That wanting is your sense of adventure, the pull toward whatever you have not tried yet. You do not have to travel far for it. The streets around your own door hold enough to fill a lifetime, once you meet them as new each time. The same walk is never the same walk twice.

Some days you want everything now, and the wanting gets ahead of you. Impatience and appetite feed each other until nothing you reach for is tasted. Stop just before the edge, the way a glass of wine is best a sip short of too much. When you overshoot, be as kind to yourself as to anyone driven by hunger.

Do the things you already do in a new way. Learn the name of the person who serves you in the shop. When someone starts talking to you in the middle of your work, stop and give them your whole attention. Life comes closer when you pause for it, and every ordinary day holds an adventure.

iching.trigram_combination: Fire over Earth is the hexagram of rising in the world with ease. Fire is the clarity in you that lets people see what you are good at. Earth is the willingness in you to serve and to follow. The clarity sits above the willingness because you rise when the good you do quietly becomes plain to others. This hexagram has long been read as the sun coming up over the earth. A morning shows each thing more clearly by the minute, and nobody has to push it. You rise most easily when you let the good in you be seen and serve the people around you.
iching.reading:
Things are going well. What you started is growing on its own, like young plants in full sun, and other people can see it. People want you around, ask you back and trust you with more. The old picture is a lord at ease, given many horses by his king and received three times in one day. None of it was seized.

What it asks is that you rise the way he rose. Serve the people above you with loyalty and the people below you with generosity. Advance quietly, like a mouse, and take your seat when it is offered. Be willing to change before you ask anything around you to change. A good run is the easiest time to overreach, so save some of what comes and stay kind to the people who helped you. Every time of rising passes.

This time shows in your eyes: you look up, and you take in more than you did an hour ago. Hold yourself the way the sun comes up, without hurry, lighting each thing it reaches.
judgement_lines: Progress. The lord at ease is given horses in great number, and is received three times in one day.
image_lines: The sun comes up over the earth: the image of Progress.
So the wise brighten the good that was already in them.

upper_trigram.name: Fire (Li)
upper_trigram.nature: Glowing light spreading in all directions. The power of consciousness. Magical fire-bird. The middle daughter.

lower_trigram.name: Earth (K'un)
lower_trigram.nature: Surface of the world, support of all existence. Essential Yin. Rest, receptivity.

lines.image: wishing to advance, and held back.
lines.reading: You try to move forward and something stops you, and nobody trusts you yet. Being blocked says nothing about what you are worth. Stay straight and calm, and keep a generous mind toward the people who doubt you. Be generous before it is earned, and the trust will come.

lines.image: advancing, and sorrowing; a great blessing from the grandmother.
lines.reading: You are moving forward and grieving at the same time, the way you can dread a winter before it comes. Both are true, so keep going without hurrying to fix the sadness. A blessing reaches you from the people who went before you, from what they put by long ago. Let yourself receive it.

lines.image: everyone around you in agreement.
lines.reading: The people around you come into agreement with you, and the regret you carried lifts. Rising needs people who move with you, as well as people who notice you. Where you cannot see clearly, borrow what they can see, without shame. Go along with them, and let them go along with you.

lines.image: advancing like a rat.
lines.reading: You get ahead the way a rat does, quickly and at night, taking what you can. It may look bright from outside while something inside is wrong, and the place you are in cannot hold it. Watch too for anyone feeding on what you have built. Advance only in a way you would be glad to be seen doing.

lines.image: regret gone; loss and gain no longer worth a worry.
lines.reading: The regret is gone, and from here it no longer matters whether a single day goes up or down. Gains and losses take their turns, and the long run is good. So stop keeping score. Go forward one step at a time, and everything you meet will help.

lines.image: advancing the horns.
lines.reading: You reach the top of the climb with your horns lowered, and force is all you have left to advance with. Used on other people, it spoils what the good run built. Used on the unruly parts of yourself, it does hard and needed work. Do it quickly and do not draw it out, and accept the small regret of having needed force at all.

gene_keys.shadow:
A hunger runs through every person, and nothing out in the world ends it. You do not know what you want, only that you want it now. While it has hold of you, you cannot think about the cost. So you reach out for food or a new person, and soon after you are full the emptiness comes back. Then comes the mistake. Either you cling to what filled you, or you blame it for failing and move on.

Whatever you reach for outside leaves you hungrier than before. Starving the hunger does not end it, and neither does stuffing it. What loosens its grip is to feel, with all of you, how completely it drives you. Once you see that, the reach stops pouring out into the world and turns back inside.
gene_keys.repressive: Afraid of where the hunger would take their life, they push it down out of sight. Holding a force that size takes most of their strength. It keeps rising and tempting them toward something new, and they keep pressing it back. They are bored and may not know it. Their face stops shining.
gene_keys.reactive: Afraid of an empty life, they fill every hour. They move from one thing to the next in a frenzy and blame each one for not being enough. They try many things and never join them up, so no wisdom comes of it. Chasing the perfect place or person, they miss the adventure itself.
gene_keys.gift:
Adventure is the hunger with love in it. Love here is not one person filling you for a while. It is the feeling of being joined to everything, and it is the only thing that ends the hunger. The reach turns inward, and what changes now is you. There is still some fear in you, but you stand high enough to outwit it.

Most of us keep our lives in sealed rooms: the job that never touches the marriage, the belief that lets no new idea in. Open one door between two of them and new people walk through. The easiest way to change your life is to give without asking anything back, in as many places as you dare. People stop short when you do it, and something opens in you.
gene_keys.siddhi: Boundlessness is the state in which you no longer feel separate from anything. There is nowhere left to reach, because you are part of everything you once reached for. The fear that gave the adventure its edge falls away too. The mind cannot hold this, but the heart can, and the heart treats love and awareness as the same thing. A child already lives this way, and to a child anything is possible. Near a love like this, what seemed impossible happens.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy reaches for the next thing, and it runs out when the reaching turns into a rush. The Space Between Time holds what it lacks: the patience to let what is coming arrive in its own time. Patience and adventure hold each other up, and each keeps the other alive. Open it when you cannot bear to wait for anything.

human_design.gate:
Gate 35 sits in the throat and presses you to live things, then pass on what they taught you. It wants the new place, the new feeling and the thing you have never done. You go through them to see what they are like, not to reach an end. You are not here to master one thing; you learn by living many.

Its first danger is the rush: one experience straight into the next, with nothing taken in. Its second comes later. After you have seen a great deal, you can grow bored and sure that nothing is new. Then you settle into a life that asks nothing of you. The drive stays healthy when you choose the experiences worth your time and share what they taught you.
human_design.centre:
The Throat Center is where what you have lived becomes words and deeds. More of you runs to it than to any other centre, so it is the town square where every road meets. This drive sits here because an experience is not finished until it has been told.

About seven people in ten have this centre defined. Their voice keeps one steady tone whoever they are with, like a bird with its own song. The other three in ten have it open. Their voice takes in every voice in the room and meets each person in that person's own tone. They can feel pressure to speak with nothing to say, and blurt, or talk past the point. When they stop pushing to be heard, the right people come to them. In an open throat this gate shows as many talents and a voice that speaks from what it has lived. It has little patience for what is not worth doing.
human_design.channel: Gate 36 sits in the centre of feeling and drives you to feel a new thing to the bottom, crisis included. Joined to Gate 35 it makes the Channel of Transitoriness, the love of adventure. You go through a thing to see what it is like and come back with a story others can use. It runs on a wave of feeling, so wait until you feel clear before you jump in. Gate 36 may be in you or in someone close to you.

tarot.ring_role: This energy reaches out to meet everyone, and one reason is that it stands alone. It is the only member of its family, the Ring of Miracles, whose theme is the impossible made possible. With no kin to lean on, it goes out to connect. This one carries the miracle that love makes possible.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Its ring and its two trigrams bring five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, to this one.

body.physiology:
This energy is given to the thyroid, and the reason is pace. The thyroid sits low in the front of your neck, across the windpipe, and what it makes sets how fast your body runs. It is the slowest dial in you. Its hormone lasts about a week in your blood, and a change in it shows only over weeks. Whatever the day's hunger wants, your body's pace was set a while ago. The same hormone turns a tadpole into a frog, and nobody sees the moment it happens.

Put two fingers on the inside of your wrist and find the beat. Fear can raise it in a second. The beat you find at rest was set by this gland, and no amount of wanting hurries it.
body.amino_acid:
The hunger you were born with runs on a substance, and the substance is tryptophan. Your body cannot make it, so it comes in with meat, eggs or beans. You carry less of it than of any other piece you are built from. From it your body makes serotonin, the chemistry of having had enough, and most of that is made in the wall of your gut. So your hunger and your feeling of enough share one chemistry, made inside you from what you eat.

Serotonin is one link in a chain your body makes for itself. Giving with nothing wanted back sets it running, and what follows is happiness and a trust that your life is in order. A meal of bread or rice lets more tryptophan into your brain than a meal of meat does.

relations.unity_line: UL 36 is this card's pair and its inverse at once, and UL 5 its partner: the light that hides and the patience that waits, where this one rises and reaches.

pair.teaching: This energy reaches for the next new thing, and it runs out when the new thing turns hard and starts to hurt. Crystal Creation is where it goes next: the dark stretch where you feel things to the bottom and keep your light out of sight. Open it when an adventure has turned into a crisis. What you go through there is what makes the story worth telling.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy end for end and the sun coming up over the ground becomes the sun gone down under it. Crystal Creation is the same light seen at nightfall. Open it when a good run has suddenly stopped.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy reaches for the next thing, and it runs out when the reaching turns into a rush. The Space Between Time holds what it lacks: the patience to let what is coming arrive in its own time. Patience and adventure hold each other up, and each keeps the other alive. Open it when you cannot bear to wait for anything.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Miracles
codon_ring.teaching: This energy reaches out to meet everyone, and one reason is that it stands alone. It is the only member of its family, the Ring of Miracles, whose theme is the impossible made possible. With no kin to lean on, it goes out to connect. This one carries the miracle that love makes possible.

tarot.teaching: Its ring and its two trigrams bring five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, to this one.

sky.teaching: the lion's steady warmth, the courage in you that has no need to roar.

immortals.teaching: Fire above carries Lu Dong Bin, the scholar whose sword cuts through illusion. Earth below carries Lan Cai He, the wandering singer who gives away every coin. One shows you what is real, and the other keeps your hands open. Between them your appetite for life stays free.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the coiled force at the base, which becomes your strength when it is gentled rather than caged.

cards.essence: An open heart is alive in you, and it shows when life shakes you. The ground goes out from under you, and your stomach drops before your mind catches up. Your heart takes in the whole of what is happening, because it can hold any amount. Life keeps drawing you toward feelings you have not had yet, and you learn from each one.

glance.reading:
An open heart is alive in you, and it shows when life shakes you. The ground goes out from under you, and your stomach drops before your mind catches up. Your heart takes in the whole of what is happening, because it can hold any amount. Life keeps drawing you toward feelings you have not had yet, and you learn from each one.

Some days your heart pulls back for a moment, and that is human. Look straight at what is happening, and let it in all the way.

Each time you come through, what you feel grows clearer. The pain you let in joins you to other people instead of setting you apart. You understand what people feel, because you have felt it. So they come to you in their worst hour, and near you they open too.

iching.trigram_combination: Earth over Fire is the hexagram of a light that has to go under for a while. Fire is the clear sight in you, the part that sees what is going on. Earth is the part of you that gives way and carries on. Here the giving way sits on top, because in some seasons what you see is not safe to show. This hexagram has long been read as the sun gone down into the earth. All night the sun is still burning, out of sight. So you can live among others, keep your light low, and still shine. What you know stays lit in you until the morning.
iching.reading:
The light has gone under. Someone in power is doing harm, and what is clear in you is at risk for being clear. One order is ending and the next has not come. The push for change is in the air, and its time has not arrived.

So keep your head down and your light lit. Do the day's work, even the drudgery. Live among the others and look like one of them. Underneath, stay firm about what is right. Do not force the change. A light shown too early gets put out, and one kept low lasts.

Your eyes do the work now, under a soft belly. Let the belly stay soft, keep your eyes open, and wait for the morning.
judgement_lines: The light is wounded. In hard times it is good to hold firm.
Know the difficulty for what it is, and keep to what is right.
image_lines: The light has gone down into the earth: the image of the wounded light.
So the wise live among the many, veil their light, and still shine.

upper_trigram.name: Earth (K'un)
upper_trigram.nature: Surface of the world, support of all existence. Essential Yin. Rest, receptivity.

lower_trigram.name: Fire (Li)
lower_trigram.nature: Glowing light spreading in all directions. The power of consciousness. Magical fire-bird. The middle daughter.

lines.image: the wounded light in flight, wings let down; three days without food, and somewhere to go.
lines.reading: Your light is hurt at the very start, before the blow has fully landed. Leave now, wings down, so no one sees you can fly. The going costs you three days without food, and the people you leave will talk. What they say hurts only the outside of you. Go while going is still your choice.

lines.image: wounded in the left thigh, and saved by the strength of a horse.
lines.reading: The hurt reaches you this time, in the left thigh, because you left a little late. You are slowed down. A strength that is not yours, a strong horse, can still carry you. Take the help that is offered, and let it carry you out.

lines.image: hunting in the south, and the great chief of the dark taken.
lines.reading: At the end of the night you hunt in the south and take the chief of what darkened you. The rest will not change in one stroke. Set everything right at once, with too hard a hand, and you stir up what you just ended. Take the chief, then go slowly.

lines.image: entering the left side of the belly, finding the heart of the dark, then leaving by the gate and the courtyard.
lines.reading: You go deep inside what is doing the harm, far enough to learn what it truly intends. Once you know its heart, you have no reason to stay and argue. Knowing is what lets you go, so walk out through its gate.

lines.image: the wise man's light hidden at the tyrant's court.
lines.reading: You are close to the one who does the harm, too close to leave. Keep your light in a basket, so you look empty and stay full inside. Act the fool if that keeps you safe, and stay firm underneath. A light kept like this cannot be put out.

lines.image: no light, only dark; first up to the sky, then down into the earth.
lines.reading: At the top, you have climbed to the sky and lit the four corners of the earth. If you never learn to draw your light back in, you fall into the ground and lose it. Draw your light in before it is taken.

gene_keys.shadow:
Disaster could strike at any hour, and everyone knows it. The news says so all day, until a low hum of fear runs under your days like weather. This storm in you is turbulence, and no life is free of it. What overwhelms you is less the suffering than the fear of it. The heart closes, the body braces, and a life gets written as one upset after the next. It shows most in love, where you want the most.

No feeling in you is wrong. You are innocent of your own chemistry and the way it makes you feel. The trouble starts when you push a feeling down or throw it at someone out of fear. Then this energy pulls crisis toward you like a magnet. It keeps bringing you the same lesson until you learn it.
gene_keys.repressive: Held in, the storm goes into the nerves. This person is terrified of change and keeps the surface calm at any cost. The feeling gets trapped and hums there, so they cannot relax. The hum leaks out and unsettles the very people they are trying to keep steady. They are hard to get close to.
gene_keys.reactive: Let out, the storm comes with no honesty or clarity in it. The same painful scenes play over and over. What was done is often hidden afterwards, out of guilt. Because the feeling is never met cleanly, the next upset comes from a part of life that looks unconnected.
gene_keys.gift:
Humanity is what grows in you once you stop running from pain. You meet the storm with an honest, open heart, and you graduate as a human being. Your suffering stops setting you apart and becomes what you share with everyone. Pleasure comes with pain, and you stop waiting for a life with only one of them. Once you let go of the idea that fate is against you, you speak cleanly with people.

You earn this over time, and you still close sometimes, because that is human too. Then you forgive yourself and the other person. You coax your heart back to life, again and again. Living from the heart, you have an answer to fear. In time nothing can wound you, because nothing wounds a healed heart.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Compassion is the fragrance left when the storm is over. It is earned, on a road through the worst a person can feel, so it speaks in a human voice. The walls between you and everyone else fall away. You feel their pleasure, their pain and their longing as your own.

You go where the light is darkest, into wars or among the poor, without flinching. You have been so low once that nothing can feel that strong again, so fear has nowhere left to live. The look in your eyes or the softness of your voice can open the hardest heart. The seed of this was in the storm all along.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy stays open to whatever life brings, and it still fails most often between two people. Harmonious Mirage holds what it lacks: the feel for people that settles a quarrel before it starts. The two grow up together, and as your heart opens, you begin to speak cleanly with others. Open it when the hard times keep arriving through the people closest to you.

human_design.gate: Gate 36 sits in the centre of feeling, low in the body, and drives you toward what you have not yet felt. It carries a desire for new experience and a fear of not being equal to it. You learn by going in, through the highs and the lows. Because you have felt so much, you understand what other people feel. The drive runs in cycles, and when boredom comes it tempts you to leap into chaos. Its work is to stay with a thing long enough to become good at it.
human_design.centre:
The Emotional Solar Plexus Center sits in the belly, and feeling moves through it in a wave. With this gate the wave is the collective kind, with high highs and low lows. The low comes when something you expected does not happen, and the bottom falls out of the world. You are fine one moment and a wreck the next.

In just over half of people this centre is defined. They never know who will let them down next, and when they crash, their feeling fills the room. For them the wave is chemistry. Their work is to notice the dashed expectation, stop and breathe until it passes. The rest have it open. Other people's feelings hit them hard and take them over, then fade once they are alone. Some feel something is wrong with them for feeling so little. Their work is to let what is not theirs pass through, the way air goes through a screen door.
human_design.channel: On its own, this drive collects experience with no way to tell it. Gate 35, in the throat, is the drive to say what has changed. Together they make the Channel of Transitoriness, which turns what you have lived into stories other people can use. From outside it can look like restlessness. The stories come only when both gates are present, in you or in someone close to you.

tarot.ring_role: This energy lets suffering in, and suffering is how its family works. It belongs to four energies, the Ring of Divinity, and each of them can wake the highest thing in you. UL 22 is Treasure of the Way, the grace of having your feelings heard. UL 37 is Journey Home, the tenderness that holds your family together. UL 63 is Adornments of Time, the doubt that sets you searching. This one carries the heart that stays open through the dark.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Five of the tarot's major cards show faces of this energy, from the weight that holds a light down to the sun that returns.

body.physiology:
The lurch is the reason this energy is given to the solar plexus. When a lift starts down or a plane drops, your stomach seems to rise before you can think. The loose organs of your belly hang on their folds, so they lag a fraction of a second behind you. The knot of nerves behind your stomach reports that lag. It reaches every organ in your belly, and the pit of the stomach in front of it is where trouble shows first. So when the ground goes out from under your life, you feel it in the same place, before you know it anywhere else. A feeling you fight instead of feel spreads from here through your whole body as a nervous hum.

Rest a hand in the soft hollow just under your breastbone. The knot lies about a hand's depth behind it, against your spine, and it is where a drop is felt first.
body.amino_acid:
What churns in you when life lurches is chemistry before it is a thought, and one substance in it is proline. Your body makes it for itself, though meat and cheese are full of it too. Collagen is what holds your skin, bones and every healed cut together. About a quarter of it is proline.

This chemistry is shared with a family of energies in you. Together they bring the strongest feelings you will have, and a dark stretch full of doubt that you come out of cleaner. Suffering is built into you to crack you open. Freezing when it comes is something you learned.

relations.unity_line: UL 35 is this card's pair and its inverse: the sun rising into the day, where this one has gone under the ground.

pair.teaching: This energy keeps your heart open through a dark stretch, and it runs out once the light returns. Navigational Star is where it goes next: the hunger for life that meets each morning as new. Open it when the hard time has passed and you want to live again. What you came through is what you bring to the day.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy end for end, and the light that went under the ground climbs back into the sky. Navigational Star is the same sun seen rising. Open it when you cannot believe the morning will come. Your light will shine in the open day again.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy stays open to whatever life brings, and it still fails most often between two people. Harmonious Mirage holds what it lacks: the feel for people that settles a quarrel before it starts. The two grow up together, and as your heart opens, you begin to speak cleanly with others. Open it when the hard times keep arriving through the people closest to you.

codon_ring.name: Codon Ring of Divinity
codon_ring.teaching: This energy lets suffering in, and suffering is how its family works. It belongs to four energies, the Ring of Divinity, and each of them can wake the highest thing in you. UL 22 is Treasure of the Way, the grace of having your feelings heard. UL 37 is Journey Home, the tenderness that holds your family together. UL 63 is Adornments of Time, the doubt that sets you searching. This one carries the heart that stays open through the dark.

tarot.teaching: Five of the tarot's major cards show faces of this energy, from the weight that holds a light down to the sun that returns.

sky.teaching: the steady earth that holds its shape through a long season, the patience to wait out a dark time.

immortals.teaching: Earth above carries Lan Cai He, who wanders with a basket of flowers and sings of how brief life is. Fire below carries Lu Dong Bin, the scholar whose sword cuts through illusion. One reminds you that everything passes, and the other helps you see clearly while it does.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the nail that joins two things, so a dark stretch stays fastened to the morning after it.

cards.essence: At the end of the day you sit down to eat with the people who are yours. You feel affection for them in your body, as the warmth that spreads through you after a meal eaten together. You need no shared blood for this, since any few people drawn together can become a family. In you it is the wish to belong, and to see that everyone near you is fed.

glance.reading:
At the end of the day you sit down to eat with the people who are yours. You feel affection for them in your body, as the warmth that spreads through you after a meal eaten together. You need no shared blood for this, since any few people drawn together can become a family. In you it is the wish to belong, and to see that everyone near you is fed.

Some days your giving carries a quiet hope of something back. Giving that comes from your head always does. Look after yourself first, and ask your own heart what it needs. The giving that follows asks for nothing.

Let people lean on you, and lean on them without shame. What you give from the heart comes back to you, often from somewhere you were not looking. Then your affection reaches past your own table, to people you have never met.

iching.trigram_combination: Wind over Fire is the hexagram of the people you live with. Fire is the warmth in you that draws your people close. Wind is the gentle way that warmth reaches every one of them. The warmth sits underneath because a home is made from the inside out. This hexagram has long been read as wind coming out of a fire. Your warmth at home spreads the same way, like the heat of a stove moving into every room of a cold house. So what you say at home needs something behind it, and the way you live needs to stay the same from day to day. When your own home is right, the good in it goes out into the world.
iching.reading:
Something out in the world has hurt you or worn you down, and you have turned back toward home. That is the right way to turn. When a birth, an illness or a death changes a life, people go home to their own. The strength here is inside the house, and what is set right there sets right what lies beyond it. So the one who keeps the house matters most. That person sees to the food, leaves no chore undone and does not follow every whim out the door.

This time asks two things of you. Let your words have something behind them, so that what you say at home can be trusted. Let the way you live stay the same from day to day, long enough to be relied on. Give each person their own place, the older as the older and the younger as the younger.

This time lives in your legs and your eyes. Your legs bring you home, and your eyes see each person there as they are. Come in and sit down among your own before you do anything else.
judgement_lines: The family. The steadiness of the woman, the one who keeps the house, furthers it.
Each in their place, the father a father and the child a child, and the house comes right. A house set right sets the world right.
image_lines: Wind comes out of fire: the family.
So the wise put substance in their words, and keep to one way of living long enough to be trusted.

upper_trigram.name: Wind (Sun)
upper_trigram.nature: Subtly penetrating. Mild, nourishing. Wood and wind. The eldest daughter.

lower_trigram.name: Fire (Li)
lower_trigram.nature: Glowing light spreading in all directions. The power of consciousness. Magical fire-bird. The middle daughter.

lines.image: a fence put up around the house while there is still nothing to keep in.
lines.reading: A fence goes up round the house before anyone has moved in. Set the house rules now, before habits form and feelings argue with them. Anything young in your care needs the line drawn before it tests one. Guard your home early, and there is nothing to regret later.

lines.image: the one at the centre of the kitchen, seeing to the food, reaching for nothing past it.
lines.reading: You are at the centre of the house, seeing to the food. Someone comes home beaten by the day and finds a meal waiting, and that is a real fortune. Look for your blessings inside the house, not out in the world. Follow no whim out the door, keep everyone fed, and it goes well.

lines.image: the household scolding, scolding, and the wife and children giggling, giggling.
lines.reading: Tempers rise in the house, or else everyone laughs and nobody is in charge. Too strict, and there is regret, yet it ends well. Too loose, and it ends in shame, because the order of the house is lost. If you have to lean one way, lean toward firm.

lines.image: a rich household.
lines.reading: A household grows rich, and not only in money. Everyone who depends on each other rises together. If you were born into a family like this, you were given a head start. Know that you were, and use it well, and it renews itself day by day.

lines.image: the king who comes home to his family.
lines.reading: Even a king comes home to a family. Whoever runs everything else still needs a place where they are only themselves. When real trouble comes, your strength is there, among people who love you and are loved back. There is nothing to worry about. Come home, and it goes well.

lines.image: sincerity carried with dignity, at the top of the house.
lines.reading: At the top of the house, your word is trusted and you carry yourself with dignity. You earned that by being the same inside as out. The good end may be slow to come. Look to yourself before anyone else, and stay sure that it is coming.

gene_keys.shadow:
Weakness here is a belief that you are powerless, and it feels like plain fact. You look at the part of your life that struggles most, money or health or one bond, and decide it is a dead end. So you bow your head to it and call that being realistic. Most people would rather stay beaten than find out otherwise. Giving in wears you down with a tiredness that has nothing good behind it. It is not the tiredness you feel after work you were glad to do.

You have been leaning on crutches you never needed. You need them only as long as you believe you are weak without them. Put them down, and you find your legs were strong all along. The part of your life that struggles most is where the whole of it can be lifted from, once you stop hiding it.
gene_keys.repressive: This person drowns the fear in feeling. They speak warmly about people and believe their moods are their heart. They go over every feeling until everyone near them is drained. The feeling is real, but it has no spine, and the fear underneath is never touched.
gene_keys.reactive: This person answers the fear by going hard. They see only who is up and who is down, and close round their heart until they forget what love feels like. Soft people look like fools to be used. They need a willing victim, and crumble first when someone stands up from the heart.
gene_keys.gift:
Equality begins inside you, between the two sides of you. You have a sharp mind and a soft heart, a will that pushes and a willingness to give way. When one side rules and the other gives in, you are split and weak. Let the two meet as equals, and the balance you find goes with you into every room.

The one a group worries about is often the one who holds it together. In a family or a team you go to that weak place and help it mend, without taking it over. You hold a young tree up until it can stand, then let go. The ones you set free are the ones who stay loyal. You are never too proud to ask for help. People know you by your friendliness.
gene_keys.siddhi: Tenderness is the way a mother holds a child, and no single person owns it. You can feel it only with other people. It passes between people and grows among a few who have been drawn together. On a bright morning in a busy market you can see it pass from one pair of eyes to the next. It has no tension in it, so nothing can push against it. It is nearer the surface than anyone thinks, and in the right conditions it comes up by itself. What frightened you most is what changes you, once you trust it. Soft as it is, nothing can beat it.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy holds people together, and it runs out when you give until nothing is left. Eternal Wellspring holds what it lacks: the will to step away alone and fill up again. Giving in to weakness here ends in exhaustion, which is where that card sits at its lowest. Open it when you have looked after everyone and are empty.

human_design.gate: Gate 37 sits in the centre of feeling, in your belly, and presses you to belong. It is the wish to have a few people who are yours and to see them looked after. Its fear is that your own needs will go unmet while you meet everyone else's. When it runs well, your loyalty holds a group together and people know they can rely on you. When it runs badly, you give until nothing is left and keep the peace by leaving the hard thing unsaid. The peace worth keeping is the one where it gets said. Its nervousness is about tradition, the way things have always been done, kept long after it has stopped serving anyone.
human_design.centre:
The Emotional Solar Plexus Center sits under your ribs, and there feeling is both an engine and a way of knowing. It moves in a wave, and there is no truth in the middle of it. What a feeling meant becomes clear once the wave has passed.

A little more than half of all people have this centre defined. Where this gate is part of a defined channel, the wave builds. You put one upset away, then the next, sure you are fine. Then someone breaks a promise, and the whole store comes out at once. A hand on your shoulder calms you faster than any words. The rest have the centre open. They take in the feelings of the people around them and feel them louder than that person does. To avoid the blast they may stay nice and leave the truth unsaid. Alone, they settle into a steady peace. For everyone, a feeling that is felt passes in a few minutes, and one that is held is stored in the body as tension.
human_design.channel: Loyalty on its own is a promise with no means to keep it. Gate 40, in the Heart Center, is the drive to step away alone and provide. Together they make the Channel of Community, the bargain a group runs on: support going one way and provision coming back the other. It keeps asking whether the bargain is fair. Gate 40 may be in you or in someone close, and the channel runs only when both are there.

tarot.ring_role: This energy gathers a few people into a family. It belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Divinity, whose theme is suffering that opens you. UL 22, Treasure of the Way, carries grace. UL 36, Crystal Creation, carries the dark stretch that tests you. UL 63, Adornments of Time, carries the questions that come once a thing is finished. This one carries the tenderness that can only be felt among people.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Four of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, come to this one through the ring and the two trigrams.

body.physiology:
A shared meal is the reason this energy is given to your solar plexus. This knot of nerves sits behind your stomach and reaches everything a meal touches, from the stomach down to the gut. After you eat, blood goes to your belly along a nerve that runs through it, and your whole body slows and warms. It runs the part of you that is fed. It knows whether you have been fed long before you have a word for it.

Sit down to eat with people you belong to. Half an hour later the hollow under your breastbone is warm and your whole body has settled. Rest a hand there and you are resting it on the part of you that knows it has been fed.
body.amino_acid:
The warmth that passes between your people has a substance in you, and it is proline. Your body makes its own from another of the twenty pieces your proteins are built from, so it never has to come from food. Milk, cheese and bread are full of it all the same. Boil bones for a stock and let it go cold: it sets to a jelly, and the setting is proline's doing.

This energy is never carried by one person alone. It is the heart of a family, whatever the blood. You will not feel it being made. You feel the warmth when you are among your people.

relations.unity_line: UL 38 is this card's pair and its inverse at once: the world outside, where people differ, and this one is the home they share.

pair.teaching: This energy draws your own people close, and it runs out at the door, where the world does not think the way your family does. Inner Light Symphony is where it goes next: standing by what matters to you among people who see it differently. Open it when you step out of the house and meet people who are not yours. Every family meets that world sooner or later.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy end for end and the inside becomes the outside. Inner Light Symphony is the same bond seen from out in the world, where people pull apart. Open it when the closeness at home starts to feel like a wall against everyone else.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy holds people together, and it runs out when you give until nothing is left. Eternal Wellspring holds what it lacks: the will to step away alone and fill up again. Giving in to weakness here ends in exhaustion, which is where that card sits at its lowest. Open it when you have looked after everyone and are empty.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Divinity
codon_ring.teaching: This energy gathers a few people into a family. It belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Divinity, whose theme is suffering that opens you. UL 22, Treasure of the Way, carries grace. UL 36, Crystal Creation, carries the dark stretch that tests you. UL 63, Adornments of Time, carries the questions that come once a thing is finished. This one carries the tenderness that can only be felt among people.

tarot.teaching: Four of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, come to this one through the ring and the two trigrams.

sky.teaching: the fixed earth sign, slow and steady, like the home you keep for the people who are yours.

immortals.teaching: Wind above carries He Xian Gu, the one woman among the eight, and her lotus is the soft centre your home gathers round. Fire below carries Lu Dong Bin, who turned his sword on his own delusion. His is the clear eye that cuts through a comfortable lie at home.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the nail that joins two pieces into one, as your affection joins a few people into a family.

cards.essence: Perseverance is alive in you once you have found something worth staying for. You know in your heart when a thing is right. Your body wants to be in the thick of it, and the effort feeds you instead of wearing you out.

glance.reading:
Perseverance is alive in you once you have found something worth staying for. You know in your heart when a thing is right. Your body wants to be in the thick of it, and the effort feeds you instead of wearing you out.

Some days the fight has nothing real to aim at, so it lands on the people closest to you. When that happens, stop and take one breath. The pattern breaks, and in the pause you can see what deserves your strength.

Be honest about where you are unhappy, in your work or in your closest bond. Then picture the thing your heart wants most, and put all that daily effort into it. Stay with it until it grows into what you hoped for. People who live this way have a light about them, and they smile easily.

iching.trigram_combination: Fire over Lake is the hexagram of two close people who have turned different ways. Fire is the clear sight in you that sees where you and another differ. Lake is the part of you that enjoys company. The clear sight sits above because once you see a difference, friendliness no longer closes it. This hexagram has long been read as a flame rising off a lake as the water sinks. Your clear sight rises the same way, while the ease between you sinks. What each of you wants from a life stays the same. You can differ from the people you love and still share one aim.
iching.reading:
Two people who belong together have turned to look different ways. Neither of you is wrong, and neither of you is an enemy. You feel misunderstood, and still the difference between you matters to what you are doing. The large question between you cannot be settled now.

So settle the small things within your reach, one at a time, and let the large one heal from the edges in. What you have lost comes back on its own if you do not chase it. Keep company with everyone, and keep your own ground while you do. Look for what you share on the things that matter most, and let the small differences stand.

Your eyes and your mouth carry this. The eyes see the difference, and the mouth wants to smooth it over. Keep the eyes clear and the mouth kind, and give it time.
judgement_lines: Turned away from each other. In small matters, good fortune.
Heaven and earth face opposite ways; their work is one.
image_lines: Fire above, the lake below: the picture of turning away.
So the wise keep company with everyone, and keep themselves.

upper_trigram.name: Fire (Li)
upper_trigram.nature: Glowing light spreading in all directions. The power of consciousness. Magical fire-bird. The middle daughter.

lower_trigram.name: Lake (Tui)
lower_trigram.nature: Open surface, interaction, pleasure, the mouth, exchange. The youngest daughter.

lines.image: the horse lost and not chased, and bad company met without harm.
lines.reading: Your horse has run off, and the one move is not to run after it. What is yours comes back on its own once you stop chasing. Then there are people you would rather not meet, who cannot be avoided just now. Look at them clearly and speak with them. Seeing plainly what is in front of you is all the protection you need.

lines.image: meeting the master in a side lane.
lines.reading: The front door is shut while people are divided, and the meeting you need will not happen in the open. It happens in a side lane, by chance, with no ceremony. Nobody will hold that against you. What ought to meet still meets, only not by the road you planned. Take the side lane when it opens to you.

lines.image: the wagon dragged back, the ox held, hair and nose cut off.
lines.reading: Your cart, your ox and your good name are all pulled backward at once. Nobody knows where this trouble comes from, and none of it is your doing. It is a bad beginning with a good end. Do not give in to the shame of it now. Hold on, and let the end come to you.

lines.image: alone in the estrangement, and a kindred one met.
lines.reading: Cut off, with nobody near who sees what you see, you are the odd one out. Somewhere there is one other of your kind, and in your hardest hour you find them. Between two who trust each other the danger stays, but the harm goes. Go looking for that person, and put your honesty beside theirs.

lines.image: the companion who bites through the wrappings.
lines.reading: The regret is gone. The one who is yours reaches you easily, and nothing stands between you. With that person beside you, going forward cannot be a mistake. Go forward, and there is cause to celebrate.

lines.image: a pig covered in mud, a wagon of ghosts, the bow drawn then put down, and rain.
lines.reading: You are alone at the far end of the estrangement. The one coming looks like a pig caked in mud or a cart full of ghosts, and you draw the bow. It is not a robber but someone come to marry, and the fear was yours. Ask before you act. Lower the bow and go on. The rain that falls washes every doubt off you.

gene_keys.shadow:
Struggle is a fight with no purpose. It turns on whatever is in reach, even your own life or the people at your table. Once you bite down on something, you do not let go until it gives way. Struggle can free you, and it traps you the moment it becomes a habit. The day begins with a list of things to do and is over before you have looked up. There is a great sadness in this, because the fight you are having is never your real one. Most of it lands on the people closest to you, and the love between you wears thin.

Under it sits an old fear. As long as you are fighting, you feel in charge of your corner of the world. With nothing to fight, you fear you might cease to be. When the fighting stops, the whole of you is still there.
gene_keys.repressive: This person gave up long ago and has never said so. The force in them has nowhere to go, so it is stored in the body as tension, and every enthusiasm goes flat. They blame only themselves, which locks it in deeper. The day they find a cause worth fighting for, the tension leaves.
gene_keys.reactive: This person cannot stop fighting and always picks the wrong fight. The tension in their body has to go somewhere, so it goes at the first person in reach, and fighting becomes a need. They can be controlling and hard to live with. Given a real purpose, they drop the aggression at once.
gene_keys.gift:
Perseverance is the same force with a fight worth having in front of it. The only thing that changes is which fight you are in. Resistance is pushing against the way things are moving, and it wears you out. An obstacle is part of the work, a test that sharpens your skill. You enjoy the odds against you, and you make hard things look easy while giving them everything. Your stubbornness can wear down a stronger opponent. Your deafness shuts out the voices that say it cannot be done.

This strength also knows when to hold back. Animals stop for no reason at all, and a fly lands on your arm and simply rests. Let life call you to these pauses. A day with pauses in it is a day you were awake for.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Honour is what the fight becomes when nobody needs to win it. It comes from living your own truth, and at its height it joins you to everyone else. To honour someone is to hold them at their best, whatever they are doing now. People can lie to you or use you, and you still do not sink to their level. The test of an act is whether it brings people together or pulls them apart.

What you do from honour is remembered and told again. Each telling reminds people what they can be. Honour is quiet, and it lights a fire in everyone who meets it.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy holds on through anything, and it cannot always tell which fight is worth having. Nobel Spark holds what it lacks: the spark that provokes and pushes into action. Held in fear, the two grind each other down. Lived well, they set each other free. Open it when you have held on so long you have forgotten why.

human_design.gate: Gate 38 is the Fighter, and it presses you to find out what is worth fighting for. The finding matters more than the fight. You question and probe, and you do not look away from a hard truth. Other people's opinions move you very little, so you stand up for what you believe in even when it is unpopular. From outside you can look stubborn, as if every disagreement has to become a fight. Pick your fights, because a fight chosen only to let off pressure leaves you drained. Near you, people find a loyal friend and a steady ally.
human_design.centre:
The Root Center sits at the base of the body, and it is where the pressure to act comes from. It is a motor and a pressure at once, the spark that gets you moving. Its key is timing. It switches on and off like the spark in a car engine. Some days the push to act is strong, and on others it is simply off. On those days the timing is off, not you.

About six people in ten have this centre defined. They live with a steady pressure, can bear it, and can aim it. When they take up fights that are not theirs, the stress wears the body down. The other four in ten have it open and take in the pressure of everyone around them. Every task feels urgent, so they rush to finish things to make the pressure stop, and it never stops. Their gift is knowing which pressures deserve an answer.
human_design.channel: Gate 28 sits in the Spleen, the part of you that asks whether a life means anything. Joined to it, this pressure becomes the Channel of Struggle. Its work is to find out which struggles are yours to take hold of. A good struggle is the most rewarding thing there is, and a bad one is the most draining. Gate 28 may be in you or in someone close to you. When both are there, the fight has a reason.

tarot.ring_role: This energy fights for what matters, as every human life does. It belongs to a family of six, the Ring of Humanity, whose theme is your own human story. UL 25, The Mysteries Play, carries the wound you start with. UL 17, Pearl of Christos, carries going past the limits of your mind. UL 21, Beyond Binary, carries letting go of control. UL 10, Internal Treasure, carries finding your true self. UL 51, Unshakable Arrival, carries your waking up. This one carries the battle with your own shadows.
tarot.tarot_resonance: The ring and the two trigrams bring five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, to this one.

body.physiology:
The fight is the reason this energy is given to the adrenals. They are two small glands, one on top of each kidney, under the last ribs at your back. When something startles you, they arm you in the same second: your heart beats harder and your airways open. They do this before you have decided anything. They arm you the same way for the wrong fight and the right one, because they cannot tell the two apart. If nothing follows, it all settles within a couple of minutes.

Put a hand on your chest a second after a door slams. The heart under it is already going harder, and you chose nothing. Keep the hand there a minute and feel it settle.
body.amino_acid:
Perseverance has a chemistry in you, and one substance in it is arginine. Your body makes it for itself and builds it into every protein in you. It also comes in meat, eggs and nuts. With two others it makes the charge your muscles keep ready for the first seconds of hard effort.

This substance is in every person, and so is the struggle it carries here, to rise above your own lower nature. It is often through defeat that a person learns to be stronger.

relations.unity_line: UL 37 is this card's pair and its inverse at once: the family gathered in, where this one stands apart.

pair.teaching: This energy stays with what matters, and it runs out when staying has kept you from the people you love. Journey Home is where it goes next: the warmth that gathers a few people around one table. Open it when you have held your ground long enough and want to come in. At that table, everyone counts the same.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy end for end and the turning apart becomes a gathering in. Journey Home is the same household seen from inside the walls. Open it when you have stood alone long enough and want to belong again.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy holds on through anything, and it cannot always tell which fight is worth having. Nobel Spark holds what it lacks: the spark that provokes and pushes into action. Held in fear, the two grind each other down. Lived well, they set each other free. Open it when you have held on so long you have forgotten why.

codon_ring.name: Codon Ring of Humanity
codon_ring.teaching: This energy fights for what matters, as every human life does. It belongs to a family of six, the Ring of Humanity, whose theme is your own human story. UL 25, The Mysteries Play, carries the wound you start with. UL 17, Pearl of Christos, carries going past the limits of your mind. UL 21, Beyond Binary, carries letting go of control. UL 10, Internal Treasure, carries finding your true self. UL 51, Unshakable Arrival, carries your waking up. This one carries the battle with your own shadows.

tarot.teaching: The ring and the two trigrams bring five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, to this one.

sky.teaching: the water sign that guards its home, as you guard what you love.

immortals.teaching: Fire above carries Lu Dong Bin, the scholar who turned his sword on his own delusion, as you can turn your fight inward. Lake below carries Zhong Li Quan, the old general who left the army to heal, as your strength can heal once the fight is over.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the fence around a field, so you know which ground is yours to hold.

cards.essence: You still carry a small child's energy, and it always wants to move. It rises in your body before you have thought, ready to act. When something stands in your way, this energy gathers there, so a block shows you where to look. It starts things and keeps them moving.

glance.reading:
You still carry a small child's energy, and it always wants to move. It rises in your body before you have thought, ready to act. When something stands in your way, this energy gathers there, so a block shows you where to look. It starts things and keeps them moving.

Some days a person gets under your skin, and you react before you can stop. Forcing a block open only makes you tighter. Holding the energy down leaves your breath shallow. Let in what bothers you, and ask which habit of yours it is pointing at.

Put the energy into what you love, and the more you make, the more of it there is. Breathe all the way down into your belly, the way a child does. Near you, people breathe more deeply and feel able to do more. This is the spark in you that wakes everyone up.

iching.trigram_combination: Water over Mountain is the hexagram of the road that closes in front of you. Water is the part of you that wants to keep moving, even toward danger. Mountain is the part of you that knows when to stop. The danger sits above the stopping because it lies ahead, and only the one who stops in time sees it. This hexagram has long been read as water on a mountain, with no way down. Water held still on a height settles and clears, and your mind does the same when you stop. The texts also say to find someone who has crossed this way before. When the road closes, you get clear by stopping.
iching.reading:
You set out, the way is blocked, and the next way is blocked too. It is not your fault; the trouble is in the lay of the land. Pushing on only takes you deeper into it. What this time asks is that you see the danger and stop. Stopping here is knowing, and it is different from giving up. Go where the ground is easy, away from the hard country. Look for someone who has already come through this, and follow what they value. Hold to what is right through it, and it ends well.

While the road is closed, the work turns back on you. Look at your own conduct and mend what you find, instead of blaming anyone. Held back from outside, you grow from within.

The body here is the feet. Notice them now, cold or warm, ready to go or planted. Let them stand where they are until the way opens.
judgement_lines: The blocked way. The southwest brings benefit; the northeast does not.
It helps to see the great person. Holding firm brings good fortune.
image_lines: Water on the mountain: the image of the blocked way.
So the wise turn their attention to themselves and shape their character.

upper_trigram.name: Water (K'an)
upper_trigram.nature: Precipice, dangerous place. Stream, flowing water, river. Venture and fall. The middle son.

lower_trigram.name: Mountain (Ken)
lower_trigram.nature: Limit, frontier, stillness. Solid, steady, unshakable. The youngest son.

lines.image: going meets the block; coming back earns praise.
lines.reading: The block is at the first step, before you are caught up in anything. Go on, and you walk into trouble. Turn back, and you are praised for seeing the danger early and stopping at once. That is good sense, and it has nothing to do with fear. Wait where you are, work on yourself, and let the time come round.

lines.image: the king's servant, meeting block after block, not for his own sake.
lines.reading: You serve something larger than yourself, and the troubles come one after another. They are not your fault, and they cannot be stepped around. This is the one place where stopping is not the counsel. Give it all you have for the sake of the whole, and there is no bitterness at the end.

lines.image: going meets the block; coming back, and those at home rejoice.
lines.reading: You are strong here, and strength wants to push on into the danger. The people who depend on you are behind you. They are glad when you come home. Stop, turn back, and look after them while the road is closed.

lines.image: going meets the block; coming back brings company.
lines.reading: You are alone and not strong enough to force a way out. Forcing it would only make the trouble worse. Come back and ask for help without shame, from someone who has the means you lack. Stand together on firm ground, and then go on.

lines.image: the great block, and friends come.
lines.reading: This is the worst of it, and friends come. They come because you kept steady in the middle, and others took you as their measure. It may get harder before it gets easier. Hold steady and let them stand with you.

lines.image: going meets the block; coming back brings great good fortune, and it helps to see the great person.
lines.reading: There is nowhere further to go, so everything now is in coming back. Your aim is inside you. Seek out someone who knows the way out step by step, and follow what they value. Turning back now brings you more than going on ever could.

gene_keys.shadow:
Someone close says a small thing in a certain tone, and something in you goes off before you can think. It is almost never the words. The tone finds the exact place where you already feel guilty or sore. Under the anger sits an older fear, of being trapped and losing your freedom to act. Anything that feels cornered will strike. You are caught the moment you react. Most people push buttons on some days and have theirs pushed on others.

Held in, the same energy keeps your breath high and short. Leaving the job or moving house does not help, because the trapped feeling moves with you. What changes it is how you meet the next tone.
gene_keys.repressive: This person's fear never shows. It stays frozen under an anger that never reaches the surface. Their life force sits locked in the same few moods, as if asleep. From outside they look calm. The trap holds because they do not know they are in it.
gene_keys.reactive: This person lets the fear out as anger. They press the sore spot and say the thing meant to sting. Each jab comes back on them. Anger is how frozen fear starts to move, though there is no freedom in it yet. Underneath, they want to be loved.
gene_keys.gift:
Dynamism is the energy you see in a small child, which never runs out and comes back as soon as it is spent. Most of it was set into habit by the age of seven, and none of that is final. When it comes back in a grown person, it comes as creativity. The quickest way to call it back is to do what you love. Your breath drops back into your belly, the way a child breathes.

Other people catch it. Near someone living this, people breathe more fully and feel able to do more. This energy does not wait. It starts things and keeps them going, and it will risk hurting someone's feelings to shake them awake. Its joy comes after long, steady work, and it shows in a laugh that shakes the whole body.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Liberation is the state where nothing can provoke you. A word enters your ear, your mind turns it into meaning, and your breath does not catch. You hear the sound without following it. To get here you give up the thing that seemed to drive you, your own separate freedom. It feels like a physical death, every plan and piece of work let go at once, and it passes through agony into joy.

People who live here are hard to be near. They aim their love at your weakest spot to test how far you have let go. If anything still lands as personal, there is further to go. A dragonfly larva hunts well under the water, then one day climbs up toward the light. The same push can rise in you, out of nowhere, and take you past a life that was working.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy stirs people up, and on its own it has no staying power. Inner Light Symphony holds what it lacks: the perseverance to see a hard thing through. Together they make the old story of the warrior, pushed into a fight and staying in it. Open it when you have started something and need the patience to keep it going.

human_design.gate: Gate 39 sits in the Root, low in your body, and it presses you to stir up what has gone still. It drives you to provoke people, sometimes by playful teasing and sometimes more fiercely, until something in them moves. What you push them toward is trust that life will give them what they need. Everything depends on timing. With the right person at the right moment, it is a spark that wakes up the whole room. If you do it only to ease your own pressure, nobody enjoys it. This gate is hard to talk out of anything. It treats every moment of feeling that there is not enough as a place to push off from.
human_design.centre:
The Root Center is the square at the bottom of the chart, and it is a motor and a pressure at once. It pumps stress into you so that something gets done. Its one law is timing. The motor pulses on and off. When you cannot get yourself moving, the time is not right.

About six people in ten have it defined. Pressure feels familiar to them, and they can focus it into steady doing. Other people's urgency does not easily push them into starting what is not theirs. The other four in ten have it open. They take in the pressure of everyone around them and feel it louder, like a pot with the lid on. The usual answer is to clean the kitchen or finish some other task. The next task is always waiting, and the pressure is not even theirs. Some people stop doing anything at all. Their gift is knowing which pressures to answer, and when the time is right they can get a huge amount done at once.
