human_design.channel: Gate 55, in the Solar Plexus, holds the rise and fall of feeling. With Gate 39 it makes the Channel of Emoting, where pressure turns into mood, and the mood stirs other people. It swings between the glass half empty and the glass half full. Watch the swing and use it, instead of flattening it. Gate 55 may be in you or in someone close, and the pressure becomes feeling only when both are there.

tarot.ring_role: This energy is the push that starts every search. It belongs to a family of six, the Ring of Seeking, and each member makes a different pressure in you. UL 52, Timeless Blossom, keeps the pressure in check. UL 53, Creation Oscillation, carries the urge to begin. UL 54, Everlasting Bounty, carries the drive to rise. UL 58, Rhythm of Life, carries joy. UL 15, Ordinary Valiance, is where the seeking comes to rest. This one wakes first.
tarot.tarot_resonance: The ring and the two trigrams bring four of the tarot's major cards here, and one of them twice.

body.physiology:
The rush is the reason this energy is given to the adrenals. Two small glands sit on top of your kidneys, and they fire before you have decided anything. Within a second the rush is through you. Your blood leaves your skin for your muscles, your hands go cold and a little damp, and you are ready to move. The rush is real, and it is gone in a couple of minutes, because your body clears it that fast. A body that keeps calling for it is under a pressure with nowhere to go. You feel that as a tiredness rest does not touch.

Think of the last time something startled you. Your hands went cold a moment later, because the blood had gone where it was needed. When the rush had passed, a deep breath came on its own. That breath is what lasts.
body.amino_acid:
The pressure in you has a chemistry, and one substance in it is serine. You feel it low in your body, where the rush starts. It is gutsy and all about action, and it never waits for your head. You share this chemistry with five other energies, and each makes a different pressure in you.

Yours is enormous, in you and in the room around you, and it is what makes things. It drives a person past what they were. When you cut yourself, serine is part of what makes your blood clot and close the wound.

relations.unity_line: UL 40 and UL 38 hold the two ends of this energy: the release that comes after a block, and the long effort that gives the push its purpose.

pair.teaching: This energy builds up behind a block, and it runs out once there is nothing left to push against. Eternal Wellspring is where it goes next: the release, when the knot comes loose and the effort can rest. Open it when the block has finally given way.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy end for end and the block becomes the way out. Eternal Wellspring is the same road seen from the far side of the knot. Open it when you are tired of pressing and want to know what comes after.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy stirs people up, and on its own it has no staying power. Inner Light Symphony holds what it lacks: the perseverance to see a hard thing through. Together they make the old story of the warrior, pushed into a fight and staying in it. Open it when you have started something and need the patience to keep it going.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Seeking
codon_ring.teaching: This energy is the push that starts every search. It belongs to a family of six, the Ring of Seeking, and each member makes a different pressure in you. UL 52, Timeless Blossom, keeps the pressure in check. UL 53, Creation Oscillation, carries the urge to begin. UL 54, Everlasting Bounty, carries the drive to rise. UL 58, Rhythm of Life, carries joy. UL 15, Ordinary Valiance, is where the seeking comes to rest. This one wakes first.

tarot.teaching: The ring and the two trigrams bring four of the tarot's major cards here, and one of them twice.

sky.teaching: the careful sign that sorts and mends, as you do when you look at your own conduct and put it right.

immortals.teaching: Water above carries Li Tie Guai, the healer who came back from his own death carrying medicine in a gourd. Mountain below carries Zhang Guo Lao, the old hermit who rides his donkey facing backward. One tells you the worst can be survived, and the other that there is no hurry to go forward. Between them they show you how to wait out a closed road.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the smallest letter, the first stroke of every other one, like the first small move that gets a stuck thing going.

cards.essence: When a long push is over and you can finally set things down, your will starts to fill again. With it you can carry what is yours all the way to its end. It rises from deep inside you the way a spring does, and nothing in it has to be forced. Work that fits you does not drain you, so you can work harder than most and still have strength left.

glance.reading:
When a long push is over and you can finally set things down, your will starts to fill again. With it you can carry what is yours all the way to its end. It rises from deep inside you the way a spring does, and nothing in it has to be forced. Work that fits you does not drain you, so you can work harder than most and still have strength left.

Some weeks you give to everyone who asks, and the tiredness goes deeper than sleep can reach. That tiredness comes from pushing your life in a direction that is not its own. Slowly put down one thing that is not yours, and your body breathes out.

There is a thing you are here to do, and it is probably in front of you already. Give yourself to it, and say no to everything else without a fight. Stop when it is time to stop, and keep some of every day for yourself. The strength you spend on what is yours comes back as fast as you give it.

iching.trigram_combination: Thunder over Water is the hexagram of the moment a hard time lets go of you. Water is the danger you have been living inside, where each step feels like a risk. Thunder is the part of you that moves, the jolt that gets you up after a long time held still. The movement sits above the danger because you get out of trouble by moving, and here you have moved. This hexagram has long been read as a thunderstorm breaking. The air is heavy for days, then the rain comes, and afterwards you can breathe again. The same rain splits the seeds open, so what was shut tight begins to grow. What held you is coming loose, and your part now is to let it.
iching.reading:
The hard time is over. What held you for so long has let go, the way the air clears after a storm. Now the time can go one of two ways. If there is nothing more to do, go back to your ordinary days and keep the old ways. If something is still to do, do it early at first light, before the trouble settles in again. Do not stay in the relief longer than it lasts. Others have come through this before you, and they were back at work the next morning.

Then forgive. Let the mistakes go, your own with everyone else's, because while you hold on to who was to blame you are still tied. Go gently, and rest the way the ground rests after rain. In the body this starts in the feet. After a long time sitting, your feet want to move before you have decided to walk. Let them take the first step, and keep the rest of you easy.
judgement_lines: Deliverance. The gain is toward the southwest, the level ground.
When there is nowhere left to go, coming back brings good fortune.
When there is still somewhere to go, going early brings good fortune.
image_lines: Thunder and rain set in: what was bound comes loose.
So the wise pardon mistakes, and forgive what was done wrong.

upper_trigram.name: Thunder (Chen)
upper_trigram.nature: Arousing power emerging from the depth of the earth. Excite, influence, move, affect. The eldest son.

lower_trigram.name: Water (K'an)
lower_trigram.nature: Precipice, dangerous place. Stream, flowing water, river. Venture and fall. The middle son.

lines.image: the border where hard meets soft.
lines.reading: On the border where the hard time meets its end, all that is said is no blame. What happened was not yours to prevent, so do not punish yourself for it. You are still weak from it. Borrow the strength of someone who knows the way out, then cross over and step carefully from here.

lines.image: three foxes caught in the field, a yellow arrow won.
lines.reading: Three foxes are caught in the field, and a yellow arrow is won. The foxes are the small tricks that got you through the hard time. Do not let them run loose now, and do not kill them either. Guide them until they go quiet on their own. The arrow is the straight way through the middle, so keep to it.

lines.image: a porter riding in a carriage, robbers drawn near.
lines.reading: A porter still carrying his load rides in a carriage, and every robber on the road notices. Relief has you showing more than you have, or riding where you should walk. The trouble this draws is your own doing, and nobody else can be blamed. Get down, carry your own load, and live plainly until you are through.

lines.image: untangle your big toe from the snare.
lines.reading: Your big toe is tangled in a poisonous plant, and it has not hurt you yet. A toe can move, but it cannot walk on its own. There is a tie to cut, to someone or something that keeps you near the danger. Cut it, and the friends you can trust will come.

lines.image: the one in charge lets the difficulty go.
lines.reading: The one in charge lets the hard time go, and the petty people around him fall back on their own. Free yourself before you try to free anyone else. A leader who stays strict after the storm keeps everyone tied. Be kind where you could punish, and even those who doubted you will see that you mean it.

lines.image: a prince shoots a hawk on the high wall, and hits it.
lines.reading: A prince shoots at a hawk on a high wall, and hits it. At the very end of a release one greedy thing remains, sitting high where it can take everything back. Do not wait for it to fly off. The time is right, so aim once and finish what you began, and everyone gains.

gene_keys.shadow:
Tired is where this begins, a tiredness that sleep no longer reaches. Picture a hand so full it cannot open. In it are the job, the people who lean on you and the things you agreed to without wanting them. You were taught that a strong person does more and holds on harder, and both drain you. The cost shows up as thirst. You want something you cannot name, and mostly you do not notice how thirsty you are. Underneath it there is usually a feeling you have refused to feel.

It shows up as too much: too much work and no time for home, or all of you going to other people. You become many things to many people and no one to yourself. Cut off from what feeds you, you run down, the way anything does that is drawn on and never filled. The hand does not need to be forced open. Noticing it is where the tiredness starts to end.
gene_keys.repressive: Held down, the tiredness leaves the hand lying open with the palm up for anyone to take from. They never learned that their own needs count, so they give without end, mostly to people who do not care about them. The word no will not come. Their life turns on the day they make a stand for themselves alone.
gene_keys.reactive: Let out, the same hand closes into a fist. Underneath is an old rage that was never allowed, turned into scorn for others, the weakest first. They look strong, because rage burns like fuel, and they keep everyone at a distance. Cutting away every support, they wear themselves down from inside, and in the end it shows.
gene_keys.gift:
Resolve starts with an open hand that holds one thing. Take hold of what is truly yours, and the rest falls from your fingers. The favours you did not want to do fall away, and so do the promises made only to please. What stays feeds you. You can work hard and not wear out, because the will is built into the work from the start. You say no without a fight, since whoever you turn away belongs somewhere else. When someone you love calls you away in the middle, you put the work down, and taking that break is part of the strength.

Most of it is knowing how to relax. Rest is everywhere once you stop giving in to too much. It is a walk with nowhere to get to, or the work you love with people you love. None of this is going without. You take what life offers, with measure, and sometimes more than you need. Someone worn out who meets you goes away changed.
gene_keys.siddhi: Both hands are empty now, and nothing is missing. You no longer feel like the one making the choices. You are free to do exactly as you please, and none of what you do is in your hands. Every part of your body is at ease, and people near you can see it as a kind of light. Nobody can pretend their way here. Some who are tired of searching take up the idea of surrender to get off the hook, and that only makes them quiet. This comes at the end of the search, when every hope has been dropped, and it comes to you alone.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy steps away to fill itself, and it runs out when it keeps everything for itself. Journey Home holds what it lacks: the warmth that feeds a few people around one table. One makes sure you have time and space of your own, and the other gives freely to the people you love. Open it when you have been alone long enough and want to give again.

human_design.gate: Gate 40 sits in the Will Center and pulls you away to gather yourself. After work or after people, it wants you on your own for a while to restock what you gave. It asks you to value yourself enough to step away, even from the people you love. A partner can read this as rejection, so tell them what it is. When it runs badly, you stay instead: you give to everyone who asks and prove your worth by doing more. Then you blame others for a tiredness you never named. The loneliness that comes with this gate is a signal to turn inward. You come back from the time away with more to give than you left with.
human_design.centre:
The Will Center sits just off the heart. It holds the strength to say you will do a thing and then do it. It is one of four motors, the one most concerned with the material world: what you can do and what you are worth. It is built to work and then rest. Pushed on without rest, it burns out, and the body pays.

About four people in ten have this centre defined. They can make a promise and keep it, and people near them borrow that strength while they are close. Their risk is pushing because they can, until the body stops them. The other six have it open. They take in the will in a room and feel it louder than it is, the doubt about worth as much as the strength. Some spend a whole life proving a worth that never needed proving, and wear out doing it. Their gift is a taste for what is truly worth something. Nothing they do adds to their worth or takes from it, any more than an orchid is worth more than a daffodil.
human_design.channel: On its own, stepping away is only someone leaving. Gate 37, in the Emotional Solar Plexus Center, is the pull to belong to a few people and see them fed. Together they make the Channel of Community, which turns the two into a bargain. Its terms are clear and fair to both sides, with your own needs written in. Then comes the strength to work without tiring on what was agreed. Gate 37 may be in you or in a person close by, and the bargain holds only when both are present.

tarot.ring_role: This energy saves your strength by not wasting it. It belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Alchemy, whose theme is turning something rough into something fine. UL 6, Harmonious Mirage, carries the walls coming down between two people. UL 47, Garden of Alchemy, carries the change of old ways. UL 64, Communion, carries the fresh possibilities that follow. This one carries the new openness into a community.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Its family and its two trigrams bring five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, to this one.

body.physiology:
Rest is the reason this energy is given to your stomach. The stomach is where what you eat becomes what you run on, and it does that only while you are at rest. It loosens to make room for a meal before the meal arrives, then works on it for hours without being asked. When you are afraid or angry or straining, it stops and the blood goes to your muscles instead. A full stomach leaves the will in you content, and an empty one sends it out to find food. What you force costs you what you had. What you take in at rest is what you have to give.

Your stomach lies high on your left, under the ribs, a little below the tip of the breastbone. After a meal, rest a hand there and you can feel the fullness. On an empty morning, the growl under your hand is its wall working on nothing. Your hand is on the part of you that works only when you leave it alone.
body.amino_acid:
The will in you has a substance, and it is glycine. It is the smallest of the twenty pieces your proteins are built from. Your body makes most of what it needs, and the rest comes from the skin and bones of meat or fish. A third of the frame that holds you up, your skin and bone, is made of it. In your spinal cord it is the signal that tells a nerve to stop firing.

Three other energies in you run on this same substance, and between them they waste no strength. Together they release everything your body still holds against itself. Carried all the way, that release leaves every part of you at rest.

relations.unity_line: UL 39 is this card's pair and its inverse at once: the hard time building, where this one sees it break.

pair.teaching: This energy lets go when a hard time ends, and it runs out when the ease turns into too much. Nobel Spark is where it goes next: the pressure that builds when the way ahead is blocked. Open it when the relief has lasted a while and something starts to press on you again. Hardship and relief follow each other.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy end for end and the release becomes the block. Nobel Spark is the same storm seen from before it breaks, when the way will not open. Open it when you are stuck and cannot yet see the rain coming.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy steps away to fill itself, and it runs out when it keeps everything for itself. Journey Home holds what it lacks: the warmth that feeds a few people around one table. One makes sure you have time and space of your own, and the other gives freely to the people you love. Open it when you have been alone long enough and want to give again.

codon_ring.name: Codon Ring of Alchemy
codon_ring.teaching: This energy saves your strength by not wasting it. It belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Alchemy, whose theme is turning something rough into something fine. UL 6, Harmonious Mirage, carries the walls coming down between two people. UL 47, Garden of Alchemy, carries the change of old ways. UL 64, Communion, carries the fresh possibilities that follow. This one carries the new openness into a community.

tarot.teaching: Its family and its two trigrams bring five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, to this one.

sky.teaching: the swift messenger planet, quick to untie a knot and carry what is freed on its way, as your will moves once nothing holds it.

immortals.teaching: Thunder above carries Cao Guo Jiu, the emperor's kin who gave up his rank. Through him you let go of what you were handed. Water below carries Li Tie Guai, the healer who came back from his own death with medicine in a gourd. Through him you come back from a hard time carrying what helps. A release asks you for both.

hebrew_letter.teaching: a house you come back to after being out in the world, the place where your strength fills again.

cards.essence: When one part of your life ends and the next has not begun, a longing for more rises in you. You feel it low in your body, as a pull toward a life you can already picture. You sense what is on its way before it arrives, and you want to feel it for yourself. The picture shows you which way to walk.

glance.reading:
When one part of your life ends and the next has not begun, a longing for more rises in you. You feel it low in your body, as a pull toward a life you can already picture. You sense what is on its way before it arrives, and you want to feel it for yourself. The picture shows you which way to walk.

Some days the picture feels so good that its hope is enough, and you stay where you are. Then life takes that picture away, and it can feel like a loss. What you wanted stays with you, and a new picture rises in its place.

Hold each picture the way you hold a plan for a trip, ready for the road to change it. Keep your plans small, and take the first real step toward what you see. Each ending then clears the way for a new start. Step by step, the picture becomes a life you are living.

iching.trigram_combination: Mountain over Lake is the hexagram of giving up what you do not need. Lake is the joy in you that gives freely. Mountain is the part of you that knows when to stop. The stopping sits above the joy because a pleasure you can stop is one that does not run your life. This hexagram has long been read as a lake at the foot of a mountain. The lake gives its water up as mist, and the mist falls as rain on the heights. What you let go of below comes back to lift you. What you give up on purpose makes room for what raises you.
iching.reading:
Something in your life is ending, and you have less to hold on to than before. The loss comes either way. What you can choose is whether you give it up freely. Given up on purpose, what you lose becomes an offering. It need not be much. Two small bowls are enough when what is in them is sincere.

Start with what you have too much of. Hold back your anger, and let a craving pass without feeding it. This is heavy at the start and light afterward, so do not take the weight as a sign that you are wrong. Keep away from what could harm you while you have less. Do not dwell on what has already ended. Setting out goes well now, and where having less ends, having more begins.

In the body this time asks for less. Eat until you have had enough, then stop, and notice how much lighter you feel. A few days by a lake or in the mountains can give back what the everyday wore away.
judgement_lines: Decrease, with sincerity in it, brings the highest good fortune and no blame. It can be held to.
It furthers you to set out. How is it to be done? Two small bowls are enough for the offering.
image_lines: At the foot of the mountain, the lake: the image of decrease.
So the wise hold back their anger and restrain their appetites.

upper_trigram.name: Mountain (Ken)
upper_trigram.nature: Limit, frontier, stillness. Solid, steady, unshakable. The youngest son.

lower_trigram.name: Lake (Tui)
lower_trigram.nature: Open surface, interaction, pleasure, the mouth, exchange. The youngest daughter.

lines.image: your own work set down, and a quick step to help someone.
lines.reading: You set your own work down and hurry to help someone who needs it, and there is no fault in that. A strong hand can give too much, though. The one you help can be swamped, and you can be left empty. Weigh how much the other can take before you give away what is yours.

lines.image: standing firm in the middle, where setting out would go badly.
lines.reading: You are steady where you are, and you want to go out and fix what is weak. Stay where you are instead. Here you help most by keeping your own ground and knowing when enough is enough. Hold to what is right in you, and you add to someone else without losing anything yourself.

lines.image: three walking together and one leaving; one walking alone and finding a friend.
lines.reading: Three set out together and one leaves them, because three begin to doubt each other. The one who walks alone is not alone for long. On this road every loss carries a gain inside it. Keep your mind on one thing, and the right companion finds you.

lines.image: an old ailment lessened, and help coming quickly and gladly.
lines.reading: Something has worn you down for a long time, a fault you have carried until it felt like yours. Lessen it even a little, and help comes quickly. The one who helps is glad to be asked. Let yourself be helped, and there is no blame in it.

lines.image: ten pairs of tortoise shells given, and no one able to refuse them.
lines.reading: Someone adds to what you have, and it cannot be turned away. Tortoise shells were once used as money and to read what was coming. Ten pairs of them arrive without your asking. This is the gain that comes when you give up honestly and ask for nothing. Take what is given, all of it.

lines.image: increase that takes from no one, and helpers gained with no house apart.
lines.reading: The time of having less is over, and you gain without anyone else losing. People come to help with what you are doing, more than you can count. You gain them and no longer keep a house apart from them. Find the people with no direction, and give them yours.

gene_keys.shadow:
A picture of a better life sits in you, and most days you live in the picture instead of the life. The pressure behind it is the pressure to grow. Through a tired mind it comes out as the pressure to feel happy, and the mind paints the right person or the money. You hold the key to your dream and never turn it in the lock. The hope it brings feels so good that you never take a step. When you feel empty, you picture being full. When you feel full, the past weighs on you and you want to be rid of it.

The picture was a light thrown down the road to show you the way, and you stand still looking at the light. Life will take each of these pictures from you, one at a time. That is good news, though it never feels like it. The emptiness a picture leaves can be filled, though never by the next picture, and never by what you achieve.
gene_keys.repressive: Held down, this person has gone into the dream and shut the door. Whatever you say, they hear through it. They do not want it to come true, only to keep dreaming it. Their body slows until the days drag. The way out is to make one small piece of it real.
gene_keys.reactive: Let out, the picture becomes fuel, and this person is always a step ahead of themselves. Nothing they do is fast enough for what they see, so they push harder until the body gives out. What saves them is letting other people into the picture and letting go of its exact shape.
gene_keys.gift:
Anticipation is the same picture once you have seen what it was asking for. Under every fantasy there is one ache: to be loved and to belong to something whole. Once you know that, the picture can be used. You stop mistaking a wish for a sign, and you begin to feel what is really taking shape. A musician can hear a whole piece before one note is written, then write it down. Someone who only pictures a thing and someone who brings it into the world may see the same thing, and only one of them starts.

The light down the road is something you walk toward now. Having found the root of your own pictures, you can see where someone else's is heading. You can sense when a habit that has held them is ready to break. Of all you make, the children you raise and the stories you tell are what last. You know how a story goes, and you can wait for its ending.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Emanation is the end of the road turning out to be where it began. You thought you were travelling forward, and you were travelling back to where you came from. Each picture that rises in you is a small light thrown ahead from that source, looking for the way home. Followed all the way, the lights lead back to where they were thrown from. Nothing you do brings this on. It simply arrives, and then there is no one there for it to happen to.

There is no more hunger here, and no more pressure to become anything. People hear an agenda in whatever you say. If you keep quiet, they hear one in that too. None of it matters to you now. It was all a dream, and you had to be asleep to hear it.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy senses what is coming, and it stalls when no one hears it. Theater of Truth holds what it lacks: the voice that says the picture aloud so others can follow it. The leaders people trust build on what came before and sense what lies ahead. Open it when you can see the way and need to say it to others.

human_design.gate: Gate 41 sits at the base of the body and presses you to picture more than is here. It imagines a fuller life or a better world, then makes you want to feel it for yourself. It gives the first push whenever something new begins in your life. What it starts it does not always finish, because starting is its work. From outside this can look like restlessness, someone never content with what they have. People may call your ideas unrealistic, or say you ask too much. Then you may keep your pictures to yourself until they turn into the worst that could happen. Share a picture when the time is right, and enjoy imagining it for its own sake.
human_design.centre:
The Root Center sits at the base of the body, where the push to act begins. It is a motor and a pressure at once. The push does not run all the time. It comes in pulses, on and then off, like the spark that fires an engine. When it is off, no amount of wanting will get you started.

About six people in ten have this centre defined. For them pressure is familiar, and they can hold it and aim it at one thing. The hard part is the off beat, when the thing they must do will not begin and they turn on themselves for it. The other four in ten have it open. They take in the pressure of everyone around them and feel it louder. Every job in the room feels like theirs, and finishing one never brings rest, because the next is already waiting. Their wisdom, over a life, is knowing which pressures were ever theirs.
human_design.channel: A picture of more has no feeling of its own to run on. Gate 30, in the Solar Plexus, is the wish to feel it. Together they make the Channel of Recognition, a picture of what is possible joined to the passion to live it. Follow every urge at once and the passion is spent. Let a picture sit until you know it is yours, and it has the heat to carry you. Gate 30 may be in you or in a person close by.

tarot.ring_role: This energy begins, and every other energy needs a beginning. It belongs to the Ring of Origin, a family of one, whose theme is the push to seek out new ground and new experience. Whatever else moves in you starts with the first step this one takes.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Five major cards of the tarot gather here, and each names something this longing asks of you.

body.physiology:
This energy belongs to the adrenals because of the morning. These two small glands sit one on top of each kidney, high at the back under the last ribs. Each night they begin your day before you wake. Their tide is lowest around midnight and rises through the last hours of sleep. It is highest in the hour after you wake, so your day has already begun when you open your eyes. They ready you whether the day will be good or not.

You cannot feel them, even with a hand flat on your back below the ribs. What you can notice is waking just before the alarm. When you know the hour you must be up, their tide rises earlier to meet it. Most people have done this without knowing why, and this tide is part of the reason.
body.amino_acid:
The longing for more has a chemistry in you, and one substance in it is methionine. Every protein your body makes begins with this one piece, because the code that spells it also says begin. Your body cannot make it. It comes in from eggs, fish or meat, and beans are short of it. Once the building is under way, that first piece is most often trimmed off.

Every story your body tells opens on the same first word. Beans are short of this piece, and rice is short of another. Eaten together they are short of nothing, which is why kitchens all over the world pair them.

relations.unity_line: UL 42 and UL 31 carry what this energy begins: the filling that follows the letting go, and the voice that says the picture aloud.

pair.teaching: This energy lets go and pictures what comes next, and it runs out when the picture has to be carried to its end. Moving to Perfection is where it goes next: the pull that carries each thing to its end so there is room for what follows. Open it when you have begun and the rest has to be finished. Every letting go turns, in time, into having more.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy end for end and giving up becomes taking in. Moving to Perfection is the same moment seen from the far side, where what you let go of comes back as more. Open it when you have given enough and it is time to receive. What leaves you below returns from above.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy senses what is coming, and it stalls when no one hears it. Theater of Truth holds what it lacks: the voice that says the picture aloud so others can follow it. The leaders people trust build on what came before and sense what lies ahead. Open it when you can see the way and need to say it to others.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Origin
codon_ring.teaching: This energy begins, and every other energy needs a beginning. It belongs to the Ring of Origin, a family of one, whose theme is the push to seek out new ground and new experience. Whatever else moves in you starts with the first step this one takes.

tarot.teaching: Five major cards of the tarot gather here, and each names something this longing asks of you.

sky.teaching: the element of the Fool, the open air you step into before there is ground under your feet.

immortals.teaching: Mountain above carries Zhang Guo Lao, the old man who rides his donkey facing backward so he can see where he began. Lake below carries Zhong Li Quan, who laid down his command and carries a fan that brings the dead back to life. When you let go and look back to where you started, you are doing what both of them do.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the first letter and a silent one, like the breath you take before you begin to speak.

cards.essence: Growth is alive in you as a steady pull to see things through. It carries a piece of work, or a bond with someone, from the first stir to its ripe end. You feel it low in your belly as a clear yes when a thing is done. When more comes to you than you planned, you pass some of it on, and more keeps coming.

glance.reading:
Growth is alive in you as a steady pull to see things through. It carries a piece of work, or a bond with someone, from the first stir to its ripe end. You feel it low in your belly as a clear yes when a thing is done. When more comes to you than you planned, you pass some of it on, and more keeps coming.

Some days you set your heart on how a thing must turn out, and by when. Whatever arrives then falls short, and you catch yourself waiting for your real life to start. Keep your hope and let the picture go. Your life is already under way.

Finish what is ready, even when it was good, because each ending clears the way for the next. You are writing your life and reading it at the same time. You feel every part of it, even the letdowns. Your life moves toward perfection one finished thing at a time.

iching.trigram_combination: Wind over Thunder is the hexagram of a time when your life is gaining. Thunder is the stir in you that wakes something new and sets it moving. Wind is the part of you that carries what has woken out to the people around you. The carrying sits above the stirring because a gain kept inside you stops growing. This hexagram has long been read as wind and thunder, each making the other stronger. A good idea goes further when someone passes it on, and passing it on brings you the next one. The same two ask you to move toward the good you see in others, and to mend the faults you find in yourself. What stirs in you is meant to reach past you.
iching.reading:
This is a time of gain. Opportunities come knocking, and more reaches you than you worked for. It comes from above you, from people or a life with more than enough, letting some of it go. The time is good for something large, even a crossing you would not risk in a leaner year. It will not stay open for long.

What it asks is that the gain keep moving. What you receive, give on, because giving is the only way the increase lasts. A full cup has to be poured before it can be filled again. Move toward the good in others as quickly as wind moves. Mend your own faults with the nerve of thunder. Kept for yourself alone, the gain turns against you.

Your feet and legs do the work now. The feet take the first step, and the thighs bring the rest of your body after them. Stand while the water is high, and cross.
judgement_lines: Increase. It is good to have somewhere to go.
It is good to cross the great water.
image_lines: Wind and thunder: increase.
So the wise, seeing good, move toward it; finding a fault in themselves, they mend it.

upper_trigram.name: Wind (Sun)
upper_trigram.nature: Subtly penetrating. Mild, nourishing. Wood and wind. The eldest daughter.

lower_trigram.name: Thunder (Chen)
lower_trigram.nature: Arousing power emerging from the depth of the earth. Excite, influence, move, affect. The eldest son.

lines.image: a great work begun from the lowest place, with help pouring in from above.
lines.reading: You are low down, and more help reaches you than your place would usually bring. Use it for something large. Work hard to meet your luck, because it is blameless only if it turns out well. Begin the great thing, and put the whole of your strength behind it.

lines.image: a gift too large to refuse, and the king carrying it up to be offered.
lines.reading: Someone adds to what you have, a gift of great worth, and it cannot be turned away. It comes from outside, and you did not scheme for it. Stay steady and true while it is yours. A king given this much offers it to heaven. Accept it with an open hand, and give some of it back.

lines.image: gain out of misfortune, and a message sent under seal.
lines.reading: Trouble comes, and it turns out to be how you gain. Let it polish you, and there is no blame in it. Stay honest and keep to the middle way. Tell the one above you plainly what happened, the way an officer shows the seal of their rank. Believe the trouble can serve you, and it stops being trouble.

lines.image: the go-between in the middle of the road, trusted enough to move a city.
lines.reading: You stand in the middle, carrying word between the one above and the people below. Walk that middle road, and your advice is followed. You could even be trusted to help move a whole city. You have no power of your own here, so lean on someone who has. Aim at everyone's good, and people will follow you.

lines.image: a kind heart that has no need to ask.
lines.reading: Here the answer speaks to you directly. If your heart is truly kind, there is nothing to ask. In your heart you already know. Kindness given this way costs you nothing and reaches everyone. Stop asking whether it is right, and act from that heart.

lines.image: the one at the top who adds to nobody, and the blow that comes from outside.
lines.reading: At the top, you keep the gain for yourself and add to no one. Now nobody adds to you, and a blow comes from a side you are not watching. A heart that keeps changing its rule cannot hold what it gathered. Put your own faults right first. Only then can you help anyone else grow.

gene_keys.shadow:
Almost everyone is waiting for the day their life comes right. The money will be sorted, love will be in place, and there will be room to live at last. First there are a few things to clear up. So the living is put off, year after year, until you are old. It is never too late to be here now. It takes seeing through what you were waiting for, once and completely.

The trouble starts when the mind takes hold of hope and gives it a date and a shape. Whatever arrives is measured against that shape, and it falls short. Hopeful or gloomy, a fixed outcome narrows your eyes until you miss the good in front of you. Under every other ending sits the one nobody escapes. Your body is made to die, and your unease about time running out comes from there. Many disappointments turn out, later, to be blessings.
gene_keys.repressive: Held in, the fear of change becomes a refusal to let anything end. They try to stay young and hold their loved ones back from their own roads. They cling to the past and call it love. What is never allowed to end cannot renew itself, and slowly they wither.
gene_keys.reactive: Let out, the same fear keeps them from finishing anything. They avoid disappointment by never quite committing, and move on before a thing can end. A cycle broken early has to be lived again in a new form. So the same pattern keeps coming back, in love and in money.
gene_keys.gift:
Detachment means feeling more, not less. No fixed outcome squeezes what happens, so you feel all of it. You can even enjoy being disappointed. It cannot be forced. Hold a feeling down by will, and the grip only tightens. It comes when you give way to every feeling fully, without always acting on it.

From there your life reads like a book. You write it as you go and read it too, absorbed but never swept away by the words. You let go of each plan as soon as life changes it, and you can see where you still want to steer. You keep your hope and drop your demands. An obstacle starts to look like a chance to grow. You find this by giving in to being ordinary and human, breathing deeply and not flinching from what hurts.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Celebration comes when the story ends in a laugh. In detachment you still watched your life from a little way off. Now the one watching and what is watched are the same, so there is only one thing happening. Every cell in you starts dying the moment it is born. You are less a fixed thing than a passage life moves through. Somewhere deep in you, something gets the joke. The whole serious search was the set-up, and you laugh because you let yourself be tricked.

Sit by a river and follow its currents with your eyes. Then stop following and simply gaze. The river loses its direction and seems to flow at you and out of you from everywhere. No practice brings this on. Whoever it happens to wants only to share the laugh.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy lets things end, and it loses its way when an ending feels like a failure. Art of Living holds what it lacks: a sense of what will last, and a fear of failing that the two share. Once you judge your life by success and failure, you are already caught. Open it when you are measuring a finished thing by whether it worked.

human_design.gate:
Gate 42 is the drive to finish what has been started. It wants to see a cycle through its beginning, its middle and its end. It can stay with a piece of work or a person until it has ripened, and it knows real growth takes time. From outside, that can look like patience or stubbornness. Its gift is knowing how to wrap a thing up so there is room for what comes next.

Its trouble runs two ways. It can hold on to something long after it is over, because finishing was the whole point. Or it feels it should start everything itself, and a pile of half-done things grows too heavy to look at. Then it rushes to close them early, just to be rid of the pressure. It works best when it is led to what is ready to finish.
human_design.centre:
The Sacral Center sits low in the body, under the navel and above the legs. It is the strongest engine you have, and it answers rather than decides. Something is put in front of you and a sound rises, a yes that lifts or a no that goes flat. Through gate 42 that engine turns toward the last stretch of a job. It has a knack for coming into the middle of something and carrying it home. Finished on a yes, the work gives back its energy. Finished to please or to fit in, it leaves a habit of resistance, and you blame yourself for it.

About seven people in ten have this centre defined, and its energy runs all the time. For them every drive here goes through the first excitement, the jump in, then a flat stretch where nothing seems to move. That flat stretch is where people quit. Whether you are finished or only resting there is a question your gut can answer with a yes or a no. The other three in ten have it open and run on the energy of the people around them. They are the pause between the notes, and they can tell when a thing is done.
human_design.channel: Finishing needs something begun. Gate 53, in the Root Center at the base of the spine, is the pressure to start new things. Together they make the Channel of Maturation, one whole cycle from the first step to the last. It carries a sense of timing, when to begin and when to close. Rushed, it leaves things half-done. Held too long, it keeps what is over. Gate 53 may be in you or in someone close, and nothing ripens without both.

tarot.ring_role: This energy closes things, and every close leaves room for a start. It belongs to a family of six, the Ring of Life and Death, which holds one whole life. When you are starting over, open UL 3, Messengers of the Infinite. When you need to be here now, open UL 20, Emerging as the Code. For clarity, open UL 23, Beneath the Surface. To go back to where a thing began, open UL 24, Frequency Flutter. To look after someone, open UL 27, Inner Majesty.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Four of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, gather around this energy. Death comes twice, because letting go runs all through your growth.

body.physiology:
Finishing is the reason this energy is given to the sacral plexus. It is a weave of nerves low in your pelvis, part of the engine that keeps a body going without being watched. The low back around it has long been held as the body's store, where you keep what you carry until its season ends. In you this weave is where a movement is carried to its close.

Stand up from your chair. Your legs begin it. The last of the rise, straightening at the hip, is done by the largest muscle you have. That muscle takes its order from this weave. You have finished that movement thousands of times without knowing where the finish was made.
body.amino_acid:
The growth in you has a substance, and it is leucine. Your body cannot make it, so it comes in with fish, milk or lentils. The muscle you move with breaks it down, where most of what you eat is handled by the liver.

This energy shares that substance with five others in its family. Together they hold the whole run of every living cell, from its first innocence to what it has learned by the end. This energy is where that run closes. What was alive in the cell steps out of the shape it wore, the way you let go of someone who has died.

relations.unity_line: UL 41 is this card's pair and its inverse at once: the giving up that comes before the gain, where this one is the gain that has to be given on.

pair.teaching: This energy grows by passing on what it gains, and it runs out when the good stretch ends. Beginning and the End is where it goes next: the time of less, when something is given up so that what matters can grow. Open it when the gain has stopped and you have to let something go. Less is where the next growth begins.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy end for end and gain becomes loss. Beginning and the End is the same flow seen from the hand that gives, where this one is the cup that fills. Open it when you are the one with more than enough.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy lets things end, and it loses its way when an ending feels like a failure. Art of Living holds what it lacks: a sense of what will last, and a fear of failing that the two share. Once you judge your life by success and failure, you are already caught. Open it when you are measuring a finished thing by whether it worked.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Life and Death
codon_ring.teaching: This energy closes things, and every close leaves room for a start. It belongs to a family of six, the Ring of Life and Death, which holds one whole life. When you are starting over, open UL 3, Messengers of the Infinite. When you need to be here now, open UL 20, Emerging as the Code. For clarity, open UL 23, Beneath the Surface. To go back to where a thing began, open UL 24, Frequency Flutter. To look after someone, open UL 27, Inner Majesty.

tarot.teaching: Four of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, gather around this energy. Death comes twice, because letting go runs all through your growth.

sky.teaching: the water sign of endings and rebirth, where a thing has to end before it comes back new in your life.

immortals.teaching: Wind above carries He Xian Gu, the one woman among the Eight Immortals, who holds a lotus. Her lotus grows clean out of mud, as your gain can grow out of trouble. Thunder below carries Cao Guo Jiu, who left the riches of the court he was born into. He gave away what he had, and you grow the same way when you pass your gain on.

hebrew_letter.teaching: a fish lives its whole life in moving water, as you can live through every change without losing yourself.

cards.essence: Insight comes to you all at once, often just after you have stopped trying to work a thing out. You hear it more than you see it, a knowing that runs through your whole body before your mind has caught up. It comes whole, like a message in code, clear to you and hard to put into words.

glance.reading:
Insight comes to you all at once, often just after you have stopped trying to work a thing out. You hear it more than you see it, a knowing that runs through your whole body before your mind has caught up. It comes whole, like a message in code, clear to you and hard to put into words.

Some stretches bring nothing, and it is tempting to fill the quiet with plans and worry. Chasing an answer only pushes it further off, the way a song will not come when you force it. Leave a gap in the day with no purpose in it, and let yourself not know for a while.

Walk through your days a little slower. The flash tends to come from where you were not looking. One clear insight can change the course of a life. You take the new path it shows you without needing to know where it leads.

iching.trigram_combination: Lake over Heaven is the hexagram of a breakthrough after a long build-up. Heaven is the drive in you that keeps building and never tires. Lake is the part of you that wants to say it out loud. The lake sits on top because what has built up for so long now has to come out. This hexagram has long been read as a lake risen into the sky. Water that high cannot stay there, and it comes down as rain. What has been building in you is ready to be said.
iching.reading:
A tension that has been building for a long time is about to break. More has piled up than can be held, and now it has to go somewhere. Only one thin thing stands in the way at the top, and everything beneath it is strength. Do not meet it with force. Say it openly where it counts, and tell the truth, knowing there is some risk in it. Tell your own people first, so they are ready for what comes. Then set out, and expect the way to differ from the one you first had in mind.

When it has broken through, give what comes of it to the people around you. Do not rest on it as if it made you better than they are.

Your mouth does the work now. Say the thing plainly, once, to the people who need to hear it.
judgement_lines: Breakthrough: make it known at the king's court, truthfully, and know the danger in it.
Tell your own city, and do not reach for weapons. It is a good time to set out.
image_lines: The lake has risen into the sky: the picture of breakthrough.
So the wise give what they have downward, and do not rest on what they have become.

upper_trigram.name: Lake (Tui)
upper_trigram.nature: Open surface, interaction, pleasure, the mouth, exchange. The youngest daughter.

lower_trigram.name: Heaven (Ch'ien)
lower_trigram.nature: Unceasing forward movement, dynamic, enduring, untiring. Spirit power. Heaven, sovereign, father.

lines.image: strength in the front toes, already striding out.
lines.reading: Your strength is all in your toes, already striding out, and it is too soon. You are not yet equal to what you are walking into. Going now brings a mistake you could have avoided. Pushing hard with no give in you feeds the very thing you want gone. Protect your footing first, and for now defend rather than attack.

lines.image: a cry of alarm in the night, and weapons somewhere in the dark.
lines.reading: A cry of alarm goes up at night, and there may be weapons in the dark. You stayed alert and can still give way, so you saw the danger before it moved. The threat is mostly empty. Keep watch the way you have been, steady in yourself, and fear nothing.

lines.image: strength set hard in the face, and a walk alone into the rain.
lines.reading: Your resolve shows in your face, in a set jaw, and that is where the trouble starts. You go on alone and get soaked in the rain. The people you counted on grumble behind you. It is uncomfortable, and it is not your fault. Decide what has to be left, then leave it, and in the end it settles gently.

lines.image: no skin left to sit on, and a sheep that will not be led.
lines.reading: You can neither sit at ease nor make headway, as if the skin were gone from where you sit. Good advice reaches you, and you hear the words without believing them. Here you are the one who needs leading. Follow this once, the way a sheep follows the one in front, and the regret goes.

lines.image: weeds on the high ground, to be pulled with resolve.
lines.reading: Weeds are growing on the high ground, and they look brighter than they are. Roots like these never come out with one tug. The difference between clearing them and being overrun is a hair's width. Pull them now, then pull again, keeping to the middle way while you work.

lines.image: a cry with no answer.
lines.reading: You call out and nobody answers. What you still keep from the old way now stands alone, with no one on its side. A decision nobody hears cannot last. If this is you, your time here is over, so let it go.

gene_keys.shadow:
Deafness here is noise: a day so full of things to do that the question with no answer never gets a hearing. You wake not knowing what the day is for, and rather than sit with that, you fill it. The day is gone before you get there. By evening you are too tired to see that it was beautiful. Your hearing is fine. You are too busy worrying to hear, or too sure of what you are doing to listen.

Underneath is fear, and it fastens onto the way your body feels. So you look for the happiness that would end it, in the right partner or in enough money. Happiness is part of your natural chemistry, there on some days and gone on others. Nothing outside you can buy it. You want change more than anything, and the wanting is what keeps it away.
gene_keys.repressive: This person carries the noise inside, as worry. The mind goes round in circles looking for a way out of worrying. It drives them into one task after another. Each task ends, and a new worry jumps into the space it leaves. Underneath is the fear of not fitting in.
gene_keys.reactive: This person cannot stop talking, and it is never to say anything. The talk drowns out how unhappy they feel. Listening to no one, least of all themselves, they speak at the wrong moment and in the wrong way. Instead of being accepted they are pushed further out, and grow angrier at being misunderstood.
gene_keys.gift:
Insight begins when the old deafness turns into a friend. You stop listening to what everyone expects of you. You go deaf to the things that used to matter and do not any more. You still hear what others say, and it simply stops moving you. What you trust now is the voice inside you, whatever it costs.

This makes you a rebel, and the rebellion is against your own mind, never against other people. You cut a new path and do not worry where it goes. There is delight in it, a glitter in the eyes, spirit without a fight. Every person is born to fill a space in the world that nobody else can fill. This is you filling yours.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Epiphany is the silence coming back, and it is loud. Sit an hour alone in the dark of a cave, listening, and the silence fills every part of you. What you learn there is that you cannot know anything. In knowing nothing, you rest in everything. You may search for years, until you are too tired to go on. When you give up, you find an ordinary person looking for what they already were.

From here you are ordinary again, and there is nothing to rebel against. You say what you like and laugh often, because nothing can be added to you or taken away. All that you know gives way to what you do not. What is left is friendliness toward everyone.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy knows a thing whole and struggles to say it. Beneath the Surface holds what it lacks: plain words that make a knowing simple enough to share. Open it when you know something clearly and cannot yet explain it. An insight makes life simpler only once it can be said.

human_design.gate: Gate 43 sits in the part of the mind behind your forehead and brings sudden clarity. A problem you have been stuck on makes sense all at once, often on a walk, in the shower or just before sleep. It cuts through the confusion and shows a way forward. It comes after its own quiet time and cannot be hurried. It can overturn your plans and what you believed yesterday. It is also hard to put into words. So you may say it before anyone can take it in, or keep it and feel alone with it. Some people with this gate come to doubt their own sanity, because they see what others miss. Its work is to trust what you know without second-guessing it.
human_design.centre:
The Ajna Center sits behind the forehead and is where you make sense of things. It sees the whole and the parts, and it tells one thing from another. Without it you could not tell whether there was a door in a wall. It decides nothing and has no direct way to act. So what it knows has to be asked for before it is shared, and said at the right time. Given to someone who cannot take it in, what would have been medicine turns to poison.

About half of all people have this centre defined. Their mind is always at work, and they know what they think. They hold on to what they learn, and their trap is being sure past the point of being right. In the rest it is open. Thoughts pass through them like water through a sieve, and they may fear that something is wrong with their mind. Gripping the mind tight to feel certain only makes it worse. Held lightly, their mind can look at anything from every side.
human_design.channel: On its own, this knowing has no way out into words. Gate 23, in the Throat Center, is the drive to say a complicated thing simply. Together they make the Channel of Structuring, which puts an insight nobody has voiced before into words people can follow. Said to people who did not ask, it sounds strange. Said when they are ready, it sounds like genius. Gate 23 may be in you or in a person close by, and the channel runs only when both are present.

tarot.ring_role: This energy drops down into your life as a knowing. It belongs to a family of two, the Ring of Destiny, whose theme is timing. UL 34, Sublime Power, carries the strength that pushes up to become more. This one carries the insight that comes down to meet it. A life is steered by the two together.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Its family and its two trigrams bring five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, to this one.

body.physiology:
You hear yourself from the inside, and that is why this energy is given to the inner ear. Everyone else hears your voice through the air. You hear it mostly through the bone of your own skull. That is why a recording of your voice sounds like a stranger. The inner ear sits sealed inside the hardest bone in your head, with no opening to the outside. In the same place, three small curved tubes of fluid keep you upright without ever telling you.

Block both ears with your fingertips and hum. The hum gets louder, because it reaches the inner ear through your skull and needs no air. That is the voice only you can hear, and the part of you that hears it is working now.
body.amino_acid:
The timing of this energy has a substance in you, and its name is asparagine. It was the first of the twenty pieces your proteins are built from that anyone ever found. It was drawn out of asparagus juice two hundred years ago and named after the plant.

This energy shares that substance with one kin, and together they carry the secret of timing. The secret is that chance and love dance together in your life. The more you let love in, the more chance seems to work in your favour. In the end what looked random turns out to have a pattern, and your timing comes right.

relations.unity_line: UL 44 is this card's pair and its inverse at once: the meeting that follows a breakthrough, where this one breaks through.

pair.teaching: This energy breaks through all at once, and it runs out once the flash has come. Sophia's Orchestra is where it goes next: meeting what arrives after, the people and chances the break brings to you. Open it when you have seen something new and it is time to meet the world with it.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy end for end and breaking through becomes being met. Sophia's Orchestra is the same moment seen from the side that receives. Open it when someone or something has come to you out of nowhere.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy knows a thing whole and struggles to say it. Beneath the Surface holds what it lacks: plain words that make a knowing simple enough to share. Open it when you know something clearly and cannot yet explain it. An insight makes life simpler only once it can be said.

codon_ring.name: Codon Ring of Destiny
codon_ring.teaching: This energy drops down into your life as a knowing. It belongs to a family of two, the Ring of Destiny, whose theme is timing. UL 34, Sublime Power, carries the strength that pushes up to become more. This one carries the insight that comes down to meet it. A life is steered by the two together.

tarot.teaching: Its family and its two trigrams bring five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, to this one.

sky.teaching: the planet of growth and good fortune, the luck that turns your way once you stop forcing it.

immortals.teaching: Lake above carries Zhong Li Quan, whose fan wakes the dead, as an insight wakes what had gone still in you. Heaven below carries Han Xiangzi, whose flute made flowers open in the snow, as a knowing can open in you out of season.

hebrew_letter.teaching: a hand closed tight on what it holds. Open it, and there is room for the turn to come.

cards.essence: When you meet someone new, you know within seconds whether they belong in your life. You feel it in your body, well before you could give a reason. Some strangers seem familiar the moment you meet them, and those are the people you have work to do with.

glance.reading:
When you meet someone new, you know within seconds whether they belong in your life. You feel it in your body, well before you could give a reason. Some strangers seem familiar the moment you meet them, and those are the people you have work to do with.

Sometimes an old hurt clouds what you feel, and you let the wrong people close or keep the right ones away. A lesson you leave unlearned comes back through someone new, even after you walk away. Stay with the fear until it passes, and your instinct comes back clear.

Trust what your body tells you, and follow each person you recognise to the next. Over time a group gathers around you that you did not set out to build. It is like finding your section in an orchestra: each of you plays your own part, and the music comes from all of you. Working together stops being work and turns into play.

iching.trigram_combination: Heaven over Wind is the hexagram of meeting what you did not plan to meet. Wind is the part of you that lets a new person in before you have decided to. Heaven is the strength in you that keeps to its own course. The letting in sits below the strength because every meeting starts small, underneath everything you have already built. This hexagram has long been read as the wind blowing under the sky, reaching every living thing. In the same way, one person you allow in reaches every part of your life. Who you let in, you carry into the whole of your life.
iching.reading:
Someone or something has come into your life that you did not plan for, and the pull toward it is strong. For now it is small, one soft thing under everything firm you have built. It arrives at a high point, the way the light starts to shorten on the longest day of the year. Every living thing comes from two things meeting, so the meeting itself is not wrong. What it asks is that you see it clearly while it is still small.

Meet it, and do not marry it. What comes in this softly keeps coming. One thing let in without a look can push one good thing after another out of its place. Hold it the way a firm hand holds a rope, neither crushing it nor letting it run. A middle course works better than giving in or fighting.

Your head and your thighs carry this time. The head sees far, and the thighs carry you toward whoever is coming. Stand with your head clear and your step unhurried, and look at what comes before you let it in.
judgement_lines: Coming to Meet. The one who comes is strong. Do not take her for a wife.
The soft meets the firm, and what they make does not last long.
When heaven and earth meet, everything alive is shown. When the firm meets what is central and right, the whole world moves. Great is the season of meeting.
image_lines: Under the sky, the wind. That is the picture of coming to meet.
So the prince sends out his commands, and they reach the four quarters of the land.

upper_trigram.name: Heaven (Ch'ien)
upper_trigram.nature: Unceasing forward movement, dynamic, enduring, untiring. Spirit power. Heaven, sovereign, father.

lower_trigram.name: Wind (Sun)
lower_trigram.nature: Subtly penetrating. Mild, nourishing. Wood and wind. The eldest daughter.

lines.image: held to a metal brake, and a lean pig straining to leap.
lines.reading: Tied to a metal brake, what has just come in cannot move, and for now that is right. It is small, but one thin pig let loose will leap, and the whole herd goes after it. Any step you take toward it now leads to harm. Keep it held, and stay where you are.

lines.image: a fish in the bag, and no share of it for the guests.
lines.reading: The fish is in the bag, and holding it is no fault. You saw what came to you before it could act, so it can do no harm. Keep it with you, and do not let it reach the other people in your life.

lines.image: the skin worn from the thighs, so that every step is hard.
lines.reading: The skin is gone from your thighs, and every step is hard. You are cut off from what you wanted to reach, and the place is dangerous, though you have done nothing wrong. Work steadily by day and take care at night, and no great harm comes.

lines.image: the bag opened, and no fish in it.
lines.reading: You open the bag and there is no fish. What you thought you held has gone, because you kept yourself far above the people around you. No one else is to blame. Come down among them, and stay close to the ones who are still there.

lines.image: a melon wrapped in willow, and something dropping from the sky.
lines.reading: A melon ripens wrapped in willow branches, out of sight. Keep what is bright in you hidden in the same way. Use no force against what grows beneath you. Hold to the middle, and what you hope for drops into your hands as if from the sky.

lines.image: meeting others with the horns.
lines.reading: At the very top nothing soft remains in you, so you meet others with your horns. It brings shame, but no blame, because you have stepped away from the trouble below. For now you are of no use to anyone. Accept the small shame of standing apart, since it keeps you clear.

gene_keys.shadow:
Interference sounds like a room where everyone plays their own tune and nobody hears anyone else. It is a family that loves each other and cannot stop hurting each other, or good people at work who make only friction. Fear plays out in two ways in a room like that. Some people go along with anything to keep the peace. Others turn the fear outward as irritation, anger and the need to control every small movement, and most of us have been both. What builds up is resentment, and resentment ends in a break. Between people it is a break-up, and inside one person it is a breakdown.

It is easy to decide the other person is the problem. It is never about the others. The noise starts inside you, as a way of seeing the world through fear, and it goes out from you into everyone you meet.
gene_keys.repressive: One bad relationship was enough, and the door shut. They live and work among others, yet keep each one at arm's length. They do it so quietly that nobody notices, often not even themselves. Part of this was inherited and part learned young. They are guarding against a pain that has already happened.
gene_keys.reactive: This one never shuts the door, and never learns either. Their instinct for people misfires, so they side with those who do not respect them or who drain what they have. They break the tie, then choose someone just like them next time.
gene_keys.gift:
Teamwork begins when fear no longer muddles how you read people. You can size someone up with a single handshake, but only up close, because you have to be near a person to read them truly. Once you trust that reading, you start to find your own people. The sure sign that you have found them is devotion.

A team like this gives each person their freedom. Nobody stands over anyone, and the lead passes sideways to whoever the music needs. There is more life in you, because the energy you spent defending yourself is free. Without organising anyone, you become the one they come together around.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Everyone around you becomes part of one music, and the conductor is inside every player. You see the whole weave of who meets whom, back through the generations, and instead of standing outside it you dissolve into it. You hear it only in silence, the way a still mind can hear a whole hive moving. Everybody leads together, each one different and each a perfect fit.

Nothing here needs fixing. You see everything as it is and leave it where it is. Every life finds its own way, even the ones still caught in the noise. The harmony was there from the beginning, only hidden. By the time it arrives, the separate person who went looking for it is gone.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy reads people, and fear from the past keeps pulling it back to the same kind of person. Frequency Flutter holds what it lacks: a mind that goes back over the same ground until it finds a new way through. At its height, that mind falls silent. Open it when the same bond keeps returning in another face. In silence the whole pattern can be heard.

human_design.gate:
Gate 44 keeps hold of what happened last time. It looks at a new situation and sees the pattern in it: what worked before, and what caused pain. Its fear fits in one sentence: last time I did this, it did not work. The pressure is there so the past does not repeat itself unchanged. It keeps what served and lets go of what did not. It also has a sense of timing, of when one round of things is closing and the next is about to start.

Pushed too far, the memory turns into suspicion. It can also become a belief that the old patterns can never change, so you stop moving at all. Used well, it turns an old pain into a purpose.
human_design.centre:
The Spleen Center sits low on the left side of the body and keeps you safe in the moment. It is the oldest kind of knowing you have, the one animals live by. It works through your five senses. Its answer comes as a hunch that something is safe or is not, and it usually speaks once, softly. Picture a cat resting in the sun on a doorstep, ears turning, ready to move. It can rest because it trusts it will be warned.

About fifty-five people in a hundred have this centre defined. They have steady access to their hunches and a strong body, though they burn out when they ignore what it tells them. The other forty-five have it open, and their bodies are more sensitive. They take in the fears of the people around them and feel them louder. A choice that felt safe with someone in the room can feel unsafe once they leave. So they do well to take their time. They also hold on to jobs and people longer than is good for them. When they are well, they can tell which fears are theirs and which are not.
human_design.channel: A memory of what worked cannot act on its own. Gate 26, in the Heart Center, is the will to show other people that something is worth having. Together they make the Channel of Surrender, the energy of a good sale. You look at the past for what helped your people, then convince them it is worth keeping. Gate 26 may sit in you or in another person, and the memory moves others only when both are present.

tarot.ring_role: This energy gathers people, and every group that works starts with two. It belongs to a family of two, the Ring of the Illuminati, which is about you and your people living in harmony. UL 50, Melt Into Perfection, carries the values that keep your group in balance once it has formed. This one carries the meeting that starts it.
tarot.tarot_resonance: The ring and the two trigrams bring five of the tarot's major cards, each a picture of how you meet people.

body.physiology:
Smell is the reason this energy is given to your immune system. The immune system is not in one place. It stands along every surface where the outside touches you: your skin, your gut and the lining of your breath. It meets whatever comes in before anything else does. It knows what it meets by the fit of a shape, the way your nose knows a smell. Once it has met a thing, it keeps cells that know that one thing, for years or for life.

That is why a childhood fever comes once and never again. Where there is a round scar high on your arm, a memory was put in on purpose. Scratch your skin, and within minutes the place turns warm and pink. That warmth is the part of you that meets everything, arriving where it is needed.
body.amino_acid:
Fear sends chemical signals through you, and they go one of two ways. Some hold you down, and some fire you up. Either way, the trouble between you and other people begins in your cells, and so does the peace. The substance of this energy in you is glutamic acid. It is one of the twenty pieces every protein in you is built from, and your body makes its own. It is also the savoury taste, what hard cheese and a ripe tomato have in common on your tongue.

You share this chemistry with one other energy. A queen holds a hive of bees together, keeping every bee on course by what she gives off. Without her, the hive falls apart. Your cells are a team in the same way. They learn to work together, and you are their captain.

relations.unity_line: UL 43 is this card's pair and its inverse at once: the parting that every meeting leads to, where this one brings people together.

pair.teaching: This energy brings people together, and every meeting carries a parting inside it. Cipher of Knowledge is where it goes next: the breakthrough, where what was held together splits apart and something is decided. Open it when a bond has run its course and you have to say so. After people part, they meet again.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy upside down and the soft thing let in at the bottom becomes the one thing sent out at the top. Cipher of Knowledge is the same moment seen from the other end. Open it when what you once let in now has to go.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy reads people, and fear from the past keeps pulling it back to the same kind of person. Frequency Flutter holds what it lacks: a mind that goes back over the same ground until it finds a new way through. At its height, that mind falls silent. Open it when the same bond keeps returning in another face. In silence the whole pattern can be heard.

codon_ring.name: Ring of the Illuminati
codon_ring.teaching: This energy gathers people, and every group that works starts with two. It belongs to a family of two, the Ring of the Illuminati, which is about you and your people living in harmony. UL 50, Melt Into Perfection, carries the values that keep your group in balance once it has formed. This one carries the meeting that starts it.

tarot.teaching: The ring and the two trigrams bring five of the tarot's major cards, each a picture of how you meet people.

sky.teaching: the sign of partners and the scales, where you ask what is fair between you and another.

immortals.teaching: Heaven above carries Han Xiangzi, whose flute draws listeners together into one feeling. Wind below carries He Xian Gu, the one woman among the eight, who holds a lotus. One calls your people to you, and the other keeps what gathers clean.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the ox-goad that keeps a team moving together toward its work.

cards.essence: When people gather around something they all need, goodwill is what lets it go round. You feel it as a wish to see everyone at the table fed, yourself included. You would rather share what you have than sell it, since it goes further that way. People relax near you, since nobody has to fight for a place.

glance.reading:
When people gather around something they all need, goodwill is what lets it go round. You feel it as a wish to see everyone at the table fed, yourself included. You would rather share what you have than sell it, since it goes further that way. People relax near you, since nobody has to fight for a place.

Some days the old fear of not having enough comes back. You feel yourself tighten the moment you step out of the door. Stop and feel the fear where it sits in your body. Given your attention, it melts, and under it is the feeling that everything is fine.

Gather the people you trust and give them the freedom to do things their own way. Let each of them add their own thread. Woven together like this, a crowd becomes one people.

iching.trigram_combination: Lake over Earth is the hexagram of a crowd coming together. Earth is the part of you that makes room and provides for everyone. Lake is the part of you that makes people glad to be near you. The gladness sits above the making room, because when you go along with people, they are happy to stay. This hexagram has long been read as water gathered on the ground. Water collects where the land lies low, and people collect around whoever makes room for them. Here the gathering is large, a whole people rather than a few neighbours. You bring people together by making room for them, and your welcome keeps them.
iching.reading:
People are coming together, far more of them than a family or a street, around something they all need. A crowd this size can do what no small group could. It can also come apart in confusion, with people pushing for the better place.

What holds it is something larger than any of you. The king in this hexagram goes first to the temple of his ancestors, to remember where his people came from. Remember your own roots before you lead. Go to someone who sees further than you. Bring your best, never what you can spare.
