Know where you are going together, because people with nowhere to go drift apart. While all is well, get ready for trouble nobody expects, since friction comes wherever many people meet.

Your mouth does the work here, in the words that bring people together and the food they share. Stand like someone who has made room at the table for one more.
judgement_lines: Gathering together. Success. The king goes to his ancestors' temple.
It helps to see a great person, and holding to what is right brings success.
Bring great offerings, and it goes well. It helps to have somewhere to go.
image_lines: The lake over the earth: the image of Gathering Together.
So the wise keep their weapons ready, to meet what nobody foresaw.

upper_trigram.name: Lake (Tui)
upper_trigram.nature: Open surface, interaction, pleasure, the mouth, exchange. The youngest daughter.

lower_trigram.name: Earth (K'un)
lower_trigram.nature: Surface of the world, support of all existence. Essential Yin. Rest, receptivity.

lines.image: sincere, but not to the end; confusion, then gathering.
lines.reading: You want to belong, but your trust does not hold, and the crowd turns into a scramble. Call out to the one person you trust. One hand taken, and the tears turn to laughter. Do not worry about the confusion. Go toward that person, and no blame comes of it.

lines.image: letting yourself be drawn; the small spring offering accepted.
lines.reading: Someone is drawing you in, and you do not have to push. Let yourself be led. When you mean it, even a small offering is enough, like the thin one made in spring when the stores are low. Bring what you have, honestly.

lines.image: gathering amid sighs; nothing that would further.
lines.reading: You want to belong, nobody answers, and you sigh. Nothing you push for here will come. Go to the people who will have you, and borrow their strength. It costs a little pride, and there is no blame in it.

lines.image: great good fortune, and no blame.
lines.reading: People gather around you without your asking, and it goes very well. You are not the one in charge, though, and the crowd could forget whose it is. Do the work of bringing people together and leave the top seat alone. Then great good fortune carries no blame.

lines.image: the gathering has its position; some are not yet sincere.
lines.reading: You hold the place the crowd gathers around, and some of them do not trust you yet. Do not tighten your grip to win them. Hand real charge to someone below you and forget about the seat. Stay steady and true for as long as it takes, and the ones you doubted prove faithful.

lines.image: sighing and weeping, floods of tears.
lines.reading: You are at the top and outside the circle, and it hurts enough to cry. You do not feel safe up here. Let the tears show. Others see that you mean it, and the door you could not force opens.

gene_keys.shadow:
Dominance starts with food. Everyone has to eat, so whoever controls the food holds the power, and money is the same thing in newer clothes. Out of the old fear of not having enough grew rank. To feel safe, you push someone down so you can rise, and the ladder feeds you for staying on it. Nobody is to blame for it, you included. The fear is older than any of them.

In you it began early, the first time the world seemed unsafe and your whole body drew in. Since then you hold on to things, a patch of ground or a person, as if you could take them with you. Most people loosen their grip only near the end. The fear is worth feeling, because it leads you toward your own heart.
gene_keys.repressive: Timid people bow their heads to anyone above them. They give up their own spirit to keep the peace. Under it is a fear so old they cannot see it: that nothing good comes of standing up to someone higher. Most people live here without knowing it.
gene_keys.reactive: The pompous climb, pushing others down to get there. Once they are up, they keep the people below them timid, because that is what holds them in place. They and the timid are caught in one game, on opposite sides of it.
gene_keys.gift:
Synergy is what a group feels when nobody needs to be on top. It comes from trust settled in your body, the sense that the whole is holding you up. Then a group finds its own order, the way iron filings on a sheet of paper line up over a hidden magnet. Given time and space, it arrives at something better than anyone could have planned. On the way, one person often carries the whole group's fear, and the group works through it together.

The hard part falls on whoever holds the power. Handing someone complete authority looks like a loss, and it is pure alchemy. The goodwill it sets free spreads outward by word of mouth and comes back many times over.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Communion is a meal with no host. You feed each other without keeping count, so money has no work to do. It feels like an early Sunday morning outside, before anyone is up. The world seems newly born, and you have nowhere you need to be. Nobody asks why they are here or what they have to do. Being here is enough.

Dying after a life like that would be no different from living. You drift in and you drift out, with no need even to miss each other. The order you found was there all along, hidden inside the old ladder, waiting.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy shares what there is, and it stalls where sharing would cost it its importance. Lighter Than a Feather holds that pride, the pleasure of feeling important. The two feed each other: pride makes it hard to hand over charge, and keeping charge feeds the pride. Open it when you notice you cannot let anyone else decide.

human_design.gate:
Gate 45 sits in the throat and is the drive to gather people and share out what there is. It has been called the king or queen of the tribe, and when it speaks, people listen. It holds the resources for the whole group, whether money, knowledge or care. Its favourite way to share is to teach, so that the people around it learn to provide for themselves.

Its fear is that there will not be enough. Then it holds back what it should share, or grows loud and showy to prove it deserves its seat. It also needs to be heard, and when it is not, it either goes quiet or gets louder. Its power comes from being present, never from putting on a show. It knows when to step forward and when to step back.
human_design.centre:
The Throat Center is where everything in you becomes words or action. Energy from every other centre is on its way here, and nothing happens in the world until it has passed through. It also sets how you take in food, and how you take in life.

About seven people in ten have it defined. Their voice is always there and sounds the same from day to day. Through this gate's channel the will can join it. Then the voice has an engine behind it and speaks like a leader.

The other three in ten have it open. They take in every voice in the room and feel pressure to say what the others cannot. Their words come best when someone has asked for them. Like a mother bird softening food for her young, they take in what people are trying to say and give it back clear. With this gate, theirs is a teacher's voice, speaking to guide the tribe.
human_design.channel: Gate 21, in the will just over the heart, is the drive to take hold of the resources and manage them. With Gate 45 it makes the Channel of the Money Line, the one place in a person where they take charge outright and follow through. Its cost is finding it hard to trust others to be as able, so it does everything itself and wears out. It works best when it tells people what it is about to do. Gate 21 may be in you or in someone close to you.

tarot.ring_role: This energy unites what people have, and on its own it can draw everything from a single well. It belongs to a family of two, the Ring of Prosperity, whose theme is abundance that is shared. UL 16, Grand Rising, carries the skill of drawing on many sources when one runs dry. This one carries the gathering that brings them together.
tarot.tarot_resonance: The ring and the two trigrams give this energy five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana.

body.physiology:
This energy is given to the thyroid, and the reason is the sea. The thyroid sits low in the front of your neck, across your windpipe, and it is the one organ in you that needs iodine. Iodine comes from the sea and the soil. You get it from fish and seaweed, from milk and eggs, and from the salt on most kitchen tables. Your thyroid pulls it out of your blood and holds it many times stronger than the blood around it. From it, the gland makes what every part of you runs on. So one thing, gathered out of what everyone eats, is kept in one place and given out to your whole body.

Look at the salt in your kitchen. Somewhere on the packet it says iodised, or iodine added, and that was put there for this gland alone. Rest a hand at the base of your throat, and you are resting it on the part of you that is fed by the sea.
body.amino_acid:
The gathering in you has a chemistry, and one substance in it is cysteine. It is one of the twenty pieces every protein in you is built from, and one of only two that carry sulfur. Where two of them meet across a folded protein, they clasp sulfur to sulfur and hold its shape. The insulin in you holds together at three such clasps. A perm works by breaking those clasps in your hair and letting them join again.

You share this chemistry with one other energy. In your body, separate pieces fuse into a working that is more than any of them.

relations.unity_line: UL 46 is this card's pair and its inverse at once: the one life rising out of a crowd, where this one gathers it.

pair.teaching: This energy gathers people and shares out what there is, and it runs out once everyone is fed and settled. Fountain of Light is where it goes next, a slow rise out of that ground into delight. Open it when the gathering is done and something in you wants to climb. A crowd comes in; a rise goes up and does not come back.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy end for end and many people coming in becomes one life going up. Fountain of Light is the same ground seen from whoever grows out of it. Open it when you have held the group long enough and want to grow on your own.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy shares what there is, and it stalls where sharing would cost it its importance. Lighter Than a Feather holds that pride, the pleasure of feeling important. The two feed each other: pride makes it hard to hand over charge, and keeping charge feeds the pride. Open it when you notice you cannot let anyone else decide.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Prosperity
codon_ring.teaching: This energy unites what people have, and on its own it can draw everything from a single well. It belongs to a family of two, the Ring of Prosperity, whose theme is abundance that is shared. UL 16, Grand Rising, carries the skill of drawing on many sources when one runs dry. This one carries the gathering that brings them together.

tarot.teaching: The ring and the two trigrams give this energy five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana.

sky.teaching: the planet of time and structure, of what is built slowly to last, like the trust that holds a group together.

immortals.teaching: Lake above carries Zhong Li Quan, whose fan is said to wake the dead, as good company revives you when you are spent. Earth below carries Lan Cai He, the wandering singer who gave their coins to the poor, as you give away freely what comes in.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the last letter, the mark of something finished, as a gathering is finished when everyone at the table is fed.

cards.essence: Some days things work out without any pushing, and you turn up in the right place at the right time. Delight lives in those days, the plain gladness of being alive in a body. Food tastes of something, and the air feels good on your skin. You love life more than any plan you have for it.

glance.reading:
Some days things work out without any pushing, and you turn up in the right place at the right time. Delight lives in those days, the plain gladness of being alive in a body. Food tastes of something, and the air feels good on your skin. You love life more than any plan you have for it.

At times you brace against how things will turn out, and worry takes the place of the gladness. The mind can be told that all is well, but it is the body that has to feel safe. Worry holds you the way a parent holds a struggling child, tighter while you fight and loose once you go still.

Hold your plans loosely enough to drop them when something better comes along. Stay open to surprises, and let life take you where it was already going. Make room for play, for good food and for the people you love. Good fortune finds you there, and you are glad to be alive when it does.

iching.trigram_combination: Earth over Wind is the hexagram of steady growth, the kind that rises a little every day. Wind, which here is also wood, is the part of you that grows into whatever room it finds. Earth is the part of you that gives way and lets that growth come through. The yielding sits above the growing because nothing rises far unless something makes room for it. This hexagram has long been read as a tree growing inside the ground. Your own progress grows the same way, out of sight a little each day, until one morning it shows. Small gains add up the same way, until something tall stands there. You rise the way anything living rises, a little at a time.
iching.reading:
The way ahead is open, and what you have worked at slowly begins to rise. Little stands in its way now. Do not worry about how it will go. Keep adding one small gain to the next, and do not overlook them, because they are what lifts you. Go and see someone who has already been where you are heading, and listen to them. Move toward what is warm and bright.

Honour where you came from as you rise, because your roots decide how long you stay up. Stay humble while you climb. People who climb fast and stop looking down miss the first signs of trouble. Calm, steady progress keeps you where you have climbed to.

Your thighs carry this time, the strongest muscles you have, the ones that lift you up a stair. Let the lift come from low down, and keep your shoulders loose.
judgement_lines: Pushing upward: from the source it goes through and grows.
It serves to see the great one. Have no worry.
Set out toward the south, and it goes well.
image_lines: Within the earth, wood grows: pushing upward.
So the wise, yielding, heap up the small until it stands high and great.

upper_trigram.name: Earth (K'un)
upper_trigram.nature: Surface of the world, support of all existence. Essential Yin. Rest, receptivity.

lower_trigram.name: Wind (Sun)
lower_trigram.nature: Subtly penetrating. Mild, nourishing. Wood and wind. The eldest daughter.

lines.image: a rising that is welcomed, a good seed in good ground.
lines.reading: Your rise begins with a welcome, and the people above you agree with where you are going. A good seed has found good soil. Come humble and open, and go to the people who know more than you do. This rise goes all the way.

lines.image: sincere, so that even a small offering at the spring rite is accepted.
lines.reading: You bring less than the others, and you feel you do not belong. It is a small offering made in spring, when the stores are low, and it is accepted for what is in it. You feel wrong here, and you are not. Bring the small thing sincerely, and there is joy in it.

lines.image: rising into an empty city.
lines.reading: You climb into an empty city, with open gates and nobody on the walls. The way may truly be clear, or you may have rushed ahead of anyone who could tell you what is there. Nothing holds you back, so go on. Find someone who knows the place before you settle in it.

lines.image: the king makes his offering on the twin-peaked mountain.
lines.reading: The king makes his offering on the mountain where his family began. You rise here by honouring what you grew out of, going from low to high in order. Go back to where you started, and give thanks there, and you keep your roots as you rise.

lines.image: steady and upright, going up the steps.
lines.reading: Near the top, the rise has become a flight of steps. Each step is easy when you take it as one step. The pull is to take them two at a time. Stay steady and upright, and go up one step at a time.

lines.image: rising in the dark, and no pause in being upright.
lines.reading: You have what you wanted, and still you climb, on into the dark. Climbing past the point where up means anything costs you what you gathered. A tree grows by night as well as by day, steadily and without a pause. Keep your breath slow, do what is right, and rise by staying constant.

gene_keys.shadow:
Seriousness is the most common ailment there is. It is worrying, expecting, wishing life were other than it is right now. Your attention sits on what is coming or on what is gone, and the day in front of you goes by. It feels like being responsible. Mostly it is a grip, and it takes you out of life and love into control. Out of step with life, you find it rains whenever you least want it to.

It is handed down. Parents who are serious about life pass it into the air a child grows up in, however much they want the child to be happy. They have forgotten how to play. Even people on a spiritual path take it too seriously, and it shows in their faces.
gene_keys.repressive: Held in, the seriousness freezes the senses. They hide from life out of fear of their own body, and disliking it turns their vitality sour. It shows in a face that stays pinched. When they start to enjoy being in their body instead of judging how it looks, a warmth buried deep in them comes back.
gene_keys.reactive: Let out, the seriousness wears a show of taking nothing seriously. They joke and stay laid back, and under it they carry a great deal of anger. It breaks out when someone is honest with them. They take life more seriously than anyone, so they run from the truth, and their loves are many and short.
gene_keys.gift:
Delight is the freedom of enjoying how rich it is to be alive. It begins with owning what is yours. Once you have seen something about yourself and let it go, you have more energy for being glad. Nothing really matters except life and love, and you feel this in your body.

A dry village sends for a rainmaker, and after a few days it rains, though he has no power over the weather. He has found what he is for, so he turns up where he likes, and it happens to rain. Find what you are for, and you need only turn up. Luck is what happens when you stop interfering with life. It tells you that you are in step with everything around you. People like this let the past go and ride the present, soft and at ease in their bodies, whatever they look like. Others are drawn to them without knowing why.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Ecstasy lives in the heart. It is your natural state whenever your mind is fully at rest. When the mind is needed it comes forward, and when the task is done the ecstasy returns. It lives in the shopping, at the family table, in the ordinary world. Others can feel it from across a room.

There is no work on earth more important than play. The heart knows only that it is alive and beating right now, and that knowing floods you. If you have felt this once, you can find it again. It begins with a slow, easy breath.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy grows lighter the less it grips, and it cannot let go of what it has not first accepted. The Mysteries Play holds that acceptance, the love that takes life as it is. The two grow out of each other, because you have to own a thing before you can let it go. Open it when you know you are holding on and cannot stop.

human_design.gate:
Gate 46 is the love of the body, the joy of being in one and meeting life through its senses. It is the determination of a child in the womb, pushing its way out into the world. It draws you toward touch and movement, and toward caring for your body tenderly. Your body is not just something you live in. It carries your whole life, and it wants to hold as much life as it can.

Turned against, the same pressure leaves you at odds with your body. You may neglect it, hide it, or try to make it into something else so that you cannot be fully seen. Some are drawn to yoga or sport, and others fall out of step with their body altogether.
human_design.centre:
The Identity Center sits in the middle of the chest and holds who you are and which way your life faces. It is the spark that calls you into a body, and it leaves the body when you die. It does not push you anywhere. It only draws, pulling toward you the people, places and work your life needs.

A little more than half of people have this centre defined, and their sense of self stays the same whoever they are with. They choose their life off the menu, and their path tends to be steady. The rest have it open, and who they are shifts with the company and the place. They piece a life together from the buffet. Where they live and where they sit matter to them more than to most. It is a relief for them to hear that what they are doing is not what they must do forever. They become what they are doing while they do it: writing, they are a writer.
human_design.channel: The love of the body needs something to give itself to. Gate 29, in the Sacral Center low in the belly, is the yes that means it and keeps going. Together they make the Channel of Discovery: you commit to an experience before you know where it leads. Once your belly has said yes, you have the stamina to see it through. You may succeed where others fail, and fail where others succeed. Gate 29 may be in you or in someone close to you.

tarot.ring_role: This energy lives in the body, where every life first learns whether it is safe. It belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Matter, which shapes how you settle into a body up to the age of twenty-one. UL 57, Flight of the Tao, carries the months you spent in the womb. UL 48, Doorways of the Unknown, carries your second seven years. UL 18, Liberation of the Greater, carries your third. This one carries the first seven years.
tarot.tarot_resonance: The tarot's major cards, its Arcana, bring five pictures to this one through its family and its two trigrams.

body.physiology:
Warmth is the reason this energy is given to the blood. Your blood is made from what you eat, and it comes out red. It goes to your palms so they can hold, and to your feet so they can walk. The warmth in your skin is the blood arriving. When you are at ease in your body, it rises to the surface. Your hands are warm, and there is colour in your face. When you brace, it draws inward and your hands go cold. Your body decides this before you do.

Lay a cold hand flat on the warm skin of your belly. The heat you feel was made deep inside you and carried out to the skin by your blood. Your marrow makes two or three million new red cells every second, so you are in new blood three times a year.
body.amino_acid:
The gladness of being in a body has a chemistry, and one substance in it is alanine. It is one of the twenty pieces every protein in you is built from. Your body makes its own, though nearly every food with protein in it carries some too.

It took you seven years to arrive fully in your body. What you learned then is written in your posture, your breathing and the way you touch things. Hours into a walk with no food, your muscles send alanine through your blood to your liver. Your liver sends it back as sugar. A body is there to be filled completely by the life in it, and delight is what that feels like.

relations.unity_line: UL 45 is this card's pair and its inverse at once: the people gathered together, where this one is the growth that rises out of them.

pair.teaching: This energy rises on its own when nothing grips it, and it runs thin when it rises alone. Tribal Tapestry is where it goes next: the pull that gathers people around what there is and shares it out. Open it when good fortune has found you and you want other people in it. Nothing grows far without people to lean on.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy end for end and the rising becomes a gathering. Tribal Tapestry is the same growth seen from the crowd that makes it possible. Open it when you have been climbing alone for too long.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy grows lighter the less it grips, and it cannot let go of what it has not first accepted. The Mysteries Play holds that acceptance, the love that takes life as it is. The two grow out of each other, because you have to own a thing before you can let it go. Open it when you know you are holding on and cannot stop.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Matter
codon_ring.teaching: This energy lives in the body, where every life first learns whether it is safe. It belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Matter, which shapes how you settle into a body up to the age of twenty-one. UL 57, Flight of the Tao, carries the months you spent in the womb. UL 48, Doorways of the Unknown, carries your second seven years. UL 18, Liberation of the Greater, carries your third. This one carries the first seven years.

tarot.teaching: The tarot's major cards, its Arcana, bring five pictures to this one through its family and its two trigrams.

sky.teaching: the first sign of spring, when a seed breaks through the soil and a new year begins in you.

immortals.teaching: Earth above carries Lan Cai He, the wandering singer with a basket of flowers, who shows you how to go through life lightly. Wind below carries He Xian Gu, the one woman among the Eight, who holds a lotus. The lotus grows clean out of the mud, the way delight can grow out of a heavy time.

hebrew_letter.teaching: a window lets light and air into a room, the way this energy lets life into your body.

cards.essence: Hope is alive in you, and it grows strongest when life hems you in. You feel it as a pressure inside to become more than you have been. It keeps you true to what lit you up, even when nothing around you changes.

glance.reading:
Hope is alive in you, and it grows strongest when life hems you in. You feel it as a pressure inside to become more than you have been. It keeps you true to what lit you up, even when nothing around you changes.

Some stretches wear you out, and the same fear keeps coming back. Much of it was handed down to you before you were born. You cannot fix it or hand it to anyone, but it is yours to own. When you cannot see the next step, trust that the way will show itself in its own time.

Turn toward the fear you most want to avoid, and stay with it. What you look at steadily begins to change, though it takes years and cannot be hurried. You grow in the very place that hemmed you in, and your hope grows with you.

iching.trigram_combination: Lake over Water is the hexagram of being hemmed in and worn out. Water is the part of you that goes into danger and keeps moving. Lake is the part of you that stays open and glad and talks with people. The gladness sits above the danger because your ease shows on the outside while the hard part goes on within. This hexagram has long been read as a lake with no water in it, the water drained away beneath. You can look fine to everyone while your reserves run dry. Your strength is covered over for a while, not gone. Being worn out does not mean you have lost what you are here to do.
iching.reading:
Your reserves have run dry, and you are hemmed in on every side. From outside you may look fine, because the surface keeps its shape after what was under it has gone. Your strength is not lost. It is covered over for a while.

What you say in this time is not believed, however true it is. The more you explain yourself, the more it wears you out. So let what you do speak for you, and keep what you can do out of sight until its hour comes. Keep to what matters most to you, and do not let hardship talk you out of it. Climbing without a pause is what drained you, so the pause is part of the climb.

In the body this time lives in the mouth. Close it, and notice how much of you was leaving through your words. Accept what has fallen to you and live it out. Keep an easy face and hold your purpose firm within. A time this hard carries the start of a new growth.
judgement_lines: Hemmed in, and still it grows. Holding firm, the great person meets good fortune, without fault.
What is said is not believed.
image_lines: There is no water in the lake: the picture of being worn out.
So the wise stake their life on what they are here to do.

upper_trigram.name: Lake (Tui)
upper_trigram.nature: Open surface, interaction, pleasure, the mouth, exchange. The youngest daughter.

lower_trigram.name: Water (K'an)
lower_trigram.nature: Precipice, dangerous place. Stream, flowing water, river. Venture and fall. The middle son.

lines.image: sitting on a bare tree stump, gone down into a shaded gully.
lines.reading: You sit on a bare stump and wander into a dark valley, and for three years no one sees you. The trouble is still small here, and help is close by. The harm comes from sitting down in it and giving up. Get up while the trouble is still small.

lines.image: hemmed in even amid wine and food. The scarlet sashes arriving.
lines.reading: You are worn out with food and wine in front of you, and help from someone in high office is already on its way. Having plenty does not end the strain. You will want to rush out and change everything at once. Stay where you are, stay sincere, and let the help reach you.

lines.image: stopped by a rock, hands grasping thorns. The house entered, the wife not there.
lines.reading: You are stopped by a rock, you lean on thorns, and you come home to find no one there. This trouble is of your own making. You are pressed by what has no need to press you. Let go of what hurts you, and turn back to what is within.

lines.image: coming slowly, slowly, hindered by a carriage of metal.
lines.reading: You come slowly, held up in a golden carriage, on your way to someone who needs you. There is shame in being late. Your heart is in the right place, and you do not go alone. Keep coming at the pace you can, because this has an end.

lines.image: nose and feet cut, hemmed in by the crimson sash of office.
lines.reading: You have lost your standing and your footing, and the people in office hem you in. You have the ability and no chance to use it. Do not force a way out. Keep your gifts out of sight and work alone, and joy comes slowly.

lines.image: tangled in trailing creepers, swaying on a dangerous height.
lines.reading: You are caught in creeping vines on a high and shaky place, telling yourself that any move will be regretted. The vines are your own doubts and old mistakes. Feel the regret, then move. Going forward now brings good fortune.

gene_keys.shadow:
A weight sits on you that did not start in your own life. It is old fear, carried down the line of everyone you come from. It feels personal, though most of it is not. Few people look at it, because the deeper they look, the deeper it seems to go. So they keep a lid on it and escape into work and distraction, or they blame the people around them.

What is kept down does not stay down. It comes out in the shape of your life, and the pattern goes on repeating. No amount of thinking will solve it. The thing that frightens you most is the road that leads you out.
gene_keys.repressive: This person bows under the weight and calls it normal. The pattern has never broken, so at some point they stop expecting it to. Hope slips away without a sound. They settle for a life of small compromises, shut in, and the fear stays safe because nobody looks at it.
gene_keys.reactive: This person pushes the fear outward and holds on to fixed views to feel safe, whether the views come from science or from religion. The views freeze everything in place. Anyone who thinks freely nearby feels like a threat. People around them agree or leave, and nothing changes.
gene_keys.gift:
Transmutation begins when you take the lid off and look at a fear. Held in your attention long enough, the fear changes, the way a thing changes in the heat of a fire. It does not simply lift. It becomes something else, and the heat of the change lifts you a little. Then the next fear shows itself, and you meet that one too.

Most of the change is small, one day after another. Now and then enough of it adds up to a leap, and your life stands somewhere new. The only thing in danger is the idea that anything about you is fixed. You let go of each thing you were sure you were. In time you greet the next fear almost gladly, because you know there is more light inside it. This change happens in your belly, the place where you feel things most.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Transfiguration is the change reaching all the way into your body. It works first through the mind, then through the feelings, and at last it reaches what you are made of. The elements in your body were made inside stars, and here you shine like one. Nobody reaches this by effort alone, and it comes as grace.

Life grows softer and quieter while the change goes on. The gaps between your thoughts widen until the thoughts are the interruption. What shows at the end is you as you really are, lit from within, like the sun after a storm.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy looks straight at what weighs on you and changes it. Treasure of the Way holds what makes that bearable: the graciousness that lets you welcome each new fear. Without it, you cannot honour your own past, and you hear other people only through your own wants. Open it when hardship has made you hard.

human_design.gate:
Gate 47 is the drive to make sense of what has happened to you. It turns raw experience into understanding, and the question it keeps asking is how. How do you make real the idea that lit you up? The way there is never straight. Confusion comes first, then frustration, then a stretch where nothing seems to move. Then the fog lifts and the whole thing comes clear at once.

From outside this can look like brooding, and people may take it for a bad mood. The drive needs a hopeful mind. If you have decided that nothing will come, you miss it when it does.
human_design.centre:
The Ajna Center sits behind your forehead, between your eyes. It takes in what comes from above and makes sense of it, seeing the whole and every part. It cannot act on what it knows. So an answer from here waits to be asked for, and given at the wrong time it turns from medicine into poison.

About half of people have this centre defined. Their minds work the same way every day, and they can count on what they think. The risk is an old belief that gets stuck and plays in a loop for years. A healthy mind can change its course. In everyone else the centre is open. They take in everyone's thoughts, have no fixed way of thinking and are not built to be certain. Gripping a thought tenses the whole body. Hold your mind lightly, the way you hold a steering wheel, and you can answer what comes.
human_design.channel: Gate 64 in the Head Center above brings you a flood of images, dreams and memories in no order. Gate 47 sorts them for you. Together they make the Channel of Abstraction, and with it you learn by soaking things up rather than step by step. You are restless for a long time, then clear in a flash. Gate 64 may be in you or in someone close, and the flash comes when both are present.

tarot.ring_role: This energy works on what was handed down to you, and it changes you from the inside first. It belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Alchemy, whose theme is turning something rough into something fine. UL 6, Harmonious Mirage, carries the walls coming down between you and someone close. UL 40, Eternal Wellspring, carries your new openness out into a community. UL 64, Communion, carries the fresh possibilities that open for you next. This one carries the change in your old ways.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Its family and its two trigrams bring five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, to this one.

body.physiology:
The past is the reason this energy is given to the neocortex, the thin outer layer of your brain. It is wired after birth, year by year, out of what happens to you. So your whole life so far is written into it, and it cannot put down what it has learned. When this energy stirs, this layer is turning your old experience over and looking for the pattern in it.

The layer has no feeling of its own. A surgeon can work on it while the person is awake and talking, because the part of you that takes everything in cannot feel itself. So you feel the weight of the past lower in your body, and the understanding catches up later.
body.amino_acid:
The change in you has a chemistry, and one substance in it is glycine. The red of your blood begins with it, because glycine is the first step in making the part of each red cell that carries iron. Your body makes glycine for itself and takes in more from food, most of all from the skin and bones of meat and fish.

This energy shares that substance with three others in you, one family whose work is turning something rough into something fine. Its own part of the work is letting your old ways change. That change happens in your body before it shows anywhere else, and to be in it is to be fully alive.

relations.unity_line: UL 48 is this card's pair and its inverse at once: the well that fills from below, where this one is the lake run dry.

pair.teaching: This energy grows under pressure, and it runs out when your own reserves are spent. Doorways of the Unknown is where it goes next: the deep source you reach when you are asked for more than you have. Open it when you are worn out and still have to give. A hardship faced openly shows its hidden meaning, and that meaning is the well.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy end for end and the dry lake becomes a well. Doorways of the Unknown is the same water seen from its source, rising from below. Open it when you have been drained and need to find what still flows.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy looks straight at what weighs on you and changes it. Treasure of the Way holds what makes that bearable: the graciousness that lets you welcome each new fear. Without it, you cannot honour your own past, and you hear other people only through your own wants. Open it when hardship has made you hard.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Alchemy
codon_ring.teaching: This energy works on what was handed down to you, and it changes you from the inside first. It belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Alchemy, whose theme is turning something rough into something fine. UL 6, Harmonious Mirage, carries the walls coming down between you and someone close. UL 40, Eternal Wellspring, carries your new openness out into a community. UL 64, Communion, carries the fresh possibilities that open for you next. This one carries the change in your old ways.

tarot.teaching: Its family and its two trigrams bring five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, to this one.

sky.teaching: the swift planet, and the metal the alchemists used to change one thing into another, as you change what weighs on you.

immortals.teaching: Lake above carries Zhong Li Quan, a general who lost his army and came back an alchemist who made silver for the poor. He is your defeat turned into something you can give. Water below carries Li Tie Guai, a healer who came back from his own death carrying medicine in a gourd. He is your loss turned into a way to help others.

hebrew_letter.teaching: four walls around you, the room that hems you in and the room where you grow.

cards.essence: Resourcefulness wakes in you when someone needs more than you know how to give. You meet them open, without a plan, and the answer rises from somewhere below what you have learned. It is rarely what you expected, and it is just what the moment needs. What you do not know turns out to be a doorway.

glance.reading:
Resourcefulness wakes in you when someone needs more than you know how to give. You meet them open, without a plan, and the answer rises from somewhere below what you have learned. It is rarely what you expected, and it is just what the moment needs. What you do not know turns out to be a doorway.

Some days a quiet fear says you are not enough for what is coming, and you want to learn one more thing first. Sit with not knowing instead, and the fear has less to hold on to.

Give what comes up to the people who ask for it, and there will be more of it. You need only a little more than enough, and it arrives when it is needed. Again and again, you find you can do far more than you thought.

iching.trigram_combination: Water over Wind is the hexagram of the source you draw from. Wind, read here as wood, is the part of you that goes down gently into what you cannot see. Water is the depth in you that holds what you need. Water sits above because what you find down there is lifted up into your day. This hexagram has long been read as a well. A town can move, but the well stays, and whoever comes can draw from it. It also asks you to keep people at their work, helping one another. What you need is under you already, and it is there for everyone who comes.
iching.reading:
You have been worn out, and now you come to the source. Everything around you may change, the work and the people, and the source does not. It gives neither more nor less than before. People come, draw from it and leave, and it is there for the next one. What you are facing goes deeper than it looks from the top.

Go all the way down. Water at the bottom helps nobody until it is brought up. The drawing fails in two ways only: the rope stops short of the water, or the jar breaks on the way up. So reach the whole way, and carry what you find in something whole. Then share it, and help the people beside you with their work.

The body's part is the ear and the thigh. The ear listens down into the dark, and the legs walk to the source and back. Stand still for a moment and listen before you reach.
judgement_lines: The well. The town may be changed, but the well cannot be changed.
It neither decreases nor increases. They come and go and draw from the well.
Nearly down to the water, and the rope does not reach; or the jar breaks: misfortune.
image_lines: Water over wood: the well.
So the wise encourage the people at their work, and urge them to help one another.

upper_trigram.name: Water (K'an)
upper_trigram.nature: Precipice, dangerous place. Stream, flowing water, river. Venture and fall. The middle son.

lower_trigram.name: Wind (Sun)
lower_trigram.nature: Subtly penetrating. Mild, nourishing. Wood and wind. The eldest daughter.

lines.image: mud in the well, and an old well that no birds come to.
lines.reading: Mud lies at the bottom of an old well, and even the birds have stopped coming. What was once a source has been left too long, and nobody drinks from it now. Do not draw from what has gone stale. Find where the living water is now.

lines.image: the depths water a minnow, and the jar leaks.
lines.reading: The spring at the bottom waters only a small fish, and the jar is cracked and leaks. What you have is real, but it does not yet reach anyone above. Giving from here costs you more than it helps them. Mend the jar before you lower it.

lines.image: the well cleared, and nobody drinks.
lines.reading: The well has been cleaned and the water is good, but no one drinks. That is a real sorrow, because the water is there to be drawn. Your worth is ready and overlooked, and it still reaches the ones who notice. Let it be seen by someone who can use it, and everyone shares the good fortune.

lines.image: the well being lined with stone.
lines.reading: The well is being lined with stone. Nothing is drawn yet and nobody is served, and that is right for now. You are neither praised nor blamed while you repair. Tend your own walls before you are asked to give, and there is no mistake in it.

lines.image: a clear, cold spring, and it is drunk.
lines.reading: The well is clear, and people drink from its cold spring. This is a source doing what a source is for, empty on top and full below, giving without running down. Let it be drunk from, because what has a real source is not used up.

lines.image: the well drawn from, and left uncovered.
lines.reading: The water comes all the way up, and the well stays open to anyone who is thirsty. When your good fortune is full, trust it and use it. Leave the cover off, and great good fortune comes.

gene_keys.shadow:
The fear of not being enough sits low in the body, and it does not come and go. It has no reason. It was laid down between seven and fourteen, while your feelings were forming and the world sent them mixed messages. It says someone else knows what you do not. So you reach for more knowledge, or a system detailed enough to feel like solid ground. None of it reaches the fear, because nothing outside you can. Underneath, the fear is of the dark itself. It is like standing at night at the edge of deep, cold water with no bottom in sight.

That water is not empty. It is warm underneath, and full of light. Tension is something you learned, and as a child you were gentle. Go gently into the dark, and it is gentle with you.
gene_keys.repressive: Held down, the fear settles into whatever pattern the world hands over. There is no hard question and no look into the dark, only the head kept low. Life brings events that force a look, and once each one passes, the head goes further into the sand.
gene_keys.reactive: Pushed out, the fear becomes a hold over other people. Rage will not let this person admit they are afraid. So they use what they know to keep everyone else unsure, and they hide behind the system. Their own fear stays away while the room is more frightened than they are.
gene_keys.gift:
Resourcefulness begins when you stop hiding from the fear and sit with it. You let a bucket down into the dark and pull it up to see what is there. What comes up surprises you, and so much of it comes out of the dark. It comes when you arrive open and unready, without the answer. Each time it comes up full, you trust it a little more, and the fear slowly loses its hold. The body takes about seven years to unlearn the old pattern.

It is meant for other people. They come and let the bucket down, and there is more each time. Used only for yourself, it dries up. Serving everyone is the surest way to serve yourself. It will not do the same thing twice, so keep moving. It needs the sky and the woods, and it fades behind a screen.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Wisdom comes from not knowing, and it was in you before anything you learned. Knowing takes effort to gather, while not knowing is already there. Wisdom wells up gently from underneath, and if you grab it, it hardens into knowledge. It is like water, empty and full at once, taking the shape of whatever holds it. You are wise because you do not know you are wise.

It looks completely ordinary. Nothing inside you has changed, and seeing that is the whole change. Every feeling is allowed to rise and pass, the fear of not being enough among them. The body feels each one, and nothing in you is wiser than the body.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy waits to be asked and gives from what it does not know. Beyond Binary holds what it lacks: the will that takes charge and acts. At their lowest, the two together try to control every part of a life so it feels safe. At their highest, the courage of one helps the other let go of what it knows. Open it when you know enough and still have not moved.

human_design.gate: Gate 48 is the pressure to go below the surface of a thing until you reach its heart. It does not work things out step by step. It gathers what it knows from experience, time spent and close watching, until the pattern underneath shows. Its fear is not knowing enough. The more you know, the more you see how much you do not, though you often know more than anyone in the room. Held too tightly, it waits for certainty before it acts, and the waiting can take over. It works best when you put what you found to use.
human_design.centre:
The Spleen Center is the body's own alertness, the oldest awareness you have. It works in the moment, through your senses. It speaks once and softly. If you miss it, it does not say it again. It keeps the body's fears as well, and most of them are old or imagined, like a rope on the path taken for a snake. Only the present moment settles them.

About fifty-five people in a hundred have this centre defined. They can rest the way a cat rests on a porch in the sun, ears still turning, because the body will warn them. Their risk is pushing on through feeling unwell. The other forty-five have it open. They tend to have a more sensitive body, and they lose track of time or feel pressed by it. They hold on to things longer than is good for them. They also take in the fears of the people around them and feel them more strongly. Their gift, when they are well, is knowing which fear is theirs.
human_design.channel: Depth alone has nothing to show for itself. Gate 16, in the throat, is the enthusiasm for a skill and the drive to perfect it. Together they make the Channel of the Wavelength, which turns what you have gathered into a skill, practised until it is yours. The fear of not being good enough keeps the practice going. Gate 16 may be your own or another person's, and depth becomes talent only when both are present.

tarot.ring_role: This energy brings people what they need in the world of things. It belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Matter. UL 18, Liberation of the Greater, carries the instinct for what has gone wrong. UL 46, Fountain of Light, carries the ease of a body that has stopped fighting. UL 57, Flight of the Tao, carries the hunch that knows the way. This one carries the answer that comes when you are asked. Together the four shaped you from the womb to twenty-one, in body, feeling and mind.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Five major cards of the tarot, its Arcana, stand around this energy.

body.physiology:
Return is the reason this energy is given to the lymph. The lymph is water that has already been your blood. The finest vessels let water out into the spaces between your cells. Most of it is drawn straight back, and a second set of vessels gathers the rest, two or three litres a day. They carry it up to the blood at the base of your neck. There is no pump to move it. It rises from your feet with every step and every breath, so it moves when you move and pools when you sit. Beside it, the spleen under your left ribs holds a store of blood back until the body calls for it.

Sit for a few hours and your ankles grow fuller. Walk for a few minutes and they empty, because the water down there was waiting for a muscle to lift it. What went down comes back.
body.amino_acid:
The depth in you has a chemistry, and alanine is part of it. Your body makes it for itself, and you also take it in from almost any food with protein, meat or beans. About one in twelve of the pieces your body is built from is alanine.

This chemistry sends you out into the world of things to get away from the fear, into work and money. Nothing you buy reaches the fear, because it lives in your body itself. What this energy in you is for is bringing people what they need. Whatever you own will wear out one day, as all matter does. Small, ordinary things can teach you more than the cleverest thinker.

relations.unity_line: UL 47 is this card's pair and its inverse at once: the dry spell that sends you down, where this one is what you find there.

pair.teaching: This energy brings up what is needed when you are asked, and it runs out when you have given everything you had. Garden of Alchemy is where it goes next: the pressure that holds one fear in front of you until it changes. Open it when you feel squeezed dry. Being worn out is what sends you back down to what you need.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy upside down and the full source becomes a dry spell. Garden of Alchemy is the same situation felt as thirst. Open it when there seems to be nothing left to draw on. What you needed was there the whole time.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy waits to be asked and gives from what it does not know. Beyond Binary holds what it lacks: the will that takes charge and acts. At their lowest, the two together try to control every part of a life so it feels safe. At their highest, the courage of one helps the other let go of what it knows. Open it when you know enough and still have not moved.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Matter
codon_ring.teaching: This energy brings people what they need in the world of things. It belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Matter. UL 18, Liberation of the Greater, carries the instinct for what has gone wrong. UL 46, Fountain of Light, carries the ease of a body that has stopped fighting. UL 57, Flight of the Tao, carries the hunch that knows the way. This one carries the answer that comes when you are asked. Together the four shaped you from the womb to twenty-one, in body, feeling and mind.

tarot.teaching: Five major cards of the tarot, its Arcana, stand around this energy.

sky.teaching: the fire that starts things, the step you take into the new before you feel ready.

immortals.teaching: Water above carries Li Tie Guai, the healer, who keeps his medicine in a gourd. Wind below carries He Xian Gu, the shaman, who carries a lotus. One has the cure ready for when it is needed, and the other opens without force. What you bring up for someone is often both, a remedy given gently.

hebrew_letter.teaching: a window lets light into a room, the way an answer lets light into what you did not know.

cards.essence: The urge for change is alive in you when the way you live stops fitting. It starts in you and in your closest bonds, before it reaches the wider world. You feel it first in your belly, as a warmth that shows you plainly what has to go. At its best you understand how things work, so you know what to keep and how long the change will take.

glance.reading:
The urge for change is alive in you when the way you live stops fitting. It starts in you and in your closest bonds, before it reaches the wider world. You feel it first in your belly, as a warmth that shows you plainly what has to go. At its best you understand how things work, so you know what to keep and how long the change will take.

For a while the people closest to you may seem harder to live with. They are not harder; you are seeing old hurts more clearly, and each one you let go shows a smaller one underneath. Forgive yourself for what you did before you could see.

Whenever something sets you off, look under the feeling for the need behind it. Once you see the need, it loses its hold on you, even if it stays. Act from goodwill toward everyone the change will touch. Some people will step back, and others will ask how you did it. Out of the ashes of the old way comes a closer union with the people you love.

iching.trigram_combination: Lake over Fire is the hexagram of changing the way you live. Fire is the part of you that sees what is still alive and what has died. Lake is the part of you that says so out loud and brings others with you. They sit this way round because what you see and what you say are at odds until one of them gives way. This hexagram has long been read as a skin that is shed. An animal that has grown sheds its old skin whole, and you leave an old way of living the same way. You do not go back to a life you have outgrown.
iching.reading:
A habit, an arrangement or a bond you live inside has stopped fitting. Now it has to change as a whole. People trust a change like this only once it is done. Before then they doubt it and dislike it, and you may doubt it too. So you do not make it in a hurry. It has its day, and when that day comes you will know it.

Until then, change the one thing you can: yourself. A change that asks everyone but you to change is the old way in new clothes. Make sure the new way is better, and not only different.

Let the change come the way one season follows another, each one clear when it arrives. It starts in your heart, and your mouth speaks only after your heart has changed.
judgement_lines: Revolution. On its own day it is believed.
Great success, for the one who holds to what is right. Regret disappears.
image_lines: Fire in the middle of the lake: the image of revolution.
So the wise set the calendar in order and make the seasons clear.

upper_trigram.name: Lake (Tui)
upper_trigram.nature: Open surface, interaction, pleasure, the mouth, exchange. The youngest daughter.

lower_trigram.name: Fire (Li)
lower_trigram.nature: Glowing light spreading in all directions. The power of consciousness. Magical fire-bird. The middle daughter.

lines.image: wrapped in the hide of a yellow ox.
lines.reading: You are wrapped tight in the hide of a yellow ox and held still. The change is real, but its time has not come, and no one is there yet to help you. Anything you did now would only copy the changes going on around you. Hold firm, stay where you are, and do nothing yet.

lines.image: your own day has come, and the change may be made.
lines.reading: Your day has come, after some time has passed. Now the change is right, and going ahead brings good fortune with no blame. Before you start, set your own wants aside. Then you can see the people around you and find the ones who can teach you. Then go.

lines.image: the talk of change goes round three times.
lines.reading: Pushing ahead here goes badly, and being right does not make it safe. People will not take a change from someone who has not changed. Talk it through, then talk it through again. By the third time, if you have changed first, they will believe you.

lines.image: regret disappears, and the order itself is changed.
lines.reading: Regret falls away here, because people trust what you are aiming for. You are strong, and you do not need to push. You can change the order of your life itself, and not only its surface. Change it with your whole heart, and your life turns for the better.

lines.image: the great one changes like a tiger.
lines.reading: You change the way a tiger does, all at once and plain for everyone to see. People trust it before they ask for any proof, because it shows. No change is stronger than the one you make in yourself. Change the whole of yourself, and let it show.

lines.image: the leopard changes, while small people change only their faces.
lines.reading: At the end, some people change the way a leopard shows its spots, all the way down. Others change only their faces and follow along. Chasing their hearts now would go badly, because no one can be pushed into changing. The change is made. Stay upright where you are, and let the way you live change people quietly.

gene_keys.shadow:
Someone close to you does a small thing, and the heat is up in you before you have thought. A cup left out or a question not answered, and you are already braced for a fight. You cannot react on your own. It takes another person, and it runs hottest with the one you share a bed with. Under each flare is the fear of being left. The more finely you feel, the closer to the surface that fear lies.

Most of what sets you off is a need you did not know you had, like a coffee at the same hour each morning. Miss it once and the whole day goes wrong. You set these needs yourself, then let other people trip over them. A need makes an expectation, and an expectation makes a disappointment that feels like something they did to you. As long as you are the good one and they are the wrong one, the heat has you.
gene_keys.repressive: This person has stopped reacting at all. A shock or a hard childhood shut the feeling down. Their life looks the steadiest of all, with no fights and no spark. With a partner they talk about nothing that matters and never show a weak spot. Under the calm sits a disappointment neither of them admits.
gene_keys.reactive: Someone with this nature leaves first. The closer someone comes, the stronger the fear gets, so they end the bond before it can hurt them. They end up alone and call it safer. They are made for a shared life, so the only bond that lasts for them is one where the two hardly meet.
gene_keys.gift:
Watched instead of obeyed, the heat becomes a way of sorting. A need rises in your body and you watch it rise. You see whether it is met, and you judge neither. Then you ask whether it was needed at all. Often the body was not hungry, and you ate anyway. Once the loud needs quiet down, you hear the quiet ones, for beauty or for a kind word to yourself. Some needs stay and some go. The sorting is uncomfortable, and it is doing you good.

Your cut grows sharper the longer you use it. You can show someone what they do not need and what they do, and it can turn their life around. Your own life gets simpler, more beautiful and harder to sell things to. You can still have the cake, because it is the right afternoon and the right cake to share. No need drove you to it. This is the revolution: to live simply, and to live well.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Born a second time, you carry nothing of the pattern you start life with. That pattern is wiped clean, not improved. A butterfly keeps nothing of the caterpillar, though it comes from nowhere else. Change goes round and round, the same fight over and over, until one leap takes you clear of the circle. That leap comes because it must, and still you have to make it.

After it you cannot be a loner. Two people who love each other are never only two, because the love between them is a third. You are more yourself than ever, and you can no longer hide.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy acts on what it feels, and in the heat of a feeling it can cut too fast. Veils of Knowledge holds what it lacks: the patience to understand why things are as they are. At its height that patience becomes forgiveness. Open it when your anger has run ahead of your understanding. A change goes deeper once you have forgiven what came before.

human_design.gate:
Gate 49 is the pressure in you to live by a principle, and to act the moment it is broken. It does not change things for the sake of change. It reads the agreement underneath a bond, between two people or in a whole country. It feels the day the values that held that agreement together have gone. Then it presses you to end it and make a new one on something truer. From inside it feels like loyalty: you keep your word, and you expect others to keep theirs.

The work is knowing when to hold on and when to let go. This pressure can quit too soon, backing away from real closeness. It can also stay far too long in a dead arrangement, afraid of the upheaval, until giving way has turned into giving yourself up. When you do leave, leave with your integrity whole.
human_design.centre:
This pressure rises from the Emotional Solar Plexus Center, low in the front of you. It is the one centre that is both an engine and a way of knowing. It knows in waves, from hope down to pain and back up, so it has no truth to give you in the moment. For this gate the wave builds quietly. You put one upset away after another and tell yourself you are fine. Then someone breaks a promise, and it all comes out at once. A feeling lasts a few minutes when you let yourself feel it. Held back, it is packed into the body as tension. After an outburst, a hand on your shoulder brings you back.

A little more than half of people have this centre defined, and their wave never stops. A decision made at the top or the bottom of it does not hold, so their clarity comes over days. In the rest it is open, with no wave of its own. They take in the feelings of the people around them and feel them even more strongly, then find them gone once they are alone. The pull for them is to be nice instead of truthful, to keep the peace.
human_design.channel: A principle alone can cut without warmth. Gate 19 feels what people need, often before they say it. Together they make the Channel of Synthesis, where knowing what has died meets knowing what people need. A change made there looks after the people living inside it. Gate 19 may be in you or in a person close by, and the change holds only when both are present.

tarot.ring_role: This energy carries change outward, into a home or a whole society. It belongs to a family of two, the Ring of the Whirlwind, which shares one chemistry in the body. UL 55, Untouched Perfection, carries the same change inward. There it is the quiet freedom of a life no longer ruled by its needs. This one carries it out into the world.
tarot.tarot_resonance: The ring and the two trigrams bring five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana.

body.physiology:
The solar plexus holds this energy because it is the place in you that gets set off. The solar plexus is a knot of nerves on the front of your spine, behind the stomach. It sits a hand's depth behind the soft hollow under your breastbone. Nerves run out from it to everything in your belly. One reaches the gland that readies you to run or fight. A fright travels this road, and the charge is in your blood within seconds. Each need you have forgotten is a wire across your middle. A touch on it sets off that charge before you know what was said. You lose your centre there because it is your centre. Each need you see through takes one wire out, and your breath sinks a little lower.

Feel it when a door slams behind you: the jolt is under your ribs before you have turned. That is the part of you that fires first.
body.amino_acid:
The change this energy makes begins in your body, and it needs heat. The hotter it runs, the faster it goes. What it builds in you is built from what was already there, out of the ashes of the old. It has a substance in you, shared with one other energy, and the substance is histidine. It goes into every protein your body makes. You cannot make it, so your body takes it in from meat, eggs or beans. What your body makes from it lies behind the warmth and redness where something has got in, a sting or a bite.

Draw a fingernail firmly once across your inner forearm. Within a minute the line reddens, a flush spreads around it, and the line itself may rise pale as you watch. What reddens along the stroke is heat your body made on purpose, from a substance it could not make at all.

relations.unity_line: UL 50 is both this card's pair and its inverse: what you do with your life once the change is made.

pair.teaching: This energy clears away a way of living that no longer fits. It runs out once the old is gone and the new has to be kept. Melt Into Perfection is where it goes next: the sense of what will feed the people near you, and the care that keeps it. Open it when the change is done and the new life needs looking after. A change is only as good as what it goes on to feed.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy end for end and the clearing becomes the cooking. Melt Into Perfection is the same change seen from the other side: the pot that turns what came through into food. Open it when you have cleared enough and want to make something from what is left.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy acts on what it feels, and in the heat of a feeling it can cut too fast. Veils of Knowledge holds what it lacks: the patience to understand why things are as they are. At its height that patience becomes forgiveness. Open it when your anger has run ahead of your understanding. A change goes deeper once you have forgiven what came before.

codon_ring.name: Codon Ring of the Whirlwind
codon_ring.teaching: This energy carries change outward, into a home or a whole society. It belongs to a family of two, the Ring of the Whirlwind, which shares one chemistry in the body. UL 55, Untouched Perfection, carries the same change inward. There it is the quiet freedom of a life no longer ruled by its needs. This one carries it out into the world.

tarot.teaching: The ring and the two trigrams bring five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana.

sky.teaching: the planet of force and the fight, the heat in you that can break what stands or clear the ground.

immortals.teaching: Lake above carries Zhong Li Quan, whose fan is said to bring the dead back to life. In you, he is the power to revive what seemed finished. Fire below carries Lu Dong Bin, whose sword cuts through illusion. In you, he is the clear eye that ends what is false. A real change needs both.

hebrew_letter.teaching: your own mouth saying out loud what has to change, so the change can begin.

cards.essence: A household or a team has fallen out of balance, and you can feel what is missing. Balance lives in you as a feel for what the people near you need, and for what has gone off. You sense it low in your body before you can put it into words. You add a little here and take a little away there, the way a cook tastes a pot and adjusts it. People settle around you without knowing why.

glance.reading:
A household or a team has fallen out of balance, and you can feel what is missing. Balance lives in you as a feel for what the people near you need, and for what has gone off. You sense it low in your body before you can put it into words. You add a little here and take a little away there, the way a cook tastes a pot and adjusts it. People settle around you without knowing why.

There are days when everyone near you is out of tune at once, and you feel it in your own body. Do not force them back into line, and do not walk away. Stay in the middle yourself, and let them find their own way back to it.

Start with your own balance, since a group finds its balance one person at a time. Change one habit at a time, slowly. Say out loud what is hidden, so nothing sits unspoken between you. In time the balance stops being work, and you melt into it.

iching.trigram_combination: Fire over Wind is the hexagram of turning what you were given into what feeds people. Wind, which here is also wood, is the patience in you that keeps feeding a task a little at a time. Fire is the clear sight in you that knows when a thing is ready. The seeing sits above the feeding because you can only judge what has been given time to cook. This hexagram has long been read as a bronze pot on three legs over a fire. Whatever raw thing you put in, you take out as food for a whole house. It is also read as the new order set up once an old one has fallen, which is harder than pulling the old one down. Whatever you inherit feeds people only once you have cooked it through.
iching.reading:
An old way of doing things has ended, and something new has to be set up in its place. Setting it up is harder than pulling the old one down. What you have been handed is raw, and it has to be cooked before it can feed anyone. Feed what is best in the people around you first, since the new grows out of them.

Clean the pot before you cook, because whatever has gone stale from before will spoil what is new. Take your right place and stand in it, and your life sets firm the way bronze sets in a mould. Go gently, and your ears grow clear and your eyes sharp. Watch the heat to the end, since one slip near the finish can lose the whole meal.

Your ears and eyes do the work now. The ears hear what the people at your table need, and the eyes see when the food is ready. Stand the way the pot stands over the fire, steady on three legs while the heat does its work.
judgement_lines: The cauldron. Supreme good fortune. Success.
Fire on wood is cooking: the wise cooked to make an offering to heaven, and cooked again to feed the worthy.
Through gentleness the ears grow clear and the eyes sharp. The soft rises to the centre, and the firm answers it.
image_lines: Fire over wood: that is the picture of the cauldron.
So the wise make their place right, and their fate sets firm.

upper_trigram.name: Fire (Li)
upper_trigram.nature: Glowing light spreading in all directions. The power of consciousness. Magical fire-bird. The middle daughter.

lower_trigram.name: Wind (Sun)
lower_trigram.nature: Subtly penetrating. Mild, nourishing. Wood and wind. The eldest daughter.

lines.image: the pot tipped over on its feet, and the stale poured out.
lines.reading: The pot is tipped over, and what had gone stale falls out. That is the good in it. Before you add anything new, clear out the old, so the pot can stand level again. If the vessel you have will not hold the new thing, take another, even a humbler one. No one will blame you for it.

lines.image: food in the pot, and one who will not come to eat.
lines.reading: The pot is full, and the one who is set against you cannot come near to eat. Their objection cannot reach you now. It may be a part of you, your head refusing what your gut knows. Be careful where you go, because the tension is still there. For now, the meal is good.

lines.image: the handles changed, the pot stuck fast, and the pheasant's fat uneaten.
lines.reading: The pot's handles are gone, so it cannot be lifted, and the rich meal inside goes uneaten. You held firm and would not give an inch, so the work stopped. Regret comes like rain, and the rain clears it. Listen to what others are saying, because the way forward is in their words, and this ends well.

lines.image: the legs broken, and the prince's meal on the floor.
lines.reading: The legs break under a pot too full, and the prince's meal spills over his robes. You took on more than your strength could carry and leaned on your position instead. Stop, and put right what was spilled. Then look again at the people you relied on before you carry anything else.

lines.image: yellow ears on the pot, and rings of gold to carry it.
lines.reading: The pot has yellow ears and gold rings to lift it by. Yellow is the colour of the middle, so you are in the right place. The ears are hollow and the rings are solid, so the soft and the firm in you carry the weight together. Keep your attention on one thing. Stay humble, since everyone answers to someone above them.

lines.image: a handle of jade.
lines.reading: The handle is jade, as hard as metal with a softness of its own, and no fire can melt it. The cooking is done, and the firm and the soft in you have become one. Everything you do now helps. Lift the pot and share what is in it.

gene_keys.shadow:
Something in you was miscopied before you were born, and it sounds like a string that rasps instead of holding its note. It is not your fault, and it is yours anyway. You meet it first in the world, in crooked dealing and in people who answer to nobody. It shows up out there because it is wound around the inside of you. Nobody clears it from the world without first clearing it in themselves.

The fault stays alive because you give up on it. No one else bothers, you tell yourself, so why should you. You have tried and prayed, and it is still there. Or you go the other way: one bad day and you tighten up and try too hard, which only makes it worse. You are like a child learning an instrument, and the sound is painful at first. Then, one small tune at a time, your notes start to hold.
gene_keys.repressive: The whole weight of the world sits on this person. They feel they must protect everyone close to them, so they put their dreams away. Those dreams were where their creativity lived. Only when they face the fear underneath does it find a way back out.
gene_keys.reactive: Here the fear comes out as anger, aimed at those above or those below. This person feels answerable to no one for what their actions do to others. They chase gain and standing. They are as trapped by the order they exploit as the people they exploit.
gene_keys.gift:
Tuned by ear, the same string in you holds its note. You find the middle by being thrown off it. Pour yourself in too hard and you tense up. Hold back and only watch, and you give up. Each extreme hurts, and the hurt sends you back to the centre.

Then you can walk into a room where everything has gone to pieces and feel what is missing. You put the parts back together, and harmony is possible again. A parent's unlived life shapes a child more than anything else, and what parents hide from each other comes out in their children. So balance cannot be imposed on anyone. Each person has to be trusted with their own.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Your note joins a music that was already playing. Balance can be lost, and this harmony cannot. Nobody makes it, and all you can do is enter it. First every sense of being separate falls away. Then your body becomes a chamber that rings, and in the end the chamber itself dissolves.

Every life is a note in one piece of music, and the music grows sweeter. It plays under your days whether you hear it or not. When one person arrives here, what was hidden comes to light around them, and the whole group shifts. You are the instrument, and the music plays through you.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy keeps things in balance, and it can hold on so tightly that nothing new gets in. Messengers of the Infinite holds what it lacks: the fresh start that brings new ingredients, and the mess that comes with them. Balance with nothing new in it goes stale, and something new with no balance falls apart. Open it when everything is steady and nothing is growing.

human_design.gate:
Gate 50 presses you to look after your people. You feel responsible for whether they are well, fed in body and in spirit, and for the values that hold them together. It is a mother's drive, whoever carries it. Under it runs a fear of not caring enough, of letting them down. The fear makes you take on more than is yours, until you are carrying people who could walk.

From the outside this can look like meddling, or like rules so strict that no one may make their own mistakes. Care driven by guilt empties the one who gives it. Look after yourself first, since that is the only way there is anything left to give. Trusting the people you love to look after themselves is its own kind of care.
human_design.centre:
The Spleen Center is the part of you that keeps you safe and well. It is the oldest kind of awareness you have. It speaks in the moment, through your senses, and it keeps time by meeting each moment fresh. It also holds the fears that once kept people alive, and this gate's fear is of failing the people in your care. Most of these fears are ropes taken for snakes. See the fear for what it is, thank it, and go on. When this centre is at ease, you have the lightness of a body that feels safe.

About fifty-five people in a hundred have this centre defined. Their bodies give off a glow that says all is well, and less settled people like to stand near it. Their fears go out into the room with the same strength, so they are worth clearing. In the other forty-five it is open. They pick up the state of whoever is nearby and can mistake another person's poor health for their own. Time slips away from them. At their best they have a fine sense of what would be good for another person.
human_design.channel: Knowing what would nourish people is not yet feeding them. Gate 27, in the Sacral Center low in the belly, brings the energy to do the caring. Together they make the Channel of Preservation, the drive to keep your people well and to pass on what holds them together. It knows what will nourish, in food and in teaching. Not everyone needs your care, and part of this is knowing who does. Gate 27 may be in your own chart or in a person close to you, and the care is complete only when both are present.
