tarot.ring_role: This energy brings a group into balance. It belongs to a family of two, the Ring of the Illuminati. Its theme is people working together as equals, with no one ruling over them. UL 44, Sophia's Orchestra, carries teamwork and the sense of who belongs together. This one carries the balance that lets them work as one.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, each show one side of the balance you keep.

body.physiology:
The spleen holds this energy, and the reason is cooking. It has long been pictured as a pot on a stove, warmed from below, that turns what you eat into blood and strength. Nothing you eat is yours until it has been cooked there. From there the strength goes out to your arms and legs.

The organ itself sits under your left ribs, behind the stomach, and it does not cook. It skims the pot. All of your blood passes through it many times a day, and it takes out the worn cells and anything that should not be there. What goes round stays fit to feed you. For some months before you were born, it was one of the places your blood was made.
body.amino_acid:
Inside every cell of you, a messenger copies the instructions for life. It can misread them, the way fear misreads what people say in a room. This energy has a substance in you, and the substance is glutamic acid. Your body makes it itself. Nearly every other amino acid your body takes apart hands its nitrogen to this one. In your brain it is the messenger that says go, and the one that says stop is made from it in a single step.

Balance starts down at this level, in your cells. A real sense of belonging somewhere can bring it all the way there. The same substance runs through one other energy, the sense of who belongs together, and it ties that sense to your balance. The liquid in each of your cells tunes itself to whatever you line up with. If you live among chaos, chaos is what your body feels like.

relations.unity_line: UL 49 is this card's pair and its inverse at once: the fire that clears the old, where this one cooks the new.

pair.teaching: This energy cooks what it was given until it can feed people, and it runs out when the pot itself has gone bad. Union in the Ashes is where it goes next: the fire that clears an old way out so a new one can start. Open it when no amount of adjusting will set things right. Some things have to end before anything new can be cooked.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy end for end and the cooking becomes a clearing. Union in the Ashes is the same fire seen from the side that throws the old away. Open it when you are keeping something alive that has already gone off.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy keeps things in balance, and it can hold on so tightly that nothing new gets in. Messengers of the Infinite holds what it lacks: the fresh start that brings new ingredients, and the mess that comes with them. Balance with nothing new in it goes stale, and something new with no balance falls apart. Open it when everything is steady and nothing is growing.

codon_ring.name: Codon Ring of Illuminati
codon_ring.teaching: This energy brings a group into balance. It belongs to a family of two, the Ring of the Illuminati. Its theme is people working together as equals, with no one ruling over them. UL 44, Sophia's Orchestra, carries teamwork and the sense of who belongs together. This one carries the balance that lets them work as one.

tarot.teaching: Five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, each show one side of the balance you keep.

sky.teaching: the scales, the sign of the season when day and night are equal, which is the balance you keep among people.

immortals.teaching: Fire above carries Lu Dong Bin, the scholar whose sword cuts through ignorance, the way your clear sight cuts through what has gone off. Wind below carries He Xian Gu, the one woman among the eight, who ate powdered stone and lived on air. One cuts away what is false in you, and the other keeps what is left clean. Between them the fire burns steady.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the stick that keeps an ox on its path with a light touch, the small correction that brings a group back to the middle.

cards.essence: Initiative is alive in you as the nerve to go first, onto a path nobody has walked. When something you did not see coming shakes your day, you are the one who moves. You feel it as a jolt of charge, and your body is ready before your mind has caught up.

glance.reading:
Initiative is alive in you as the nerve to go first, onto a path nobody has walked. When something you did not see coming shakes your day, you are the one who moves. You feel it as a jolt of charge, and your body is ready before your mind has caught up.

At times that charge turns to nerves, and you brace for the next blow. Bracing only makes the blow land harder. Let the fright come, give it room, and it passes through you.

Take the step that is yours, without waiting for it to feel safe. The more you believe in yourself and act on it, the more life comes to meet you. Each shock you take this way leaves you steadier on your feet. Others see it and find the nerve to go their own way.

iching.trigram_combination: Thunder over Thunder is the hexagram of a shock that shakes you, and what you do with it. Thunder is the jolt in you that makes you start at a sudden crash. Here it comes a second time, before the first has died away. You can shrug off one jolt, and the second reaches all the way down. This hexagram has long been read as a person in a temple who spills no wine from the ladle when the thunder breaks. Your hand stays on the work in front of you while the noise goes past. Fear comes first, then laughter, once you see you are still standing. You can be frightened and still keep hold of what is yours to carry.
iching.reading:
Something you did not see coming has happened, and it has shaken the ground you stood on. At first there is fear, then laughter once you see you are still here. Everyone near you felt it too. Most people jump and then forget it. They go back to talking as before and learn nothing.

This time asks you to use the fright. You cannot choose what strikes, and you can choose how you answer it. Let the shaking make you look at your life, then set in order what it shows you. The care that fear puts in you is where the good fortune comes from. Keep to the calm at the centre of the storm, and go on with the work that is yours. Whatever you lose now comes back to you in time.

Your feet do the work now. Put your weight down through both of them and feel the ground still there.
judgement_lines: Shock brings success. Shock comes, and there is alarm. Then laughing words.
The shock frightens for a hundred miles, and the ladle of wine is not spilled.
image_lines: Thunder repeated: the image of shock.
So the wise, in fear and trembling, set their life in order and look at themselves.

upper_trigram.name: Thunder (Chen)
upper_trigram.nature: Arousing power emerging from the depth of the earth. Excite, influence, move, affect. The eldest son.

lower_trigram.name: Thunder (Chen)
lower_trigram.nature: Arousing power emerging from the depth of the earth. Excite, influence, move, affect. The eldest son.

lines.image: the shock comes, alarm, then laughing words.
lines.reading: The shock comes, and you look around in fright. A moment later you are laughing and talking again. Fear first and ease after is the right order. Being careful at the start is what lets you be glad at the end. Take the fright as a warning, and keep what it taught you.

lines.image: treasures lost, the nine hills climbed, and back in seven days.
lines.reading: The shock comes with real danger, and you lose something you valued. Climb to high ground instead of chasing it. From up there you can see the whole of what happened. Plan for what you can gain, and let the loss be a loss for now. In seven days, once this has passed, what was yours comes back.

lines.image: distraught in the shock, and moved to act by it.
lines.reading: The shock has left you shaken and unable to think straight, and the sound is already fading. Do not let it fade without moving you. If you cannot find the strength in yourself, borrow it from someone who has it. Act with care while the fright is still in you, and you come to no harm.

lines.image: the shock sunk in the mud.
lines.reading: The shock lands in mud and goes no further. There is force in it, and with no firm ground under it the force comes to nothing. You have the strength and have let it sink into habit and bad company. Pull your feet out, and move again against the odds.

lines.image: the shock going and coming, and business still to do.
lines.reading: The shock goes and comes back, with danger each way. You lose nothing that matters. Keep to the calm centre and ride it out from there. There is still work in front of you, so stay steady and do it.

lines.image: shock at the top, eyes darting, and the strike landing next door.
lines.reading: At the far end of the shaking you are frightened, and your eyes dart everywhere. Setting out now would go badly. The blow has struck your neighbour, not you, and that is your warning. Take care now, while it is still next door, even if your family talks about it.

gene_keys.shadow:
Life is not in your control, and some part of you never forgets it. Something could happen to you at any moment. You see it happen to others, one house hit while the next is spared, and your body waits for its turn. Trust in life is not a thought or a mood. It is felt in your body, or it is not. Without it you stay jumpy and on edge, waiting for the next crack of thunder.

That restless charge wants a way out. It pushes you to do something, anything, just to feel it go. You may shy away from life, or rush at it. You may need to come first, not to grow but to stand above the others. Underneath all of it is the one shock nobody escapes, your own death. Pushing that thought away is what takes the life out of your days.
gene_keys.repressive: Fear runs this person's life, though they have the strength to get out. Hope drains away a little at a time, and they shut down and turn inward. The real fear is of facing the fear. Faced, it turns out to be empty, and only they can face it.
gene_keys.reactive: The charge goes outward in this person, as rage joined to a sense that nothing matters. This person seeks out danger and stirs up anger in others, with no aim behind it. They cannot help it and do not care. Only something they make, carried through to the end, gives the charge somewhere to go.
gene_keys.gift:
Initiative starts when you stop copying anyone and follow your own lead. There is no net under it. The crowd keeps to what is safe, so it admires this path and fears it at once. Teachers can inspire you, and none of them can tell you where your feet go. Whatever you fear most, you meet on this path, and you get past it.

A shock met with harshness makes you hold on tighter, the way a cold wind makes a man pull his coat close. You lean into it and give it room instead, the way the sun gets the coat off. The charge that rattled you becomes the push to make something new. Life rewards you for it, and sometimes it shocks you with good fortune.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Awakening comes once, without warning, and it stays. There are only two states, awake and asleep, and anyone who draws a ladder between them is still asleep. No practice brings it, and it has come to kind people and cruel ones alike. It comes to someone so fully themselves that it has no choice. You do not take the leap. The leap takes you.

After it, nothing in you is separate enough for a shock to strike. You become a vessel that only gives, with nothing in the way of life flowing through. That giving is love, though not always the warm kind. The thunder you once feared is now the sound of your own giving.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy goes first onto a path nobody has walked, and it cannot see the way by itself. Flight of the Tao holds what it lacks: the quiet hunch that knows the way, soft as the wind. Your restlessness feeds its unease, and its softness lets you meet a shock without breaking. Open it when you have the nerve to go and no sense of where.

human_design.gate: Gate 51 sits in the Will Center, near your heart, and it is the gate of shock. It presses you to meet a sudden turn and come out of it stronger. It gives you a taste for the unknown and a pull away from what is comfortable, and people feel a charge around you. When it runs well, a shock becomes the start of something, and your sense of purpose holds through the turn. When it runs badly, you chase upheaval for its own sake and jolt people just to jolt them. Or you try to control every outcome, and that drains you.
human_design.centre:
The Will Center is where your sense of what you can do comes from. It is small, and it is the one motor in you that deals with the material world. It holds your worth and your capacity to act.

A little over a third of people have it defined. They can say what they will do and then do it, and they keep their promises. Proving themselves feels like play to them. This centre is built to work and then rest, and pushed on without rest it burns out. The rest have it open. They take in the worth of the people around them and feel it more strongly than those people do. Beside someone sure of themselves they can do anything, then find at home that they cannot. They may spend a life proving their worth, and nothing proves it for good. Their gift is to know what is truly worth something, with nothing of their own to prove.
human_design.channel: On its own, this pressure is a jolt with nowhere to go. Gate 25 sits in the Identity Center, and its love of spirit reaches every living thing alike. Together they make the Channel of Initiation, whose force does not come from wanting to do something. It lets you come through wild upheaval, and it can shock other people into their hearts. Shaken out of the world you knew, you land somewhere new. Gate 25 may be in you or in a person close by, and the channel runs only when both are present.

tarot.ring_role: This energy steps off the known path, a step every human life has to take. It belongs to a family of six, the Ring of Humanity, whose theme is the whole human story. UL 25, The Mysteries Play, carries the wound you start from. UL 38, Inner Light Symphony, carries your fight with your own shadows. UL 17, Pearl of Christos, carries the limits of your mind. UL 21, Beyond Binary, carries your letting go of control. UL 10, Internal Treasure, carries finding your true self. This one carries your waking up.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Its family and its doubled trigram bring three of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, to this one.

body.physiology:
Decision is the reason this energy is given to your gallbladder. It is a small bag tucked under the right side of your liver, and it makes nothing of its own. Between meals it holds what your liver makes and draws the water out, until the store is five to ten times as strong. When a meal reaches your gut, it gets one signal. It squeezes, empties within the hour, and goes still again. You know this from inside: the long hours of holding before a leap, then the moment you go. When you find the gall to do a bold thing, you are naming this organ.

Find the place under your right ribs where the flat muscle of your belly meets them. The tip of your gallbladder lies just beneath, too soft to feel. Rest your hand there, on the part of you that waits and then goes all at once.
body.amino_acid:
At some point in your life you leave the crowd and head off alone into the wild country of your own heart. That step off the known path has a substance in you, and it is arginine. Your body builds it into every protein you have. Your body makes it for itself, and more comes in with eggs, beans or a handful of seeds. The substance in you was first found in seedlings, as a salt of silver, and is named for silver.

You share this substance with five other energies, and all six are about being human. What wakes you also wakes the people close to you, one family after another, until everyone has heard it.

relations.unity_line: UL 52 is this card's pair and its inverse at once: the stillness that follows, where this one is the jolt.

pair.teaching: This energy moves first when a shock comes, and it runs out once the shaking has passed. Timeless Blossom is where it goes next: the stillness at the end of a cycle, which holds until the next one is ready. Open it when the upheaval is over and you do not know what to do. After thunder, the ground goes quiet.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy end for end and the jolt becomes a stop. Timeless Blossom is the same moment seen from the side that keeps still. Open it when you have moved too fast and need to stay where you are.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy goes first onto a path nobody has walked, and it cannot see the way by itself. Flight of the Tao holds what it lacks: the quiet hunch that knows the way, soft as the wind. Your restlessness feeds its unease, and its softness lets you meet a shock without breaking. Open it when you have the nerve to go and no sense of where.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Humanity
codon_ring.teaching: This energy steps off the known path, a step every human life has to take. It belongs to a family of six, the Ring of Humanity, whose theme is the whole human story. UL 25, The Mysteries Play, carries the wound you start from. UL 38, Inner Light Symphony, carries your fight with your own shadows. UL 17, Pearl of Christos, carries the limits of your mind. UL 21, Beyond Binary, carries your letting go of control. UL 10, Internal Treasure, carries finding your true self. This one carries your waking up.

tarot.teaching: Its family and its doubled trigram bring three of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, to this one.

sky.teaching: the sign of home and the shell around it, which a shock breaks open so you can step out.

immortals.teaching: Thunder above and below carries one figure, Cao Guo Jiu. A relative of the emperor, he gave away his wealth and rank for a life in the mountains. When you go first, you leave the safety you were born into, as he did.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the fence around a field, the known ground you step past when you go first.

cards.essence: At the end of a cycle, stillness settles in you. Your breath drops low into your belly, and your weight rests on whatever holds you. Nothing in you is in a hurry. You see your life in seasons rather than days, and the people near you slow down without being asked.

glance.reading:
At the end of a cycle, stillness settles in you. Your breath drops low into your belly, and your weight rests on whatever holds you. Nothing in you is in a hurry. You see your life in seasons rather than days, and the people near you slow down without being asked.

Some days the pause feels like being stuck, and on others you cannot sit still at all. Both come when your breath has risen high into your chest. Let it fall back down to the floor of your body, and the pause becomes rest again.

Once you are calm, the way forward is plain. While you rest, the next thing is already forming out of sight, the way buds form on a branch before a single blossom shows. It opens in its own time, and you are ready when it does.

iching.trigram_combination: Mountain over Mountain is the hexagram of knowing when to stop. Mountain is the part of you that can stop and stay stopped. Here it stands a second time, so you are still on the inside as well as the outside. It sits on itself because a thing that has gone as far as it can go has nowhere left to go but rest. This hexagram has long been read as a back kept still. Your eyes, hands and mouth all reach for something, and your back only holds you straight. You stop when it is time to stop, and move when it is time to move.
iching.reading:
Whatever you are asking about has gone as far as it can go for now. A cycle has closed, and before the next one opens there is time to stop and see where you stand. Your eyes reach for what they see and your hands for what they can hold. Your back reaches for nothing; it stands straight and carries you. Rest your attention there, and the reaching lets go of you. You can be among people and still be alone, doing what is right whether anyone is watching or not.

Stop at the point where it is right to stop. Stop when it is time to stop, move when it is time to move, and nothing is missed. When you are lost, do not wander. Stay where you are, and a path clears. Once you have stopped, you can see what is coming, which you cannot see while you are still moving. Watch for a stop held with a clenched jaw, in anger or in pride. That is stubbornness, and it only looks like stillness.

Sit straight and let your weight go down. Keep your thoughts on where you are and on what is yours to do.
judgement_lines: Keep still at the back, and the body drops out of mind.
Walk your own courtyard and see no one there.
No fault.
Stop when it is the season for stopping, move when it is the season for moving, and the way stays bright.
image_lines: Mountains stand joined, one beside the other.
Thought keeps to the place it stands in and does not go out past it.

upper_trigram.name: Mountain (Ken)
upper_trigram.nature: Limit, frontier, stillness. Solid, steady, unshakable. The youngest son.

lower_trigram.name: Mountain (Ken)
lower_trigram.nature: Limit, frontier, stillness. Solid, steady, unshakable. The youngest son.

lines.image: toes held still before the first step.
lines.reading: Your toes are still, before the first step, and nothing has gone wrong yet. This is the easiest stop there is, made before there is anything to undo. You are easily led at this point, so keep to it every day it is asked of you. Stop at the start, and stay stopped.

lines.image: the calves held still, the heart not glad.
lines.reading: Your calves are still, while the one you follow walks on out of reach. Calves go where the feet go and cannot decide for themselves. You were halted by someone who would not turn back to listen, and your heart is not glad. A stop you did not choose is not peace. Do not call being left behind stillness.

lines.image: the waist locked, the spine wrenched, the heart smoking.
lines.reading: Your waist is locked, the one place in you built to bend. The top of you and the bottom no longer work together. What cannot go down rises into your chest as a burning wish to win and be done. You are forcing a stop you do not mean. Loosen, and let the stop go lower than the waist.

lines.image: the trunk held still, the self governed.
lines.reading: Your trunk is still, the whole middle of you at rest, and no harm comes of it. You look after what is yours and push none of it onto anyone else. Most wrong turns start in the body, and stopped there they go no further. Govern yourself, and leave the judging of others alone.

lines.image: the jaws at rest, the words in order.
lines.reading: Your jaw is still, so your mouth no longer opens at random. What you say now comes in order, weighed before it leaves you, and old regrets fade. Keeping quiet about what matters most to you is the hardest silence there is. Speak when your words are in order, and not before.

lines.image: stillness kept generously, through to the end.
lines.reading: You are still inside and out, and nothing is forced down. The wish for a quick finish has gone, and what is left is generous and thorough. You finish what you began, steady and lasting. Keep still like this to the end, and good fortune comes.

gene_keys.shadow:
The pressure you live under is not only yours. Everyone alive puts it into the air, and in a city you cannot get away from it, even alone at home. The first thing it does is lift your breath. Somewhere in growing up your breath left your belly for the top of your chest, and the day runs short from there. Time changes with it. It goes too fast or too slow, and you are always behind.

You hand the trouble to your mind, and your mind sets out to fix it. The thinking is the pressure, so every plan to end it feeds it. Nobody enjoys the rush, but most of us get used to it, and then we need it. Your body sounds an alarm when your rhythm falls out of step with the world around you. Most people hear it so often that it sounds like silence. The alarm is on your side. It asks you to stop, breathe low and come back to the base of yourself.
gene_keys.repressive: One kind of person folds under the pressure. A heavy, stuck feeling settles into the body and stays, until getting off the ground seems impossible. Energy drains away, and hope goes with it. What lifts them is being of use to someone else, and slowly their life comes back.
gene_keys.reactive: The other kind cannot sit still. They fill every hour to stay ahead of the fear, and their frustration lands on whoever is closest. It looks like drive. Over the years it burns them out, until they stop and look at the fear underneath.
gene_keys.gift:
Everything alive has its own speed, and you know this in your body. A yew seed and a sunflower seed are about the same size. The sunflower is full grown within a few months. The yew may take ten years to reach that height, then live for thousands. The bigger the thing you are growing, the slower it starts, and hurrying it disturbs the ground it was sown in.

What you begin from fear carries the fear into everything that grows from it. What you begin with a clear wish to be of use already holds all it will need. It even draws the right people at the right time. Your part is to leave it alone while it grows. Someone who lives like this steadies everyone around them, the way an anchor lets a boat rest and find where it is. One question sets your pace: how can I be of the greatest use?
gene_keys.siddhi:
Slow yourself down far enough and everything in you stops. Speed up far enough and it all runs together, which is also a stop. Stillness waits at both ends, and it is full of life. Your body is rebuilt every hour you are alive, and underneath all that building nothing moves.

Gaps open between your thoughts. A feeling rises so slowly you could turn it over in your hands before it breaks the surface. It spreads through you like a coin dropped in a pond, then settles back into the quiet. You watch the drama of your life from a little way off. Near you, other people's thoughts go quiet and time seems to slow. Whatever moves in you now moves only to meet the same stillness in someone else.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy slows you down until you have time. Rhythm of Life holds what it lacks: joy, the feeling of being alive that grows when it is shared. At their lowest the two run together as never having enough time and never being quite satisfied, and between them they wear the body down. Open it when your calm has gone flat. Stillness gives joy room, and joy keeps the stillness alive.

human_design.gate: Gate 52 is a pressure low in your body to find the one thing worth your focus. It is a charge held at the base of your trunk, strong enough to drive a whole life, waiting to be aimed. Think of a bow drawn back with no target yet. While you wait, you can see the whole of what needs to happen and the order it needs to happen in. So much at once can freeze you, or send the charge into whatever is nearest. When you find the thing, you can work at it for hours and forget the room around you. The hard part then is stopping. From outside, the waiting can look slow and the focus can look like not caring. You are holding still until you know where to aim, then giving that one thing all you have.
human_design.centre:
The Root Center sits at the base of your trunk and presses you to act. It works like a motor that pulses on and off. When it is on, you can get a great deal done. When it is off, you cannot make yourself do something you know you need to do. It is easy then to think something is wrong with you, when you are only waiting on the timing.

About six people in ten have this centre defined. Pressure is familiar to them, often so familiar they do not notice it, and they can put it to work. The other four in ten have it open. They take in the pressure of the people around them and feel it louder than it is. They try to get rid of it by doing. The kitchen needs cleaning, so they clean it, and the next task is already waiting. Or it all becomes too much and they do nothing. Their gift is knowing which pressures are theirs to answer.
human_design.channel: Gate 9, in the Sacral Center low in your belly, is the part of you that picks one thing to focus on. Together the two make the Channel of Concentration, which turns the pressure from the base into steady focus on one task at a time. That focus can hold for hours, and it can tip into obsession. Until Gate 9 has chosen, the pressure has nowhere to go, and you feel rattled and uneasy. Gate 9 may be in you or in a person close by.

tarot.ring_role: This energy holds pressure steady, and it belongs to the Ring of Seeking, a family of six that each press you to look for more. Ordinary Valiance (UL 15) draws people to you. Nobel Spark (UL 39) stirs you to act. Creation Oscillation (UL 53) makes you grow, Everlasting Bounty (UL 54) makes you rise, and Rhythm of Life (UL 58) makes you feel alive. This one keeps all of that in check, so your search lasts long enough to find something.
tarot.tarot_resonance: The Hermit comes to you three times here, through the ring and both trigrams, as the seeker who stops to see.

body.physiology:
This energy lives at the floor of your body, in the perineum, and the reason is the breath. The perineum is the small floor of muscle between your legs. Each breath you take rises from it and returns to it, and nothing in you is lower. At the other end of your spine is the soft spot on the crown of your head, and the two hold the spine between them. When your breath reaches the floor, you are at rest, and everything above it settles. When it stops short, high in your chest, you are already hurrying.

Sit down and let your weight settle. It rests on two bones, one under each side, with the perineum between them. You sit on either side of it, never on it. Breathe in and it gives a little, with your belly. Breathe out and it lifts. It has moved with every breath since your first. Let your breath go all the way down to it, and you are resting on the part of you that stops.
body.amino_acid:
There is more life in you than you can use at once, and it presses to get out. That pressure has a chemistry in you, and serine is part of it. It is one of the twenty small pieces every protein in you is built from. Your cells hold a protein still or let it go by pinning a small charge onto it. Four times in five, that charge goes onto a serine. You share this chemistry with five other energies.

Under fear your body releases adrenaline, the rush that keeps you moving. You can get so used to the rush that you go looking for it. In deep stillness your body releases other chemicals, ones that quiet your thoughts, so the stillness is in your body before it reaches your mind.

relations.unity_line: Your stillness moves on through these: the shock that ends it, the joy that keeps it alive, and the family of pressures it keeps steady.

pair.teaching: This energy brings a cycle to rest, and a rest held too long goes stale. Unshakable Arrival is where it goes next: the shock that breaks the stillness and sends you first into what nobody has done. Open it when you have rested long enough and something in you is ready to jump. The stillness comes back once the shock has passed.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy over and the stop becomes a start. Unshakable Arrival is the same moment seen from its other end, the jolt that ends a pause. Open it when your rest has turned into waiting for something to happen. You never get one without the other.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy slows you down until you have time. Rhythm of Life holds what it lacks: joy, the feeling of being alive that grows when it is shared. At their lowest the two run together as never having enough time and never being quite satisfied, and between them they wear the body down. Open it when your calm has gone flat. Stillness gives joy room, and joy keeps the stillness alive.

codon_ring.name: Codon Ring of Seeking
codon_ring.teaching: This energy holds pressure steady, and it belongs to the Ring of Seeking, a family of six that each press you to look for more. Ordinary Valiance (UL 15) draws people to you. Nobel Spark (UL 39) stirs you to act. Creation Oscillation (UL 53) makes you grow, Everlasting Bounty (UL 54) makes you rise, and Rhythm of Life (UL 58) makes you feel alive. This one keeps all of that in check, so your search lasts long enough to find something.

tarot.teaching: The Hermit comes to you three times here, through the ring and both trigrams, as the seeker who stops to see.

sky.teaching: the earth sign that sorts and waits for the harvest, and for you it means patience with what is still ripening.

immortals.teaching: Mountain above and below carries one immortal, Zhang Guo Lao, the oldest of the eight. He rode his donkey facing backward, and at night he folded it away like paper. For you he means you can stop completely and lose nothing, because what you put away comes back when you need it.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the smallest letter, a single point, and for you it means the small still place every next move starts from.

cards.essence: At the start of something new, the urge to begin rises low in your body. You feel more alive in that first push than at any other time. This urge comes and goes in pulses, and each time it returns a new start is ready in you.

glance.reading:
At the start of something new, the urge to begin rises low in your body. You feel more alive in that first push than at any other time. This urge comes and goes in pulses, and each time it returns a new start is ready in you.

Some days the urge is gone, and you cannot make yourself start. Nothing is wrong with you, since the pulse has only gone quiet. The harm comes from starting early out of fear of being late.

So ask what a new start is really made of, because it goes on the way it began. Start only when every part of you says yes, then slow down and let the thing grow. Someone else may carry it to the end, and it is still yours. Year by year your life outgrows its old shape, and each start reaches wider than the last.

iching.trigram_combination: Wind over Mountain is the hexagram of growth that takes years. Wind is the part of you that goes on, a little further every day, without force. Mountain is the stillness in you that stays put and keeps what it has. The going on sits above the stillness because only what is rooted can keep growing. This hexagram has long been read as a tree on a mountain. A tree up there grows slowly, and its roots matter more than its height. Its six lines follow a wild goose that lands by stages, the way you arrive in anything new. What you build slowly is what lasts.
iching.reading:
Something has begun that will take years, and the years are part of it. What comes quickly leaves the same way, and what grows by degrees stays. Others will seem to move faster. Let them, because your success will come in time and it will last longer than theirs.

Be firm and be slow. Take one small, honest step and then the next, the way a good marriage is made. Play to the nature you have rather than the one you wish you had. When people are coarse with you, answer with dignity, because how you carry yourself is part of what you are building.

The thighs do this work in the body, the long muscles that carry you uphill one step at a time. They keep a pace the head does not. If you are already at the top in your mind, come back to the step you are on.
judgement_lines: Development. The maiden is given in marriage. Good fortune.
It goes well for the one who holds firm and keeps to what is right.
image_lines: On the mountain, a tree: that is Development.
So the wise stay in dignity and worth, which betters the ways of the people around them.

upper_trigram.name: Wind (Sun)
upper_trigram.nature: Subtly penetrating. Mild, nourishing. Wood and wind. The eldest daughter.

lower_trigram.name: Mountain (Ken)
lower_trigram.nature: Limit, frontier, stillness. Solid, steady, unshakable. The youngest son.

lines.image: the wild goose comes down to the shore; the young one in danger, and there is talk.
lines.reading: The goose lands on the shore, out of the order it kept in the air. You are young in this, with nobody behind you, and people are talking. It is no fault. Go slowly, put your roots down first, then ask those who could help you for what you need. The talk passes, and the roots stay.

lines.image: the goose on the great rock, eating and drinking at its ease.
lines.reading: The goose rests on a great rock, eating and drinking at its ease. You have solid ground under you now, and the first good of it is coming in. You earned this rest, and it is not idle. Share it with the people who doubted you, since you will need their trust further up. Rest here, then go on.

lines.image: the goose strays onto the high plateau; the husband goes out and does not return, the wife carries a child and does not bring it forth.
lines.reading: The goose strays onto a high, dry plateau, far from water. You climbed too high too fast. What you set out on does not come home, and what you were carrying does not come to term. This is no time to conquer or to start anything new. Stay with your own people and guard what you have.

lines.image: the goose in the trees, and perhaps a flat branch to rest on.
lines.reading: The goose is in the trees, where a webbed foot cannot grip, and still it may find a flat branch. You are out of your element, and it does you no harm. Take the branch that will hold you rather than the higher one. Then wait quietly for the next firm step.

lines.image: the goose on the high summit; for three years the woman has no child, and in the end nothing can stop her.
lines.reading: The goose reaches the summit, alone and in sight of everyone. For three years nothing you hoped for comes, and some people below would be glad to see you fail. Keep to the middle. What was held back was only waiting. In the end what you wanted comes, and it comes to stay.

lines.image: the goose risen past the summit into the heights, its feathers kept for the sacred dance.
lines.reading: The goose flies past the summit, out of sight, and its feathers are kept for the dance. There is no further to climb. The order you kept the whole way up is what you leave behind. Others will use it for their own steps. Rest now, and teach the people who come after you.

gene_keys.shadow:
Looking outside for the answer to a problem that can only be solved inside is where this energy starts. The cause seems to lie with the boss or the town. So you try to fix it out there, where the fix never holds. Under it runs a restlessness that says the next thing will be the one. A life can be spent on the next thing, always one step short. Nothing outside has ever given anyone the fulfilment it promised. Most people keep looking until a book, a teacher or a loss turns them round.

Flowers open at different times of year. Snowdrops come up through the snow, while others wait for autumn and are just as beautiful. People ripen at different times too, and nobody is behind. Under all of it lies a fear of not existing, rooted in you like a weed. The grace here is seeing how much of what you do grows from that fear. Once you see it, your heart begins to trust life as it is.
gene_keys.repressive: Held down, the energy to begin new things turns a person solemn. They stay fixed on one activity their whole life, because anything new feels like a threat. A deep sadness sits under it, as if they might cave in. It takes great pressure to be that serious, and the pressure is fear.
gene_keys.reactive: Let out, the same energy never sits still long enough to grow. This person starts one thing after another and follows none through, because staying would mean facing themselves. Their life looks exciting from outside and has no depth. Their fear comes out as anger, and the anger they meet gives them reason to leave.
gene_keys.gift:
Maturing feels like slowing down. A mature river is wider and slower than the stream it was. When your breath drops deeper, life seems to move in slow motion while your seeing grows sharper. The restless drive that chased the next thing turns round to face what it was running from. It uses your hardest times as fuel.

What grows then is your whole life at once. Your work keeps outgrowing its shape, the way life outgrows every shape it takes. Awareness, love and making grow together, since your life is one thing and not a set of rooms. This growth comes without effort. It brings calm instead of excitement, and perspective instead of ambition. The way in is to give way, to let life carry you and drop your ideas of who you are. Life turns out simpler than you thought.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Beyond plenty there is a place where nothing is counted. It is neither plenty nor lack, but the source both come from. The seeking of a whole life ends here, when you find that nothing is missing. Life is endless beginnings with no endings, and you watch it with no stake in how it turns out. The excitement is gone, and so is the weight.

From here the rush of the world is a game in time. Run in it and you feel it slow around you. The fruit that was ripening drops from the branch on its own. All that remains to learn is the art of letting go.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy begins, and on its own it would keep beginning. Everlasting Bounty holds what it lacks: the ambition that pushes one thing all the way up. Together they are two of the most driven energies there are, and they drive a person either mad or to great wisdom. Open it when you keep starting and nothing climbs.

human_design.gate:
Gate 53 is the pressure to start something new, felt low in the body. It gives a new thing its first push, before anyone has agreed it should exist. You feel more alive at that point than at any other. Your part is to strike the match, and someone else may tend the fire. You do not have to carry every fire to its end.

Under pressure, the urge rushes to start out of fear of being late. It then burns out when the thing does not come as hoped. After enough of that, you may hesitate before starting anything at all. It works best when you start only once every part of you agrees, then let go of how it turns out. Value what you started, even when someone else finishes it.
human_design.centre:
The Root Center sits at the base of your trunk and is one of four places in you that make energy. What it makes is the push to move, a raw drive that runs on stress. Its one law is timing. The drive pulses on and off, like the spark that fires an engine. When it is off, you cannot make yourself do what you know needs doing. The danger then is deciding something is wrong with you.

About six people in ten have this centre defined. The drive is their own, and they can bear more pressure than others would believe. The other four in ten have it open. They take in the pressure of the people around them and feel it louder. They clean the kitchen to get rid of it, and the next task is waiting before they finish. Most of that pressure belongs to someone else. Their wisdom is knowing which of it is.
human_design.channel: A start is only half a cycle. Gate 42, in the lower belly, is the drive to stay with a thing until it is done. Together they make the Channel of Maturation, a life with clear beginnings, middles and endings. One cycle has to be finished before the next can start. Gate 42 may be in you or in a person close by, and a start matures only when both are present.

tarot.ring_role: This energy pushes outward, and every push is part of a search. It belongs to a family of six, the Ring of Seeking, and each member is a pressure that sends you looking. UL 15, Ordinary Valiance, is the pull you have on people. UL 39, Nobel Spark, is the push that stirs people awake. UL 52, Timeless Blossom, is your power to hold still. UL 54, Everlasting Bounty, is your wish to rise. UL 58, Rhythm of Life, is your joy in being alive. This one is your life outgrowing its shape.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Four of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, show how this energy moves in you.

body.physiology:
Growing up is the reason this energy is given to the adrenals. These two small glands grow up in stages, to a clock nobody sets. You were born with them far too big, each a third the size of the kidney it sits on. In your first weeks they lost a third of themselves, as the part built for life in the womb died away. By two they were back to their birth weight, and they reached full size around your puberty.

You can check this by memory rather than by touch. At about seven the glands began a new work, and the first sign was that your sweat changed. Most people remember the year. Growing up had started, before you knew it. The glands sit high at the back under your lowest ribs, each the size of the top joint of your thumb. They cannot be felt.
body.amino_acid:
The pressure in you to begin has a chemistry, and one substance in it is serine. Every protein in you is built from twenty pieces, and serine is one of them. It sits in the outer skin of every cell you have and in the sheath around each nerve. At its lowest, this pressure comes out as stress and a wish to be rich. What you build then is a stockpile, held out of fear.

The same pressure shows you what your wanting, your greed and your fear are made of. In time it teaches you that what you were seeking is already in you. Slowed down, with your breath deeper, it becomes a flow that widens and narrows with its seasons. You share this chemistry with five other energies.

relations.unity_line: UL 54 is this card's pair, its inverse and its partner at once: where you start something, it is the drive that carries it higher.

pair.teaching: This energy starts new things, and it runs out once the start is made. Everlasting Bounty is where it goes next: the drive to rise, which carries what was started up through the world. Open it when your beginning has taken root and needs to climb. A start grows only when something carries it higher.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy end for end and the slow courtship becomes the marriage itself. Everlasting Bounty is what a union needs once it has begun, the conduct that lets it last. Open it when the slow start is over and you have to live inside what you began.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy begins, and on its own it would keep beginning. Everlasting Bounty holds what it lacks: the ambition that pushes one thing all the way up. Together they are two of the most driven energies there are, and they drive a person either mad or to great wisdom. Open it when you keep starting and nothing climbs.

codon_ring.name: Codon Ring of Seeking
codon_ring.teaching: This energy pushes outward, and every push is part of a search. It belongs to a family of six, the Ring of Seeking, and each member is a pressure that sends you looking. UL 15, Ordinary Valiance, is the pull you have on people. UL 39, Nobel Spark, is the push that stirs people awake. UL 52, Timeless Blossom, is your power to hold still. UL 54, Everlasting Bounty, is your wish to rise. UL 58, Rhythm of Life, is your joy in being alive. This one is your life outgrowing its shape.

tarot.teaching: Four of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, show how this energy moves in you.

sky.teaching: the sign of careful work, where a thing is tended until it is ripe.

immortals.teaching: Wind above carries He Xian Gu, the shaman among the eight, who holds a lotus. Mountain below carries Zhang Guo Lao, the alchemist, who carries a drum. The lotus is the growth in you that opens slowly. The alchemist is the part of you that turns one thing into another.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the smallest letter, which every other letter starts from, the hand that begins a thing.

cards.essence: Ambition lives in you as the wish to rise. You feel it most when you start low, in a place where others got there first. Carried with trust, it settles a room before you speak, and people want to work with you.

glance.reading:
Ambition lives in you as the wish to rise. You feel it most when you start low, in a place where others got there first. Carried with trust, it settles a room before you speak, and people want to work with you.

Some days you measure yourself against everyone above you. Then the wish to rise starts to grab, and people feel it and pull back. Notice the grab without fighting it, and the trust comes back.

Know what you are worth, and win your own approval first, so you have no one to convince. Take no shortcuts, because rushing ahead before you are ready costs more than the long way. Keep what you gain moving between people, and the bounty keeps coming back. You rise, and you bring others up with you.

iching.trigram_combination: Thunder over Lake is the hexagram of coming into a place below the one you want. Lake is the delight in you that draws you toward what is above you. Thunder is the part of you that jumps to act. The delight sits underneath because a liking moves you before you have thought it through. This hexagram has long been read as a young woman who marries in as a second wife, below the first. A newcomer in a house already arranged finds a place by how she carries herself. The same holds wherever you work under someone else's rule. Your worth, carried quietly, raises you further than any push.
iching.reading:
You have come into a place below the one you hoped for, and someone else already holds the first seat. A change came that was not in your hands, and you are inside it now. Pushing forward from here goes wrong. Nothing you force will help you.

Know what you are worth, and stand in it without show. When you are sure of your worth you have no need to convince anyone. Do not take the first offer, because waiting can work for you. Rise only by ways you would be glad to be seen using. Whatever happens, keep your composure where others can see it. You begin with no power, and by the end you may be the one holding it. Before you start, decide what you are willing to pay, and pay no more.

Thunder is read as the feet, so this time shows in how you walk into a room. Set each foot down fully, and walk in as someone who came to stay.
judgement_lines: The marrying maiden. To set out brings misfortune.
Nothing is gained by it.
image_lines: Thunder over the lake: the marrying maiden.
So the wise see what passes in the light of how it ends.

upper_trigram.name: Thunder (Chen)
upper_trigram.nature: Arousing power emerging from the depth of the earth. Excite, influence, move, affect. The eldest son.

lower_trigram.name: Lake (Tui)
lower_trigram.nature: Open surface, interaction, pleasure, the mouth, exchange. The youngest daughter.

lines.image: the maiden married as a junior wife; a lame man who can still walk.
lines.reading: You come in as the second wife, lame and still able to walk. The time is wrong for you and your conduct is right, and your conduct is what carries you. Serve well from below, and let the one above you keep the look of authority. Go forward, and it goes well.

lines.image: blind in one eye, and still able to see.
lines.reading: Blind in one eye, you can still see. You do not see the whole of it, and you see enough to act. Keep faith with what you chose, the way someone living alone keeps faith when nobody is watching. Hold to what you know is right, and it holds.

lines.image: the maiden who waited for the high match, and returns to marry as a junior wife.
lines.reading: You wait for a higher match, it never comes, and you go back to take the lower place. What went wrong was reaching for the outside and losing hold of what was inside. Do not try to bend the outcome into what you hoped for. Accept what is here, and it can still end well.

lines.image: the maiden draws out the time; a late marriage comes in its season.
lines.reading: You let the usual time for marrying pass, and you do not hurry. The offer that came was not the right one, and you would rather come late than come wrong. Use the wait to become more fully yourself. Hold out, and the right time comes.

lines.image: the king gives his sister in marriage; her sleeves are plainer than her attendant's; the moon is nearly full.
lines.reading: The king's sister marries below her rank, in sleeves plainer than her maid's. Your worth is in who you are, and it shows without fine clothes. You are the moon a night short of full, still growing. Take the lower place without pride, and good fortune comes.

lines.image: the woman holds a basket with no fruit in it; the man stabs the sheep and no blood flows.
lines.reading: She carries a basket with no fruit in it, and he cuts the sheep and no blood flows. You can go through every step of a thing with nothing inside it. A rise made only for its own sake ends this way. Before you go through with something, look at what is in it.

gene_keys.shadow:
Greed is the wish to rise with the trust taken out. It wants to be at the top and to look it, with the new car and the bigger house. It is greediest in love. You taste love and chase more of it, then blame the other person when it slips away. Fear sits at its root, the old fear of not surviving if you do not climb. So it trades its own honesty in a moment for what it wants, and that is its downfall. It cannot trust its allies either, since they want the same things.

None of this is wrong in itself. It is raw fuel, and a child who says I want that is only being honest. Seen for what it is, greed shows you the empty place it comes from, and that seeing is where it starts to turn.
gene_keys.repressive: Held down, the wanting stops before it starts. They start with fire and then give up. Sure the goal is out of reach, they decide not to begin. The drive goes still, then dark. Some turn from the body too, feeding the spirit while starving the flesh.
gene_keys.reactive: Let loose, the wanting has no brake and feeds itself without ever being full. Owning more becomes their rage made visible. They may grow rich and still lack one thing: the feeling that their life is of use to anyone. With the heart shut, they see people as things to own.
gene_keys.gift:
Aspiration is the same wanting with its trust kept, pointed at something higher. The word shares a root with breathing: you breathe in the raw fuel of the want and refine it. Ambition aims at one goal. Aspiration is wider, a reach toward something higher that you sense before you can name it. It starts with honesty about the wish to rise in you.

Then one question cuts through it: how can I be of use? What you gather goes down to the people below you, the way fruit falls and feeds the roots of its own tree. Your reach turns into hope you carry into rooms where people feel stuck in lives of compromise. When it runs too hot, life brings you back down to earth, and that is part of the gift.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Ascension is the climb that goes on past every ladder. The pressure that once wanted the top now rises through the body itself. It has long been pictured as a serpent coiled at the base of your spine, waking each part of you as it climbs. No step can be skipped. The one person who always makes trouble for you cannot be walked around; it has to pass through your heart. The wanting is never cut out. It is worn smooth, the way wind wears rocks.

The road up takes a warrior's will, and near the top you find you have become all yielding. At the end your body itself changes, in a heat like liquid fire, and then you go still. Keep reaching, and sooner or later you rise.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy brings the drive, and alone it grows the business without growing the person. Creation Oscillation holds what it lacks: the maturity that finishes one cycle before it starts the next. Open it when you keep getting more and it never feels like enough. The drive and the growing need each other.

human_design.gate: Gate 54 sits at the base of your body and presses you to move up in life. It gives you a feel for how the ladder is built. The ladder may be work or rank, or how deep your understanding goes. It does not tell you what is fair in the climbing, so that part is yours to bring. Nothing you have now ever feels quite enough, and other people's places get measured against yours. Left to run, it overworks, treats people as steps and burns out. Lived well, it holds an idea until it is ripe instead of forcing it into shape. It wants what answers something in you, and it can be content and ambitious at once.
human_design.centre:
The Root Center sits at the very bottom of your trunk, and the pressure to act comes from here. It works like a motor with a pulse. It switches on and off in its own time, and when it is off, no dream can be pushed into being.

About six people in ten have this centre defined. They can carry a steady amount of pressure, and other people's hurry does not move them easily. What wears them down is starting something on the wrong day. The other four in ten have it open. They take in the pressure of everyone near them and feel it louder than it is. They rush to clear it, finish one job and find the next already waiting. Their big dreams are still real, and trying to push them into being does not work. Over a life they learn which pressures are theirs.
human_design.channel: Gate 32, in the spleen, is the sense of what will last and what will not. Together with Gate 54 it makes the Channel of Transformation, the drive to improve a life in business or on the way to waking up. Survival drives it underneath. Gate 32 tells the drive which dreams to follow. Off course, the fear of failing turns into overwork, and the success slips away. Gate 32 may be in you or in someone close to you.

tarot.ring_role: This energy is one of six ways people look for something higher. It belongs to the Ring of Seeking. Creation Oscillation (UL 53) climbs beside it. When climbing wears you out, the others show you another way to seek. Timeless Blossom (UL 52) and Rhythm of Life (UL 58) sit still and let the energy move. Ordinary Valiance (UL 15) seeks by serving, and Nobel Spark (UL 39) cuts straight through.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Three of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, arrive through the ring and the two trigrams.

body.physiology:
The tailbone is where your body keeps this energy, and the reason is the base. It is the last bone of your spine, the bottom of the column, curving forward under you. It is what is left of a tail. Five or six weeks after you were conceived you had one, and your body soon took it back. The floor of your body is anchored to it. The two chains of nerves that run down either side of your spine meet in front of it and become one. Every climb up your back starts here.

Sit upright on a hard chair, and your weight rests on the two bones either side of it, with the tailbone hanging free. Slump and lean back, and it takes the weight. It is the bottom of you, and it carries you the moment you stop holding yourself up.
body.amino_acid:
The wish to rise in you has a chemistry, and one substance in it is serine. Every protein in you is built from twenty pieces, and serine is one. One of its carbons goes into the letters of your DNA. It belongs to a pressure you share with five other energies. Pointed outward, that pressure is the urge to gather more. Turned inward, the same pressure becomes the urge for meaning.

That pressure seeks in six ways, and yours is the way of effort. You yoke yourself to a practice or a teacher and climb by degrees, a little finer at each step.

relations.unity_line: UL 53 is this card's pair, its inverse and its partner at once: the slow growth that keeps the climb from outrunning itself.

pair.teaching: This energy wants the top, and it runs out when it tries to skip a step. Creation Oscillation is where it goes next: growth that moves by degrees and lasts. Open it when you are climbing faster than the rest of your life can follow. What rises too fast does not hold.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy over and the one who comes in from below becomes the one who grows into a place by degrees. Creation Oscillation is the same arrival, seen from the slow side. Open it when you want the place before the ground under it is ready.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy brings the drive, and alone it grows the business without growing the person. Creation Oscillation holds what it lacks: the maturity that finishes one cycle before it starts the next. Open it when you keep getting more and it never feels like enough. The drive and the growing need each other.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Seeking
codon_ring.teaching: This energy is one of six ways people look for something higher. It belongs to the Ring of Seeking. Creation Oscillation (UL 53) climbs beside it. When climbing wears you out, the others show you another way to seek. Timeless Blossom (UL 52) and Rhythm of Life (UL 58) sit still and let the energy move. Ordinary Valiance (UL 15) seeks by serving, and Nobel Spark (UL 39) cuts straight through.

tarot.teaching: Three of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, arrive through the ring and the two trigrams.

sky.teaching: the earth sign of careful, patient work, which suits a climb made one honest step at a time.

immortals.teaching: Thunder above carries Cao Guo Jiu, told of as a noble who left the court he was born into. Lake below carries Zhong Li Quan, told of as the eldest of the immortals, whose fan brings the dead back to life. One asks you to rise on your own worth, and the other shows that what seemed finished can live again.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the hand that does the work, so what you rise by is what you do yourself.

cards.essence: Freedom is a fullness you feel from the inside. On a good day your whole life seems to be at its height, and your feelings run as high as they go. You know the lift does not come from the money or the person who walks in, so you have nothing to chase. There is a perfection in you that nothing happening around you can touch. What you make from there comes out of plenty.

glance.reading:
Freedom is a fullness you feel from the inside. On a good day your whole life seems to be at its height, and your feelings run as high as they go. You know the lift does not come from the money or the person who walks in, so you have nothing to chase. There is a perfection in you that nothing happening around you can touch. What you make from there comes out of plenty.

Some days the feeling drops, and you want to blame something outside you for it. Let the low be yours as much as the high was. A low you do not pin on anyone passes on its own and leaves you clear.

You cannot chase freedom head on. It comes sideways, while you live an ordinary life with everything in it. When a time is at its fullest, spend it and share it rather than guard it against the end. Let yourself be as you are, and if that changes, let it. Each time you do, you grow lighter and freer.

iching.trigram_combination: Thunder over Fire is the hexagram of a full life at its height. Fire is the clarity in you that sees the whole of what you have. Thunder is the drive in you that acts on it. The action rests on the clarity because what you do well grows out of what you see clearly. This hexagram has long been read as thunder and lightning arriving together. In one flash you see everything you have, and the thunder moves you to act on it. A storm like that is over fast, and so is a time this full. It is also read as the sun at noon, which has only one way left to go. Your fullest times are real, and they are yours to live while they last.
iching.reading:
Everything in your life has come to its height at the same time. The work is done, the people are near and there is plenty. A time this full cannot last, and the counsel here is plain: do not grieve. The sun at noon begins to set, and the full moon begins to wane. Spend the bright hours giving your light to everyone around you, the way the sun shines on all. Know when you have enough, and stop there.

The danger is a screen. Pride or doubt draws a curtain around the fullness until the stars show at noon. When someone doubts you, say plainly what you mean, and the shade lifts. Meet your equals as partners, and draw able people in. Whoever shuts the door on a full house ends up alone in it.

Your eyes and your feet do the work now. Your eyes take in the whole of what you have in one look, and your feet move while the light lasts. Stand the way someone stands at the top of a good day, with open hands and the doors open.
judgement_lines: Abundance goes through. The king reaches it. Do not grieve.
Be like the sun at noon.
image_lines: Thunder and lightning come together: the image of abundance.
So the wise decide a case with the clarity of the flash, and carry out the sentence with the force of the thunder.

upper_trigram.name: Thunder (Chen)
upper_trigram.nature: Arousing power emerging from the depth of the earth. Excite, influence, move, affect. The eldest son.

lower_trigram.name: Fire (Li)
lower_trigram.nature: Glowing light spreading in all directions. The power of consciousness. Magical fire-bird. The middle daughter.

lines.image: meeting your equal, who becomes your partner.
lines.reading: You meet someone of your own strength, and there is no fault in being alike. For a while, ten days or ten years, you sharpen each other. Pushed too far, being equals turns to disaster. Go forward together while it is fresh, and you will be honoured.

lines.image: curtains so thick the stars show at noon.
lines.reading: The curtains are so thick that the stars show at midday, and the one above you cannot see. Go to them now and you meet suspicion, which spreads like a sickness. The shade is made of doubt. Hold to what you truly mean, say it plainly, and the doubt lifts.

lines.image: a darkness at noon, and the right arm broken.
lines.reading: The dark is so deep that even the small stars show at noon, and your right arm is broken. Nothing great can be done now, and you are not to blame. You pushed too fast and fell back as fast. Rest the arm, and wait for the light to return.

lines.image: stars at noon, and the hidden one met.
lines.reading: The curtain is still thick, but the dark is thinning. In it you meet someone of your own kind, plain to look at and carrying more than shows. Be strong without forcing anything. Go toward the one you found, and it goes well.

lines.image: brilliance coming, and the able gathered round.
lines.reading: Light returns, and able people gather round you. There is praise, and there is good fortune. The striving nobody saw ends in an ease everybody sees. Empty yourself of the need to do it all, and the fullness arrives by itself.

lines.image: the house made grand, the door shut, and no one seen for three years.
lines.reading: The house is made grand and screened off, and whoever looks through the door finds it still and empty. For three years nobody comes. This is plenty hidden away for fear the light would show what is inside. Open the door while someone is still outside it.

gene_keys.shadow:
Every mood seems to come from outside you, and you can always name the cause. The high was the money, the good weather or the right person arriving. The low was the food, your partner or the news. Looking outside for the reason you feel the way you do is the commonest habit on earth. It is so common that it looks like plain noticing.

What holds you there is longing. When you are low, you long to be high. When you are high, you long to hold on to it. The hunger is for the search and never for the finding, because what you love is the hope. So you rise and fall on every swell, in love and then out of it. Your breath goes thin at the bottom and fills your chest at the top, and you call the swell freedom.
gene_keys.repressive: Held in, this shadow becomes complaining, most of it silent. Every complaint puts you at the centre of a sad story and keeps the story going. Each one hands a little of your power away. Over time it wears the body down, and it makes life as hard as it says it is.
gene_keys.reactive: Let out, the same shadow fires blame at a target. The arrow lifts the weight of your situation off you and onto someone else, so the drama goes on. You cannot blame another for your fate while you see you are playing a part. Catch the arrow in mid-flight, and you are free.
gene_keys.gift:
Freedom begins with understanding, never with a method. It dawns in the whole of you that your own beliefs have held you. To leave a prison, you first have to know you are in one. Then you start to take the suffering back inside, yours first and then other people's. The drama outside runs out of fuel. You stop pushing your life where you wanted it to go, and you drift, watch and let it be. The search that was desperate becomes almost funny.

A dragonfly lives for years underwater before it climbs into the air. The water from its old life is pumped into its new wings to spread them. Your feelings are that water. When you feel them to the end, they are what lifts you.
gene_keys.siddhi: At its height freedom keeps the same name and stops being yours. You stop feeling shut inside your own body, and what you feel moves freely between you and other people. The idea that a feeling belongs to someone starts to seem absurd. There is one wave of feeling, and some people make it while others receive it. In love, neither of you pulls while the other pushes away, and what you share runs over like a full cup. You no longer fall in love; you rise in it. People can see the peace in your eyes.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy frees you from making anyone else the cause of how you feel. Mystics Treasures holds what it lacks: the longing to be known, which gets through whatever two people keep between them. Freedom asks you to hide nothing, and closeness is where that starts. Open it when you feel free on your own and guarded with the people you love.

human_design.gate: Gate 55 presses you to feel life at full depth and to be changed by what you feel. Every feeling that passes through it grows larger on the way. It wants your passion to be what supplies you, and it fears not knowing which passion to follow. At its best it makes things from faith that there is enough. Pressed by fear, it hoards, holds back or takes more than its share. Then it forces things by will until the will runs dry. From outside, all of this can look like plain moodiness.
human_design.centre:
The Emotional Solar Plexus Center sits low in the front of you and makes feeling. It is both a motor and a way of knowing, and it moves in a wave. For this gate the wave is passionate and moody, mostly even, with short bursts up or down. Its low end can be melancholy, and there is wisdom in the low if you can stay with it. Nobody can tell when the melancholy will come, and time alone is the right use of it.

A little over half of people have this centre defined. Their feelings run all the time, so the truth of a feeling shows over days. A choice made on the crest tends to go wrong. The rest have it open. They take in the feelings of the people around them and feel them louder, and when they are alone the feelings leave. At a funeral they may feel nothing and wonder what is wrong with them. Nothing is wrong with them at all. When they are alone they know a steady peace.
human_design.channel: Gate 39 sits at the base of the trunk and provokes, poking at whatever has settled. Joined to this gate it makes the Channel of Emoting, which brings feeling out into the open to stir feeling in the people nearby. It often ignores what anyone thinks is possible and wants it anyway. Gate 39 may be in you or in a person close to you, and the stirring happens only when both are present.

tarot.ring_role: This energy works a quiet change inside your own life. It belongs to a family of two, the Ring of the Whirlwind, bound by one chemistry. UL 49, Union in the Ashes, turns the same change outward into the upheaval you see when a whole society falls apart. Here it turns inward, and your moods stop running you.
tarot.tarot_resonance: One of the tarot's major cards meets this energy twice, through the ring and the upper trigram.

body.physiology:
The sun is the reason this energy is given to the solar plexus, which is named for it. Two knots of nerves, each the size of a fingertip, sit on the front of your spine behind your stomach. Fibres go out from them like rays to everything in your belly. They run your organs and vessels on their own, without a word from your brain. A strong feeling passes through them with more force than any thought you could set against it. A full day or an empty one is felt there first.

Lay a hand in the soft hollow just below the tip of your breastbone and take a sharp breath in. The hollow pushes out against your hand. The sun in the middle of you lies about a hand's depth behind it.
body.amino_acid:
Your body is getting ready for a change in its own cells as you read this, and so is every other body. One substance in that change is histidine. Your body cannot make it and has to take it in from milk, fish or lentils. In your blood, the iron that carries each breath is held in place by it. Every breath you take while reading is carried on it.

This energy has a chemistry in you that rises and lets go, the way the body does at the height of love. You share that chemistry with its kin, so what rises in you rises in them too.

relations.unity_line: UL 56 is this card's pair and its inverse at once: the fullness carried on the road, where this one has it at home.

pair.teaching: This energy fills a life to its height, and it runs out when the fullness is kept in one place. Infinite Journey is where it goes next: a taste for life that takes the world in and hands it back as a story. Open it when the good time at home has peaked and you feel the pull to move. At home many people gather round you, and on the road there are few, so each one counts.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy upside down and the full house becomes a traveller's room. Infinite Journey is the same fullness with no home to keep it in. Open it when staying put has started to feel heavy.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy frees you from making anyone else the cause of how you feel. Mystics Treasures holds what it lacks: the longing to be known, which gets through whatever two people keep between them. Freedom asks you to hide nothing, and closeness is where that starts. Open it when you feel free on your own and guarded with the people you love.

codon_ring.name: Codon Ring of the Whirlwind
codon_ring.teaching: This energy works a quiet change inside your own life. It belongs to a family of two, the Ring of the Whirlwind, bound by one chemistry. UL 49, Union in the Ashes, turns the same change outward into the upheaval you see when a whole society falls apart. Here it turns inward, and your moods stop running you.

tarot.teaching: One of the tarot's major cards meets this energy twice, through the ring and the upper trigram.

sky.teaching: the planet of force and heat, the drive in you that will not let a full time sit still.

immortals.teaching: Thunder above carries Cao Guo Jiu, born to royal blood, who gave away his wealth and left the court. Fire below carries Lu Dong Bin, the scholar whose sword cuts through illusion. You can do what each of them did: let go of what you own before it owns you, and cut through what is false. Then no amount of plenty can hold you.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the mouth that opens and says what was shut inside, so the doubt that screens a full house lifts.

cards.essence: Somewhere new, away from everything you know, your senses come wide awake. This is where delight lives in you. The food tastes of the place, and the light falls differently. You can tell what feeds you from what only passes the time.

glance.reading:
Somewhere new, away from everything you know, your senses come wide awake. This is where delight lives in you. The food tastes of the place, and the light falls differently. You can tell what feeds you from what only passes the time.

Some days you jump from one new thing to the next and cannot settle. Let yourself be bored for a while instead. When nothing is going on, you notice what is really there. That feeds you more than any rush.

Taste one thing at a time with your whole attention, and a little goes a long way. Leave room between one job or one home and the next. In that gap, what you gathered settles and becomes yours. Later it comes out of you as a story that other people love to hear. Lived like this, life is a journey that never runs out of things to taste.

iching.trigram_combination: Fire over Mountain is the hexagram of being a stranger far from home. Mountain is the stillness in you that stays in one place, wherever your feet go. Fire is your attention, bright and open to everything new. The stillness lies underneath because away from home there is nothing outside you to lean on. This hexagram has long been read as fire passing over a mountain. The mountain stays where it is like an inn, and the fire moves through it like a traveller. You can stay a night anywhere and leave the place as you found it. You travel well when you are still inside and wide awake outside.
iching.reading:
You are away from home, among people who do not know you. What counted where you came from counts for little here. Few people are close to you, and you are watched the way any stranger is watched. This is a time for small gains, and small gains are enough. Every place on the road is a place to pass through.

Travel light and carry only what you need. Be humble, and keep what you have out of sight. Keep your loyalties to yourself until you know the ground, and stay out of the local gossip. When you have to judge someone, judge clearly and let it end there. A guest who treats the house well is welcome to come back.

Your eyes do the work now, and they take in more than you can hold. Let them rest on one thing at a time, and keep your hands still. Sit the way a traveller sits at an inn, with the pack set down.
judgement_lines: The traveller. Success in small things.
Holding steady on the road brings the traveller good fortune.
image_lines: Fire on the mountain: it moves on and does not stay.
So the wise judge with a clear mind and with care, and let no case drag on.

upper_trigram.name: Fire (Li)
upper_trigram.nature: Glowing light spreading in all directions. The power of consciousness. Magical fire-bird. The middle daughter.

lower_trigram.name: Mountain (Ken)
lower_trigram.nature: Limit, frontier, stillness. Solid, steady, unshakable. The youngest son.

lines.image: the traveller fussing over small things.
lines.reading: You fuss over small things at the start of the road, coins clinking loudly in your pocket. Showing off in a strange place draws trouble, and the trouble is your own doing. You have wandered off your own path. Lift your aim above the small things and go quietly.

lines.image: an inn, money kept close, a young helper.
lines.reading: You reach an inn with your money kept close, and a young helper stays loyal to you. You mix with whoever is there without being pulled down by them. Being modest is how a stranger earns trust. Keep what you have out of sight and treat the people who help you well.
