lines.image: the inn burned, the helper gone.
lines.reading: The inn burns, and the helper is gone. You were too hard and too proud with the people who served you, and they left. Even if you are in the right, you are in danger now. Be the first to forgive, and show the people around you that you care.

lines.image: a shelter, money and an axe, and a heart that is not glad.
lines.reading: You have found shelter, money and an axe to keep you safe, and still your heart is not glad. No one here knows what you can do, and there is no place yet where you can do it. What you have is real, but it does not fill the heart. Stay alert, and keep looking for the place where you are needed.

lines.image: a pheasant shot, one arrow lost.
lines.reading: You shoot a pheasant and lose one arrow, and in the end you are praised and given a place. You win it without forcing your sight or your strength. Stay open to the good people here, and who you are will move them.

lines.image: a bird burning its own nest.
lines.reading: A bird burns its own nest. You laughed at first from the high branch, and now you weep with nowhere to land. You blame others and never look at yourself. Through carelessness you lose your mild nature. Nothing is heard of you again. Look at yourself before you look at anyone else.

gene_keys.shadow:
Under all the busyness sits an ache, an old longing with no name. You go looking for pleasure to be rid of it. The pleasure fades and leaves the ache deeper, so the two keep turning each other like a wheel. Out through the senses you go, to whatever is bright or loud, and while they are full you feel nothing underneath. Too much or too little, either one keeps you numb. Meanwhile the world tells you what to want and whose fault it is. Blame what happens to you, and the same pattern comes round again. Take it as it comes, and your life starts to move. Some turn the other way, into a private dream with no ground under it.

Switch off the screen and there it is, the ache you were running from. It was the one thing you needed to feel.
gene_keys.repressive: Too little comes in, and the spirit sinks into a numbness that can last for years. It is a teenager's long sulk, kept into adult life. The days turn to tedium, and the eyes lose their shine.
gene_keys.reactive: Everything has to keep moving. The eyes above all must be fed, with something to watch or somewhere new to go. Inside there may be a whole private life of daydreams that no one sees. Feeling what is really there is the one thing never tried.
gene_keys.gift:
Enrichment is something you stop doing more than something you do. Once you stop feeding the chase, whatever you do starts to feed you. You learn, in the moment, what nourishes you and what drains you. You would enjoy the cake, but today it would not do you good, so you let it pass. Another day you have it. This is choosing, and nothing is given up. There is a simple test: is there anything you cannot say no to? While there is, it has a hold on you.

The same energy that went out through your senses turns inward, toward where it came from. Real enjoyment starts inside you, and your senses grow finer. You find wonder where others find sameness, and beauty where others see something ugly.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Love is the arrow here, and you have let it pierce you again and again until nothing is left to defend. Keeping this takes no discipline at all. You are still distracted, but only by what lifts you. Nothing of the senses is given up. Everything is tasted slowly, the bitter as sweetly as the pleasant.

Of all the senses, the mouth takes life in deepest, and a kiss gives and takes at once. You laugh easily from here, having found there is no point to any of it, only wonder. The people near you catch it, the way a good wine is shared.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy takes in everything and can lose itself in the taking. Woven Light holds what it lacks: limits, a shape and a structure to live inside. It asks you to accept the moment exactly as it is, with no daydream laid over it. Open it when you are drifting from one thing to the next and need a form to hold you.

human_design.gate: Gate 56 sits in the throat and turns what you have lived into a story. It gathers first, place after place and person after person, then shapes what it found into something to say. It can make an ordinary day sound like an adventure. From outside it can look restless, a life that never settles on one thing. Its cost is talking more than listening. A story told from lack or struggle makes the people hearing it smaller, and one told from what is possible makes them bigger. The feeling behind a story counts as much as what happens in it. The right story, told to the right person at the right time, works like medicine. Silence can tell one too.
human_design.centre:
The Throat Center is where what is inside you comes out as a word or a deed. Eleven gates lead into it, more than into any other centre, so the whole of you is trying to reach it. It drives nothing by itself. It turns whatever drives you into speech or action. Through gate 56 what comes out is a story, and the timing decides whether anyone hears it.

About seven people in ten have this centre defined. Their voice has one steady tone that is always there for them, like a bird with its own song. With gate 56 they turn every explanation into a story without noticing. Told when no one has asked, the story fills the air and nobody listens. The other three in ten have it open. Their voice shifts to meet whoever they are with, and a story gives it solid ground. Told at the right moment, what they say has real power.
human_design.channel: A story needs an idea to hold it together, or it is only a list of things that happened. Gate 11 sits in the mind and is where ideas form, more of them than a life can use. Together the two gates make the Channel of Curiosity, which turns what you think into stories. The idea gives the experience its shape, and the experience gives the idea a body. Gate 11 may be in you or in a person you spend time with, and the story comes out whole only when both are present.

tarot.ring_role: This energy is how you forget yourself, out through the senses. It belongs to a family of three, the Ring of Trials, three tests every life meets again and again. The first belongs to UL 33, Echos of Time: forgetting who you are. The last belongs to UL 12, Petals of Freedom: giving up everything you have gained. This one carries the middle, the pull of the world through your five senses.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Five of the tarot's major cards arrive here, and each shows one side of how you travel.

body.physiology:
The journey is the reason this energy is given to the thyroid. Before you were born, the gland began at the back of your tongue. It travelled down the front of your neck to where it sits now, across the windpipe below the Adam's apple. It has not stopped moving since. It is tied to your voice box, so it rises every time you swallow. Put two fingers either side of your windpipe and swallow. What lifts under them is the voice box, with the gland going along. In a healthy neck you feel the lift and not the gland.

On the back of the thyroid sit four smaller glands, each the size of a grain of rice. Whatever you ate and wherever you are, they hold the calcium in your blood at one steady level. When it drops, they borrow from your bones and pay them back later. It is the one thing in your blood that does not wander.
body.amino_acid:
No substance in you belongs to this energy. What belongs to it is a stop. Your body builds each protein by reading a message one piece at a time. At a stop the reading ends, and the finished protein is let go whole. Every protein in you ends at a stop, and there is no other way one can end. Anywhere you looked in your body's own instructions, you would meet a stop every now and again.

In you, this stop is knowing exactly when to stop. It closes the places where your life leaks out, and your five senses are those places. As they close, your energy turns inward and a flame grows inside you that needs nothing from outside. It is the middle one of three such stops in you, the place where your senses lead you to forget yourself.

relations.unity_line: UL 55 is this card's pair and its inverse at once: the full house at the height of plenty, where this one is the road away from it.

pair.teaching: This energy tastes the world on the move, and it runs out when you need somewhere to stay. Untouched Perfection comes next: a fullness at its height, the home that plenty builds. Open it when you are ready to stop travelling and fill one place. A full house cannot last, and in time it sends someone out on the road again.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy end for end and the open road becomes the harvest at home. Untouched Perfection is the same life seen from the full table instead of the path. Open it when you have travelled so long that you forget what you set out with. Neither the table nor the road lasts for good.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy takes in everything and can lose itself in the taking. Woven Light holds what it lacks: limits, a shape and a structure to live inside. It asks you to accept the moment exactly as it is, with no daydream laid over it. Open it when you are drifting from one thing to the next and need a form to hold you.

codon_ring.name: Codon Ring of Trials
codon_ring.teaching: This energy is how you forget yourself, out through the senses. It belongs to a family of three, the Ring of Trials, three tests every life meets again and again. The first belongs to UL 33, Echos of Time: forgetting who you are. The last belongs to UL 12, Petals of Freedom: giving up everything you have gained. This one carries the middle, the pull of the world through your five senses.

tarot.teaching: Five of the tarot's major cards arrive here, and each shows one side of how you travel.

sky.teaching: the Hanged Man's element, still enough when you stop moving to hold the whole sky on its surface.

immortals.teaching: Fire above carries Lu Dong Bin, the scholar who wandered the world with a sword that cuts through illusion. Mountain below carries Zhang Guo Lao, the old hermit who rode his donkey facing backwards and folded it away like paper when he stopped. One keeps you clear on the road, and the other lets you rest anywhere.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the letter of the deep, where you sink below the busy surface and see what is there.

cards.essence: Before you have thought a choice through, your body often leans one way. That lean is intuition, a quiet knowing that speaks in the moment and gives no reasons. When you act on it at once, you move before doubt has had time to speak.

glance.reading:
Before you have thought a choice through, your body often leans one way. That lean is intuition, a quiet knowing that speaks in the moment and gives no reasons. When you act on it at once, you move before doubt has had time to speak.

It speaks once and softly, so the mind can talk over it. A worry and a hunch can feel alike in the body. The worry is about what might come, and the hunch is about now. When you cannot tell which is speaking, let the worry run its course before you decide.

Each time you trust it, it grows a little stronger. People soften toward you, and events move more smoothly than your worries predicted. It shows your own way, never anyone else's. When it leads you onto harder ground than you wanted, keep going, because the reason shows later. Followed gently, your hunches become a way through life that only you could have walked.

iching.trigram_combination: Wind over Wind is the hexagram of getting through by gentleness. Wind is the part of you that goes in softly and keeps going. Here it meets more of itself, so each small effort you make is followed by another. A single gust passes and changes nothing. Wind that keeps blowing one way bends a whole field. This hexagram has long been read as wind following wind, and as a root going into the ground. A root finds the soft places between stones, and your patience works like that. You get where you are going by staying gentle and staying on course.
iching.reading:
You are in a situation that force will not move, and gentleness can. What works here is small, done again and again in one direction. You do not need to overturn anything here. Things are corrected a little, then a little more, the way wind shapes a field over a season. The strength of it comes from time. You come to this after a stretch with no place of your own, so going in gently is the only way open.

Have somewhere to go, then walk there step by step on the same path. Do not change course at every gust. Look below the surface, where the matter is really decided, and weigh each move by where you stand. Find someone who has done this before, and put yourself in front of them. The gains will be small, and they will hold.

Your legs do the work now, carrying you forward one steady step at a time. Walk softly, and keep walking.
judgement_lines: The gentle. Success through what is small.
It helps to have somewhere to go. It helps to see the great person.
image_lines: Wind follows wind: the gentle, going in.
So the wise give their word again, then carry the work through.

upper_trigram.name: Wind (Sun)
upper_trigram.nature: Subtly penetrating. Mild, nourishing. Wood and wind. The eldest daughter.

lower_trigram.name: Wind (Sun)
lower_trigram.nature: Subtly penetrating. Mild, nourishing. Wood and wind. The eldest daughter.

lines.image: advancing, then drawing back, then advancing again.
lines.reading: You go forward, then back, then forward again. Nothing out in the world is in doubt; the wavering is in your own mind. A soldier steadies before a march by deciding, and so can you. Decide once, and walk the way you decided.

lines.image: something hidden under the bed, and many helpers called in.
lines.reading: Something is hidden low, under the bed, and you cannot tell what it is. Go down after it. Call in the people who keep records and the people who read signs, more of them than looks sensible. Asking this openly is not confusion. Search low, ask for help, and it goes well.

lines.image: the same soft pressing, again and again, and shame.
lines.reading: You keep making the same gentle appeal to something that has not moved. Wind that never stops is no longer gentle, and it turns into a strain. The aim is blocked, and that is the shame of it. Stop repeating what failed, and find another way in.

lines.image: regret gone, and three kinds of game taken in the hunt.
lines.reading: The regret is gone, and the hunt comes home with three kinds of game. There is enough for the offering, enough for the guests and enough for the kitchen. Steady, gentle effort has paid off. Take what it brings, and share it three ways.

lines.image: no good beginning, but a good end; three days before the change, three days after.
lines.reading: It did not begin well, and still it will end well. Hold steady in the middle, and stay willing to yield. Before a change, give three days' notice. After it, take three days to weigh how it landed, and good fortune follows.

lines.image: still under the bed, and the axe lost.
lines.reading: You are still down under the bed when the time for staying low has passed. Somewhere down there you have lost the axe you made your decisions with. Softness kept past its moment costs you your means and your say. Come up, stand on your own feet, and be firm while you still can.

gene_keys.shadow:
Sit still in a quiet room for a few minutes, and a discomfort starts up underneath with nothing it is about. It is a sense that all is not quite as it should be. It comes with living in a body that will not last, and it drives much of what you want and fear. Once it was a warning that went off only when danger was near. Now the mind picks it up and turns it into worry that never stops. You hum at whatever pitch is played beside you, the way a tuning fork does. Most of the world around you is playing fear. So you build safety out of money and plans, and the unease stays behind them. No amount of thinking ends it, because thinking is what keeps it going.

Turning to face it takes courage, since looking away is easy. It does not leave when you look. Once you can see it, it stops driving you.
gene_keys.repressive: This person's body knows what is right, down to every cell. A moment later the mind arrives with its doubt and a second opinion, and the knowing goes dark. They cannot bring themselves to commit. They live inside their worries, and the certainty they feel never gets to move them.
gene_keys.reactive: Here the unease is met with a fast decision, anything to make it stop. The choice comes out of the fear itself, so it brings more turmoil. It is not always wrong, since a life needs some upheaval. What ends the loop is feeling the fear fully before acting.
gene_keys.gift:
Trust is something you can live inside, and you move into it by listening. Intuition is the part of you that already knows the way out of the maze. It is a quiet voice, softer than thought, and nature speaks to you through it. Much of the time you hear it without following it, which is how you learn. The fear stays for a while. Then the knowing grows stronger than the old habits, and your body hums with life.

The mind explores and conquers, while this listens and receives. When the listening leads and the mind follows, you feel at ease in your body, perhaps for the first time. Fear turns out not to be inside you at all. It is a field you can live in, pass through or rise above.
gene_keys.siddhi:
The surprise, when it comes, is how gentle it is. The listening that guided you leads to an edge, and there it leaves you. You wait at that threshold, where the oldest fears live. Then something takes your hand, and you slip through. There is no path after that, because you have arrived. There is no fear, because there is no tomorrow.

You stop humming to whatever is played beside you, and everything goes quiet. What remains is softness at the heart of everything, like wind moving through the top of a tree. The more softly you touch a thing, the more it opens to you. Gentleness turns out to have no weakness in it.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy knows the way in a soft voice, and it runs out when that voice has been ignored too long. Unshakable Arrival holds what it lacks: the shock that wakes you all at once. The unease of this energy and the agitation of that one feed each other, and at their height they wake together. Open it when the quiet voice has been missed and life has to shout.

human_design.gate:
Gate 57 presses you to know, right now, whether you are safe. It works through the senses and takes in the whole moment before thought can weigh it. It picks up a change in a room, or something coming before it has arrived. More than once it has moved you out of harm's way without your deciding anything. The knowing comes whole, with no reason attached, and it comes once.

Because no reason comes with it, a hunch is easy to argue away, especially when it goes against what everyone thinks. There is a second trap. You sense so much that you throw it forward and frighten yourself with a future you have made up. Nobody knows the future. What the pressure is for is timing: knowing when the moment is right, then moving in it instead of second-guessing what you already know.
human_design.centre:
The Spleen Center sits low on the left side of the body and holds this pressure. It is the oldest awareness you have, the one plants and animals live by. Its job is to keep you alive, so it is quick and quiet. It speaks once, in the moment, and never repeats itself. It is also the centre of time, meeting each moment fresh. Its fears are the fears of survival, and the one that belongs to this gate is the fear of tomorrow.

About fifty-five people in a hundred have this centre defined. For them the hunch is always there. They can rest like a cat dozing in the sun, whose ears still turn at every sound. The body is a reliable guide if they act on it at once. Their trouble is the mind talking over it, or pushing past feeling ill because the body has always coped. The other forty-five have it open. Their bodies are more sensitive, and they often know they are getting ill before the first sign shows. They take in the fears of whoever is in the room and feel them louder. They lose track of time or feel pressed by it. Their work is to learn which fears are their own.
human_design.channel: This gate reaches three ways at once. Gate 10, in the Identity Center, turns the hunch into how you carry yourself and treat yourself. Gate 20, in the Throat Center, lets you say what you know the moment you know it. Gate 34, in the Sacral Center, gives the hunch the power to act. Wherever one of the three meets gate 57, whether in you or in a person close by, the hunch becomes something lived.

tarot.ring_role: This energy lays down the first pattern of your body, in the nine months before birth. It belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Matter, whose theme is a body growing from conception to the age of twenty-one. UL 46, Fountain of Light, carries the first seven years. UL 48, Doorways of the Unknown, carries the second seven. UL 18, Liberation of the Greater, carries the third. This one carries the time in the womb.
tarot.tarot_resonance: One of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, arrives through the family.

body.physiology:
Your spleen does its work without ever telling you, and that is why this energy is given to it. It is the one organ in your belly that you cannot feel. It lies under your left ribs, behind the stomach. All of your blood passes through it many times a day. It meets whatever should not be in the blood before anything in you hurts. It has no duct and no nerve that reports to you, so none of this reaches you as a feeling. Taste works in the same instant way, deciding before any thought whether a thing is safe to swallow.

Lay a hand flat on your left side, under the last ribs, and breathe in. You feel nothing there. A healthy spleen is about the size of a fist, and no hand can find it. Your hand is resting on the part of you that knows first and says nothing.
body.amino_acid:
This energy has a chemistry in your body, and one substance in it is alanine. Your body makes it for itself, though meat, eggs and beans all carry it too. Only one of the twenty pieces your proteins are built from is smaller. If you have had a blood test, you may have seen the letters ALT, which name the enzyme that makes it and takes it apart.

The unease in you came in at conception. Your body was built at the pitch of the world your mother lived in while she carried you. This is the oldest pattern written into you, the one that makes the world feel solid, and it was made to be unlocked. You share this chemistry with three other energies.

relations.unity_line: UL 58 is this card's pair and its inverse at once: the joy that opens outward, where this one goes softly in.

pair.teaching: This energy goes quietly inward and finds its way to the centre of a thing, and it runs out once the way is found. Rhythm of Life is where it goes next: joy that grows by being shared. Open it when a hunch has brought you somewhere good and you want to share what you found. What was found in quiet wants company.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy end for end and the soft going-in becomes an open, glad meeting. Rhythm of Life is the same gentleness seen from the side that faces outward. Open it when you have been listening inward for a long time and want to be with people.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy knows the way in a soft voice, and it runs out when that voice has been ignored too long. Unshakable Arrival holds what it lacks: the shock that wakes you all at once. The unease of this energy and the agitation of that one feed each other, and at their height they wake together. Open it when the quiet voice has been missed and life has to shout.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Matter
codon_ring.teaching: This energy lays down the first pattern of your body, in the nine months before birth. It belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Matter, whose theme is a body growing from conception to the age of twenty-one. UL 46, Fountain of Light, carries the first seven years. UL 48, Doorways of the Unknown, carries the second seven. UL 18, Liberation of the Greater, carries the third. This one carries the time in the womb.

tarot.teaching: One of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, arrives through the family.

sky.teaching: the first fire of the year, the push that starts a season, the nerve to move the moment the hunch says go.

immortals.teaching: Wind above and below carries He Xian Gu, the immortal who holds a lotus and needs almost no food. She moves through the world so lightly that nobody can hold her. She shows you how far the lightest touch can go.

hebrew_letter.teaching: an opening in a wall that lets the light in, the way a hunch lets you see outside before you step out.

cards.essence: Some mornings you wake up glad to be alive, for no reason you could name. You want to tell someone, so you call a friend, and your good mood spreads to the people near you. You see how the things in front of you could be a little better, and making them better is a pleasure.

glance.reading:
Some mornings you wake up glad to be alive, for no reason you could name. You want to tell someone, so you call a friend, and your good mood spreads to the people near you. You see how the things in front of you could be a little better, and making them better is a pleasure.

Joy has its own rhythm, and on some days it goes quiet. A restlessness takes its place, a feeling that life should be more than it is. Chasing the next plan or purchase will not bring the joy back any sooner. Let the restlessness be, and the gladness returns on its own.

Do something kind that nobody asked for, and notice how much more alive you feel. When you see what could be better, wait until someone asks, and your help will be welcome. Shared this way, joy comes back to you as more life, and the people around you feel it too.

iching.trigram_combination: Lake over Lake is the hexagram of joy that is shared. Lake is the joy in you that you cannot hide. Here it meets the same joy in someone else. A lake on its own dries down in the sun. Two lakes keep each other full. That is why its image is friends gathered to talk a thing through. So the joy in you wants to be spoken. Your joy grows only when someone else has it too.
iching.reading:
Things are going well, and it is a time to enjoy them with other people. The work is done or on its way, and a celebration is in order. Gather your friends, talk over what each of you has learned, and practise it together. What you learn alone stays thin. Talked through with a friend, it deepens for both of you.

Stay firm inside while you are warm outside. Win people with friendliness, never by pressure. Honest joy shows in your face, and people trust it. Joy put on to draw people in turns sour. Be a little careful whom you open to, since some who come near your good mood want something from it.

When you lead people with joy, they forget how tired they are. When you face a hard thing beside them with joy, they forget their fear. Your mouth is where this joy shows first, in talk, laughter and food. Notice whether what you said today had any pleasure in it, and spend your talk and your meals with people who are good for you.
judgement_lines: Joy brings success.
Staying firm and true is what makes it last.
image_lines: Two lakes, one resting on the other, each keeping the other full.
So the wise meet with friends to talk things over and practise them together.

upper_trigram.name: Lake (Tui)
upper_trigram.nature: Open surface, interaction, pleasure, the mouth, exchange. The youngest daughter.

lower_trigram.name: Lake (Tui)
lower_trigram.nature: Open surface, interaction, pleasure, the mouth, exchange. The youngest daughter.

lines.image: joy at peace with itself, needing no one to agree.
lines.reading: You are glad and at peace with yourself, and you need no one to agree. Joy like this comes without effort and copies nobody. You want nothing from anyone, so nothing you do is in doubt. Keep your joy this simple.

lines.image: honest joy, and the regret goes out of it.
lines.reading: Your joy is honest, and the regret you were carrying goes. What you mean inside shows on the outside, so people trust your aim. Enjoy what is real, never what only flatters you.

lines.image: pleasure sent for, brought in from outside.
lines.reading: You are looking outside yourself for something to cheer you up. Company kept for the lift it gives leaves you as empty as before. The people you used for it feel used. Joy that lasts comes from inside you, so stop reaching out for it.

lines.image: two pleasures weighed, and no peace until one is let go.
lines.reading: You are torn between two pleasures and cannot settle. Even at a party a sadness sits in you while the choice is put off. Look at what pulls you toward the lesser one. Then choose quickly and firmly, and the joy comes back.

lines.image: trust given to someone who is wearing you down.
lines.reading: You have trusted someone who is wearing you down, and you do not see it. When you like being agreed with, you stop hearing honest words. Honest care can still help someone who has lost their way. Keep your eyes open to who is near you and what they take.

lines.image: charm used to draw people after you.
lines.reading: You are drawing people after you with charm and clever words. If there is nothing true behind the charm, they leave no happier than before. Before you lead anyone toward joy, make sure you have some yourself.

gene_keys.shadow:
Under most lives runs a restlessness with no cause. It is not sadness or worry, which have a reason. It is only the feeling that this is not quite it yet, always pointed at tomorrow. Picture a lake whose surface never settles, and you have what it is like inside. Your mind takes it as an order to fix something, so you improve the house, the job or yourself. Each change calms the water for a day, then the restlessness stirs it again. When the world runs out of things to fix, the search turns inward, to a practice or a teacher who promises peace later. That is the same search in different clothes.

The restlessness will not let you rest until every answer has been tried. The emptiness left then is the first honest thing it gives you. Everyone carries this same ache, the ache to come home, and there is something beautiful in that.
gene_keys.repressive: Nobody can hold this energy down. It is the life in your body, and a body cannot refuse its own life. Push the restlessness away and it comes back as the next thing to fix. So there is no quiet version of this shadow.
gene_keys.reactive: This person meddles with life. They once felt joy arrive by itself, so they try to make it happen again, pushing at things that were already moving. Every push brings more discomfort, and that calls for another push.
gene_keys.gift:
Aliveness wells up once you stop chasing a better tomorrow. The force that poured out into the future turns back into your body, and the water starts to move freely. You are happy for no reason. Your thoughts slow, with more space between them, and what happens to you matters less. Even an old or tired body feels younger for it.

Loss is part of this joy. The people you have lost stay part of you, and your life is fuller for them. The wish to make things better is still here, but it no longer helps in order to ease your own ache. It feels where life is stuck in something and frees it without forcing. Walk into a room with this alive in you, and the room moves more easily.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Bliss is the lake gone still. Your seeking turns so far inward that it comes back to where it began. Something lets go at the very bottom, and you no longer feel a centre inside you. Nobody stirs the water any more, so it stays still. Awareness comes in like a flood and wipes you clean in less than a breath. Your gaze goes soft, your heart fills past what it can hold, and it shows in your face.

You cannot reach this by seeking, though seeking usually comes first. Look at your own restlessness until you can laugh at it. Then you see the joy was inside the ache all along, as the fruit is inside the seed.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy is restless to make things better, and it keeps moving. Timeless Blossom holds what it lacks: the stillness that comes at the end of a cycle. Joy settles only when it has somewhere still to rest. Open it when your good mood keeps running after the next thing.

human_design.gate:
Gate 58 is the drive to make life better because being alive is good. You feel it low in your body, a lively pressure that sees how whatever is in front of you could be more alive. For you, joy and improving things go together. Practice feeds it: you do the same thing again and again because the doing is a pleasure, and your skill grows.

It has two costs. Offered before anyone asks, your idea of what could be better is heard as criticism. When it is refused, it feels as if you were refused. The other cost runs inward. If you were taught that pleasure must be earned, you ration what you love and call it discipline. The joy was never a distraction from the work, since it is what drives it.
human_design.centre:
The Root Center sits at the base of the body and holds the pressure to act. It does not decide. It presses, and it presses in pulses. When the pulse is on, you can start anything. When it is off, you cannot make yourself do even what you know you should. The key to this centre is timing: rest in the pause, and do not push when the push is not there.

About six people in ten have this centre defined. They have steady access to the pressure and can bear a great deal of it, but they risk burning out. The other four in ten have it open, and they take in the pressure of the people around them and feel it louder. Someone says the kitchen needs cleaning, and they are already at the sink. The pressure is never theirs, so each task done only brings the next. Felt without being obeyed, this pressure becomes the hum that draws a hummingbird to a flower.
human_design.channel: Joy knows something could be better without knowing exactly what. Gate 18, in the Spleen Center, sees the flaw. Together they make the Channel of Judgment, which improves whatever is in front of you so that people have more joy. Its corrections are welcomed when someone has asked for them. Gate 18 may be in you or in someone close to you.

tarot.ring_role: This energy is one of six pressures in the Ring of Seeking, each keeping you looking for more until it turns you inward. UL 15, Ordinary Valiance, is the pull people feel toward you when you slow down. UL 39, Nobel Spark, is the push in you that stirs what has gone still. UL 52, Timeless Blossom, is the restraint that lets you hold pressure without acting on it. UL 53, Creation Oscillation, is your urge to begin. UL 54, Everlasting Bounty, is your wish to rise. This one is your joy in being alive.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Three of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, show your joy from three sides.

body.physiology:
Fear takes hold first at the perineum, and that is why this energy is given to it. It is the small sling of muscle at the floor of your body, between the legs. When you are afraid, it tightens before you know it, and the grip climbs the spine into your jaw. Held tight, it puts you on automatic, doing the next thing without being there to choose it. The restless feeling that life should be more can live here for years, as a floor held tight and a breath kept high.

Laugh, and the floor tightens a moment before the laugh comes. It is the same muscle you use to stop the flow of urine. Squeeze it now and notice your breath rise. Let it go, and your breath drops on its own, with your shoulders after it.
body.amino_acid:
The restlessness in you has a chemistry, and one substance in it is serine. It is one of the twenty pieces every protein in you is built from, and there is plenty of it in meat, eggs and beans. When you eat, the juices in your gut cut the food into those twenty pieces, and serine is part of what does the cutting.

You share this substance with a family of pressures, each driving you to look for an end to your longing. That longing is fuel. As it falls away, the life in you runs clearer. Even bliss is chemistry: a release in the brain, felt as joy with no cause.

relations.unity_line: UL 57 is this card's pair and its inverse at once: joy opens people in plain sight, and the wind reaches them unseen.

pair.teaching: This energy is joy spoken out loud, and it runs out where talking cannot reach someone. Flight of the Tao is where it goes next: a hunch that finds its way quietly into what words cannot open. Open it when your good mood has been shared and something still needs to go deeper. Joy opens the door, and gentleness goes the rest of the way.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy over and what shows becomes what is hidden. Flight of the Tao works quietly, where this energy is out in the open. Open it when being seen has worn you out and you need to trust what you cannot say.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy is restless to make things better, and it keeps moving. Timeless Blossom holds what it lacks: the stillness that comes at the end of a cycle. Joy settles only when it has somewhere still to rest. Open it when your good mood keeps running after the next thing.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Seeking
codon_ring.teaching: This energy is one of six pressures in the Ring of Seeking, each keeping you looking for more until it turns you inward. UL 15, Ordinary Valiance, is the pull people feel toward you when you slow down. UL 39, Nobel Spark, is the push in you that stirs what has gone still. UL 52, Timeless Blossom, is the restraint that lets you hold pressure without acting on it. UL 53, Creation Oscillation, is your urge to begin. UL 54, Everlasting Bounty, is your wish to rise. This one is your joy in being alive.

tarot.teaching: Three of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, show your joy from three sides.

sky.teaching: the earth sign that sorts and refines, the part of you that wants whatever is in front of you a little better.

immortals.teaching: Zhong Li Quan, the one Immortal for Lake above and below, carries a fan said to bring the dead back to life. When you share your joy, it wakes up the people around you who had gone flat.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the smallest letter, a single point, the way one small kindness starts your joy moving outward.

cards.essence: When someone comes close, a longing rises in you to be known by them. You feel it in your body first. You let them see you as you are. You say what is true, and your heart decides how much to share. You listen as closely as you speak.

glance.reading:
When someone comes close, a longing rises in you to be known by them. You feel it in your body first. You let them see you as you are. You say what is true, and your heart decides how much to share. You listen as closely as you speak.

Some days you pull back from someone and cannot say why. Turn toward the feeling instead of away from it. Most often it is old pain. Hold it the way you would hold a frightened child, and in time it lets go of you.

Be honest with your own heart, and you can be honest with anyone. Once you no longer need the other person to change, your heart stays open whatever they do. What you kept hidden, once opened, turns out to hold love. Near you, other people feel free to be honest too.

iching.trigram_combination: Wind over Water is the hexagram of a thaw between people, when what had set hard breaks up. Water is the feeling in you that has been held down with nowhere to go. Wind is the gentle pressure in you that finds its way into a closed place. The wind sits above because a feeling locked inside rarely frees itself, and something has to reach it. This hexagram has long been read as ice breaking up and melting. A warm wind over a frozen pond turns the ice back into water, while a cold one freezes it harder. What is warm in you frees what has gone cold between you and another person.
iching.reading:
Something between you and other people has set hard, and now it is breaking up. It may be a suspicion, a grudge, or a group you have held on to out of habit. While it breaks up it can feel like a loss. It is a thaw.

What it asks first is warmth from inside you. Nobody else can warm you up. Whatever you send out carries your own warmth or your own cold.

This time has long been pictured as a king who goes to his temple when his people are scattered. When people have drifted away from you, do not try to drive them back. Be sincere where they can see it, and they come back on their own. Let go of what ought to go, and what matters can come together again. This is a good time for a large undertaking, like a boat on wide water with the wind behind it.

In the body, it is energy that was blocked inside you starting to move again. Stay warm, stay sincere, and be ready to cross.
judgement_lines: Dispersion. Success. The king comes to his temple.
It is good to cross the great water. It is good to hold to what is right.
image_lines: The wind moves over the water: the image of dispersion.
So the kings of old made offerings to the highest and built temples.

upper_trigram.name: Wind (Sun)
upper_trigram.nature: Subtly penetrating. Mild, nourishing. Wood and wind. The eldest daughter.

lower_trigram.name: Water (K'an)
lower_trigram.nature: Precipice, dangerous place. Stream, flowing water, river. Venture and fall. The middle son.

lines.image: a strong horse, and a rescue while the trouble is small.
lines.reading: The trouble has only just begun, and you cannot deal with it alone. Help is close by, strong as a horse. Let it carry you out of the water onto dry ground. Take the help now, while the trouble is still small.

lines.image: running to what holds you up, in the middle of the stream.
lines.reading: Things around you are coming apart, and you run toward what can hold you up. You leave what was harming you, the way a horse breaks out of its stall. In the middle of the stream you find something steady to lean on. Go to what is reliable, and your regrets fall away.

lines.image: letting go of yourself, with your aim set outside you.
lines.reading: Here what you let go of is your own interest. You throw yourself in, the way someone dives in after a person who is drowning. Your aim is outside you, with the ones who need you. Put them first, and there is nothing to regret.

lines.image: leaving your own group, and a crowd gathering like a hill.
lines.reading: You step away from the group you took sides with. Out of that leaving comes a larger gathering, people standing together like a hill. Nobody would have expected it. Let go of the small loyalty, and a larger one forms around you.

lines.image: a great cry that goes out like sweat, and the king in his place.
lines.reading: You speak from the heart of things, and like sweat your words cannot be taken back. You open your own stores to the people around you. There is no fault in giving like this. Say what cannot be unsaid, then stay in your place.

lines.image: the wound put far away, and walking out.
lines.reading: At the end, what you let go of is the hurt itself. You put the harm at a distance and walk away from the fear that came with it. There is no fault in leaving like this. Keep the harm far from you, and be wary of anyone who flatters you back toward it.

gene_keys.shadow:
A part of you stays hidden from other people, and it came with you. When someone walks into the room, a faint fear starts up in the air between you. Alone, you do not feel it. As long as you keep something back, the other person has something to fear. That fear is also what draws two people together, and once you stop fearing someone the pull goes. Most of this is not a lie you choose to tell.

It starts inside, in the story you tell yourself about why you did what you did. The story puts the blame on someone else. So you change your partner or move to another country, and the same knot ties itself again. Under it is old pain, stacked in the body, much of it handed down to you. This is what makes a room full of people feel lonely.
gene_keys.repressive: This person leaves themselves out, then feels left out. Staying outside keeps their defences in place, and the feeling becomes a habit they cannot put down. It lets them feel in control. The moment they choose to include themselves, it falls apart.
gene_keys.reactive: Here the same fear comes out as anger. They push their way into another person's space and feelings. When they are turned away, they storm off. To avoid being rejected, they try to run the relationship, so they never stay with anyone honest enough to stand up to them.
gene_keys.gift:
Intimacy starts when you let the fear between you be there. You admit it, understand it and leave it alone. That allowing works like a valve, and the full force of attraction pours out. It is not soft. It is the raw power that makes new life, and it breaks up whatever kept two people apart.

When two people meet like this, something forms between them that neither had alone. The more different the two of you are, the further it can take you. The force rises until it reaches the heart, where two people share one awareness. The nearest most people come to it is falling in love, when you feel the other person even from far away.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Transparency is what is left when there is nothing in you to hide. You see the world the way a clear mirror does, adding no comment and no judgement. The last wall to go is the one between you and everyone else, and then nobody feels like a stranger.

Every man and woman is your brother or sister, and no one is an island. Two people joined this way are not parted by distance, or even by death. Fear turns out to have been a thin skin you had to pass through.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy reaches out toward another person, and reaching is half of what makes something new. Untouched Perfection holds what completes it. This one is the seed, that one the egg. Where this energy changes how people come together, that one frees each person from the inside. Open it when the closeness you want starts to feel like a trap.

human_design.gate:
Gate 59 is the drive to break through a barrier and get close to someone. At its root it is the urge to make new life. It chooses whom you are drawn to without asking you. Beyond that root it reaches for people of every kind, wanting to understand them and be understood.

Its question is where, and with whom. The same force can make a partnership or a business thrive, or start a pregnancy nobody wanted. The strength that takes a wall down can also be used to push past someone's limits or to get your way. So be clear before you act on it.
human_design.centre:
The Sacral Center sits low in the body, under the navel, and it is the strongest engine you have. It is the energy for making things, keeping a house, raising a child and sex. It does not decide. It answers, with a yes that lifts or a no that goes flat, and only to what is actually in front of you.

In about seven people in ten this engine runs all the time. For them the pull toward another person is steady, and it grows when they follow a real yes. It drains away when they give it where there was no yes, or when others get it out of them through guilt.

In the other three the engine is open. They take in the energy of the people around them, and they can merge into another person's world without noticing. They do not know when enough is enough until the body gives out. Their gift is the pause, knowing when to stop.
human_design.channel: Gate 6 sits in the Solar Plexus Center, where feelings and desires rise, and it guards the edge of what you feel. With Gate 59 it makes the Channel of Mating: the drive to get close meets the feeling that decides whether to let it in. Tension often comes before closeness here, and it is part of the process. Gate 6 may be in you or in a person close to you, and a bond is made only when both are present.

tarot.ring_role: This energy takes down the barriers between people, and its family turns on it. It belongs to a family of four called the Ring of Union, whose aim is to bring people together as one family. UL 4, Veils of Knowledge, carries the understanding that lets you stop blaming. UL 7, Essential Nexus, carries the guidance that comes when you are truly together. UL 29, All In, carries the commitment that holds nothing back. This one carries your closeness to one other person.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Four of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, arrive through the ring and the two trigrams.

body.physiology:
New life is the reason this energy is given to the sacral plexus and the sexual organs. The sacral plexus is a weave of nerves low in your pelvis. Its nerves carry the feeling between your legs and ready your body for another body without a thought from you. Close by lie the ovaries or the testes, where the start of a new person is made.

Everyone you have ever met is here because this place did its work in two other people, and so are you. It is also the part of you least under your control. Nothing here waits for your permission, and nothing here can be argued into readiness.
body.amino_acid:
The longing for union with another has a substance in you, and the substance is valine. Your body cannot make it, so it comes from food, more from a bowl of oats than from white rice. When food runs short, your body can turn it into sugar.

You share this substance with three other energies, and together they have long shaped how people are with each other. In you it runs from forgiving yourself, to the goodness that follows, to pouring yourself out for others. Then it comes to this closeness, where there is no inside left to keep anything in.

relations.unity_line: Each card here is about how you come together with other people: what gives your closeness a shape, what meets it, and the family it belongs to.

pair.teaching: This energy opens you up and takes down what stands between you and another person, and on its own it keeps spreading. Woven Light is where it goes next: the limit that says this far and no further, and gives a thing its shape. Open it when everything has been opened and nothing yet holds. What has been opened needs an edge to last.

inverse.teaching: Seen from the other side, the opening in you becomes a place to stop. Woven Light is that stop, the joint in a bamboo stalk that divides it and holds it together at once. Open it when you have given yourself away and need to find where you end.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy reaches out toward another person, and reaching is half of what makes something new. Untouched Perfection holds what completes it. This one is the seed, that one the egg. Where this energy changes how people come together, that one frees each person from the inside. Open it when the closeness you want starts to feel like a trap.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Union
codon_ring.teaching: This energy takes down the barriers between people, and its family turns on it. It belongs to a family of four called the Ring of Union, whose aim is to bring people together as one family. UL 4, Veils of Knowledge, carries the understanding that lets you stop blaming. UL 7, Essential Nexus, carries the guidance that comes when you are truly together. UL 29, All In, carries the commitment that holds nothing back. This one carries your closeness to one other person.

tarot.teaching: Four of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, arrive through the ring and the two trigrams.

sky.teaching: the twins, the part of you that wants another person beside you.

immortals.teaching: Wind above brings He Xian Gu, who holds a lotus: the part of you that is open with nothing to hide. Water below brings Li Tie Guai and his gourd of medicine: the old pain in you that carries a cure. Closeness asks you for both.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the blade that divides, so you can see what is real between you and another before you join.

cards.essence: You have an idea you want to make real, and it needs a shape before it can stand. Common sense is what finds that shape. You know what a thing will cost, how long it will take and how much one day can hold. You set the edges first and build inside them. People come to you when they want something to actually get done.

glance.reading:
You have an idea you want to make real, and it needs a shape before it can stand. Common sense is what finds that shape. You know what a thing will cost, how long it will take and how much one day can hold. You set the edges first and build inside them. People come to you when they want something to actually get done.

Some days you are pulled two ways, toward the next big reach and back toward what feels safe. Go too far toward the reach and you burn out. Go too far toward safety and you shrink. You need the structure, and you need to be free of it at the same time.

So build what the idea needs, and hold the frame lightly. Make it the kind that bends when the ground moves under it. Then what you imagined has a place in the world, and it lasts.

iching.trigram_combination: Water over Lake is the hexagram of how much you can hold. Lake is the part of you that is content inside its own shore. Water is everything that keeps pouring in, the work and the money to spend. The flow sits above because more always arrives than any one place can keep. This hexagram has long been read as the joints of a bamboo stalk. Each joint ends one length and starts the next, which is how the cane grows so tall. The year has joints too, which is why it turns through four seasons. You grow the same way, one measured length at a time.
iching.reading:
More is coming in than you can hold, and it needs a limit before it can be of use. A lake must hold its water without spilling over or drying out. So its level is checked all the time. Set a good limit, and things go well. What you set now is how much you will spend, how far you will go and what you will not do.

Then weigh what you do against those measures. A good measure harms nothing you own and hurts no one near you. Keep your measures sweet, and they will feel like your own. A rule that has turned bitter cannot be kept for long, and holding on to it only leads you to a dead end.

The body knows this in its joints. A knee or a knuckle is where one bone stops and the next begins, and that is why a limb can move at all. Sit easy, with every joint loose.
judgement_lines: Limitation. Success.
A limit that has turned bitter cannot be kept.
image_lines: Water above the lake: limitation.
So the wise set number and measure, and weigh what is right to do.

upper_trigram.name: Water (K'an)
upper_trigram.nature: Precipice, dangerous place. Stream, flowing water, river. Venture and fall. The middle son.

lower_trigram.name: Lake (Tui)
lower_trigram.nature: Open surface, interaction, pleasure, the mouth, exchange. The youngest daughter.

lines.image: not going out of the door and the courtyard.
lines.reading: You stay inside your own door, and there is no fault in it. You have the strength to go, but the way ahead is blocked for now. Knowing when a road is open and when it is closed is the whole skill here. Stay quiet for now, since care at the start leaves you no regret at the end.

lines.image: not going out of the gate and the courtyard, when the gate stands open.
lines.reading: You stay inside the gate after it has opened. The moment to act has come, and you are letting it pass. Waiting is watching for the right time, and hesitating is letting it go by. Know your limits, but do not mistake them for doubt about yourself. Go out through the gate while it stands open.

lines.image: no limit at all, and then the sigh.
lines.reading: You did as you pleased with no limit, and now you sigh over it. Nobody else is to blame. The harm is small this time, and it is your own. Decide where your line is before you set out, and keep to it.

lines.image: peaceful limitation, the measure kept without effort.
lines.reading: You keep your limits at peace, without strain. You took them from someone steadier and made them your own. Now they come without effort. Work inside what is fixed, and inside it there is no end to what you can do.

lines.image: sweet limitation, from the middle place.
lines.reading: You keep your measure so well that it tastes sweet. You take neither too much nor too little, and you stay content even when things are hard. Others cannot be forced to keep a limit, but they follow one they see kept. Go on, and people will respect you for it.

lines.image: bitter limitation, held to past its use.
lines.reading: You hold yourself to a rule that has gone bitter. You can hold back, but you can no longer reach out. Even if the rule is right, keeping it brings harm. This is still a smaller fault than having no rule at all, so it can be mended. Let the rule go, and the regret goes with it.

gene_keys.shadow:
Closed thinking is the low of this energy. Your mind goes round the same track as yesterday, about your partner or your money. Nothing new gets in, because you keep no door open for it. Out in the world it is red tape, rules so tangled they no longer protect anyone. It is a child kept at a desk when every part of them wants to run. It cannot bear anything new or young.

Under it is a lack of trust. Life puts itself right in its own time, and this part of you cannot believe that. So it holds everything still. It will not move for force. It waits for one thing, which is time.
gene_keys.repressive: Held down, this energy leaves a life with no frame at all. Nothing they start lasts, and they keep changing where they live and what they do. Commitment frightens them, because it is a structure. So their gifts miss the people and the place they need to grow.
gene_keys.reactive: Let out in anger, it grips hard. Nobody may question what they say or do, and anyone who crosses them meets their temper. Every new idea feels like a threat to their safety. They hold the form so tight that its purpose is lost, and unless they let go, they shrivel.
gene_keys.gift:
Realism is knowing how a new idea becomes a real thing. A good idea will not arrive in the world on its own. It needs a shell, the way a seed does, or it never takes root. So you graft the new shoot onto an old, strong root, and change grows out of what already stands. All a new thing needs is some structure and an open mind.

You know that every structure you build will end one day, and you can smile about it. Knowing this keeps you from being trapped inside what you built. So you set up the easel or open the shop, and you begin from the heart. Something breaks through in the gap between what you meant and what you made. The best of this gift is knowing when to step back and let the thing go.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Justice here is a gift given, never a punishment. A man once stole the silver from the one house that had taken him in. Caught and brought back, he heard the owner say the silver had been a present. Being forgiven by someone you wronged cracks you open. Life evens the balance, and nobody has to punish anyone.

What drops away at this height is weight. Let go of your past, and you become light, in both senses of the word.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy builds structures, and it can get so busy with them that it forgets what they were for. Infinite Journey holds what it lacks: a taste for the world that keeps moving and tells what it finds. Open it when your plans have grown heavier than the reason you made them. The traveller reminds the builder why it began.

human_design.gate: Gate 60 is the pressure to bring something new into form within set limits. Its name here is Conservation, which means keeping what still works. In a time of change or loss, it keeps your eyes on what is still standing rather than on what fell. That is what lets you rebuild. Its gift is a lotus that grows up out of the mud. When nothing shows, you can feel that something is wrong with you. Nothing is wrong, since the seed is growing under the ground where you cannot see it.
human_design.centre:
The Root Center sits at the base of the body and runs on adrenaline. It is one of four motors in the body, but it does not run steadily. It pulses on and off, so everything it does depends on timing. Of the paths it drives, this is the one that brings sudden change into your life.

About six people in ten have this centre defined. They can bear pressure and aim it. When the pulse is off, it feels as if the rug has been pulled out from under them. They cannot make themselves do what they know they need to do, sometimes for a month. The other four in ten have it open. They take in the pressure of everyone around them and try to get rid of it by doing. Starting things is hard for them. Their gift is knowing which pressures are really theirs to act on.
human_design.channel: Gate 3, low in the belly, is the drive to bring order out of a mess. Joined to Gate 60, it makes the Channel of Mutation. Its energy comes in bursts you cannot predict, each one trying to bring something new to life. It is change by growth, never by overthrow. Gate 3 may be in you or in someone close to you, and the new thing takes form when both are present.

tarot.ring_role: This energy gives the earth its weight. It belongs to a family of three, the Ring of Gaia, through which you can feel your kinship with every living thing. UL 19, Solection, is the part of you that can feel what it is like to be another creature. UL 61, Celestial Remembrance, is the part of you that knows the truth at the heart of things. This one is the solid ground under your feet, where both of them stand.
tarot.tarot_resonance: The tarot gives this energy one of its major cards, its Arcana, and it speaks to what you grow.

body.physiology:
The banks are the reason this energy is given to the colon. A river without banks is a flood, and the colon is the bank inside you. About a litre and a half of liquid reaches it each day. It takes all but a cupful of the water back into your blood, so what arrived loose leaves with a shape. It holds what it has for a day or two. Then it moves in a few long pushes, most often after the first meal of the day. Only at the very end does one muscle wait for your decision.

Lie on your back and press in low on the left, below the navel. When it is full, you may feel a firm rope under your fingers, the last bend. That is the part of you that gives the day's leftovers a shape.
body.amino_acid:
The weight you carry has a chemistry, and one substance in it is isoleucine. Your body cannot make it, so it comes from meat, cheese or beans. This energy is the earth at its most solid, the plain weight of things. Your muscles take the substance apart themselves, in the part of you that works against the pull of the ground.

You share it with two other energies. One of them is the moment a thought breaks out of its old track. So what keeps you steady and what sets your mind free share one chemistry.

relations.unity_line: UL 59 is this card's pair and its inverse at once: the water let out of the lake, where this one holds it.

pair.teaching: This energy holds things in a shape, and it runs out when the shape starts to shut people out. Mystics Treasures is where it goes next: the longing that gets through the walls between two people. Open it when your edges have done their work and something needs to loosen. Nothing stays gathered forever.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy end for end and the holding becomes a letting go. Mystics Treasures is the same water, let out of the lake. Open it when what you built has started to hold you in. Holding and releasing are one motion.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy builds structures, and it can get so busy with them that it forgets what they were for. Infinite Journey holds what it lacks: a taste for the world that keeps moving and tells what it finds. Open it when your plans have grown heavier than the reason you made them. The traveller reminds the builder why it began.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Gaia
codon_ring.teaching: This energy gives the earth its weight. It belongs to a family of three, the Ring of Gaia, through which you can feel your kinship with every living thing. UL 19, Solection, is the part of you that can feel what it is like to be another creature. UL 61, Celestial Remembrance, is the part of you that knows the truth at the heart of things. This one is the solid ground under your feet, where both of them stand.

tarot.teaching: The tarot gives this energy one of its major cards, its Arcana, and it speaks to what you grow.

sky.teaching: the planet of beauty and the body, where what you love takes a form you can touch.

immortals.teaching: Water above carries Li Tie Guai, the healer with his medicine in a gourd, who reminds you to keep what heals close at hand. Lake below carries Zhong Li Quan, whose fan brings the dying back to life, the way a little rest brings you back.

hebrew_letter.teaching: a door is a limit you can walk through when the time is right.

cards.essence: Inspiration is alive in you, and it begins with a question you cannot work out by thinking. You carry the question through your day, and it keeps you wondering. Then something comes in that you did not think, and afterwards you see your life a little differently. It feels less like learning something new than like remembering it.

glance.reading:
Inspiration is alive in you, and it begins with a question you cannot work out by thinking. You carry the question through your day, and it keeps you wondering. Then something comes in that you did not think, and afterwards you see your life a little differently. It feels less like learning something new than like remembering it.

Some days the question presses, and your thoughts go round and round. Your mind will grab any answer that promises to end the pressure, and none of them lasts. Leave the question open, because the next flash comes in its own time. Between flashes the days can go flat.

When your mind is troubled, pick up a pencil or a trowel and make something. As the work takes shape, the worry empties out and only what matters is left. Other people feel it in what you make, and they are drawn to it. Each flash goes into your hands and comes out as something real.

iching.trigram_combination: Wind over Lake is the hexagram of the truth you hold inside. Lake is the openness in you that shows on your face and in what you say. Wind is the gentleness in you that reaches people without pushing. The openness sits inside and the gentleness outside, because what is true in you reaches others only when nobody is pushed. This hexagram has long been read as wind moving over open water. Nobody sees what you hold inside, but everyone sees what it moves in them. The less you push, the further you reach.
iching.reading:
Here your word is believed, because there is nothing hidden behind it. It reaches even the people who trust nobody, the ones no argument can move. A small offering made honestly counts for more than a grand one made for show. With this behind you, you can take on something large and hard and see it through.

What it asks is an open heart with no hidden plan in it. Go in empty, the way an empty boat crosses a wide river. When someone has done wrong, take your time before you judge them. Find out why they acted as they did, and answer them instead of reacting.

Sincerity is felt in the chest before anyone sees it. Keep your chest open and your plans in plain sight, and speak from there.
judgement_lines: Inner truth. It reaches even the pigs and the fishes, and it goes well.
It is worth crossing the great water. Holding to what is true brings it through.
image_lines: Wind over the lake: the image of inner truth.
So the wise weigh each case with care, and put off the sentence of death.

upper_trigram.name: Wind (Sun)
upper_trigram.nature: Subtly penetrating. Mild, nourishing. Wood and wind. The eldest daughter.

lower_trigram.name: Lake (Tui)
lower_trigram.nature: Open surface, interaction, pleasure, the mouth, exchange. The youngest daughter.

lines.image: at rest in yourself, and no rest if you look elsewhere.
lines.reading: At the start of trust, you are at rest in yourself, and that brings good fortune. Look to someone else for your certainty, and the rest is gone. Once a second thought slips in beside the trust, the mind cannot settle. Weigh what you can believe before you believe it, and then keep to it.

lines.image: a crane calling from the shade, and its young answering.
lines.reading: A crane calls from the shade, and its young answer, knowing the voice. What is true in you, said quietly and out of sight, is heard by the people who share it. You do not need to be seen to be heard. Speak from where you are, and share what you have with whoever answers.

lines.image: a match found, and the drum beaten then dropped, the sob then the song.
lines.reading: You have found your match, and now your mood rises and falls with theirs. Now you beat the drum and now you stop. Now you weep and now you sing. What you trust has moved outside you, so it swings as they swing. Bring your certainty back inside, where nobody else can turn it.

lines.image: the moon nearly full, and a horse leaving the one it was harnessed with.
lines.reading: The moon is nearly full, and a horse leaves the one it was harnessed with. Something in you has grown close to its fullest. Going on means parting from a companion who matched you at the last stage, and there is no fault in it. Turn toward what is higher, and let the pair go.

lines.image: truth that links everyone to it, hand in hand.
lines.reading: You are sincere through and through, and it links people to you hand in hand. Nothing has to be added and nothing argued. The whole room trusts it and stays. Keep it firm, and let the trust do the joining.

lines.image: a rooster's crow climbing toward the sky.
lines.reading: A rooster's crow climbs toward the sky, but a rooster cannot fly. Words that go higher than the truth under them do not last, however sure they sound. Even holding firm will not save this. Bring your voice back down to what you actually know.

gene_keys.shadow:
Losing touch with what is real is the ordinary state of most minds, and almost nobody knows they are in it. Here it starts as the question why, and a pressure to answer it that the mind cannot bear. One side of the mind reaches for a faith to end it, and the other side reaches for a science. Neither of them can end the pressure. The mind is sick for one reason: it is looking for itself. You cannot think your way out from inside the thinking.

The worst of it is worship. The moment you put someone above you as the one who knows, you set yourself below them and stay there. The only way through is to walk into the pressure instead of trying to make it stop. Do it slowly, in your body, with your feet on the ground.
gene_keys.repressive: This person turns away from the question young, because following it would mean leaving everything comfortable. They take the expected road through school and work, and do it well. Whatever they gain, they stay restless underneath, because the question is still there.
gene_keys.reactive: Here is someone who fixed on one answer and built a whole life around one teacher or one creed. They carry it to everyone as a mission. Underneath is a well of not knowing, and it comes up as anger whenever the question gets close.
gene_keys.gift:
Inspiration means breath coming in, and this energy at its best is exactly that. Something enters you that you did not think, and it takes apart a piece of what the mind had built. The energy locked up in that building is set loose, and it wants to become something. What comes out of you is your own, unlike anyone else's.

A man loses his wife, and for a year he rises at dawn and pours his grief into a garden. At the end there is a garden, a clear mind and something made for her. Being born in a body means being born wounded, and this is how the wound is tended. As you tend your own, you begin to tend it in others.
gene_keys.siddhi: Holiness is what is left when inspiration has used itself up. A great silence comes down, and all the noise of the mind stops at once. The pressure leaves the head and goes out through the whole of you, everywhere at once. You feel empty and full at the same time, and the sense of someone watching it is gone. The question why is never answered here. It ends, and what remains is living without answers. It arrives as a glimpse, and then you fall and begin the work again. One night you sit alone on open rock and watch the full moon rise, and there is nothing more to ask.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy is a pressure in the head that has not yet become a question. Voice of Nature holds what it lacks: the mind that takes the pressure and puts it into words. Together they turn what you cannot name into something you can say. Open it when your thinking has crowded out your wonder.

human_design.gate:
Gate 61 is the drive to know why, and its name is Wonder. It reaches past what can be explained toward the mystery itself, and comes back with a knowing it cannot account for. You know things without being able to say how, and you know them all the same.

From outside it can look like being lost in thought, and it is often misunderstood. Nobody around can confirm what it knows, so doubt creeps in. Left to run, the need to figure things out turns bitter. The story of why things happened takes the place of wonder that they happened at all. Let the answer go and keep the wonder. Being present turns out to hold more than knowing.
human_design.centre:
The Head Center sits at the crown, and it makes questions and inspiration, nothing else. It has no motor and decides nothing. Its one way out is the mind just beneath it, which has to turn each question into something usable. It is a pressure centre: the moment a question rises, the pressure to close it rises too. The art here is to leave the question open long enough for something to arrive.

About three people in ten have this centre defined. Their mind broadcasts all day, a radio station that never goes off the air, and it will not simply go quiet. Under pressure with no answer in sight, the question can turn inward as worry or despair. The other seven in ten have it open. They take in the questions of the people around them and make them louder, so every conversation tosses the mind about. Defined or open, a mind that stops obeying the pressure can rest, the way a mountain stays still while everything on it moves.
human_design.channel: A question alone has nowhere to go until it is thought through. Gate 24, in the mind just below, turns a thing over until it makes sense. Together they make the Channel of Awareness, which keeps coming back to the same question and refines the answer as more comes in. Gate 24 may be in you or in someone close. What the two make is a knowing you can hold, even before you can say it. Not everything needs to be understood.

tarot.ring_role: This energy looks inward, where every living thing keeps its truth. It belongs to a family of three, the Ring of Gaia, whose theme is the life of the whole planet. UL 19, Solection, carries the closeness that lets you feel what another creature feels. UL 60, Woven Light, carries the limit that gives life its form. This one carries the question hidden inside everything.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Three of the tarot's major cards arrive here, one through the ring and two through the Wind.

body.physiology:
The dark is the reason this energy is given to the pineal gland. The gland sits in the very middle of your head, the size of a grain of rice. Nearly everything in the brain comes in pairs, and this one is single. It never sees light, and it learns from your eyes when the day has gone. While the light is on it does nothing, and when the light goes it begins its work. The question in you rises the same way, from a part of the mind no light reaches.

Sit in a dim room in the evening, and over an hour or two your body slows and grows heavy. That is this gland at work. Turn on a bright light and within minutes it stops. You cannot feel it working, only what it brings.
body.amino_acid:
The pressure of the mystery in you has a substance, isoleucine, one of the twenty pieces that build every protein in you. Your body cannot make it, so it comes in with food such as meat, eggs or beans. It has a twin of exactly the same weight, built from the same pieces in a slightly different order. The two are not the same thing, and the difference is inside, where nobody can see it.

Deep in your body the pressure of the mystery beats in every part of you. Whatever is of real value in you is hidden inside, never on the surface. You share this one substance with two other energies.

relations.unity_line: UL 62 is this card's pair and its partner at once: the words that let what you know be heard.

pair.teaching: This energy knows more than it can say, and it runs out at the edge of words. Voice of Nature is where it goes next: the small, exact words that let a little of what you know cross to someone else. Open it when you know something and cannot get it across. What is lived without words still wants to be told.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy end for end and it comes back the same. What is true at your centre looks the same from every side, so there is no hidden face behind it. What it lacks sits beside it, in its partner, never underneath.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy is a pressure in the head that has not yet become a question. Voice of Nature holds what it lacks: the mind that takes the pressure and puts it into words. Together they turn what you cannot name into something you can say. Open it when your thinking has crowded out your wonder.

codon_ring.name: Codon Ring of Gaia
codon_ring.teaching: This energy looks inward, where every living thing keeps its truth. It belongs to a family of three, the Ring of Gaia, whose theme is the life of the whole planet. UL 19, Solection, carries the closeness that lets you feel what another creature feels. UL 60, Woven Light, carries the limit that gives life its form. This one carries the question hidden inside everything.

tarot.teaching: Three of the tarot's major cards arrive here, one through the ring and two through the Wind.

sky.teaching: the planet of love and of what draws people close, the way your sincerity draws them without force.

immortals.teaching: Wind above carries He Xian Gu, the one woman among the eight, who holds a lotus that grows clean out of the mud. Lake below carries Zhong Li Quan, whose fan is said to bring the dead back to life. Keep them near for what they stand for in you: a clear mind out of a troubled one, and breath coming back.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the door between one room and the next, and each flash of inspiration opens one for you.

cards.essence: Precision comes alive in you on the days when only small things can be done. You see the detail everyone else walked past, and you put it right. Before you speak there is a pause in your throat while the right word arrives. You say that word and stop.
