This is precision the way nature has it, with the seasons arriving on time and no clock to keep them.

glance.reading:
Precision comes alive in you on the days when only small things can be done. You see the detail everyone else walked past, and you put it right. Before you speak there is a pause in your throat while the right word arrives. You say that word and stop. This is precision the way nature has it, with the seasons arriving on time and no clock to keep them.

Some days the details become a place to hide. The lists grow so that you never reach the feeling underneath. At other times you plan and plan for fear of not being ready. When you catch this, put the list down and feel what it was keeping away.

Give the small thing your full care, and leave the big step until its time comes. Say less, and let your heart choose what you say while your mind only finds the words. Then people lean in when you speak, because every word you say is one you mean.

iching.trigram_combination: Thunder over Mountain is the hexagram of small things done well. Thunder is the part of you that wants to move and be heard. Mountain is the part of you that knows where to stop. The stillness sits underneath because every move you make now has to come out of it. This hexagram has long been read as a bird leaving its call as it flies. A call sent down to the ground is heard, and a call sent up into the sky is lost. So keep your voice near the people it is for. You go further now by doing small things a little better than by reaching for a great one.
iching.reading:
This is a time when small things can be done and great things cannot. The stir in you wants the big move, and the ground under you holds it back. What gets through is what stays close. A little too little is safer now than a little too much.

Go a little past the usual in the small things, always on the side of modesty. Be a little more respectful than the occasion needs. When you lose someone, mourn with more feeling than show. Spend a little less. Do the near thing a little better than anyone else would, and climb one step at a time. Reaching for the great thing now costs more later than it gains today.

Your feet want to go, and your hands keep things in their place. Let your hands be busy with the near thing, and keep your feet on the ground.
judgement_lines: The small goes a little past the mark, and it goes through. It goes well for the one who holds to what is true.
Small things may be done; great things may not.
The bird on the wing leaves its call behind it: not up, but down. Great good fortune.
image_lines: Thunder on the mountain: that is the small going past the mark.
So the wise go a little far in respect, a little far in grief, a little far in thrift.

upper_trigram.name: Thunder (Chen)
upper_trigram.nature: Arousing power emerging from the depth of the earth. Excite, influence, move, affect. The eldest son.

lower_trigram.name: Mountain (Ken)
lower_trigram.nature: Limit, frontier, stillness. Solid, steady, unshakable. The youngest son.

lines.image: a bird flying up, and misfortune.
lines.reading: A bird flies up before its wings are ready. You want to rise at the very start, when this is the time to rest and get ready. Hurrying to get ahead is how you fall behind, and once you are up, nothing can be done about it. Stay where you are and improve what you already have.

lines.image: passing the grandfather, meeting the grandmother; not reaching the ruler, meeting the minister.
lines.reading: You go to find the grandfather and meet the grandmother; you go to the ruler and meet his minister. You did not get as far as you meant to, and you got far enough. The one you overlooked is the one who can help. Take the meeting you are given, humbly, and there is no fault in it.

lines.image: no extra care taken, and a blow from behind.
lines.reading: You feel strong and take no extra care, and someone comes at you from behind. In a time of small things, the danger is the small enemy you thought not worth guarding against. Your own confidence leaves the door open. Take the precaution you think is beneath you.

lines.image: no fault; meeting the moment without going past it.
lines.reading: You meet the moment as it is and go no further, and there is no fault in that. Going on from here is dangerous. Hold one firm stance too long and it fails you, because this will not last. Stay alert, do not act yet, and be ready to change when the time does.

lines.image: heavy clouds and no rain from the west; the prince takes what was in the cave with an arrow on a string.
lines.reading: Heavy clouds gather and no rain falls: something is building that has not yet broken. You cannot make it rain alone, however high your seat. The prince shoots an arrow on a string into a cave and draws out what was hiding there. The help you need has stepped out of sight. Look for it low down, among people who keep away from the centre.

lines.image: passing by without meeting, and the bird flying too far.
lines.reading: The bird flies past the moment it should have met and goes on too high, away from the flock. You pushed past where you should have stopped, and the harm is your own doing. Claiming more than is true is what brings you down. Know how to come back as well as how to go on.

gene_keys.shadow:
A name is not the thing it names, and the clever mind lives on names. Look at a tree through it and you see what you were taught about it. You see its name and its kind, and you miss the tree. Every fact needs a name, so a life built on facts is built out of words, and words shift. Today's facts become tomorrow's fables. Your days run on numbers, on the clock and in the bank. Much of what you call the world is only what someone said about it.

You were not born this way. A child's intelligence is in how it moves and how its eyes shine, and schooling fills the head until that brightness goes quiet. Intelligence belongs to the heart and cleverness to the head, and the head will argue to the end rather than give way.
gene_keys.repressive: Turned inward, this becomes a life lost in small things. They use the details so they do not have to feel what hurts. The days fill up with lists, and there is no room for what they might have made. It is their own mind that holds them, not the details.
gene_keys.reactive: Turned outward, it becomes a mind that cannot switch off. They question everything and enjoy the obscure fact that proves someone else wrong. Watching other people spares them from looking at themselves. Underneath is anger kept bottled up, and most days something lets it out.
gene_keys.gift:
Precision starts on the day the questioning turns around on itself. If you were lost in details, you begin to ask why. If you used facts to win, you see that the misery was your own, from years of looking at anything but your own pain. Then it is as if someone cleaned the windows. You look at the tree and take in its life before you reach for its name.

You can tell which patterns are true and which only look true, and you put things and people where they belong. Your words get more exact, and people cannot help listening. It takes some nerve, because you risk being laughed at for speaking from the heart.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Impeccability comes when you are no longer the one trying to get it right. Your words stop passing through your thinking. They come up out of your own silence, plain, and you need fewer of them the further this goes. What counts now is the moment of making, and not what gets made. A song that no one hears still counts, because the moment of singing it stays.

Nothing in you is out of place, the cracks included. A bowl mended with gold is worth more than one that never broke. The woodpecker finds its food and its home in a dead tree. You find what you need in the parts of your life you tried to leave behind.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy tries to reach the truth through the mind, one exact word at a time. Celestial Remembrance holds what it lacks: a way to the truth that goes around the mind altogether. Each on its own splits people in two, facts on one side and faith on the other. They come together only when the heart leads both. Open it when being right has stopped being enough.

human_design.gate:
Gate 62 drives you to get ready. It takes something vast and gives it a handle you can hold. You gather the facts and the small things, so nothing is missing when the time comes. It breaks a hard idea into plain steps that others can follow. This makes yours a voice of reason, grounded on what can be checked.

It goes wrong as over-preparing. The plan becomes more important than what it was for, and the lists grow to keep the fear of not being ready away. Meanwhile the day goes by unattended. Trust that you will know what you need to know when you need to know it.
human_design.centre:
The Throat Center sits in your throat, and everything in you is trying to get there. It is where something inside becomes a word or an act. It has no power of its own to move anything. It speaks for whatever it is joined to. Here that is the mind, so what comes out is your view with the details in place. Timing decides whether that view is heard. Advice given before someone is ready works like medicine they cannot take, and it turns to poison. Wait until you are asked.

About seven people in ten have this centre defined. Their voice is steady, with one tone, and they can nearly always find something to say. The other three have it open. Their voice changes with the people around them, and they can meet each person in the tone that reaches them. For them this gate gives the voice firm ground: the details, and what can be checked.
human_design.channel: Gate 17 sits just above, in the part of your mind that forms a view of how things could go. Joined with this gate it makes the Channel of Acceptance, a way of explaining that other people can accept. Your view gives the shape and your details give it ground. What comes out is a hard thing broken into steps a stranger can follow. Gate 17 may be in you or in a person close by, and your details make sense only beside a view.

tarot.ring_role: This energy chooses its words, and it cannot take them back once they are said. It belongs to a family of two, the Ring of No Return, whose theme is the words you cannot unsay. Its one kin is UL 31, Theater of Truth, where your words move a whole room. This one finds the exact word for you.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, show this energy in faces you may already know.

body.physiology:
The hum is the reason this energy is given to your throat. Every word you say begins as a small hum there. Two folds no longer than a fingernail flutter there a hundred times a second or more. Your tongue and lips cut that hum into words on the way out. As a baby you had only these sounds, a sigh or a groan. You learned to speak by shaping them. Low in the front of your throat sits the thyroid. Its whole day's work is a fleck, held within a narrow band. That small amount sets the pace of your whole body.

Lay a hand flat on your throat and hum. The buzz under your palm is your voice before it becomes a word. Now whisper the same word, and the buzz is gone. A whisper is only breath, and what you felt a moment ago is what every word of yours is made from.
body.amino_acid:
The sureness in your body has a substance, and one part of it is tyrosine. What your head is sure of can be argued away. What your body is sure of cannot, and the one thing it is sure of is love. Your body makes tyrosine for itself, so it is never missing. As your words become more exact, your heart shows through them.

A word, once spoken, does not come back. The substance it was spoken through was made in you before you chose the word. You share it with one other energy, the one that leads people with words. Break an old hard cheese and you find white grains that crunch. Those grains are tyrosine, the same substance your own body makes.

relations.unity_line: UL 61 is this card's pair and its partner at once: the truth felt in silence, where this one finds its words.

pair.teaching: This energy finds the exact word, and it runs out where words cannot reach. Celestial Remembrance is where it goes next: the sureness that needs no proof and moves people without an argument. Open it when every word you have is right and something is still missing. What is said exactly still needs something felt behind it.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy end for end and it comes back the same. There is no other side to it to run to. Whichever way you come at it, it asks for the small thing done well.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy tries to reach the truth through the mind, one exact word at a time. Celestial Remembrance holds what it lacks: a way to the truth that goes around the mind altogether. Each on its own splits people in two, facts on one side and faith on the other. They come together only when the heart leads both. Open it when being right has stopped being enough.

codon_ring.name: Ring of No Return
codon_ring.teaching: This energy chooses its words, and it cannot take them back once they are said. It belongs to a family of two, the Ring of No Return, whose theme is the words you cannot unsay. Its one kin is UL 31, Theater of Truth, where your words move a whole room. This one finds the exact word for you.

tarot.teaching: Five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, show this energy in faces you may already know.

sky.teaching: the spark that passes from one person to the next, as your word does once it is spoken.

immortals.teaching: Thunder above carries Cao Guo Jiu, the nobleman's son who left the court. Mountain below carries Zhang Guo Lao, the hermit who rides his donkey facing backward. One gave up his rank, and the other keeps his eyes on where he has been. Both show you a life lived below the heights.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the teeth that help shape sound into speech, as your mouth cuts a hum into words.

cards.essence: Curiosity comes alive in you once something is finished. You want to know how it works, so you take it apart piece by piece. What you learn on the way matters more than the answer. You spot the detail that does not fit, the one others walk past. Your questions leave things simpler and better ordered for everyone who uses them.

glance.reading:
Curiosity comes alive in you once something is finished. You want to know how it works, so you take it apart piece by piece. What you learn on the way matters more than the answer. You spot the detail that does not fit, the one others walk past. Your questions leave things simpler and better ordered for everyone who uses them.

Some days the questions turn into doubt about yourself. Talk it over with someone you trust, and it passes through.

Look at a thing whole before you take it apart, and let its beauty reach you first. Hold every answer lightly, the way a child holds a game. In time your questions turn inward, to who you really are. Follow them there, and your mind comes to rest, like sitting under a tree after a long day's walk.

iching.trigram_combination: Water over Fire is the hexagram of what comes after a thing is done. Fire is the clarity in you that sets each part of your work where it belongs. Water is the part of you that knows where the danger still is. The watching sits above the order because once a thing is done, keeping it is the work that is left. This hexagram has long been read as a pot of water over a flame. Tend both, and the water boils. Let either run wild, and it puts an end to the other. You are never more at risk than when everything is in its place.
iching.reading:
The crossing is behind you, and what you set out to do is done. Every part of it is in its place. What is left is small, the settling in and the tidying up. This is where the danger lies. A thing in perfect order can move only one way, toward disorder. People stop watching once a matter is settled, and that is when they are most exposed. So the good fortune comes at the start of this time, and the disorder at its end.

Think about trouble while there is none, so you are ready when it comes. Keep going in the small things the way you did in the large ones. Think of the people who depend on what you have built, and put their good before your own. Know more than you use, and keep some of your strength back.

Your eyes and ears do the work now. The eyes go over what is finished. The ears catch the first drip of a leak. Sit the way someone sits when the day's work is done, with loose hands and open ears.
judgement_lines: After completion. Success in small things, and it goes well for the one who keeps on.
At the beginning good fortune. At the end, disorder.
image_lines: Water over fire: the pot on the flame, in balance for as long as it is watched.
So the wise take thought of trouble before it comes, and are ready for it in advance.

upper_trigram.name: Water (K'an)
upper_trigram.nature: Precipice, dangerous place. Stream, flowing water, river. Venture and fall. The middle son.

lower_trigram.name: Fire (Li)
lower_trigram.nature: Glowing light spreading in all directions. The power of consciousness. Magical fire-bird. The middle daughter.

lines.image: the wheels held back, and the fox with its tail in the water.
lines.reading: You brake the wheels at the water's edge, and the fox's tail is wet from the crossing. The work is done and the next has not begun. The wheels skid because you are ready to go before it is time. Go slowly until you know where you are heading, and no blame comes of it.

lines.image: a woman who has lost the curtain of her carriage.
lines.reading: The curtain is gone from your carriage, and people can see in. Something that kept you private is lost, and you want to run after it. Chasing it would cost you your balance. Left alone, it comes back by the seventh day. Stay where you are and let it return.

lines.image: the great ancestor who took three years to subdue the far country.
lines.reading: The old king takes three years to win the far country, and he is worn out by it. Some things are finished only by a long campaign, well past the point where the end seemed near. Leave small-minded people out of it, since they can neither see the plan nor help carry it. Call on the unusual helper, and give it the years it takes.

lines.image: the finest clothes turning to rags, and rags kept ready for a leak.
lines.reading: The finest clothes turn to rags, so keep rags ready for the leak. In the middle of plenty something is already going thin. Doubt is useful here, the kind that looks for the drip before the boat fills. Be careful all day long while things are good.

lines.image: the neighbour in the east who kills an ox, the neighbour in the west with a small offering.
lines.reading: One neighbour kills an ox for the offering, and the other brings a little. The little is what is blessed. What counts is that you mean what you give, and give it at the right time. A cup already full has no room for anything to arrive. Give the small, honest thing, and the blessing comes in full.

lines.image: the head gone under the water.
lines.reading: Your head goes under the water at the end of the crossing. You kept going at full pace after the work was done, unable to stop. Now what you gained is slipping back into the river. Nothing here lasts, and that is the warning. Leave a finished thing while leaving is still your choice.

gene_keys.shadow:
Uncertainty is a pressure most people cannot bear. Whatever you settle, the doubt moves on to the next thing, and nothing ends it. So people take on a firm set of beliefs and hold them up against the doubt like a wall. Anyone who offers to end your uncertainty for good is selling you something false. Doubt is not the enemy. It turns harmful when you make it personal. Pushed out, it falls on the people closest to you. Turned in, it becomes doubt about yourself.

Here the mind works in the wrong order. Shown a sunset, it hears only its own words about it and is already thinking of tomorrow. Take a thing in first, and examine it after.
gene_keys.repressive: Held down, the doubt turns on the one holding it and runs on comparison. They measure themselves against everyone, come up short, then believe the measuring. Fear fixes it there, and it eats away at them as a steady worry. Nothing they do or say is ever good enough.
gene_keys.reactive: Let out, the same doubt becomes suspicion, and it falls on those closest. They doubt a partner, a boss, even their own child. The other person grows defensive, which looks like proof, so every round feeds the next. They call it being sceptical. A true sceptic has not made up their mind. This one made it up long ago.
gene_keys.gift:
Inquiry is doubt put to work. You can ask all your life without needing an answer to end it. A mind that fixes on one answer as the truth must defend it, and someone will always attack. An open mind has nothing to defend. It has the lightness of a child at play.

Ask deeply enough into anything and you find you are part of what you are looking at. From there the asking turns inward. What am I, asks the mind. What is love, asks the heart over and over, and it needs no final answer. A mind kept open grows soft, and an open mind opens the heart.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Truth arrives when the question swallows the one asking it. You climbed for years toward an answer and wore yourself out on the way. At the top you found it had been at the foot all along, before you took a step. Trusted far enough, doubt turns out to be the truth itself, and the doubter dissolves into it.

Then there is rest, like sitting under a tree on a warm evening after walking all day. Every sigh brings you nearer to it, and so does every time your face softens. It is your plain state, closer than your own heartbeat. It is there at every step of the way.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy moves one step at a time, testing each before the next. Communion holds what it lacks: the whole picture that arrives at once and cannot be taken apart. The mind that asks feeds the mind that imagines, and neither knows much without the other. Open it when your questions have run out and nothing new has come.

human_design.gate: Gate 63 sits at the top of your head and asks what comes next. It looks ahead to see which path will hold, what to follow and what to leave. It works by testing the next step before you take it, and it can tell a real teacher from a fake. Its fear is being wrong. Under the fear is a craving for certainty that no next step can meet.
human_design.centre:
The Head Center sits at the crown and is where questions start. It presses for an answer and cannot act on one, so every question it raises is carried down to be worked on somewhere else.

About three people in ten have this centre defined, and they always know what they think. Ask them where to eat and they already have an answer. Their thinking runs within set lines, so what they cannot picture they tend to refuse at first, and they are not always right. The other seven in ten have it open. They can see every side of a question and hold no fixed view. A thought does not stay with them for long, and a whole answer sometimes drops in from nowhere. A mind at rest is possible for them.
human_design.channel: A question alone is only pressure. Gate 4, in the mind just below, is the drive to turn a doubt into a formula. Together they make the Channel of Logic, which turns a doubt into a way of checking. It finds the flaw others miss, then proves a claim or drops it. It works best when someone has asked for the answer. Gate 4 may be in you or in a person close by, and the question is answered only when both are present.

tarot.ring_role: This energy asks, and asking is how every search begins. It belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Divinity, whose theme is suffering that opens you. UL 22, Treasure of the Way, carries grace. UL 36, Crystal Creation, carries the dark stretch that tests you. UL 37, Journey Home, carries the warmth of a family. This one carries the first question.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, arrive through the ring and the two trigrams.

body.physiology:
Sleep is the reason this energy is given to the pineal gland. The gland is the part of you that says the day is finished. About two hours before your usual bedtime it begins to tell your body that night has come. It says only that it is night, and leaves the sleeping to you. On some evenings your head lets go when it hears this, and on others the questions go on.

It keeps a clock that runs a little longer than a day. Each morning the first light through your eyes sets it again. Kept in dim light, a person drifts later day by day, and a morning outdoors puts it right.
body.amino_acid:
The doubt in you has a chemistry, and one substance in it is proline. Every protein in you is built from twenty pieces, and this is the one that turns the chain wherever it sits. When fear takes hold of doubt, heavy hormones go through you. Self-doubt taken all the way drains the body at that level, until your strength is simply gone.

Every person carries the same discomfort of not remembering who they truly are, and all people are equal in this one suffering. You share its chemistry with three other energies.

relations.unity_line: UL 64 is this card's pair, its inverse and its partner at once: the crossing still ahead, where this one has it behind.

pair.teaching: This energy asks how a finished thing works, and it runs out when the last question is answered. Communion is where it goes next: the open time before completion, where a new picture forms. Open it when every question has been answered and something new is waiting to begin. Each finish is the start of the next crossing.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy end for end and what is finished becomes what is not yet done. Communion is the same river seen from the bank not yet reached. Open it when the order you made starts to feel too tidy to trust. Nothing stays finished for long.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy moves one step at a time, testing each before the next. Communion holds what it lacks: the whole picture that arrives at once and cannot be taken apart. The mind that asks feeds the mind that imagines, and neither knows much without the other. Open it when your questions have run out and nothing new has come.

codon_ring.name: Codon Ring of Divinity
codon_ring.teaching: This energy asks, and asking is how every search begins. It belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Divinity, whose theme is suffering that opens you. UL 22, Treasure of the Way, carries grace. UL 36, Crystal Creation, carries the dark stretch that tests you. UL 37, Journey Home, carries the warmth of a family. This one carries the first question.

tarot.teaching: Five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, arrive through the ring and the two trigrams.

sky.teaching: the fixed earth that keeps what has been built, steady and in no hurry to chase the next thing.

immortals.teaching: Water above carries Li Tie Guai, the healer who keeps his medicine in a gourd for the day it is needed. Fire below carries Lu Dong Bin, the scholar who turned his sword on his own delusion. One keeps the cure ready, and the other cuts through a false certainty.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the nail that fastens one thing to another, so what is finished does not come loose.

cards.essence: Imagination wakes in you in the middle of a change, when the old order has gone and the new one has not yet formed. You see the shape and colour of a new thing before it exists. The picture wants your hands to build it. Even pain can turn into something you make, a song or a painting.

glance.reading:
Imagination wakes in you in the middle of a change, when the old order has gone and the new one has not yet formed. You see the shape and colour of a new thing before it exists. The picture wants your hands to build it. Even pain can turn into something you make, a song or a painting.

Not knowing can feel hard to bear while everything is in pieces, and you want order back. Near the end, keep your eyes on the work in front of you, because the picture can make a thing feel done before it is.

Trust the pictures that come, even the strange ones, and start building. It is like riding a wild horse: you can steer it only where it agrees to go. Your life becomes a work of art, always in progress.

iching.trigram_combination: Fire over Water is the hexagram of being nearly across. Fire is the clearness in you that tells one thing from another. Water is the risk you are still standing in. The clearness sits above the risk because you can see where you are going long before you are out of danger. That is why this hexagram has long been read as a young fox crossing a river. A step from the bank it thinks it is across, its tail goes in the water, and it cannot go on. Fire climbs and water sinks, so the two draw apart until each is set in its place. You can see clearly and still be in danger.
iching.reading:
You are nearly across, and the last stretch is the one that decides it. Most of what you set out to do is done. The far bank is so close that watching your step now feels foolish. This is the moment the fox wets its tail. It acts as if it were across before it is, and loses the whole crossing at the last step.

What this time asks is that you check what is done before you call it done. Look at each part of what you have made and ask what it is really doing. Fire can warm water or boil it away, and water can cool a fire or put it out. The same two things help or harm depending on where they sit. So put each thing where it does its good.

Your feet are the last of you to cross, so keep your attention on them until you are out. Take the last step as carefully as the first. Wanting to be across is not the same as being across.
judgement_lines: Not yet across. Even so, it grows.
The young fox, nearly over, wets its tail.
Nothing is gained by forcing it.
image_lines: Fire above water, each going its own way.
So the wise one tells things apart with care and keeps each in its place.

upper_trigram.name: Fire (Li)
upper_trigram.nature: Glowing light spreading in all directions. The power of consciousness. Magical fire-bird. The middle daughter.

lower_trigram.name: Water (K'an)
lower_trigram.nature: Precipice, dangerous place. Stream, flowing water, river. Venture and fall. The middle son.

lines.image: its tail in the water before the first real step.
lines.reading: Your tail is wet before the first real step. You set out to finish the whole thing from the very bottom, before you knew where your reach ended. The shame is small and it passes. Learn where your reach ends before you take the next step.

lines.image: a wheel dragged back, the cart held on the bank.
lines.reading: You drag the wheels and hold the cart back on the bank. From outside it can look like lost nerve, the way a skilled hand can look clumsy. It is strength kept for the moment it is needed. Hold to the middle of the road and it goes well.

lines.image: far bank in sight, the army wanting to march.
lines.reading: The far bank is in sight and you want to charge at it. Set out from here on your own strength and it goes badly. The river can still be crossed with help. Let someone who has been further carry you over.

lines.image: thunder loosed on the demon country, three years of it.
lines.reading: You stay true and the regret burns off. Now comes a long campaign against old habits that will not leave on their own. It takes three years, because what is true is slow to come back and what is false is slow to go. Keep at it and the reward is a whole country.

lines.image: a clear person's brightness, true all the way through.
lines.reading: The false shine has gone and a steadier light stands in its place. You are calm and quick at once. Nothing here needs regret. Your light is true, so let people see it.

lines.image: wine drunk in good faith, then the head going under.
lines.reading: The crossing is made, and you drink with the others in good faith. There is no fault in that. Drink until your head goes under and the good faith is gone. Too much trust at the end is the same mistake as too much doubt at the start. Keep your measure now.

gene_keys.shadow:
Confusion is what a mind feels when everything in it has come loose and nothing has its order yet. It comes when what you knew about yourself stops holding. In itself it is full of what could be. It turns painful only when the mind tries to explain it. The mind wants a reason, then something to do, then the old order back.

Being unfinished is hard to bear, so the pull is to keep things as they were. A change that was trying to move you gets pressed back into its old shape. While it lasts you feel alone in it.
gene_keys.repressive: Holding that much unease down takes the help of everyone else. So this nature copies. It follows its parents and its friends, and while everyone agrees nobody has to feel anything. Copying is the one thing imagination cannot live beside, though some manage to look original while they do it.
gene_keys.reactive: This nature cannot keep the unease down at all, so it spills out into the life. Closeness breaks in the same place again and again. The anger is aimed at a world that seems to have everything settled. The whole life becomes a way of getting even with life.
gene_keys.gift:
Imagination begins when you stop trying to make the not knowing go away. The mind that was busy explaining goes quiet. The energy it was using comes back to you, and you start to make things with it. What arrives first is often the ache you were trying to avoid. Give it a shape in paint, in words or in a song, and it begins to change in your hands. Keep going, and the fears you drew at the start turn out to hold something good.

Imagination is also the end of copying. It goes where nobody has been, too quick and too wild to stop and explain itself. It will not keep to what you did last year. It asks you to let your life keep changing.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Illumination is imagination that no longer belongs to you. The pictures and words still come, and they are made for whoever needs them. You stay empty while they pour through you.

Near such a person the eyes seem to shine and the room seems to shimmer. You hear such people only once you stop listening for the meaning. In the quiet between their words something true gets across.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy moves by leaps, and a leap needs somewhere steady to land. Adornments of Time holds what it lacks: reasoning that tests each step before it takes the next. One is the way of the artist and the other the way of the scientist. Open it when the picture is clear and nobody can follow how you got there.

human_design.gate: Gate 64 sits at the top of your head, where the question how begins. It fills with pictures: images, dreams and pieces of the past that arrive out of order. You can see them long before you can explain them. Along a straight line they read as a mess, which is why the gate is named for confusion. The pressure is to answer at once how each picture becomes real. Answered too early, that question shuts the dreaming down and leaves you tired and low.
human_design.centre:
The Head Center sits at the crown of your head and does one thing: it asks. It is one of two centres in the body that run on pressure, so a question and the push to answer it arrive together. It has no motor of its own and cannot act on anything it asks. It is not where a decision is made either. Most of us treat its questions as orders and move before the answer has come. Others turn the pressure inward, and it becomes worry.

About three people in ten have this centre defined. Their minds keep asking all day, and even while the pictures are unclear they know the mind is working on something. The other seven in ten have it open. They take in the questions of everyone around them and feel them louder than their own. Asked what they think, they can go blank. For them the relief is in noticing whose question it is.
human_design.channel: The Channel of Abstraction joins this gate to Gate 47, just below it in the Ajna, the centre of the mind. The head hands its pictures down, and Gate 47 turns them over until they mean something. Together they think in images and leaps, and they learn best with no set order. Without Gate 47, in you or in someone you are with, the pictures keep arriving and never add up.

tarot.ring_role: This energy turns a loose state into something new, and it does not do it alone. It belongs to a family of four called the Ring of Alchemy. UL 6 breaks down the walls between people, UL 40 builds that openness into communities, and UL 47 lets old ways change. This one opens a fresh set of possibilities.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Four of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, arrive through the ring and the two trigrams.

body.physiology:
The pineal gland carries this energy, and the reason is light. It is the size of a grain of rice and sits in the middle of your head, where no daylight ever reaches. It learns whether the sun is up from your eyes, by a long road down into the neck and back. When the eyes report that the light has gone, it lets out the hormone of the dark and your body begins to slow. So a gland that lives in the dark keeps your day by light.

Sit in a dim room in the evening and within an hour or two you feel yourself grow heavy. Switch on a bright screen and the gland reads it as day, and the heaviness holds off.
body.amino_acid:
The light that lies hidden in you until it is ready to show has a substance, and it is glycine. It is the smallest of the twenty pieces your proteins are built from. Your body makes its own and takes in more from meat, fish and the jelly a cooled stock sets into. In your brain it sits at the gate where memory is laid down, and that gate will not open until glycine is in its seat.

You share this substance with three kin, and together the four change one state into the next. That change has long been told in colours. It starts black and passes through white and yellow to the red of gold. So whatever feels dark in you now is where that change begins.

relations.unity_line: Read with UL 63, this is the two banks of one river, the crossing not yet made and the crossing already behind you.

pair.teaching: Imagination runs out the moment the thing it pictured is finished. Adornments of Time is where it goes next: the curiosity that asks how the finished thing works and finds its flaw. Open it when what you made has to be looked after. A thing that is built still has to be kept.

inverse.teaching: This energy stands in the river and looks at the far bank. Turned end for end it stands on that bank and looks back. Adornments of Time is that view.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy moves by leaps, and a leap needs somewhere steady to land. Adornments of Time holds what it lacks: reasoning that tests each step before it takes the next. One is the way of the artist and the other the way of the scientist. Open it when the picture is clear and nobody can follow how you got there.

codon_ring.name: Codon Ring of Alchemy
codon_ring.teaching: This energy turns a loose state into something new, and it does not do it alone. It belongs to a family of four called the Ring of Alchemy. UL 6 breaks down the walls between people, UL 40 builds that openness into communities, and UL 47 lets old ways change. This one opens a fresh set of possibilities.

tarot.teaching: Four of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, arrive through the ring and the two trigrams.

sky.teaching: the quick messenger moving between two shores with the word not yet delivered, the right sky for a crossing held open.

immortals.teaching: Fire above carries Lu Dong Bin, the scholar tested ten times before he was let through. He wears a sword and drives out whatever haunts a place. Water below carries Li Tie Guai, the healer who came back through his own death with his medicine in a gourd. Both are in you: clear sight that has to pass its tests, and a risk you get through only by going in.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the room that gives a work four walls and a roof. Even a step from the bank an unfinished thing needs one, or it comes apart.
